tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 4 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/ srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du ba theg pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/ —1—

'a 'dra dpe skrun mnyam las go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brdzid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug nye gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying g.yin pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug nye gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'jug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi nga/nga / to wid lta bu yo rob dang / a— rdo digs su grags wo gyi slob grwa ho mo

sngon 'gro'i zhu tshigarnams su bod yig gi dpe ma sgo r+ṣa po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ zugad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/ —2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru / gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mche/na mkhye/na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu ri las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal nga5/da/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1—

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa —chen pos 'bras sbrungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon kha bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan khu/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈dzhai 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di( 3dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las sa/zhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/sgro6—

gnyos ༵ ༵ ba /rti rag ༵ chung sog sgo rngogs ga 'es che sgyu ni ma /rnyed pa / pa po /rngo sgi gyis ༵ ༵ ༵/ shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba shar rdo ༵ kau rno/rde rdo ༵ rnyi 'i sna~X/ byoba~Xrdo/ rnyi/gas sdu tshi rmi snro~X dī rjo sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu ༵sa ༵༵ ༵༵ dzñā gcod sna rjo zhe~X /ma~X sna ga~X ༵'i/ ltas dang bcas sku tsongs te dang / da/sna ༵ ga~Xshā nā rdo~X pyi ༵ rderde~X rnyi dā bla sdu kun sna~X ༵rderde sbyi sna skri / ༷ /nyeg kun da : jo nang ka she ༷ / gzhargyus gi ya skyu nge gas ༷hūṃ rni / dh+ri ༷ mū/ rterderde/rderderde— 1—

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhus lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gshugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mi tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhud bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug kū hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bar/sa gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjed che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bzhes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ga rta nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen da ༈nga lo zhe ga cig ༵ snro ༵ dzi ༵༵ pa'i shi/nga yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dzhai rjo gas kau/kau lha sna lag ༵nga dang lgi~X sngu dzharde~X ga sdu ༵ gas ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/dhi ra~X rnyi/ma sngu rdo dhi ༵ ༵sna ༵༵ zangs rdzob / sa gser zanga~X ༵༵ ༵༵ /pa da pa la darnga ri / bde gshe/gas mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/༵lha/ spyu/ rjo rjo sna ༵ mang ༵ dang ga/bka ༵ ༵ ༵ da sos skong / ༵ sgro sna ba/༵ shing rdoX /du skabs yar klung bro / spre ka sum nas mo gad rjo bye pem dī dhi rjo zhig grel wo chen / ༵ tshod ga nyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras spungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635)la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/— 10—

zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs stu / ba/ dra/ rnga/ rnga/sdo / ba/rba// 1dus kyi 'khor lo'i brgyud 'debs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 3dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa dpag bsam ljon shing la 'jug pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 6dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho'i dgongs don zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 100dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstod pa'am mngon rtogs nye bar bsdus pa bzhu / gas/ 196bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi bskang gso bde stong rol pa zhes bya ba bzhu / gas/ 206dus 'khor tshogs mchod bdud rtsi 'khyil ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 217dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dgyes glu bde chen rdo rje'i gsang tshig zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 224

‘pa/ba/ stu sku zu/ rnga spro sdo / kha/spro5/ 228dpal dus kyi wor lo dbang chog las rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho la 'ju ga pa bzhugs/ 239dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gong ma'i cho ga bzhugs/ 255dpal dus kyi 'khor lo snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs ye shes 'od 'phro zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 285dpal sdom pa chen po'i sgrub dkyil gyi rim pa'i khyad par gsa'5 byed bzhu / ga bro// 328dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sdom pa chen po'i dkyil 'bor la brke(da pa bsdo/gas/ 387dus 'khod ra sdom chen gyi thig tshon gsal byed bzhugs/ 395dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs dang 'grel pa'i phyag rgya'i rnam grangs rab gsal snang ba bzhu / gas/ 400

gsol 'debs zhes bya ba bsdogs/na mo gu ru budha bo dhi satwa smyoXn mo na maX drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu la gsol ba 'debs/ /brgyud pa'i byin rlabs 'jug par gsol ba 'debs/ /byin rlabs snying la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs/snying gi mun pa sel bar byin gyis rlobs/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ yab sras tshos byin gyis rlobs/ gzhi bde gshegs snying po la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gsol ba 'debs/ /'bras bu bral 'bras chos sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs/ /longs sku dus kyi 'khor lo la gsol ba 'debs/ /sprul sku shākya thub pa la gsol ba 'debs//chos rgyal sum cu rtsa lnga la gsol ba 'debs//grub chen dus zhabs pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /grub chen dus zhabs gnyis pa la gsol ba 'debs//rgyal sras nā len+t+ra pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /paṇa chen zla ba mgon po la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgra bsgyur sgro ston lo smo la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma lha rje sgom pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma sgro ston gnam brtsegs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma grub chen yu mo la gsol ba 'debs/ /sras mchog dharme shwa ra la gsol ba —1—

'debs/ /mkhas pa nam mkha' 'od zer la gsol ba 'debs/ /ma cig sprul sku jo 'bum la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma grub thob se chen la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rje 'jam dbyangs gsar ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtshungs med kun spangs chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /byang sems rgyal ba ye shes la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rgyal phyogs las rnam rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtshungs med nya dbon kun dga' la gsol ba 'debs/ /grub chen kun dga' blo gros la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po la gsol ba 'debs/ /'dren mchog nam mkha'i mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs/ /paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang la gsol ba 'debs/ /lo chen rat+na bha dra la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo la gsol ba 'debs//dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog la gsol ba 'debs//blo gsal rgya mtsho'i bde dgyes la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs sras mkhas grub rnams tsho la gsol ba 'debs//'jam dbyangs kun dga' snying po la gsol ba 'debs//bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang la gsol ba 'debs/ khyab bdag sgrol ba'i mgon po la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /yab sras tshos byin gyis rlobs/ /ma ṅga laX/—2—

zhes bya ba bzhu / gas/oṃ āXhuX hoXhaX k+ṣaX mchog gi dang po'i mgon po rtag pa'i dpal/ /sems nyid rin chen rdo rje rnam bzhi yi/ /lam gyis rab sbyangs sku bzhi mngon gyur pa/ /chos kun mnyam nyid ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /sku bzhi dbyer med yan lag bdun ldan sku/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug mi bdag sprul pa'i sku/ /chos rgyal rigs ldan 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'jig rten mgon pos rjes bzung dus zhabs pa/ /de yi zhabs brten dus zhabs gnyis pa dang / /rgyal sras chen po nā len+d+ra pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga phul byin zla mgon zhabs/ /'jig rten mig 'byed 'bro ston shes rab grags/ /rdo rje theg pa'i srog shing dkon mchog srungs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /mkhas grub sngags 'chang sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ /grub pa'i khyu mchog mi bskyod rdo rje'i zhabs/ /chos kyi dbang phyug ma lus chos kyi bdag /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /ngo mtshar bgrangs bcas ma cig sprul sku dang / /nam mkha' 'od zer mtshan 'a myong mkhas pa'i phul/ /sngon gnas rjes dran grub thob se mo che/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i shes rab —3—

'od zer dang / /rab gsal rgyal po'i rnam 'phrul dge steng pa/ /srog 'dzin rgya mtsho'i mthar son kun spangs rje/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon mkhyen thogs med rgyal ba ye shes dang / /mkhas btsun grub brnyes yon tan rgya mtsho dang / /rigs ldan sprul sku kun mkhyen jo nang pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /legs bshad rin chen 'byung gnas nya dbon dang / /grub chen 'gran zla med pa'i kun blo ba/ /nges don bstan pa'i srog shing dkon mchog bzang / /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /mdo sngags kun chub nam mkha' chos skyong dang / /mkhas dbang paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang po/ /lo chen mtshan 'chang rat+na bha dra la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /thogs med brtul zhugs grub pa kun dga'i mtshan/ /gnyug ma mngon gyur lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / /skyabs gnas kun 'dus kun dga' snying po'i zhabs/ /gsol 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /gsol ba 'debs so kun mkhyen jo nang ba/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'gro drug byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon 'gro dben pa gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs shing / /dngos gzhi yan lag drug gi sbyor ba yis/ /mthar thug sku bzhi rdo rje rnam pa bzhi/ /myur du mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes spyor drug jo nang lugs kyi brgyud 'debs tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /sngon sbyangs mkhyen pa'i rin chen rgya mtsho dang / /thar pa'i lam ston blo gros rnam par rgyal/ /grub pa'i mchog gyur ngag dbang 'phrin las zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin rlobs/ /mtha' 'khob mun sel ngag —4—

dbang rnam rgyal dang / /dam chos dga' ston spel mdzad dar rgyas mtshan/ /rgyal ba kun dngos 'phrin las rnam rgyal zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin rang bzhin lhun gyis grub//zab lam mthar phyin 'jigs med rnam rgyal dang / /dus 'khor brgyud 'debs kyi kha skong 'di'ang sprul sku 'jigs med rnam rgyal gyis ri khrod du thun mtshams su bris pa'o/ /rigs kun khyab bdag chos 'phel rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rim gnyis mthar son chos kyi 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul zad kun dga' dpal ldan rje/ /dbang lung gdams ngag mdzod 'dzin chos 'byor la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas lugs gshegs snying mngon gyur mkhas grub dbang / /yi dam zhal gzigs bstan pa gsal byed zhabs/ /rgyud sde rab 'byams spro bsdu rdo rje bzang / /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /spyod 'chang rnam 'phrul dkon mchog dar rgyas rje/ /gzhan stong 'dzam gling khyab mdzad blo gros grags/ /drin can mngon gyur rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /dus 'khor brgyud 'debs kha skong 'dzam thang gtsang chen gzim khang bde chen bshad sgrub dpal gyi pho brang gi gdan rabs rim byon ltar blo bzang chos 'phel bas bris pa'o/ /

dpag bsam ljon shing la 'jug pa zhes bya ba bzhu / gas/oṃ swā sti/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs dpag bsam ljon shing la 'jug pa/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig 'dod pa'i 'ching las grol yang rtag tu 'dod chags chen pos gang / /dngos dang dngos med rnam pa bral yang rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan/ / tshig tu brjod pa kun las grol yang 'gro kun skad kyis chos rab ston/ /gcig dang du ma'i gzugs dang bral yang sna tshogs gzugs mang ston la 'dud/ /gang zhig brten na srid dang grol ba yi/ /dpal kun rab ster rim gnyis sgrub pa'i thabs/ /kun mkhyen ches mdzad dpag bsam ljon shing las/ /ngag 'don 'bras bu ci nus bsdus te bshad/ /'di la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba gsum las/ dang po la/ rgyud sbyang ba thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang / nges par bya ba thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag nyid sgrub thabs nyams len gyi skabs su nges par dgos pa la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas gsum mo/ /de yang / bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang baX par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam

pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /skye( swa bhā wa〈rang bzhin 〉 shuṅgāX〈dag pa rnams 〉 sarba dharmāX 〈chos rnams thams cad 〉swa bhā ba stso3haX/〈rang bzhi dag pa'i bdag go/〉 stong pa'i ngang las rang gi spyi bor paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūX las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūX la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang pad+ma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āXthugs kar spyoX/ lte bar hoX thugs ka'i hūX las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaXhuX baX hoXganyis su med par bstim/bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor —7—

ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka tī no pa la ḍi rnyo me bha wa/ su to stso me bha wa/ a nu ra lto me bha wa/ su po khyo me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi sme pra ca sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+ta shrī ya ku ru skyo/ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa a hū phaṭa/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon po skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /'khor ba thogs ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum zla ba zhu ba ltar gyur pa bdag gi spyi gtsug nas thim pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje dang / rang gi lus ngag yid gsum ye shes rdo rje rnams dbyer med du gyur/gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro rnam pa bcu ni/ rdo rje'i zhal dag rigs drug dgod pa dang / /rdo rje bzhi dang yan lag drug rnams 'god/ /bdud tshogs gzhom zhing bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sgom/ /mkha' la rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams rtogs bya ste/ /bla med mchod pa rnam pa bdun gyis mchod/ / lam bsten stong pa nyid la dmigs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ o u hu ho : ha k+ṣathugs ye ༵ ༵ nyo a dhi ༵ je/ ༵ /༵ /dag nyo ༵ ༵ / ༵ dhi dhi ༵ s+ho/bhe/rlo —8—

lus ngag sems ye shes rdo rje 〉 badz+ra a mṛ ta swa bhā waX/〈rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rang bzhi du mdzod mdzod 〉 ku ru ku ru skan+ta bhā tu ā ya ta naX niX〈phung po khams skye mched rnams 〉sā bhā waX swāhā/〈rang bzhin med pa'i gzhi tshugs shig〉 lan gsum brjod/ de nas gtsug tor gyi steng du waX yig yongs su gyur pa las/rdo rje zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha bcu drug yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de zhu ba lus la zhugs pas/ gtsug tor nas rkang sen gyi mthar thug pa'i ma dag pa'i lus sprul gyi shun pa ltar lan gsum du dor te/ lus dang ngag dang sems dang ye shes rnam par dag pa rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zla ba dri ma med pa ltar gyur/gnyis pa rigs drug dgod pa ni/ tseX( 〈rang bzhin dag pa rnams chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin dag pa'i bdag go/〉spyo bhā wa shu khyu duX sarba dharmāX su bhā wa 8skyosa3haX/ dpral bar oX dkar po las snang ba mtha' yas dkar po/ mgrin par āXdamar po las rin chen 'byung ldan dmar po/ snying gar hūX nag po las don yod grub pa nag po/ lte bar hoXser po las rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ gtsug tor du haX ljang khu las mi bskyod pa ljang khu/ gsang bar k+ṣaXsngon po las rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po rnams zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ so sor dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnam pa rnams 'khod par gyur/gsum pa rdo rje bzhi dag pa ni/ lag pa phan tshun mnye zhing bkru ba'i phyag rgya byas nas/ skye( hraXsarba a sta rā dza 〈thams cad mtshon cha'i rgyal po 〉mā ra kle sha an+ta ka ra/〈bdud dang nyon mongs pa mthar byed pa 〉 badz+ra tik+ṣa 〈rdo rje rnon po 〉duXkha〈sdug ba blal 〉ts+tsha da 〈gcod pa 〉mā ma ka ra tu bi phre| dha ya 〈bdag gi lag pa rnam par sbyongs/〉swāhā/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u —9—

phyag ngar bzhi nag po/ bzhi dmar po/ bzhi dkar po/ sor gdub rnams kyis spras pa'i mthe bong ser po/mdzub mo dkar po/gung mo dmar po/srin lag nag po/mthe'u chung ljang khu/phyag gi mthil nas brtsams te/tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po'o/ /sku la rdo rje'am rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga'am drug dang ldan pa/ dbu la rdo rje'i dar dpyangs kyi steng du rdo rje'i zla ba phyed pa dang / rked par stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ phrag par bdud rigs brgya'i mgo bo'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ spyi bor thod pa lnga'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /oṃ haX haX bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa kaṇi yor badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa1 le huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/〈g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag la rdo rje'i rna rgyan du mdzod mdzod/〉tso( aX aXka lcaX ka rte badz+ra me kha lwa badz+ra kaṇ+ḍi ke huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/〈rked pa dang mgrin pa la rdo rje'i 'og pag dang rdo rje'i mgul rgyan du mdzod mdzod/〉 oX a āX bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa ka ra yor badz+ra ru tsa ko huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/〈g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i lag pa dag la rdo'i lag gdub tu mdzod mdzod/〉 tsho( ha hā/ bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa pā da yor badz+ra nā pu re huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/ 〈g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i rkang pa dag la rdo rje'i rkang gdub tu mdzod mdzod/〉 oṃ haX baX/ pañtsa ā kā ra mahā hūṃ n+ya swa bhā wa 〈stong pa r+ṣa po rnam pa lnga'i rang bzhi 〉badz+ra shi ro ma ṇi shi ra si 'a rje spyi bo la nor bu spyi bo dang 〉sarba aX ge bhasmi huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/〈yan lag thams cad la thal ba mdzod mdzod/〉 ma rna aX/ gikau/ nā rī shwa ra 〈phyed pa ma tsho dbang phyug 〉badz+ra a rna tsan+d+ra badz+ra pas sdi zhe huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ 〈rdo rje phyed pa'i zla ba rdo rje'i dar dpyangs kyi steng du mdzod mdzod/ yang na rus pa'i rgyan drug go/〉 tsho( a āX.aX/ sarba su ra e ka tri 〈dbyangs thams cad gcig pa 〉swa ra su bhā wa badz+ra ya rno pa bī ta skarnye huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/〈dbyangs gsum gyi rang bzhin rdo rje'i mchod phyir thogs phrag par mdzod mdzod/ phyag rgya drug dgod —17—

pa'o//〉 glu( k+ṣa dur nān+ta a bhi mā na k+ṣa ya ka ra 〈gdul dka' ba mngon pa'i nga rgyal zad par byas pa 〉byu gha tsarma ka ṭo hu hu phaṭa phaṭa/〈stag gi pags pa rked par mdzod mdzod/〉 oṃ ha k+ṣatri sha ta 〈sum cu 〉su ra 〈dbyangs 〉sa sta ti 〈bdun cu 〉hra swa 〈thung ngu 〉di rgyu 〈ring po 〉༵kau ༵ glu rnyi〈skarnye hu / ra~X sna dhi // shā rī ༵ gas ༵gu rdo rde ༵snra ༵ rdo~X kau si sdu / dī dhi ༵ dī dhi/ ༵/ erang ༷ṭā rdo bor nyo s+ho pā/ sdu ༵dzā ༵ rnyi phaṭa dī / /༷ thod ༵ phreng ba mdzod mdzod/〉g.yas kyi phyag bcu gnyis rnams na/khro bo'i rdo rje/ral gri /rtse gsum/ gri gug mda'/ lcags kyu/ ḍā ma mā tho ba/ 'khordo ra lo/ mdung / dbyug pa/ dgra stu rnams so/ /g.yon gyi phyag bcu gnyis rnams na/ rdo rje'i dril bu/rmyo/sbyi ngas dī~X mgo/ po lha/sna gas pa ba pho ni pa/ rnam/ so//pa/༵ga/ sngu/ ༵ gnyis/ ༵gas kar bsnol zhing / lhag pa'i phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pa nag po dang / g.yon pa ser pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas te glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa khrag dang ba/rdo ༵ mgo ༵ dhi/ khrag gis ga~X ba'i lhi dzo~X sna~X /༵ /te/ ṭā rnyi /〈g.yas kyi phyag mawo bcu gnyis kyi sa bon 〉kro dha badz+ra hu phaṭa/〈khro bo'i rdo rjer ma sgo/〉 o ldi badz+ra kha ḍa ga hu phaṭa/ 〈rdo rje'i ral grir ma sgo/〉 oṃ spri badz+ra tri shā la hu phaṭa/〈rdo rje'i rtse gsum du ma sgo/〉 oṃ kyā badz+ra karnya ri hu phaṭa/〈rdo rje'i gri gug tu ma sgo/〉oṃ ldi—18—

badz+ra pā ṇa huX phaṭa/〈rdo rje'i mda' ru mdzod/〉 glu rna kyāX badz+ra aX ku sha huX phaṭa/〈rdo rje'i lcags kyur mdzod/〉 8( kyāX badz+ra ḍa ma ru ka huX phaṭa/〈rdo rje'i cang te'ur mdzod/〉 rnye( kyāXbadz+ra mud ka ra huX phaṭa/〈rdo rje'i tho bar ma sgo/〉 oṃ spra biX rdzu tsakra huX phaṭa/ 〈rdo rje'i phrog ra lor mdzod/〉oṃ spriX badz+ra kun ta huX phaṭa/〈rdo rje'i mdung du ma sgo/〉 oṃ kyāX badz+ra da ṇa ḍa huX phaṭa/〈rdo rje'i stug par mdzod/〉 oṃ kyāX badz+ra par shu huX phaṭa/〈rdo rje'i dgra stur mdzod/〉oX khyuX 〈sa bon 〉badz+ra lha rnye hoXphre phaṭa/〈rdo rje'i dril bur mdzod/〉 oṃ hwaX badz+ra khe ṭa ka hoXphre phaṭa/〈rdo rje'i phub tu mdzod/〉 oṃ hāX badz+ra kha ṭaX ga hoXphre phaṭa/ 〈rdo rje'i kha ṭāX gar mdzod/〉 oX hāX badz+ra ka pā la hoXphre phaṭa/〈rdo rje'i sgod par mdzod/〉oṃ hāX badz+ra tsā pa hoXphre phaṭa/〈rdo rje'i gzhu ru mdzod/〉 oṃ hāX badz+ra pā sha hoXphre phaṭa/〈rdo rje'i zhags par mdzod/〉oṃ hāX badz+ra rat+na hoXphre phaṭa/〈rdo rje rin po cher mdzod/〉oṃ hāX badz+ra pad+ma hoXphre phaṭa/〈rdo rje'i pad+ma ra mdzod/〉 oṃ hāX badz+ra shaX kha hoXphre phaṭa/〈rdo rje'i dung du mdzod/〉 oṃ hāX badz+ra ā dar sha hoXphre phaṭa/〈rdo rje'i me long du mdzod/〉oṃ hāX badz+ra sh+lau kha le hoXphre phaṭa/〈rdo rje lcags sgrog tu mdzod/〉 oṃ hāX tsa tur be da mu kha swa bhā wa brarmi 3ni raX ho / ༷༷phre phaṭa/〈rigs bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi gdong can tshangs pa'i mgo bor ma sgo/〉 oṃ k+ṣa khyu spu khyo skyusmyu khri klu sko sko k+ṣaX k+ṣaX ha hā hi hi gri shrī hu hū lha lha haX haX sarba bighā bi dwa 'i ri ta ga dza tsar ma pa ḍa ar tra rak+ta shra wa ta khuX/ phre/ 〈bgegs thams cad rnam par bcom pa'i glang po che bsad pa'i ko ba rlon pa khrag 'dzag par mdzod/〉klu'i dbang po rgyal ba ral pa'i cod pan la bcings shing / rnam par rgyal ba dar dpyangs la bcings pas gnas pa/ stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma rna rgyan la —19—

gnas pa/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong phyag gdub la gnas pa/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan 'og pag dang mgul rgyan la gnas pa/ 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po zha kha/sa gdub la gnas pa'o/ /tseX( huX badz+ra dza ya nā ga in+d+ra badz+ra dza ṭā mu ku ṭa ban khyu tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/〈rdo rje rgyal ba klu'i dbang po rdo rje ral pa'i cod can la bcings pa gnas par gyis gnas par gyis/〉 oṃ khriX badz+ra bi dza ya nā ga in+d+ra badz+ra pa sna ban khyu tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha huX hruX phaṭa phaṭa/ 〈rdo rje rnam rgyal ba klu'i dbang po rdo rje dar dpyangs la 'chings pa gnas par gyis gnas par gyis/〉oṃ yiX h+phuX badz+ra ka ra ko ṭa ka badz+ra pad+mo bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa kun ḍa la yoXtiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/〈rdo rje stoXbaXs kyi rgyu dang rdo rje pad+ma dag g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna rgyan dag la gnas par gyis gnas par gyis/〉oX ri grwa badz+ra bā su ki shaX kha pā lo bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa ru tsa ka yoXtiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/〈rdo rje nor rgyas dang dung skyong dag g.yon dang g.yas gyi lag gdub dag la gnas par gyis gnas par gyis/〉 oṃ hwaX hāX badz+ra a nan ta ku li ko me kha lwa kaṇa ji ka yoXtiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/〈rdo rje mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dag ske rags dang mgul rgyan dag la gnas par gyis gnas par gyis/〉 oX khyuX kluX badz+ra tak+ṣa ka mahā pad+mo bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa pā da nā pu ra yoXtiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/〈rdo rje 'jog po dang pad+ma wo po dag g.yon dang g.yas kyi rkang gdub dag la gnas par gyis gnas par gyis/〉de ltar bdag nyid khro bo'i dbang po dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs shing / rab tu 'jigs pa'i skur gyur/ oX huX 〈khro bo'i sa bon 〉kro bhā ispro3haX 〈khro bo'i dbad po nga /〉kro bhā nāX udzñā dā ya ka 〈khro bo rnams la bka' bsgo pa po nga yin tsho no//〉swāhā/ de nas khang pa brtsegs pa'i steng dang 'og dang khang brtsegs bar ma'i rwa ba la nye bar phyogs dang phyogs bral gyi khro bo bcu'i gnas/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams kyi nang du raXyig yongs su gyur pa las/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor —20—

rnams su gyur/ bdag nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/snro brtsegs pa'i rang bzhin yi ge'i gong bu rnams su gyur/ha hā las byung ba'i zla rdo rje ljang khu dang sngon po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dang gnod mdzes rgyal po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu dang sngon po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/gri gug dgra stu/g.yon pa gsum gyis/rdo rje'i dril bu/ thod pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa dag zhal gyi gtso bo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag nas spros te/ steng du khang pa brtsegs pa'i nang gi rtsibs kyi nang dang / 'og dang rdo rje sa gzhi la rtsibs kyi nang du (〈dzaX〉 waṃnyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la )gnas pa'o//yi yī las byung ba'i ral gri nag po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ bgegs mthar byed dang dbyug sngon can zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog nag po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis ral gri/ gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gsum gyis phub/ thod pa/ kha ṭāX ga dkar po 'dzin pa dag g.yon dang g.yas kyi sna bug nas spros te/shar dang me'i rtsibs su gnas pa dang / las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ shes rab mthar byed dang ṭak+ki zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis me'i mda'/ rdo rje'i lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍā ma sa g.yon pa gsum gyis gzhu/ zhags pa/rin po che rtse mo dgu pa 'od 'phro ba 'dzin pa dag g.yon dang g.yas kyi mig —21—

dag nas spros te/ lho dang bden bral gyi rtsibs su gnas pa dang / wu lha las 'byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ pad+ma mthar byed dang mi g.yo ba zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas zhal nag cing g.yon zhal dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis tho ba/ mdung /rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gsum gyis 'dab ma brgyad pa'i pad+ma dkar po/ me long /bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa dag lte dang chu lam nas spros te/ byang dang dbang ldan gyi rtsibs su gnas pa dang / slo ā+o ཾ las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po dag yongs su gyur pa las/gshin rje mthar byed dang stobs po che zhal gsum phyag drug pa/rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ser po/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis 'khor lo/ dbyug pa/ khro bo'i rdo rje/ g.yon pa gsum gyis dung / rdo rje'i lcags sgrog sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa dag bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas spros te/ nub dang rlung gi rtsibs su gnas pa ste/thams cad kyang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la g.yas brkyang gis gnas shing / phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ khro bo'i dbang po lta bu ste/ khang brtsegs kyi nang bsrung zhing skyong bar mdzad pa'o/ /slar yang bdag nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ dzña brtsegs pa'i rang bzhin yi ge'i gong bu rnams su gyur/ nga dwa las ā+oṃ byung ba'i zad par stong pa ljang khu dang sngon po gnyis zhal gyi gtso / bo'i du nam g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag nas spros te/ khang pa brtsegs pa'i phyi rol kyi steng mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang / gnod mdzes kyi 'og tu ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o/ /nyi gī las byung ba'i —22—

zad par rlung nag po gnyis g.yon dang g.yas kyi sna bug dag nas spros te/shar dang mer gnas pa dang / rjo sgrilas byung ba'i zad par me dmar po gnyis g.yon dang g.yas kyi mig dag nas spros te/ lho dang bden bral du gnas pa dang / mu mū las byung ba'i zad par chu dkar po gnyis lce dang chu lam nas spros te/ byang dang dbang ldan du gnas pa dang / rli hṝ las byung ba'i zad par sa ser po gnyis bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas spros te/ nub dang rlung du gnas pa ste/thams cad kyang rang rang gi 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor la mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas gnas pa/ khang pa brtsegs pa'i phyi rol bsrung zhing skyong ba ste/ zad par dang khro bo nam mkha' dang ye shes yang dag par spyor bas sems kyi khams bsrung bar mdzad pa'o/ /slar yang bdag nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sgro brtsegs pa'i rang bzhin yi ge'i gong bu rnams su gyur/ gha ghā las byung k+ṇiba'i tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug gnyis zhal gyi gtso bo'i g.yon dang g.yas /kyi rna ba dag nas spros te/ rwa ba gsum pa'i nang gi tshad kyi steng dang 'og tu gnas par gyur/ dzhai dhī las byung ba'i bden bral dang rlung lha gnyis g.yon dang g.yas kyi sna bug nas spros te/ shar dang mer gnas pa dang / hai snye las byung ba'i gshin rje dang me lha gnyis g.yon dang g.yas kyi mig dag darānas spros te/ lho dang bden bral du gnas pa dang / bhu bhā las byung ba'i rgya mtsho dang bde byed gnyis lce dang chu lam nas spros te/ bya pa dang dbang ldan du gnas pa dang / zlo zlo las byung ba'i dbang po dang gnod sbyin gnyis bshang —23—

lam dang gtsug tor nas spros te/ nub dang rlung du gnas pa ste/ de dag kyang /ngang pa la gnas tshangs pa ljang khu rig byed zhal/ /phyag bzhi khab dang bgrang 'phreng pad+ma spyi blugs 'dzin/ /mkha' lding la gnas khyab 'jug sngon po rgya mtsho'i phyag/'khor lo dbyug tho pad+ma skye lnga'i dung gi mtshan//yi dwags la gnas bden bral mig sman lta bu'i mdog /phyag bzhi ral gri gri gug phub dang thod pas brgyan/ / ri dwags la gnas rlung lha nag po phyag bzhi yis/ /dpag bsam yongs 'du'i me tog nor bu ut+pal 'dzin/ /ma he la gnas gshin rje shin tu dmar ba'i mdang / /phyag bzhi dbyug pa ral gri lcags sgrog zhags pas brgyan/lug la nyer gnas me lha dmar po rig byed phyag /shasti dbyug pa chu skyes spyi blugs mtshan mas spras/ /chu srin la gnas rgya mtsho dkar po phyag bzhi pa//zhags pa rin chen sbrul zhags zla ba chu shel 'dzin/ /khyu mchog la gnas bde byed dkar po dus kyi phyag /rtse gsum mda' dang sprul ldan kha ṭāX gzhu yis mtshan/ /glang chen la gnas dbang po gser mdog rig byed phyag /rdo rje me mda' rdo rje dril bu gzhu yis mtshan/ /'khor los drangs pa'i khang brtsegs la gnas gnod spyin ser//phyag bzhi nor bu be con ne'u le pad+ma 'o//de ltar phyogs skyong bcu ni rwa ba gsum pa'i nang bsrung zhing skyong bar mdzad pa'o/ /slar yang bdag nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rna brtsegs pa'i rang bzhin yi ge'i gong bu rnams su gyur/ ga gwa las byung sdoba'i sgra gcan dang dus me ljang khu dang sngon po gnyis zhal gyi gtso bo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag nas spros te/ rwa ba gsum pa'i phyi rol kyi steng du —24—

nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang / 'og tu ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o/ /dzi dzī las byung ba'i nyi ma dang zla ba nag po gnyis g.yon dang g.yas kyi sna bug dag nas spros te/ shar dang mer gnas pa dang / rje n-i las byung ba'i gza' lhag dang bkra shis dmar po gnyis g.yon dang g.yas kyi mig dag nas spros te/ lho dang bden bral du gnas pa dang / bu byu las byung ba'i pa sangs dang phur bu dkar po gnyis lce dang chu lam nas spros te/ byang dang dbang ldan du gnas pa dang / blo rlo las byung ba'i mjug ring dang spen pa ser po gnyis bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas spros te/ nub dang rlung du gnas pa ste/ de dag kyang / sgra gcan dus me dag ni lag gnyis nyi zla 'dzin/ /rta bdun nyi dkyil bsil zer zla ba phyed pa ste/ /gza' lhag mda' gzhu mig dmar chu gri mi mgo bsnams/ /dkar po bla ma bgrang 'phreng spyi blugs mjug ring ni/ /ral gri sbrul zhags spen pa dbyug to khu tshur brten/ /thams cad kyang rang rang gi 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ rwa ba gsum pa'i phyi rol bsrung zhing skyong ba ste/gza' dang phyogs skyong me dang rlung yang dag par sbyor bas ngag gi khams bsrung bar mdzad pa'o/ /slar yang bdag nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng du/ : brtsegs pa'i rang bzhin yi ge'i gong bu rnams su gyur/ kha ji las byung tāba'i rgyal ba dang rnam par rgyal ba ljang khu dang sngon po gnyis/ zhal gyi gtso bo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag nas spros te/ rwa ba lnga pa'i nang gi steng du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang / 'og tu ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'o/ /tshi —25—

rī las byung ba'i stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma nag po gnyis g.yon dang g.yas kyi sna ༵pa dang /sna zlo dam/ra ༵ gnyi sa je yond dā g.ya/sa ༵ dzñā ga dag lhi ༵ no za pas te/ lho tsho dang bden bral du gnas pa dang /phu phu las byung ba'i mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar po gnyis lce dang chu lam nas spros te/ byang dang dbang ldan du gnas ༵ hā jeng/ snyon to/ ḍā spros te nub/ rdo / ༵rngo ngh+ru shā/ sa ༵ rnyi /rdo mas ca darang rang gi 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje'i gdan gyis gnas shing / rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhal gcig pa spyan gsu/ma pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis kyis pad+ma dang rin po che 'dzin pa/ rwa ba lnga pa'i nang bsrung zhing skyong bar mdzad pa'o/ /slar yang bdag nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/sni ༵gh+ri sgri ༵ ༵sa dpa hūṃ~X ༵༵ lja pa khud 1 sna rno ༵ dhi snror/ /zhal sbyi gtso bo~X g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag nas spros te/rwa ba lnga pa'i phyi rol kyi steng du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khore dang / 'og tu ye shes kyi dkyil 'khore la gnas pa'o/ /tsi gri las byung ba'i mi 'am ci khyi'i gdong pa can dang / skyes bu 'am ci bya rog gi gdong pa can nag po gnyis/ g.yon dang g.yas kyi sna bug dag nas spros te/rdo/ /dang byi rti ༵ sna/ bye ga/ dong hūm̐ ༵sna dam dro ༵ sgi sna~X /di ༵ sna /ḍi ga~Xshā —26—

kyi mig dag nas spros te/ lho dang bden bral du gnas pa dang / pu pū las byung ba'i srin po stag gi gdong pa can dang / yi dwags 'ug pa'i gdong pa can dkar po gnyis lce dang chu lam nas spros te/ byang dang dbang ldan du gnas pa dang /kli hūṃ las byung ba'i brjed byed lce spyang gi gdong pa can dang / nam mkha' lding ser po gnyis bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas spros te/ nub dang rlung du gnas pa ste/ thams cad rang rang gi 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor la zlum po'i stabs kyi gnas shing / gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mgo bo'i 'phreng ba mgul du 'byu’nga ba/ zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag gnyis kyis g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ rwa ba lnga pa'i phyi rol bsrung zhing skyong ba ste/klu dang 'byung po chu dang sa yang dag par sbyor bas lus kyi khams bsrung bar mdzad pa'o/ /nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ oṃ 〈de bzhin gshogs pa thams cad kyi bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i rang bzhi gyi bdag ṣ+ka nga'o//〉sarba ta thā ga tā rak+ta tsakra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ khro bo rnams la bka' bsgo ba ni/ oX haX 〈rdo rje'i khro bo rgyal po gtsug tor r+ṣa po steng gi phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/〉badz+ra kro dha rā dza mahā snyo ṣa ur dha di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ yaX 〈rdo rje'i khro bo rgyal po shin tu stobs thams cad bgegs mthar byed pa shar phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/〉 badz+ra kre/ dha rā dza a ti bā la sarba bighā an+ta ka phu rba di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ raX 'a rje'i khro bo rgyal po rmugs byed gdug pa'i shes rab mthar byed pa lho'i phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/〉 badz+ra kre/ dha rā dza nga ka du ni pradzñā an+ta ka da spyi ṇa di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/oṃ waX 'a rje'i khro bo rgyal po nga rgyal rnam par chags pa'i pad+ma mthar byed pa byang phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/〉 badz+ra kro dha rā dza mā na ka bi rā ga pad+ma an ta ka ut+ta ra di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ laX 'a —27—

rje'i khro bo rgyal po rengs byed gshin rje mthar byed pa nub phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/〉 badz+ra kro dha rā dza nga ka ya ma an+ta ka pa nyi ma di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/oṃ lāX〈rdo rje'i khro bo rgyal po stobs po wo po rma gi phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/〉badz+ra kro dha rā dza mahā ba la bā ya byāX di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oX wāX〈rdo rje'i khro bo rgyal po mi g.yo ba dbang ldan gyi phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/〉 badz+ra kro dha rā dza a tsa la yī sha na di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oX rāX〈rdo rje'i khro bo rgyal po 'dod pa bden bral gyi phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/〉 badz+ra kro dha rā dza ṭak+ki ni ṛ t+yāX di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oX yāX〈rdo rje'i khro bo rgyal po stug sngon can me'i phyogs bsrung bar mdzod mdzod/〉 badz+ra kro dha rā dza nī la da ṇa ḍā asne lbāX di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oX hāX〈rdo rje'i khro bo rgyal po gnod mdzes 'og gi phyogs bsrung bar mdzod ma sgo/〉 badz+ra kro dha rā dza nga a dho di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ de dag gis kyang bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams rdo rje lcags kyus btab cing rdo rje zhags pas bcings pa rnams kyi steng du/rdo rje phur bu rno zhing rab tu 'bar ba stod khro bo'i gzugs can rnams kyis btab par 'gyur/phur bu bsgril ba'i sngags ni/ tsho( āXhūX lte rteXhaX k+ṣaXhūX huX huX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra gī la 〈rdo rje'i phur bu 〉 kā ya lha ka tsit+ta dzñā na a dhi pa ti ṣaḍa mu kha/〈sku gsung thugs ye shesakyi mnga' bdag zhal drug pa 〉 ṣa te/ bhu dza/ 〈phyag drug pa 〉 ṣa te/ tsa ra ṇa/ 〈zhabs drug pa 〉sarba sna bi nā ya ka ā di du hā nāX/〈thams cad pa gegs dang log 'dren la sogs pa gdug pa rnams kyi 〉 kā ya lha ka ci / sta dzñā nā ni/〈lusang ga sems ye shes rnams la 〉 gī 'a/ ya gī la ya huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ 〈phur bus thobs phur bus thobs/〉phur bu 'debs pa'i sngags ni/tseX( sloXbadz+ra mud ga ra mā ra ā dī nāX/〈rdo rje tho bas bdud la sogs pa rnams kyi 〉 si ra si 〈mgo bo 〉nga —28—

〈mgrin pa 〉hri da ye 〈snying ga 〉nā bho 〈lte ba 〉gu hre/ a rnye badz+ra gī la kwan/ 〈gsang ba'i mthar thug pa rdo rje phur bu 〉 ā ko ṭa ya/〈rdungs 〉 ā ko ṭa ya/〈rdungs/〉 k+ṣaX kluX k+ṣi skyu skyu klu khyuX khriX tha sko hūX hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ rdo rje'i tho bas brdungs te bgegs kyi ra dwa tshogs rnams bde ba chen por ro gcig pa'i de bzhin nyid rnam par dag par gyur zhing / lhag ma rnams kyang ring du bros par gyur/ skabs 'dir long skabs yod cing spro na/ rkang pa bcu drug pa dang bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa'i bzlas pa yang byed par gsungs pa ltar yin la/ 'on kyang de dag dngos gzhi'i bzlas par byed pa gtso che bas/ phyag len la skabs 'dir mi mdzad do//'dir gtor ma 'bul na/gtor ma chu chang nang mchod kyis sbyangs la/gong du bshad pa'i sngags kyis sbyangs/spel/sbar/ bdud rtsir byas nas/rdo rje'i phyag rgyas spyan drang ba ni/ oX āXhuX hoX badz+ra bhi ra wa sgyi ka rā ya/ sa pa ri wā re khyuX〈'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 〉 rdo rje'i phyag rgyas 'bul ba ni/ i daX/〈'di 〉 ba li/ 〈gtor ma 〉 gan+dhaX/〈dri 〉put+paX /〈me tog 〉 dh+wa paX/〈bdug spos 〉dī paX/〈sgron me 〉 ak+ṣa taX/〈ma nyams pa 〉 da dā ma he/〈bdag 'bul gyis to te tsa ā ga tu/〈de rnams kyang byon nas 〉sa pa ri wā raX〈'khor dang bcas pa rnams 〉 shī gh+raX/〈myur du 〉 i daX/〈'di 〉 ba li/〈gtor ma 〉 gro sna stu/〈bzung bar mdzod 〉ji da stu/〈gsol bar mdzod 〉 pi bskye/〈btung bar mdzod/〉 dzaXhūX baX hoX〈de ni dgug gzhug bcing mnyes sa bon 〉 saX chen ba tāX〈yang dag par mnyes pa rnams 〉 sarba satwa nāX/〈sems can thams cad kyi 〉 shan+ti/〈zhi ba 〉 pu zhi//〈rgyas pa 〉 rak+ṣa/〈bsrung ba 〉 ā wa ra ṇa/〈bskyab pa 〉gup+taX/ 〈sba ba 〉 kurba skye 〈mdzad du gsol/〉 huX huX phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra/〈rdo rje 'chang gi 〉 udzñā pa ya ti swāhā/ 〈bka' bzhin mdzod/〉 rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ āXdzaXspe hoX 〈rdo rje'i bzhi'i sa bon 〉usti lga 〈gtsug tor 〉sum bha ni sum bha/〈gnod mdzes nges par gnod mdzes 〉 bighā —29—

an+ta ka 〈bgegs mthar byed 〉 nī la dwaṇ+ḍa/〈dbyug pa sngon po 〉 pradzñā an+ta ka 〈shes rab mthar byed 〉 ṭak+ki rā dza/〈'dod pa'i rgyal po 〉 pad+ma an+ta ka〈pad+ma mthar byed 〉 a tsa la 〈mi g.yo ba 〉ya ma an+ta ka 〈gshin rje mthar byed 〉 mahā ba le khyuX〈stobs po che rnams/〉 gri gug gi phyag rgya dang / tso( āXhuX ho / ༷༷ ā ka shā/〈nam mkha' 〉 ba yu 〈rlung 〉 te dza 〈me 〉 u da ka 〈chu 〉pri thi lī/ 〈sa〉 spyo dhi te khyuX〈grub pa rnams/〉 ral gri'i phyag rgya dang / tsho( āXhūX ho / ༷༷ prah+ma/〈chas pa 〉 biñdzu/〈khyab 'a༅ 〉ni ṛ tu/〈bden bral 〉 bā yu/〈rma 〉 ya ma 〈gshin kyi rje 〉 asni/〈me 〉 sa mu tra〈rgya mtsho 〉 sī shwa ra/〈dbang phyug 〉 in+d+ra/〈dbang po 〉 yak+ṣi khyuX 〈gnod sbyin rnams/〉 rin po che'i phyag rgya dang / glu( āXhuX hoX rā hu/〈sgra gcan 〉 kā la asni/〈dus me 〉 tsan+d+ra/〈zla ba 〉 srur+ya/〈nyi ma 〉 bu dha/〈gza' lag 〉ma ṅga la/〈bkra shis 〉shu kra/〈pa sangs 〉bṛ has pa ti/〈phur bu 〉ke du/〈mjug ring 〉sha ni khyuX〈spen pa rnams/〉pad+ma'i phyag rgya bcas la/ glu( āXsihuX lha steX dza ya/〈rgyal ba 〉 bi dza ya 〈rnam par rgyal ba 〉 pad+ma/〈pad+ma 〉 karko ṭa ka 〈stobs kyi rgyu 〉 ba su ki〈nor rgyas 〉 shaX kha pā la/〈dung skyong 〉ku li ka〈rigs ldan 〉 a nan+ta 〈mtha' yas 〉 tak+ṣa ka 〈'jog po 〉 mahā pad+ma khyoX〈pad+ma chen po rnams/〉 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ āXhūX hoX be tā ḍa/ 〈ro langs 〉 bi krita mu kha 〈rnams par 'gyur ba'i zhal can te grul bum 〉shā/ 〈khyi〉 kā ka〈bya rog 〉 snyu ka ra/〈phag 〉gro dh+ra/〈bya rgod 〉 byā gh+ra/〈stag〉sna/ pū ka〈lug pa 〉 dzam+bu ka〈lce spyang 〉 ga ru ḍa/〈mkha' lding 〉mu khe khyuX〈gdong can rnams/〉 zhes pa rnams kyi mthar/ sa pa ri wā re khyoX i daX ba li/gan+taX/ pusaX/ dha paX/ dī paX/ ak+ṣa taX/ da dwa ma he/ te dza ā ga t+ya/ sa pā ri wā raX shī gh+raX/ i daX ba rwa spo/ gro hū ཾ / khā dan+tu/ pi skyi/ dzaXhuX baX hoX saXcha te// sarba sa tā nāX/shwan ti/ pu spyi/ rak+ṣa/ ā ba ra ṇa/ gu sti/ kuṇ+ḍa3skyi huX huX phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra udzñā pa ya ti —30—

swāhā/ phyi mchod ni/ badz+ra ste ra wa sgyi ka rā ya/〈rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed pa 〉 sa pa ri wā re khyoX badz+ra gan+taX pra tisnro na maX badz+ra ngu yiX pra tisnro na maX badz+ra dhu paX pra tisnro na maX badz+ra hi paX pra ca na maX badz+ra ni be t+yaX pra ru na maX badz+ra ak+ṣa taX pra titsā na maX badz+ra lā gyaX pra tīts+tsha na maX badz+ra hā suX pra tīts+tsha na maX badz+ra wa t+yaX pra titsā na maX badz+ra dra t+yāX pra ca na maX badz+ra gī taX pra ca na maX badz+ra kā maX pra ru na maX nang mchod ni/ oṃ badz+ra bhe ra wa/ ha ya ra wa la/ nga nya ṇa ma na/ gha dzha lha bha dha/ ga dza ḍa ba da/ kha tsha ṭha pha tha/ ka tsa ṭa pa ta/ oṃ chu yiX/ bstod pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par mdzad/ /dpa' bo gdul dkar 'dul ba po/ /dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /rje bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin//khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyi gtso//dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs he ru ka /rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde drug bsrung ma drug cu 'khor bcas la/ /mchod gtor 'di dang dri dang me tog dang / /bdug spos snang gsal ma nyams bdag 'bul gyi/ /de rnams 'khor dang bcas pa tshur byon la/ /gtor ma 'di dag len zhing gsol ba dang / btung bar mdzad de shin tu mnyes pa yis 'gro la zhi rgyas bsrung skyob sba ba rnams/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin mdzad du gsol/ /tsogs su gsol ba ni/ gsang bar haX yig la khro bo'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ gtsug tor du aX yig la zad par gyi 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gshegs su gsol/ dpral bar i yig la phyogs skyong gi 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ mgrin par ṛ yig la gza'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ snying gar u yig la klu'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su —31—

gsol/ lte bar '-i yig la 'byung po'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/bdun pa tshogs zhing spyan drang ba ni/ bdag nyid skad cig gis dus kyi 'kho(ra lo'i skur gsal ba'i snying gar pa las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a yig yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hū las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang / de las rdo rje nyi ma bzhin du 'od zer kha dog lnga rnams 'phros pas/ bla ma dang de bzhin gshe/gas pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pas/ nam mkha'i mthil du badz+ra sa mā dza 'od zer gyi tshogs rnams rang gi snying ga'i rdo rje la zhugs par gyur/brgyad pa mchod pa rnam pa bdun ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs dpal la 'dud/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /srid gsum skye 'jig med pa'i dngos/ /shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag n+ḍi /|// | ༷ / // / |༷/ / ༷ / // rdo | ༷/ / rdo —32—

te ni we bya pū dzī ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oX lha badz+ra ak+ṣa te ak+ṣa ta pha la snyeX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oX badz+ra lā r+gha phya wasta a bha ra ṇa pū dzāX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oX badz+ra hā gya bhaṇ+ḍa.ā dar+sha pū dzāX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ 1 badz+ra bā bye bā du pū dzāX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oX badz+ra dra skye sgro tu pū dzī ñdzaku ru ku ru swāhā/ oX spyi badz+ra gī te gī ta pū dz+wa ku ru ku ru swāhā/ lkoX spyi badz+ra kā me sarba ske bud+dhā bo dhi sa tā nāX kro dha ā dī nāX/ badz+ra su ra ta pū / dzī ku ru ku ru swāhā/ srid 'gro nyams ngar byis pa'i blo yis ni/ /shin tu mi bzad sdig pa gang bgyis pa//stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spyan sngar mchis nas ni/ /sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rnam mang dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag mtha' dag la ni sdis/ pa rnam bral byang chub spyod la rjes su gnas pas rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi lus 'bul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing mya ngan mi 'da' yun ring bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do/ /dgu pa lam bsten pa ni/ byang chub mchog gi sems dang ni/ /lhag bsam rnam par dag pa dang / bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin spong ba'i/ /rtsa ba bsten bgyi tshogs gsum phyir/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan —33—

shes rab thabs dang ni/ /smon lam stobs dang ye shes kyi/ /pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs par bgyi/ /byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang / /btang snyoms rnams la gnas bgyi zhing / /sbyin dang snyan par smra ba dang / /don spyod pa dang don mthun spyad/ /srog gcod ma byin gzhan gyi bud med dang / /rdzun dang tshig rtsub rnams dang phra ma dang / /'khyal bar 'gyur ba'i tshig dang brnab sems dang / /gnod sems lta ba ngan pa rnam par spang / /'gyod dang gnyid rmugs rgod dang the tshom ste/ /sgrib pa lnga po yongs su spang bgyi zhing / /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal gyi//nyon mongs bzhi rnams bdag gis kun tu spang //'dod dang srid pa ma rig lta ba yi/ /zag pa bzhi yang yongs su spang bgyi'o/ /bcu pa stong pa nyid la dmigs pa ni/ dngos po med la sgom pa med/ /sgom pa sgom pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /khams gsum po rnam par dpyad na cir yang mi dmigs pa dang /bdag nyid kyi lus kyi chu'i khams kyis me rnam par nyams shing / me med pas sa yang sra ba nyid dor nas/lan tshwa bzhin du zhu bar gyur te chu la thim zhing /chu yang rlud gis skams par byas nas/ rlung gi tshogs rnams nam mkha' la mi snang bar gyur te/rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid do//oṃ 〈stong pa nyid l+lī ༷ / ༷ ༷ / /rde khro// hūṃ sdi / /༷ sdi ༷// dh+ri lnge/ hūṃ —34—

bdag nyid nga'o//〉bhi sa skra ra dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3ha/gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la/ sku rdzogs pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gsung rdzogs pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag las rgyal mchog thig le rdzogs pa sgrub pa'i yan lag thig le'i rnal 'byor/bde ba rdzogs pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro//dang po la/ rten gzhal yas khang sgom pa dang / brten pa lha sgom pa gnyis las/ dang po la yang gnyis kyi/ dang po gzhal yas khang gsal gdab pa ni/rdo rje'i rang bzhin rtsibs bcu pa zlum po'i dbus su chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams la ya las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po/ dbus su gzhu'i rnam pa rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi pa rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ra las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po dbus su gru gsum gyi rnam pa rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gsum pa bkra shis kyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du grelas chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po dbus su zlum po'i rnam pa rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gnyis pa pad+mas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du la las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po dbus su gru bzhi'i rnam pa rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig pa rdo rjes mtshan pa/de thams cad kyi steng dang 'og tu hu las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis gnyis dang ldan par gyur/ sa'i steng du ma las ri rab lhun po 'og gi rgyar dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug pa/steng la dpag tshad stong phrag lnga bcu pa'o/ /de'i steng du k+ṣa las sna tshogs chu skyes dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ lte ba pad+ma'i sum cha'i tshad dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du ha las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor pad+ma'i lhe ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du rnam par bcad pa —35—

las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zla ba dang mnyam pa de'i steng du thig le las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor mthon mthing nyi ma dang mnyam pa de rnams gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa las/ sgoX zhes pa'i sa bon gyi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jig rten gyi khams snga ma bzhin du grub par gyur/lhun po'i steng du hūX las byung ba'i rdo rje'i gur rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi phyogs kyi mdog can gyi gzhi la bhāX yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes rin po che lnga'i rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor ri yu pa gsum las/ phyi rol tu sku'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi pa dang / de'i nang gi phyed du gsung gi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gnyis pa dang / de'i yang nang gi phyed du thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig pa ste/ sgo bzhi bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor so so la nang nas rim pa bzhin du ste/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la rin po che nag po dang /dmar po dang / dkar po'i rwa ba rim pa gsum dang / gsung dang sku'i dkyil 'khor la rin po che ljang khu dang / nag po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang /ser po'i rwa ba rim pa lnga lnga dang ldan pa ste/ sgo dang mnyam pa'i sgo khyud dang sgo 'gram dang sgo logs te/ glo 'bur gyi rnam pa grub pa'i sgo khang nyid do/ /rwa ba rnams kyi phyi rol tu stegs bu dkar po 'gram stegs kyi rnam pa can khor yug tu yongs su bskor ba dang / dkyil 'khor gsum char la mtshungs par rwa ba'i steng du rin po che'i snam bu dmar po kha bad kyi rnam pa can la rin po che du mas mdzes par spras pa dang / de'i steng du thog phubs kyi gdung 'degs pa'i ka thung —36—

rnams kyi bar bar du chu srin ma ka ra'i kha nas 'phyang ba'i do shal dang do shal phyed pa dkar po/ me long dang / rnga yab dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las ci thur du 'phyang ba'i ba ku li dang / steng du mdzes par tshar du mngar ba'i kra ma shwa r+ṣa dkar po'o/ /sgo khang rnams kyi steng du sgo las sum 'gyur gyi rta babs nor bu gser gyi rang bzhin brtsegs ma gsum dang / sgo logs kyi g.yas dang g.yo na gyi stegs bu'i steng du btsugs pa'i ka ba ser po bzhi bzhis bteg pa rnams te/ brtsegs ma re re la'ang gdung dang / myos pa bsrung ba dang / ka thung rnams kyi bar bar du mchod pa'i lha mo'i gnas gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ 'og gzhi kha dog sna tshogs pa shin tu mdzes pa'o/ /de la brtsegs ma dang po'i logs gnyis nas glang po che mnan pa'i seng ge dag dang / brtsegs ma gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i logs gnyis nas mchod pa'i lha mo dag gis gdung 'degs bzhin pa dang / steng du har mi mdzes pa bum pa'i tog dang bcas pa bum pa'i g.yas dang g.yon du rgyal mtshan dang snam bu rnams las dril bu dang / me long dang / ba dan dang / rnga yab la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas du ma nye bar dpyangs pa ste/ gzhal yas khang gi zur rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje dang / sgo dang sgo khyud gyi mtshams kyi zur la rin po che du mas mdzes par spras pa'o/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi phyed du bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag phyed pa dang / de'i nang gi phyed du o yig las byung ba'i gtso bo'i pad+ma rgyar dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga pa dang / de'i lte ba la ma yig las byung ba'i zla ba dang /ra yig las byung ba'i nyi ma dang / hu yig las byung ba'i sgra gcan gyi dkyil —37—

'khor rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa ste/ gnam stong gi mthar nyi zla gnyis ka gzas 'dzin pa dang / rtsa gsum gcig tu gyur pa'i dag pa'o/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo la bung ba'i mdog can gyi ka ba bcu drug ste/ shar du ral gri'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa bzhi dang / lhor rin po che'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa bzhi dang /byang du pad+ma'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa bzhi dang / nub tu 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa bzhi'o/ /ka ba de rnams kyi nang gi thad sor yang gtso bo'i pad+ma la gru bzhir bskor ba'i ka ba bcu gnyis te/ phyi nang gi ka ba de dag gis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung rim pa gnyis kyi nang ma sngon po dang phyi ma ljang khu'o/ /nang gi ka ba rdo rje'i gdung dang bcas pa'i steng du yang ka ba rnams kyis bteg pa'i gtso bo'i gnas kyi thog phub phyur bu'i rnam pa/ rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis nye bar mdzes pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gsum char la rwa ba rnams kyi nang du snying po'i sgo'i drug cha spangs par lha snam dkar po'o/ /gtso bo'i pad+ma 'og gzhi sngon po dang / de nas mchod pa'i sa'i mthar thug pa'i 'og gzhi rdo rje'i sa dang steng gi thog rnams kyi mdog ni gtso bo'i zhal gyi dbye bas shar nag po/ lho dmar po/ byang dkar po/nub ser po'o/ /sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol mchod pa'i sa gzhi la pad+ma dang bum pa bzang po la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin phung du ma nye bar 'khrigs pa dang / de'i phyi rol tu sa'i 'khor yug gi steng gi nam mkha' la dbang ldan nas zla ba nya gang ba 'char bzhin pa dang / bden bral du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nub bzhin pa'o/ /de'i yang phyi rol tu chu dang me dang rlung gi khor yug rnams dang /de'i phyi rol tu nam mkha'i khor yug la dbus su rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dang bcas —38—
