pas yongs su bskor ba ste/ de ltar dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi rol phyogs kun nas rdo rje'i me lce ye shes kyi 'od zer mtha' yas pa kun tu 'phro ba'o/ /thugs dang gsung gi rta babs kyi re'u mig gi gzhi kha dog sna tshogs pa la mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs pa dag gnas shing / sku'i rta 'bab kyi brtsegs ma 'og ma'i re'u mig dbus ma'i gnas la shar du chos kyi 'khor lo nag po/ g.yas dang g.yon du ri dwags dang ri dwags mo/ ltor bum pa bzang po dmar po/ g.yas dang g.yon du dung dang pad+ma/ byang du rnga bo che dkar po/ g.yas dang g.yon du dbyug pa dang tho ba/ nub tu byang chub kyi shing ser po/ g.yas dang g.yon du mi'am ci dang mi'am ci mo dag gnas shing / re'u mig gi gnas gzhan rnams su mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs pa gnas pa'o/ /bde gshegs 'phar ma'i ka ba rnams kyi bar bar du oṃ yig las skyes pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lha'i gdan rnam pa brgyad de/ phyogs bzhi dkar po dang / mtshams bzhi dmar po'o/ /de dag gi bar bar du yang bdud rtsi'i bum pa brgyad kyi gnas so/ /thugs kyi lha snam la shar dang lho'i g.yas dang g.yon dang byang dang nub kyi g.yas rnams su oṃ yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang / mtshams rnams dang / byang dang nub kyi g.yon dag tu oṃ yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang /shar dang byang gi sgor pad+ma dkar po dang / lho dang nub kyi sgor pad+ma dmar po'o//pad+ma dmar po bcu gnyis kyi lte bar lo'i phyogs nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i nya bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa ma yig las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dang /dkar po bcu gnyis kyi nye bar gnam stong bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa ra yig —39—

las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis so/ /gsung gi lha snam la phyogs bzhir oṃ yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang / mtshams bzhir oṃ yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'o/ /sku'i lha snam la phyogs bzhi'i g.yas dang g.yon rnams su oṃ yig la byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma nyer brgyad pa brgyad dang / mtshams bzhir o yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma nyer brgyad pa bzhi ste/ rim pa dang po la 'dab ma bzhi/gnyis pa la 'dab ma brgyad/gsum pa la 'dab ma bcu drug dang bcas pa'i lte ba la lha rnams kyi bzhon pa dang bcas pa'o/ /sku'i shar sgor phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta nag po/ lho sgor rta bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta dmar po/byang sgor seng ge bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta dkar po/ nub sgor glang po che bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta ser po/ steng du nam mkha' lding mig gsum pa kha dog lnga pa bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta ljang khu/ 'og tu seng ge rkang pa brgyad pa bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta sngon po'o/ /me dang rlung gi khor yug gi mtshams su dur khrod chen po mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa brgyad la/ phyogs bzhir rtsibs brgyad pa'i 'khor lo dmar po rnams dang / mtshams bzhir rtsibs brgyad pa'i 'khor lo dkar po rnams dang / steng dang 'og tu yang shing rta ljang khu dang sngon po gnyis so/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor chen po kun nas dwangs shing sgrib pa med la/ phyi nang kun tu 'od gsal zhing / mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rgyan gyi rnam pa mchog tu bkra ba du mas mdzes par gyur/gnyis pa dag dran ni/ ka ba rnams dang rdo rje phreng ba sa'i dkyil 'khor rtsig —40—

pa nyid ni rus pa rnams kyis mdzod/ /sha khrag chu dang bshang ba rnams kyis lha dang gshin rje nor spyin gzhan du rdul tshon gdab pa ste/ /mkhris pa bad kan gyis ni nyi ma ri bong can yang de bzhin chu rgyus rnams kyis chu skyes rnams/ /rwa ba lnga yi re sku sa dang chu dang bsreg za rlung dang nam mkha' las skyes rnams kyis so/ /dus kyi rtsa yis gtso bo'i chu skyes g.yo ba me yi dkyil 'khor la sogs pags pa la sogs kyis/ /nyi ma'i sgo rnams bug pa rnams kyis nor bu'i rang bzhin bkod pa so yi 'phreng bas de bzhin nyid/ /g.yo ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas dur khrod brgyad du 'khor lo rnams ni sor mo rnams kyi sen mo yis/ /ba sbu rnams kyis dkyil 'khor mthar ni phyogs dang phyogs bral dag tu gnas pa'i rdo rje me lce ste/ de ltar mchog gi yon to rnam mang sku yi rdo rje nges par dkyil 'khor gyis ni rnam par gsungs/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun chos/ /thugs gsung sku yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi rnams kyis ni/ /rdo rje'i thig ni bzhi po ste/ /dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi rnams kyis/ /gru bzhi mnyam pa de nyid de/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'gags pa yis/ /sgo ni bcu gnyis po rnams te/ /de bzhin sa ni bcu gnyis kyis/ /rta babs dag ni mdzes pa rnams/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad rnams kyis//phyogs brgyad du ni dur khrod rnams/ /stong nyid bcu drug ka ba rnams/ khams rnams kyis kyang khang pa brtsegs/ /rnam thar brgyad kyis sgo khyud rnams// gzugs can yon tan brgyad rnams kyis/ /'gram rnams dang ni logs rnams nyid//thugs gsung sku yi dbye bas so//tshul khrims la sogs phung po lngas/ /kha dog lnga ni rnam par dag /theg pa gsum —41—

gyis rwa ba gsum/ /dad pa'i dbang po sogs kyis lnga/ /dad sogs stobs rnams dag gis lnga/ /thugs gsung sku yi dkyil zhe bor la'o/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams kyis/ /dkyil 'khor gsum la stegs bu ste/ /pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs pa yis/ /rin chen snam bu rnam par bkra/ /ma 'dres chos ni bcwa brgyad kyis/ /do shal do shal phyed pa rnams// dbang rnams kyis kyang ba ku lī/ /dge bas kra ma rnya 'o//stong nyid la sogs rnam thar gyis//dril bu'i sgras ni gang ba ste/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pas rgyal mtshan gtams// spong bas me long rab tu 'bar/ /byang chub yan lag rnga yab g.yo/ /yan lag dgu yis 'phreng bas brgyan/ /bsdu ba bzhi po rnams kyis ni/ /zur du sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan/ /bden bzhis rin po che rnams kyis/ /sgo dang sgo khyud mtshams su spras// mngon shes lnga yis rtag tu ni/ /khor yug chen po lnga yis bskor/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen byang chub pas/ /rdo rje 'phreng bas legs par bskor/ /bde ba gcig pu'i khor yug gis/ /de bzhin ye shes rdo rje 'bar/ /thabs dang shes rab cha yis ni/ /zla ba nyi ma rtag tu shar/ /thugs gsung sku dang dag pa yis/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bum pa che/ /rnga bo che dang byang chub shing / /de bzhin yid bzhin nor bu sogs/ /'di ni dpal ldan dus wor gyi/ /dkyil wor chos kyi dbyings nyid do/ /gnyis pa brten pa lha sgom pa la gnyis las/ dang po lha bskyed pa ni/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la gnas pa'i zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo/a i ṛ u '-i/a e ar o al/ha ya ra wa la a zhes pa rnams g.yon bskor dang / lā wā rā yā hā/ ul au ur i ā/ lī ྅ —42—

grwa yī ā aX zhes pa rnams g.yas bskor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs dang ldan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /de'i 'og tu dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ khru tre sgra khyu snyi/ skru tre sno sgra lha/ spa sgri ṣ+ṭha sh+ka sni t+ta thro sdo dzhai n+ma/ spa h+pha bru spyi sma/ rngo spyo khra lho ṇ+ḍa/ ts+tsha ts+tsha sdo rdzi nyi/ spro khri ga rwa / zhes pa rnams g.yas bskor dang / nga gha ga kha ka nya dzha dza tsha tsa/ ṇa bha ḍa ṭha ṭa/ ma bha ba pha pa/ na dha da tha ta/ skosha ṣa phi sa/ ha ya ra wa la/khyu ḍa ya wa la/ zhes pa rnams g.yon bskor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed dang ldan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /zla ba'i dbus su huX yig zla ba'i mtshan ma lta bu so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /de rnams gcig tu gyur pa hi yig dang bcas pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/ /de las lha'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa haX yig dang bcas pa ni shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ bdag nyid dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga rnams 'gyed cing / bdud dang nyon mongs pa'i snying gar mnan pa'i zhabs gnyis pa/ mgrin pa gsum pa/zhal bzhi pa/ phrag pa drug pa/ dpung pa bcu gnyis pa/ phyag gi pad+ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ mtshon cha rnams dang rdo rje'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas pa dmar po brkyangs pas 'dod lha dmar po gdong gcig pa/ lag pa bzhi'i —43—

g.yas gnyis gyis me tog gi mda' lnga dang / lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis kyis gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'i snying gar mnan pa/ g.yon pa dkar po bskums pas drag po dkar po gdong gcig pa/ mig gsum pa/ lag pa bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang ḍā ma sa g.yon gnyis kyis kha ṭāX ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i snying gar mnan pa/ bdud kyi dga' ma dang / drag po'i u ma dag ni dman pa'i gdong gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi mthil la 'dzin par byed cing g.yo ba med par gnas pa/ sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus kyi mgrin pa nyi ma dang zla ba dang bung ba'i mdog can/mdun zhal nag po mche ba phyed gtsigs pa/ g.yas zhal dmar po chags pa dang bcas pa/ g.yon zhal dkar po rab tu zhi ba/ rgyab zhal ser po ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa ste/zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /ral pa'i cod pan la sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ spyi gtsug tu rdo rje nor bu dang / rdo rje rna rgyan dang / rdo rje mgul rgyan dang / rdo rje gdub bu dang /rdo rje ska rags dang /rdo rje rkang gdub dang /rdo rje dar dpyangs dang /rdo rje 'phreng ba dang / stag gi pags pa'i na bza' dang ldan pa/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi phrag pa dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po/ de bzhin du dpung pa gnyis nag po/ gnyis dmar po/ gnyis dkar po/ phyag dar bzhi nag po/ bzhi dmar po/ bzhi dkar po/ de dag re re la yang sor gdub rnams kyis spras pa'i mthe bong ser po/ mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag nag po/mthe'u chung ljang khu'o/ /de rnams re re la yang phyag gi mthil nas brtsams te/—44—

tshigs kyi phreng ba dang po rnams nag po/ gnyis pa rnams dmar po/ gsum pa rnams dkar po'o/ /de lta bu'i phyag g.yas pa rnams kyi nag po bzhis/ rdo rje/ral gri/ rtse gsum/ gri gug dmar po bzhis/ mda'/rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍā ma sa tho ba/ dkar po bzhis/ 'khor lo/ mdung / dbyug pa/ dgra stu rnams 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa rnams kyi nag po bzhis/ rdo rje'i dril bu/ phub/kha ṭāX ga kha phye ba/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ dmar po bzhis/ gzhu/ zhags pa/rin po che/ pad+ma dkar po/ dkar po bzhis/ dung / me long / rdo rje lcags sgrogatshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa pad+mas spras pa 'dzin zhing / phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'byud pa ste/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes don dam pa'i bde ba'o/ /de la 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum sku mdog ser mo/ zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad ma/bcom ldan 'das kyi nub zhal gtso bor bzhag pa lta bur mdun zhal ser mo/g.yas zhal dkar po/ rgyab zhal nag po/ g.yon zhal dmar po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis gri gug lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍā ma sa bgrang 'phreng rnams 'dzin cing / g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa/ zhags pa/ 'dab ma brgyad pa'i pad+ma dkar po/ rin po che rnams 'dzin pa/rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can/rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bcom ldan 'das la 'khril shing / des kyang snyoms par zhugs pa ste/ shes rab dang ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin ma/ rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid do/ /spyin pa la —45—

sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa gzhan brgyad ni 'dab ma brgyad la gnas pa ste/shar dang nub tu a ā/ byang dang lhor a a rnams yongs su gyur pa las rim pa bzhin du bdug spos kyi snod dang / dri'i dung dang / lha bgos dang / mar me phyogs kyi mdog can rnams dang / me dang rlung du ha hā/ dbang ldan dang bden bral du ha ha rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rnga yab phyogs kyi mdog can rnams so/ /de rnams yongs su gyur pa las shar du nag mo 'bar ma/ nag dmar ser dkar ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis bdug spos dang /tsan+dan dang / gur gum dang / gla rtsir bcas pa'i ga pur rnams kyi snod dang /g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang /pad+ma dang /yongs 'du'i me tog dang /me tog sna tshogs kyi 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/lhor dmar mo 'bar ma/dmar ser dkar nag pa'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis mar me dang / do shal dang /cod pan dang / gdub bu/ g.yon pa rnams kyis gos dang / ska rags dang / rin po che'i rna rgyan dang / rkang gdub 'dzin pa/ byang du dkar mo 'bar ma/ dkar nag dmar ser ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis 'o ma dang /chu dang / sman bzang po dang / chang rnams kyi snod dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis bdud rtsi dang / grub pa'i bcud len dang / bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu dang / 'bras chan rnams kyi snod 'dzin pa/ nub tu ser mo 'bar ma/ ser dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal bzhi/phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis dung dang /gling bu dang /nor bu dang / ḍa ma sa g.yon pa rnams kyis pi wang dang / rnga dang / zhabar rnga dang /zangs dung rnams 'dzin pa/ mer du ba ma nag mo 'bar ma dang 'dra ba las/—46—

phyag brgyad na rnga yab nag po brgyad bsnams pa/ bden bral du smig rgyu ma dmar mo 'bar ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag brgyad na rnga yab dmar po brgyad bsnams pa/ dbang ldan du me khyer ma dkar mo 'bar ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag brgyad na rnga yab dkar po brgyad bsnams pa/ rlung du mar me ma ser mo 'bar ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag brgyad na rnga yab ser po brgyad bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gyi mdog ni g.yas bskor kyi rim pa ste/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad/ spyan bcu gnyis ma/ phyag rgya lnga dang /rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can no/ /'di dag gi rgyab tu yang dbang ldan du o las byung ba'i chos kyi dung dkar po/ bden bral du u las byung ba'i chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi dmar po/ mer hū las byung ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu nag po/ rlung du ho las byung ba'i dpag bsam gyi shing ser po rnams su gyur/ de nas dal ge rgor pa rnamasaspro ba ni/ 'dod chags chen pos gdul bar bya ba'i sems can rnams dang po'i sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snod du mngon par gzigs nas/ yum la stoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i shin tu dga' ba'i sgras/ nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i rnam par dag pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched las dbang yul dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum/ byang chub sems dpa' yab yum/ khro bo yab yum thams cad rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pas rang gi lus la zhugs par gyur/ slar yang rang nyid las 'phros te sna tshogs yum la zhugs par gyur/ de las kyang log nas slar rang nyid la zhugs te/ zla ba byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par zhu bar gyur pa —47—

rnams rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra spros te/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las/lha dang lha mo'i tshogs su gyur pa ni/ a yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las/ mi bskyod pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ gri gug dgra stu/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje'i dril bu/ thod pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi nga/ 'dzin pa la/ rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas 'khyud pa nam mkhar spros nas sems can gyi don byas te/ slar yang rang nyid la bdag por bzhugs par gyur/ i yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ don yod grub pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog nag po g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis ral gri/ gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gsum gyis phub/ thod pa/ kha ṭāX ka dkar po 'dzin pa la/ spyan ma ser mos 'byud pa/ shar du pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ ṛ yig las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis me'i mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma sa g.yon pa gsum gyis gzhu/zhags pa/rin po che rtse mo dgu pa 'od 'phro ba 'dzin pa la/ mā ma gī dkar mos 'phyud pa/ lhor pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ u yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/snang ba mtha' yas zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dkar —48—

po/ g.yas zhal nag cing g.yon zhal dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis tho ba/mdung /rtse gsum/g.yon pa gsum gyis 'dab ma brgyad pa'i pad+ma dkar po/me long / bgreng 'phreng 'dzin pa la/ gos dkar mo dmar mos 'phyud pa/ byang du pad nyi'i steng du sdend par gyur/le yig las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ser po/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis 'khor lo/ dbyug pa/ khro bo'i rdo rje/ g.yon pa gsum gyis dung / rdo rje lcags sgrog sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa la/ sgrol ma nag mos 'byud pa/ nub tu pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ lnga char yang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje'i gdan gyis gnas shing /thabs gtso bor gyur pa'o//yī yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las/sgrol ma nag mo don yod grub pa lta bu la/rnam par snang mdzad ser pos 'khyud pa/ me mtshams su pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/grwa yig las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/gos dkar mo dmar mo rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu la/ snang ba mthar yas dkar pos 'byud pa/ bden bral du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ mū yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ mā ma gī dkar mo snang ba mtha' yas lta bu la/ rin chen 'byung ldan dmar pos 'phyud pa/ dbang ldan du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ lī yig las byung ba'i 'khor lo'i ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ sangs rgyas spyan ma ser mo rnam snang lta bu la/ don yod grub pa nag pos —49—

'byud pa/ rlung mtshams su pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ thams cad kyang pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la pad+ma'i gdan gyis gnas shing /shes rab gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /de dag gi g.yon dang g.yas su yang hi hi hṝ hṝ hu hu hṝ dzñā rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ bdud rtsi'i bum pa dkar po pad+ma 'al sa/nas shing pad+ma'i kha brgyan pa brgyad de/ shar du rkang 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang / lhor khrag 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang / byang du gci ba 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang /nub tu bshang ba 'gags pa'i gnyis so/ /haX haXlas byung ba'i steng du khu ba 'gags pa'i bum pa dang / 'og tu rdul 'gags nga/'i bum pa rnams su gyur/ yaX yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ bgegs mthar byed nag po don yod grub pa lta bu la/ lāXyig las byung ba'i rengs byed ma ser mo gas/na rje mthar byed lta bus 'byud pa/shar sgor pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ raX yig las byung ba'i dbyug pa dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/shes rab mthar byed dmar po rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu la/ wāXyig las byung ba'i khengs byed ma dkar mo pad+ma mthar byed lta bus 'byud pa/ lho sgor pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ waX yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/pad+ma mthar byed dkar po snang ba mtha' yas lta bu la/ rāXyig las byung ba'i rmugs byed ma dmar mo shes rab mthar byed lta bus 'byud pa/ byang sgor pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ laX yig las byung ba'i tho ba ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje mthar byed ser po rnam par snang mdzad lta bu la/ yāXyig las byung ba'i shin tu brtson 'grus ma nag mo —50—

bgegs mthar byed lta bus 'byud pa/ nub sgor pud zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ khro bo khro mo brgyad po de rnams zhal re re la spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rab tu khros shing 'jigs su rung ba/ klu'i dbang po phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/shar dang byang gi sgor pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang /lho dang nub kyi sgor pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la khro bo rnams g.yas brkyang dang / khro bo'i lha mo rnams g.yon brkyang gis gnas shing / thabs gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /a yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las/ phyag na rdo rje ljang khu mi bskyod pa lta bu la/ sgra rdo rje ma sngon mos 'byud pa/ lho sgo'i g.yon du pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ e yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ nam mkha'i snying po nag po don grub lta bu la/ dri rdo rje ma ser mos 'khyud pa/ shar sgo'i g.yas su pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ar yig las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ sa'i snying po dmar po rin chen dbang po lta bu la/ gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mos 'byud pa/ lto sgo'i g.yas su pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ o yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar po 'od dpag med lta bu la/ro rdo rje ma dmar mos 'byud pa/byang sgo'i g.yas su pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ al yig las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ sgrib pa rnam sel ser po rnam snang lta bu la/ reg bya rdo rje ma nag mos 'khyud pa/ nub sgo'i g.yas su pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ a yig las —51—

byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po yongs su gyur pa las/ kun tu bzang po sngon po rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu la/chos khams rdo rje ma ljang khus 'byud pa/shar sgo'i g.yon du pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ thams cad kyang pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje'i gdan gyis gnas shing / thabs gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /ā yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las/chos khams rdo rje ma ljang khu mi bskyod pa lta bu la/kun tu bzang po sngon pos 'byud pa/nub sgo'i g.yon du zla'i steng du 'khod par 'gyur/ /mai yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs gyur pa las/ reg bya rdo rje ma nag mo don grub lta bu la/ sgrib pa rnam sel ser pos 'phyud pa/ me mtshams su pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ ur yig las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ ro rdo rje ma dmar mo rin chen dbang po lta bu la/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar pos 'phyud pa/ bden bral du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ au yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo 'od dpag med lta bu la/ sa'i snying po dmar pos 'byud pa/ dbang ldan du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ zhwal yig las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ dri rdo rje ma ser mo rnam snang lta bu la/ nam mkha'i snying po nag pos 'khyud pa/ rlung mtsham/sa su pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ ā yig las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po yongs su gyur pa las/ sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu la/ phyag na rdo rje ljang khus 'phyud pa/ byang sgo'i g.yon du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ thams cad kyang pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la pad+ma'i gdan gyis gnas shing /shes —52—

rab gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /de ltar na de rnams thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa ste/ sgrol ma/ bgegs mthar byed/ shin tu brtson 'grus ma/ nam mkha'i snying po/ reg bya rdo rje ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog nag po g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis ral gri/ gri gugartse gsum/g.yon pa gsum gyis phub/thod pa/kha ṭāX ga dkar po 'dzin pa/gos dkar mo/shes rab mthar byed/rmugs byed ma/ sa'i snying po/ro rdo rje ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dmar po g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis me'i mda'/rdo rje'i lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma sa g.yon pa gsum gyis gzhu/zhags pa/rin po che rtse mo dgu pa 'od 'phro ba 'dzin pa/ mā ma gī/ pad+ma mthar byed/ khengs byed ma/ 'jig rten dbang phyugagazugs rdo rje ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dkar po g.yas zhal nag cing g.yon zhal dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis tho ba/ mdung / rtse gsum/g.yon pa gsum gyis 'dab ma brgyad pa'i pad+ma dkar po/ me long / bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ sangs rgyas spyan ma/ gshin rje mthar byed/ rengs byed ma/sgrib pa rnam sel/ dri rdo rje ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ser po g.yas zhal dkar zhal g.yon zhal nag pa/phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis 'khor lo/dbyug pa/khro bo'i rdo rje/ g.yon pa gsum gyis dung / rdo rje'i lcags sgrog sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ phyag na rdo rje dang chos khams rdo rje ma rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ gri gug dgra stu/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje'i dril bu/thod —53—

pa/tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/kun tu bzang po dang /sgra rdo rje ma ni rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/gri gug dgra stu/g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje'i dril bu/ /thod pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa'o/rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ / zhe klu sdu stu sga'i) g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu la/ ra rja //// shar du dri ma dang phreng ba ma nag mo/ lhor 'a bdug spos ma dang snang gsal ma dmar mo/ byang du bdud rtsi ma dang 'bras bu ma dkar mo/nub tu sgeg mo dang bzhad ma ser mo/ steng du sgra ma dang gar ma ljang khu/ 'og tu glu ma dang 'dod ma sngon mo ste/ thams cad rang rang gi ming dang mthun pa'i mchod rdzas thogs shing / gzungs ma grangs med pa dang bcas pa'o/ /thugs dkyil gyi lha mtha' dag sa bon kho na las bskyed kyang rung zhing / nus ma rnams dang / rdo rje bzhi rnams mngon byang lnga las gtso bo dang lhan cig bskyed chog go /de nas/ gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha snam la rnal 'byor rnams spro bar bya ste/ ha yig las byung ba'i gri gug nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ tsar tsi ka nag mo la dbang po ser pos 'byud pa shar gyi pad+ma'i lte bar yi dwags dmar po la gnas pa dang / hi hi ya yi ldi yu slo yaX rnams las byung ba'i gri gug nag po brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jigs ma/ rlud shugs ma/drag mo/dus kyi mche ba ma/me 'bar gdong ma/rab gtum ma/drag mig ma/sna chen ma rnams kyang nag mo/ mdun dang rgyab kyi 'dab ma dang / g.yas kyi 'dab ma gsum dang /—54—

g.yon gyi 'dab ma gsum la gnas pa/ dgu char yang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis gri gug dang rtse gsum/g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa dang kha ṭaX ga 'dzin pa'o/ / k+ṣa yig las byung ba'i 'khor lo nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ khyab 'jug ma nag mo la tshangs pa ser pos 'khyud pa/ me mtshams kyi pad+ma'i lte bar mkha' lding la gnas pa dang / khyi gh+ri yā yī yaXrnamasalas byung ba'i 'khor lo nag po brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ yu g.yung mo/rnam par rgyal ma/sgyu ma/grags ma/bkra shis ma/dpal spru 'aldan rgyal ma/ dpal ldan rgyal byed ma/ 'khor lo ma rnams kyang nag mo/ mdun dang rgyab kyi 'dab ma dang / g.yas kyi 'dab ma gsum dang / g.yon gyi 'dab ma gsum la gnas pa/dgu char yang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang be con/ g.yon gnyis kyis pad+ma dang dung 'dzin pa'o/ /haXyig las byung ba'i dbyug pa dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ phag mo dmar mo la drag po dkar pos lkod pa/ rdzo pad+ma'i lte bar ma he la gnas pa dang / rje lhar ri hṝ ru hai raX rnams las byung ba'i dbyug pa dmar po brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ keng rus ma/gtsigs ma/dus mtshan ma/rab khros gdong ma/dus kyi lte ma/nag mo/drag mo/ gzugs ngan ma rnams kyang dmar mo/ mdun dang rgyab kyi 'dab ma dang /g.yas kyi 'dab ma gsum dang / g.yon gyi 'dab ma gsum la gnas pa/ dgu char yang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis lcags sgrog dang phub 'dzin pa'o/ /k+ṣaXyig las byung ba'i shasti dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/gzhon nu ma dmar mo la tshogs bdag dkar pos 'byud —55—

pa bden bral gyi pad+ma'i lte bar rma bya la gnas pa dang / lco spri rā rī tshwa rū rnyi raXrnams las byung ba'i shasti dmar po brgyad yongs su gyur the 'es/ pad+ma ma/rin chen 'phreng ba ma/ lus med ma/ gzhon nu ma/ ri dwags bdag pos 'gro ma/mig bzang ma/ rul ma/ bzang mo rnams kyang dmar mo/ mdun dang rgyab kyi 'dab ma dang / g.yas kyi 'dab ma gsum dang / g.yon gyi 'dab ma gsum la gnas pa/ dgu char yang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis shasti dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /haX yig las byung ba'i rtse gsum dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ drag mo dkar mo la gshin rje sprel sde tsho pa 'byud pa/ byang gi pad+ma'i lte bar khyu mchog la gnas pa dang / hu hu wa wi lnga lha zla waX rnams las byung ba'i rtse gsum dkar po brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ go ri 'degs ma/ gaX gā ma/ rtag ma/ myur ma/mtshon byed ma/ dmar ser ma/ nag mo rnams kyang dkar mo/ mdun dang rgyab kyi 'dab ma dang / g.yas kyi 'dab ma gsum dang / g.yon gyi 'dab ma gsum la gnas pa/ dgu char yang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang ḍā ma sagayon gnyis kyis kha ṭāX ga dang ltos 'gro 'dzin pa'o/ /k+ṣaX yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal mo dkar mo la gdong drug dmar pos 'khyud pa/ dbang ldan gyi pad+ma'i nye bar seng ge la gnas pa dang / khri pa wā lī lha lha smu waXrnams (〈pho〉 rgolas byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po brgyad ) yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ldan dkar mo/ 'dzin ma/ zla ba'i ri mo can ma/ ri bong 'dzin zhal ma/ngang pa'i mdog ma/pad+ma'i dbang mo/skar mig ma/dri med ri bong —56—

'dzin ma rnams kyang dkar mo/ mdun dang rgyab kyi 'dab ma dang / g.yas kyi 'dab ma gsum dang / g.yon gyi 'dab ma gsum la gnas pa/ dgu char yang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis pad+ma dang bgrang 'phreng / g.yon gnyis kyis chu skyes dang rin po che 'dzin pa'o/ /hā yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ dbang mo ser mo la bden bral nag pos 'byud pa/nub kyi pad+ma'i nye bar glang po che la gnas pa dang / hṝ hṝ la li lu slo laX rnams las byung ba'i rdo rje ser po brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo ljo rje 'od/ bkra ba'i ri mo/ rdo rje'i lus ma/ gser ldan ma/ urba sī/ ram bha/ zug rngu med ma/ shin tu sgrol ma rnams kyang ser mo/ mdun dang rgyab kyi 'dab ma dang / g.yas kyi 'dab ma gsum dang / g.yon gyi 'dab ma gsum la gnas pa/ dgu char yang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu dang gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /nywa yig las byung ba'i bar bu ser po yongs su gyur pa las/tshangs ma ser mo la khyab 'jug nag pos 'khyud pa/ rlung mtshams kyi pad+ma'i lte bar ngang pa la gnas pa dang / blo sko lā lī ྅ slu laXrnams las byung ba'i bar bu ser po brgyad yongs su gyur pa la shrī mchod sbyin 'dod ma/ ngag gi dbang phyug ma/ pad+ma'i spyan ma/ chu skyes ldan ma/ blo gros ma/ glu ma/ glog ma/ dran ma rnams kyang ser mo/ mdun dang rgyab kyi 'dab ma dang / g.yas kyi 'dab ma gsum dang / g.yon gyi 'dab ma gsum la gnas pa/ dgu char yang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis pad+ma dang tshangs pa'i dbyug pa/ g.yon gnyis kyis spyi blugs dang bar bu 'dzin pa'o/ /gtso mo brgyad po rnams ni sa ga'i stabs kyis gnas —57—

shing / bcom ldan 'das la mngon du phyogs pa dang / 'khor rnams ni rol pa'i stabs can rang rang gi gtso mo la mngon du phyogs pa ste/ tshangs ma 'khor dang bcas pa ni gdong bzhi ma/ gzhon nu ma 'khor dang bcas pa ni gdong drug ma/gzhan rnams gdong gcig ma/ thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa ste/ rnal 'byor ma'i thabs brgyad ni sku'i lha chen rnams kyi skabs dang phyag mtshan 'dra ba'o/ /de nas/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha snam la tshes kyi lha rnams spro bar bya ste/nya nyi gri nyu 〉 nyaX/ dzha dzhai ljo tshuzle dzhaX/ dza rdze rdzudzu : dzaX/ tsha tshi skyu du tshwa oṃ/ tsa tsi lja tsu spre rtsa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ ral gri nag po rnams su gyur te/rtsa dang sgro las byung ba'i ral gri dag yongs su gyur pa las/ srin po nag po la dzad rdo rje ma srin mo ser mos 'byud pa/ shar gyi g.yas su pad+ma'i lte bar yi dwags la gnas pa dang / mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i nya rdo rje ma/ nyi rdo rje ma/ de bzhi du sbyar te/ ljo nyu slo nyaX/ dzha dzhai smra dzu lha dzhai/ dza dzi rmi dzu : pho/tsha tshi sgro tshu sne/ tsa tsi smra tsuky-i rdo rje ma rnams kyang nag mo/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri dang gri gug /g.yon gnyis kyis phub dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ nag pa zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o//des rigs sgres te 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /tsā rnyi hṝ tsū lha tsaX tshwa dhī hṝ tsū lha tshaX dzā dzī rno sdo dzñā dzaX dzñā —58—

dhī ljo dzñā tram̐ dzhaX nywa nyi ྅ nyu snyo nyaXrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dpag bsam gyi shidzon go po rnams su gyur te/ nyaXdang dzhai phra thing ba'i dpag bsam gyi shing dag yongs su gyur pa las/ rlung lha nag po la rī rdo rje ma rab gtum ma ser mos 'khyud pa/ me mtshams kyi pad+ma'i lte bar ri dwags la gnas pa dang / mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i/ tsā tshwa dzā dzñā snyi rdo rje ma rnams kyang nag mo/gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis dpag bsam gyi shing dang yongs 'du'i me tog g.yon gnyis kyis nor bu in+d+ra nī la dang /ut+pal sngon po 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /de ltar zla ba gnyis ni dpyid kyi dus so/ /ṇa ṇi ljo ṭu tho ṇaX/khyu dhi rje ṇa rlo lhaX/ ḍa ḍi dzo lhu lco ḍaX/ ṭha 'i rje khu zlo ṭhaX/ ṭa ṭi hṝ thu ḍā ṭaX rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ mdung dmar po rnams su gyur te/ṭaX dang dzo las byung ba'i mdung dag yongs su gyur pa las/ /me lha dmar po la rje rdo rje ma chu lha mo dkar mos 'byud pa lho'i g.yas su pad+ma'i lte bar lug la gnas pa dang / mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i/ ṇa bha ḍa ṭha blo rdo rje ma rnams kyang dmar mo gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis mdung dang dbyug pa/ g.yon gnyis kyis chu skyes dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ snron gyi zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /ṭā khyi shrī skyo hū ཾ ṭaX khyu khri spru ṣ+ka sgri ṭhaX ḍā ḍi rmyo ḍū 'o ḍaX bhā dhī phyu hūṃ zla bhaX ṇa —59—

ṇi hṝ ṇa rmyo ṇaXrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shasti dmar po rnams su gyur te/ṇaXdang tshwa las byung ba'i shasti dag yongs su gyur pa las/ gdong drug dmar po la rde rdo rje ma dpal mo dkar mos 'byud pa/ bden bral gyi pad+ma'i lte bar rma bya la gnas pa dang / mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i/ ṭā khyu ḍā bhā rmyo rdo rje ma rnams kyang dmar mo/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyi shan+ti dang mdung / g.yon gnyis kyis nor bu dang me long 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ chu stod kyi zla ba'i tshes rnus sa shā rnam par dag pa'o/ /de ltar zla ba gnyis ni sos ka'i dus so/ /ma mi lnga mu slamaX/bha bhi ljoghu༈bhaX/ ba bi dzo bu blobaX/ pha phi sgro phu slo phaX/ pa pi sgro pu slo paX rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ zhags pa dkar po rnams su gyur te/ paX dang gri las byung ba'i zhags pa dag yongs su gyur pa las/ rgya mtsho dkar po la sgro rdo rje ma phag mo dmar mos 'byud pa/ byang gi g.yas su pad+ma'i lte bar chu srin la gnas pa dang / mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i ma bha ba pha : rdo rje ma rnams kyang dkar mo/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis zhags pa dang rin po che/ g.yon gnyis kyis sbrul zhags dang zla ba chu shel gyi nor bu 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ gro bzhin gyi zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /pā bī shrī pū tshwa paX phu phri shrī phu lha phaX bā bī shrī byu hū ཾ baX bhā sgyi dzhai bhū lha bhaX mā sī sdi mū lha maXrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dgra —60—

stu dkar po rnams su gyur te/ maXdang shrī las byung ba'i dgra stu dag yongs su gyur pa las/ tshogs bdag dkar po la sdo rdo rje ma gzhon nu ma dmar mos 'khrud pa/dbang ldan gyi pad+ma'i lte bar byi ba la gnas pa dang /mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i/ pā phu bā bhā snya rdo rje ma rnams kyang dkar mo/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis dgra stu dang rdo rje / g.yon gnyis kyis zhags pa dang nor bu 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/khrums stod kyi zla ba'i po kyi rna ༷ rnam sde po da gā pa'o/ /de ltarwa zla ba gnyis ni dbyar gyi dus so/ /na ni spreX/dha dhi je rnyu 〉 dhaX/da di drwa du rdal daX/tha thi sgro thu : thaX/ ta ti skyu tu hṝ taX rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje ser po rnams su gyur te/ taX brong dra las byung ba'i rdo rje dag yongs su gyur pa las/dbang po ser po la dh+ra rdo rje ma rlung lha mo nag mos 'khyud pa/ nub kyi g.yas su pad+ma'i lte bar glang po che la gnas pa dang / mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i na dha da tha hṝ rdo rje ma rnams kyang ser mo/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis kyis dril bu dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ tha skar gyi zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /tā tī pho tu hūṃ taX thā shrī lho byu༈ thaX dā dī lha du h+pho daX dh+wa dhī spyi dhū zlo dhaX nā nī hṝ nā h+pho naXrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ khab ser po rnams su gyur te/ naXdang shrī las byung ba'i khab dag yongs su gyur pa las/—61—

mes po ser po la hṝ rdo rje ma glog ma nag mos 'byud pa/ rlung mtshams kyi pad+ma'i lte bar ngang pa la gnas pa dang / mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i/tā thā dā bhā r+ghaṃ rdo rje ma rnams kyang ser mo/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis khab dang bgrang 'phreng / g.yon gnyis kyis pad+ma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/smin drug gi zla ba'i tshes rke rke ༷rnams rnam par kre pa'o//de ltur zlu ba gnyis ni rton gī dus so/ /rko rtsi skyu rku klo ka/sha shi shor shu shā shaX/ṣa ṣi lnga khuṣ+ṭha ṣaX/pi pi gri spu spru skraX/sa si sno su slo saX rnams snrongs su gyur pa las/ rtse gsum sngon po rnams su gyur te/ saX dang 6ji las byung ba'i rtse gsum dag yongs su gyur pa las/ drag po sngon po la ji rdo rje ma ri sras ma ljang khus 'byud pa/ byang gi g.yon du pad+ma'i lte bar khyu mchog la gnas pa dang / mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i sko sha ṣa pi slo rdo rje ma rnams kyang sngoXn mo/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis kyis sprul dang bcas pas kha ṭāX ga dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ mgo'i zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /sma sī sdi snyu spyi saX spru shrī sdi sdi lha skraX khri ṇi shu lha khaXshā shī shrī hūṃ shrī shaX gī dhī phri ri dzñā skaX rnams yongs su gyur pa las be con sngon po rnams su gyur te/ skyiXdeng sde las byung ba'i be con dag yongs su gyur pa las/cu bdag sngon po la spru rdo rje ma nor gyi dbang mo ljang khus —62—

'phyud pa/nub kyi g.yon du pad+ma'i lte bar glang po che la gnas pa dang / mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i/ sā spru khyi shā tshwa rdo rje ma rnams kyang sngon mo/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis nor bu dang be con/g.yon gnyis kyis ne'u le dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes tsho gi dzo par dag po/ /de ltar zla ba mug spyo 'a dgun stod sdi dus so/ /nga ngi khu dāX / gha ghi smra ghu sna ghaX/ ga gi grwa gu sla gaX/ kha khi khra khu khri khaX/ ka ki klo ku kla kāX rnams yojesi su gyur pa las/ 'khor lo ljang khu rnams su gyur te/ kaX dang po byung ba'i 'khor lo dag yongs su gyur pa las/ khyab 'jug ljang khu la gā rdo rje ma dpal mo sngon mos 'byud pa/shar gyi g.yon du pad+ma'i lte bar mkha' lding la gnas pa dang / mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i nga gha ga kha kṛ rdo rje ma rnams kyang ljang khu/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dbyug tho/ g.yon gnyis kyis pad+ma dang skye ba lnga pa'i dung 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ mchu'i zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /kā gī shrī kū lkalā kaXji khri khye kha z-i khaX ska sgo ga t+yā baX zi z-i z-i ༷༷ ngu rdi j-i nga za gli ra mi sgo4 tā tā ḍa/ tswa/zha/ / hā hā sdu sdomā ho sgo dzā tswa9nge lu ngaXrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbyug pa ljang khu rnams su gyur te/ngaXdang spru las byung ba'i dbyug pa dag yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje ljang khu la shrī rdo rje ma skyon rje mo sngon mos 'phyud pa/ lho'i g.yon du pad+ma'i —63—

lte bar ma he la gnas pa dang / mtshan ma lhag ma rnams las byung ba'i/ kā ji gā ghā dhī rdo rje ma rnams kyang ljang khu gtso 'khor thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyi dbyug pa dang ral gri g.yon gnyis kyis lcags sgrog dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nang bskor gyi pad 'dab mdun ma nas brtsams te/ pad 'dab rnams la g.yas bskor gyi rim pas gnas pa/ dbo'i zla ba'i tshes rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /de ltar zla ba gnyis ni dgun smad kyi dus so/ /gtso bo rnams ni rdo rje'i gdan gyis gnas shing bcom ldan 'das la mngon du phyogs pa dang / 'khor rnams ni rol pa'i stabs can rang rang gi gtso bo la mngon du phyogs pa ste/ tshangs pa 'khor dang bcas pa ni gdong bzhi pa/ gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas pa ni gdong drug pa/ gzhan rnams gdong gcig pa/ thams cad kyang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa'o/ /sku'i sgo skyong spro bar bya ste/ ya yig las byung ba'i dbyug pa nag po yongs su gyur pa las khro bo dbyug sngon can nag po phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis kyi phub dang ltos 'gro 'dzin pa la/ lā yig las byung ba'i 'od zer can ma ser mo stobs po che lta bus 'phyud pa/ shar sgor 'od zer can ma'i shing rta la gnas pa dang / ra yig las byung ba'i mda' dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po dmar po phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis mda' dang lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis kyis gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa la/wā yig las byung ba'i skul byed ma dkar mo mi g.yo ba lta bus 'byud pa/ lho sgor tsun da'i shing rta la gnas pa dang /wa yig las byung ba'i gtso shing dkar —64—

po yongs su gyur pa las mi g.yo ba dkar po phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis tho ba dang mdung / g.yon gnyis kyis pad+ma dang me long 'dzin pa la/ rā yig las byung ba'i khro gnyer can ma dmar mo 'dod rgyal lta bus 'byud pa/ byang sgor khro gnyer can gyi shing rta la gnas pa dang / la yig las byung ba'i be con ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ stobs po che ser po phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dbyug pa/ g.yon gnyis kyis dung dang rin po che 'dzin pa la/ yā yig las byung ba'i rdo rje lcags sgrog ma nag mo dbyug sngon can lta bus 'khyud pa/ nub sgor lcags sgrog ma'i shing rta la gnas pa dang / haX yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba ljang khu/phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis dgra stu dang rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis kyis sbrul zhags dang kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa la/ haXyig las byung ba'i shin tu sngon mo gnod mdzes rgyal po lta bus 'phyud pa/ steng du shin tu sngon mo'i shing rta la gnas pa dang / ha yig las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po yongs su gyur pa las/ gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis gri gug dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis kyis thod pa dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ hā yig las byung ba'i drag spyan ma ljang khu gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba lta bus 'khyud pa/'og tu drag spyan ma'i shing rta la gnas pa ste/ khro bo yab yum de rnams thams cad kyang zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa/rab tu khros shing sbrul gyis brgyan pa/khro bo rnams g.yas brkyang dang /khro bo lha mo rnams g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pa'o/ /mi spro na khro mo bstopo rnams kyi sa bon bor kyang wo ngo / /—65—

sku'i stegs bu la rta 'bab kyi ka ba'i nang rol du klu rnams spro bar bya ste/ h+pha khyu las byung ba'i rgyal mtshan dag yongs su gyur pa las/ stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma nag po la/ mkha' lding gdong ma dang / lce spyang gdong ma ser mos 'byud pa/shar sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu'i steng du/rlung gi dkyil 'khor zlum po nag po thig les mtshan pa la gnas pa dang / re grwa las byung ba'i bkra shis 'khyil pa dag yongs su gyur pa las/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar po la/ 'ug gdong ma dang / stag gdong ma dkar mos 'byud pa/ lho sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po bkra shis kyis mtshan pa la gnas pa dang / rna shā las byung ba'i pad+ma dag yongs su gyur pa las/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar po la/ bya rgod gdong ma dang / phag gdong ma dmar pos 'byud pa/ byang sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor zla gam dkar po pad+mas mtshan pa la gnas pa dang / khyu lī las byung ba'i rdo rje ( 〉 rtse ser po ) dag yongs su gyur phywa las/ 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po ser po la/ khwa gdong ma dang khyi gdong ma nag mos 'khyud pa/nub sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu'i steng du/ sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rjes mtshan pa la gnas pa dang / steng du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ljang khu la rgyal ba ljang khu/ rdo rje mig mas 'phyud pa dang / 'og tu ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor sngon po la/rnam par rgyal ba sngon po/shin tu sngon mos 'khyud pas gnas pa ste/ thams cad kyang rdo rje'i gdan gyis gnas shing rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis bdud rtsi'i —66—

bum pa dang rdo rje/ g.yon gnyis kyis pad+ma dang rin po che 'dzin pa'o/ /dur khrod 'khor lo'i steng du rab gtum ma rnams spro bar bya ste/ 1 dang gri gug las byung ba'i khyi gdong ma nag mo la pad+ma chen pos 'byud sngo pa/ shar gyi dur khrod rtse mos 'bigs par bse'i steng du 'khor lo'i gdan la gnas pa dang /spyu dang gri gu las byung ba'i khā gdong ma nag mo la 'jog pos 'byud pa/ shar ca lho'i dur khrod lhag ma can du bhe ru ṇa ḍa'i steng du 'khor lo'i gdan la gnas pa dang / k+ṣa dang gri gug las byung ba'i phag gdong ma dmar mo la rigs ldan sdu gyis 'khyud pa/ lho'i dur khrod ro bsreg se par dom gyi steng du 'khor lo'i gdan la gnas pa dang / d+dhādang gri gug las byung ba'i bya rgod gdong ma dmar mo la mtha' yas /kyis 'byud pa/ bden bral gyi dur khrod drag po'i g.yul du khrung khrung gi steng du 'khor ra lo'i gdan la gnas pa dang / kyā dang gri gug las byung ba'i stag gdong ma dkar mo la dung skyong gis zla 'byud pa/ byang gi dur khrod rul bar 'bri'i steng du 'khor lo'i gdan la gnas pa dang / m+bha dang gri gug las byung ba'i 'ug gdong ma dkar mo la nor rgyas kyis sgro 'byud pa/dbang ldan gyi dur khrod byis pa shi bar bya ma byi'i steng du 'khor lo'i gdan la gnas pa dang / rmyo gri gug las byung ba'i lce spyang gdong ma ser mo la pad+mas 'byud r+ghaṃ pa/ nub kyi dur khrod rnag gi drir seng ge'i steng du 'khor lo'i —67—

gdan la gnas pa dang / gri gug las byung ba'i mkha' lding gdong ma ser mo la stobs kyi rgyus 'byud pa/ rlung gi dur khrod sprul gyis bzung bar mig sngon gyi steng du 'khor lo'i gdan la gnas pa dang / steng dang 'og tu yang sngon mo dang /rdo rje'i mig ma ljang khu dang sngon mo la rnam par rgyal ba dang / rgyal ba dag gis 'byud pa/ shing rta ljang khu dang sngon po la gnas pa ste/thams cad zlum po'i stabs kyis gnas shing / gcer bu phyag rgya lnga brgyan pa/mi mgo'i 'phreng ba mgul du 'phyang ba/zhal gcig pa/spyan gsum ma/phyag gnyis kyis g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor la sa bon dang mtshan ma sna tshogs pa las byung ba'i 'byung po bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi dang / gza' bcu dang ngh+ru wa dang / a ga sdu la sogs pa'i drang srong rnams dang / rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa skar ma thams cad dang / khyim bcu gnyis dang / cha bcu drug dang / phyogs bcu skyong ba dang / dga' byed dbang phyug dang / nag po chen po dang / dril bu'i rna ba can dang / bh+ring gi ni dang / zhing skyong dang / pho nya thams cad dang / 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang / skra'i grangs kyi grub pa rnams/ dbyibs dang / kha dog dang / mtshan ma sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa rnams kyang 'khod par gyur/de nas/ gsung gi stegs bu la 'dod ma rnams spro bar bya ste/tsaXtshaXdzaXdzhaXnyaXrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ sgrol ma las byung ba dbye bar 'dod ma dang / reg bya rdo rje ma las byung ba gos 'dod ma dang / khyab 'jug ma las byung ba mchil ma ma dor bar 'dod ma dang / lcags sgrog ma las byung ba —68—

reg bya 'dod ma dang / khra gdong ma las byung ba lhag ma za bar 'dod ma rnams shar sgo'i g.yas kyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas nga dang / ṭa ṭha ḍa bha ṇa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ gos dkar mo las byung ba bskyod par 'dod ma dang / ro rdo rje ma las byung ba zas 'dod ma dang / gzhon nu ma las byung ba gar 'dod ma dang / khro gnyer can ma las byung ba 'gugs par 'dod ma dang / bya rgod gdong ma las byung ba'i g.yul 'dod ma rnams lho sgo'i g.yas kyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang /pa pha ba bha ma rnams yongs su gyur pa las/mā ma gī las byung ba rgyas par 'dod ma dang / gzugs rdo rje ma las byung ba rgyan 'dod ma dang / dpal mo las byung ba rgyal srid 'dod ma dang / tsun dā las byung ba 'ching bar 'dod ma dang / lug gdong ma las byung ba byis pa sdigs par 'dod ma byang sgo'i g.yas kyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang / ta tha da dha na rnams yongs su gyur pa las/spyan ma las byung ba rengs par 'dod ma dang /dri rdo rje ma las byung ba dri 'dod ma dang / tshangs ma las byung ba chu la rkyal bar 'dod ma dang /'od zer can ma las byung ba phur bus 'debs par 'dod ma dang / mkha' lding gdong ma las byung ba sbrul 'ching bar 'dod ma rnams nub sgo'i g.yas kyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa ste/ lnga pa rnams ni stegs bu'i zur la gnas pa'o/ /sa skra ṣa sha rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shin tu sngon mo las byung ba kun tu gdung bar 'dod ma dang / shin tu brtson 'grus ma las byung ba bskrod par 'dod ma dang / tsar rnyi kā las byung ba lus 'khrug par 'dod ma dang / khyi gdong ma las byung ba yan lag bskyod par 'dod ma rnams shar sgo'i g.yon gyi —69—

stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang la kha ga rnams yongs su gyur pa las/drag spyan ma las byung ba rgyug par 'dod ma dang / rmugs byed pa las byung ba skems par 'dod ma dang /phag mo las byung ba lus kyi dri ma 'dod ma dang /phag gdong ma las byung ba bshang gci zag par 'dod ma rnams lto sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang / gha ngal wa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ sgra rdo rje ma las byung ba rol mo 'dod ma dang / khengs byed pa las byung ma 'jam par smra bar 'dod ma dang / drag mo las byung ba mal stan 'dod ma dang /stag gdong ma las byung ba rtsod pa mang po 'dod ma rnams byang sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang /ra ya ha 'a rnams yongs su gyur pa las/chos kyi khams ma las byung ba 'khrig par 'dod ma dang / rengs byed ma las byung ba gnyen bdun gdod ma dang / dbang mo las byung ba mal stan bsnyes par 'dod ma dang / lce spyang gdong ma las byung ba sems can slu bar 'dod ma rnams nub sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa'o/ /de nas/ sku'i stegs bu la phyir 'dod ma rnams spro ba ni/ rtsa oṃ dza dzña nya rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ sgrol ma las byung ba dbye bar mi 'dod ma dang /reg bya rdo rje ma las byung ba gos mi 'dod ma dang / khyab 'jug ma las byung ba mchil ma 'dor bar mi 'dod ma dang / lcags sgrog ma las byung ba reg bya mi 'dod ma dang / khwa gdong ma las byung ba lhag ma za bar mi 'dod ma rnams shar sgo'i g.yas kyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang / ṭa ṭha ḍa lha ṇa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ gos dkar mo las byung ba skyod par mi 'dod ma dang / ro rdo rje —70—

ma las byung ba zas mi 'dod ma dang / gzhon nu ma las byung ba gar mi 'dod ma dang / khro gnyer can ma las byung ba 'gugs par mi 'dod ma dang / bya rgod gdong ma las byung ba g.yul mi 'dod ma rnams lho sgo'i g.yas kyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang / pa pha ba bha ma rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ mā ma gī las byung ba rgyas par mi 'dod ma dang / gzugs rdo rje ma las byung ba rgyan mi 'dod ma dang / dpal mo las byung ba rgyal srid mi 'dod ma dang / tsun dā las byung ba 'ching bar mi 'dod ma dang / 'ug gdong ma las byung ba byis pa sdig par mi 'dod ma rnams byang sgo'i g.yas kyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang / ta tha da dha na rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ spyan ma las byung ba rengs par mi 'dod ma dang /dri rdo rje ma las byung ba dri mi 'dod mi dang /tshangs ma las byung ba chu la rkyal bar mi 'dod ma dang / 'od zer can ma las byung ba phur bus 'debs par mi 'dod ma dang / mkha' lding gdong ma las byung ba sprul 'ching bar mi 'dod ma rnams nub sgo'i g.yas kyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa ste/lnga pa rnams ni stegs bu'i zur la gnas pa'o/ /sa pi ṣa sha rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shin tu sngon mo las byung ba kun tu gdung bar mi 'dod ma dang /shin tu brtson 'grus ma las byung ba bskrod par mi 'dod ma dang / tsar rnyi ka las byung ba lus 'khrug par mi 'dod ma dang / khyi gdong ma las byung ba yan lag bskyod par mi 'dod ma rnams shar sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang / rno ka kha ga rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ drag spyan ma las byung ba rgyug par mi 'dod ma dang / rmugs byed ma las byung ba skems par mi 'dod —71—

ma dang / phag mo las byung ba lus kyi dri ma mi 'dod ma dang / phag gdong ma las byung ba bshang gci zag par mi 'dod ma rnams lho sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang / ghaX ngaX laX waX rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ sgra rdo rje ma las byung ba rol mo mi 'dod ma dang / khengs byed ma las byung ba 'jal par smra bar mi 'dod ma dang / drag mo las byung ba mal stan mi 'dod ma dang / stag gdong ma las byung brtsod pa mang po mi 'dod ma rnams byang sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa dang / raX yaX haX k+ṣaX rnams yongs su gyur pa las/chos kyi khams ma las byung ba 'khrig pa mi 'dod ma dang / rengs byed ma las byung ma gnyen 'dun mi 'dod ma dang / dbang mo las byung ba mal stan bsnyes par mi 'dod ma dang / lce spyang gdong ma las byung ba sems can bslu bar mi 'dod ma rnams nub sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa'o/ /de ltar ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lor rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes 'khor dang bcas par gyur/ oX 〈shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhi gyi bdag nyid nga'o// 〉su bi shudha dharma dh+wa tu swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/gnyis pa snying rje'i dbang bskur ba ni/ thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa dag gis 'gro ba drug na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad bkug nas dkyil 'khor chen por bcug par gyur/ de nas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshe/gas pa yum dang bcas pa thams cad bkug nas rang gi snying khar rab tu zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa rnams gsang ba'i rdo rje las —72—

spros nas sems can thams cad la dbang bskur bar gyur/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer rnams kyis reg pa'i sems can de rnams mchog gi dga' ba dang bde bas gang ba'i lha'i sku thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid/ zhal dang sku mdog la sogs pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa dang / de dag re re zhing yang skad cig gis lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gyur/ k+ṣa khyi spyu khri snga las phung po lnga rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas lnga dang / nywa gh+ri yi khri sko les khams lnga rnam par dag pa yum lnga dang / k+ṣa slo kyā khyo lngal k+ṣaX las dbang po drug rnam par dag pa sems dpa' drug dang / nywa gh+ri nywar khyo nywal k+ṣaXlas yul drug rnam par dag pa sems ma drug dang / lha spri waṃ khyi las/ las kyi dbang po lnga rnam par dag pa khro bo lnga dang /lju skri spri k+ṣu las/ las kyi dbang po'i yul lnga rnam par dag pa khro mo lnga ste/4 'a 'o sgyu mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par gyur te/ slar yang de rnams rang rang zhing du gshegs su gsol/gnyis pa gsung rdzogs pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag las rgyal mchog ni/ dang por lte ba dang gtsug tor gyi a wa dh+wa ti'i lam du hoXyig dag dang / dpral ba dang /mgrin pa dang / snying ga rnams su sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje oX āXhuX rnams las byung ba'i zla ba dang nyi ma dang sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor rnams 'khod par gyur/hoXyig dus kyi me'i 'od zer gyis steng dang 'og nas sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams bzhus te/ gtum mo shes rab kyi chags pas yab yum gnyis zla ba zhu ba ltar gyur/ lha mo rnams kyis glu dag mdzad de bcom ldan khyod ni sems can —73—

kun la phan par mdzad pa po/ bdag cag srungs shig lha mi'i bla ma rdo rje ldan pa 'dod pa don gnyer rnams la 'dod pa mdzod/ spyan ma bdag ni 'gro ba'i yum/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rgyu mthun gnas/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod//mā ma gī bdag sring mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rnam smin gnas/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /gos dkar mo bdag bu mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi skyes bu'i gnas/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /sgrol ma bdag ni tsha mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dri bral gnas/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod//stong pa'i dkyil 'khor nyams myong nas//'gro ba bsgral ba'i bsam pa yis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba'i mgon pos spro bar mdzod/ /ces pa'i glu rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das stong pa nyid la rab tu zhugs pa 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i slad du bskul ba las/bcom ldan 'das rab tu sad de/ 'gro ba mthar dag sgyu ma lta bur gzigs nas/ gzhan gyi don du slar yang bskyed par mdzad pa ni/ hū las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / de las byung ba'i dus kyi 'khor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ rdo rje'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan zhing / mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i ngo bo sna tshogs yum gyi 'khyud pa'i skur gyur pa dang / 'dab ma brgyad la nus ma brgyad/ phyi rol kyi grwa bzhi la rdo rje bzhi dang bcas pa rnams skad cig gis bzhengs par gyur pa ni/ zla ba'i sku dang zung gi zhabs te me yi —74—

mgrin pa chu gter dpal ldan zhal ni sna tshogs mdog /phrag pa drug dang nyi ma'i dpung pa rgyal ba'i phyag gi pad+ma stong pa drug dang me yi tshigs/ /zhabs dag gis ni zla ba nyi ma bsreg za'i dkyil 'khor dag la bdud dang drag po skrag bzhin pa/ /rol pas mnan pa'i srid med srid mnyam pa dus kyi 'khor lo gcig pu de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje ral gri rtse gsum gri gug mda' dang lcags kyu ḍa ma sa /tho ba 'khor lo mdung dbyug dgra stas g.yas kyi phyag brgyan g.yon pa yang / /dril bu phub dang kha ṭa thod pa gzhu dang zhags pa rin po che/ /pad dkar dung dang me long lcags sgrog tshangs mgos brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stag lpags dang ni rdo rje'i rgyan ldan rdo rje'i sku can bde ba che/ /'od gsal stong nyid sna tshogs yum gyis kun nas rab 'khyud gser mdog ma/ /zhal bzhi phyag brgyad gri gug lcags kyu ḍa ma ru dang bgrang 'phreng dang / /thod pa zhags pa pad+ma dkar dang rin chen 'dzin mar bcas la 'dud/ /nag mo 'bar ma bdug spos tsan dan gur gum dang ni ga bur snod/ /dril bu pad+ma yongs 'du'i me tog sna tshogs me tog 'phreng ldan ma/ /dmar mo'i g.yas na mar me do shal cod pan dang ni gdu bu ste/ /g.yon na gos dang ska rags dang ni rin chen rna rgyan rkang gdub 'dzin/ /dkar mo'i g.yas na 'o ma chu dang sman mchog chang gi snod rnams te/ /g.yon na bdud rtsi grub pa'i bcud dang bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu 'bras chan snod/ /ser mo 'bar ma dung dang gling bu nor bu dang ni ḍa ma sa /pi wa rnga dang zhabar rnga zangs dung rang phyogs gtso bo'i zhal ldan ma/ /de dag dang mtshungs du ba smig rgyu me khyer dang ni mar me ma/ /rang mdog dang mtshungs rnga yab brgyad —75—

ldan phyag rgya lnga yis rnam brgyan ma/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan dang ldan rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma/ /mnyam pa'i stabs can pha rol phyin rdzogs srog gi dkyil 'khor 'gags la 'dud/ /tshad med rnam thar rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dbang dang bsnyen sgrub dga' ba bzhes/ /lus ngag sems dang chags pa'i thig le gnas skabs rnam bzhi rnam dag pa/ /skad cig mkhyen pa sku dang rdo rje byang chub rnam bzhi sems dpa' bzhi/ /chos kyi dung dang gaṇ+ḍi nor bu dpag bsam shing la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de rnams sngon bzhin bskyed kyang chog go/yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa rnams dang / dkyil 'khor pa rnams dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gyi don du rang gi lus la rab tu bcug nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par zhu bar gyur pa rnams/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra spros te/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las lha dang lha mo'i tshogs su gyur pa ni/ aX yig las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ gri gug dgra stu/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje'i dril bu/thod pa/tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa la/rang dang 'dra ba'i sher phyin mas 'phyud pa nam mkhar spros nas sems can gyi don byas te/ slar yang rang nyid la bdag por zhugs par gyur/ i yī las byung pa'i ral gri nag po dag dang / ṛ grwa las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po dag dang / u mū las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po dag dang / '-i lī las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po —76—

dag dang /hi hi hṝ hṝ hu hunywa tshwa haX haXrnams so/ /yaX yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po/ raX yig las byung ba'i dbyug pa dmar po/ waX yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po/ laX yig las byung ba'i tho ba ser po/ a aX las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu dang sngon po dag dang / e i las byung ba'i ral gri nag po dag dang / ar ur las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po dag dang / o au las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po dag dang / /al ul las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po dag dang / ā aXlas byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu po rngeX dag dang / kho spre k+ka smri snyu rnams dang /ha hi hi ya yi lnga yu sla yaX rnams dzñā zla rgyu sgri.ā+oṃlas byung ba'i gri gug nag po 'a/ 'a ka slarnams dang / k+ṣa spyi rnya yā yī sde lta snyo yaXrnams las byung ba'i 'khor lo nag po rnams dang / haXrgyu grwa ra ri shrī ru ru rli raX rnams las byung ba'i dbyug pa dmar po rnams dang / k+ṣaX ljoljo rā rī brnya dzñā raXrnams las byung ba'i shasti dmar po rnams dang / haX hu hu wa wi ldi wu slo waX rnams las byung ba'i rtse gsum dkar po rnams dang / k+ṣaX khri khri wā lti lte 〉 〉 waX rnams las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po rnams dang / hā hṝ hṝ la li ljo lu slo laX rnams las byung ba'i rdo rje ser po rnams dang / nywa spo la lwa lī lte lha ltu laX rnams las byung ba'i bar bu ser po rnams dang / nya nyi gri nyunyunyaX la sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i ral gri nag po rnams dang / tsā rnyi gri tsū tshwa rtswaXl sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i dpag bsam gyi shing nag po rnams dang / ṇa ṇi rje ṇa rlo ṇaX la sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i mdung dmar po rnams dang / khyu khyi hṝ ṭu blo ṭaX la sogs pa —77—

rnams las byung ba'i shalti dmar po rnams dang / ma mi sngo mu slo maX la sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i zhags pa dkar po rnams dang / pā bī sdi pū hṝ pāX la sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i dgra stu dkar po rnams dang / na ni lcu nu slo naX la sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i rdo rje ser po rnams dang /tā tī hṝ tā tā taXl sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i khab ser po rnams dang / sko ni sgro rbonaX la sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i rtse gsum sngon po rnams dang ra/ bī swe skṛ sru spyi snguX la snrogs pa rnams las byung ba'i be con sngon po rnams dang / 'ang ngi dra pu bla rkengaX la sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i 'khor lo ljang khu rnams dang / kā gī krā kū smya kaX la sogs pa rnams las byung ba'i dbyug pa ljang khu rnams dang / ya ra la wa haX hā rnams las byung ba'i dbyug pa dang / mda' dang /lto shing dang / be con dang / rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog can rnams dang / khyu h+phu hā shrī sna h+phu khyu khyu rnams byung ba'i rgyal mtshan dang / bkra shis 'khyil pa dang / pad+ma dang / rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog can rnams dang / zo kū snyi 1 sbya rnams las byung ba'i gri gug phyogs kyi mdog can tram̐l+le sla spruṅgharnam bro/ dang / ca / ༷༷'aXdza/༷༷dzñaXnyaX ṭaXṭhaXḍaXkhyuXṇaXrnga/༷༷tha/༷༷rnga / ༷༷bha/༷༷3/༷༷ /skiXtha/༷༷nga niXju / ༷༷sbya/༷༷ tha5༷༷stu/༷༷khriXrngonaX3spyiḥ mo/༷༷ltabaXb/༷༷sna/༷༷skyuraXlaXwaXraXyaXhaXk+ṣaXrnams dang / rtsa oṃ rjo dzhai nyaX/ ṭaX ṭhaX ḍaX khyuX ṇaX/ paX phaX baX bhaX maX/ taX thaX daX dhaX naX/ saX piX ṣaX shaX sngeX kaX khaX gaX ghaX ngaX / laX waX raX yaX haX k+ṣaX rnams te/ de rnams so sor yongs su gyur pa las/ khu khrag rkang dang khrag gi tshogs can dri chu dri chen —78—

rab 'gags pas/ /zhes pa nas/ srid gsum dang ba mngon du byed gyur cig/ces pa'i bar/ chos rje kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i bstod chen gyi tshig rnams 'don zhing / spros pa'i lha rnams kyi zhal phyag gsal gdab bo/ /ci ste rgyas pa la mngon par dga' bas ni gtso bo sa bon phyag mtshan las bskyed pa dang /mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can du byed pa dang /rdo rje sems dpa' rang la bstim pa ste/ khyad par de tsam ma gtogs/ dkyil 'khore rgyal mchog gi skabs ji lta ba bzhin brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dag pa dran pa ni/ lha mo sangs rgyas rig ma shing dang bcas shing bum pa dang bcas rgyal ba yi ni dag pa'i sku/ /khro bo'i dbang po byang chub sems dpa' nges par ro yi rdo rje ma ni chos kyi sku de nyid/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams longs spyod sku ste rab mchog shing rta la gnas lha ni nyi mar rab grags pa/ /klu ni rgyal po rnams dang rab gtum ma rnams 'khor dang bcas pa sangs rgyas kyi ni sprul pa'i sku/ /de bzhin slar yang rgyal ba'i sku ni dbye ba gnyis su 'gyur te phyi rol dag dang nang du yang / /mngal nas skyes pa ji lta ba nyid de bzhin kho nar dkyil 'khor la ni nges par rab tu 'gyur/ /ston pa lha mo sogs dang bum pa lhan skyes rgyal ba'i sku ste dkyil 'khor snying po'i dbus su'o/ /sangs rgyas la sogs chos kyi sku ste nges par ro yi rdo rje ma sogs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /khro bo sprul pa'i sku ru 'gyur te rigs kyi dbang gis dkyil 'khor gyi ni snying por yang dag gnas/ /phyi rol tu ni tsā mraṇa ḍā la sogs pa lha mo brgyad po 'khor dang bcas pa dag pa'i sku/ /lha la sogs pa chos kyi sku ste mtha' dag gdengs can rigs kyang 'dir ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /gtum mo rnams ni sprul pa'i skur 'gyur mi yi bdag po sems can kun gyi don gyi slad du'o/ /—79—

lo dang zla ba la sogs dbye ba'i dus kyi dag pas dpal ldan rdo rje can 'gyur mi yi bdag /nyin zhag so so rnam par dag pa'i dbang gis sna tshogs yum ni sems kyi rnam pa nyin mtshan min/ /rlung gi dag pas du ba la sogs rang gi snying ga'i pad+ma ra rtsa yi 'khor lo la gnas rnams/ /nyon mongs rnams kyis drag po chung mar bcas pa khyab bdag zhabs kyi 'og tu bdud kyi tshogs kyis bdud/ /de bzhin dung dang gaṇ+ḍi nor bu ljon pa zhes pa dag kyang sku yi rdo rje la sogs kyis/ /bum pa brgyad ni bdud rtsi'i yan lag gis te rgyal dang rnam rgyal bum pa byang chub sems sogs kyis/ /'du byed don yod grub pa tshor ba dri med nor bu'i phyag dang 'du shes snang ba mtha' yas te/ /gzugs ni 'khor lo can no ri bong can dang stobs khrag bshang ba gci ba rnam par dag pa'o/ /lha mo drug ni khams rnams kyis te yul dang yul can rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' phyag rgyar bcas/ /khro bo lnga ni stobs rnams kyis te nges par slar yang gzhan pa lnga ni dbang po gzhan rnams kyis/ /tsā myuṇa ḍā sogs thun brgyad kyis te pad+ma'i 'dab mar gnas rnams nyi ma'i dus sbyor chu tshod kyis/ /lha min la sogs nyi ma'i zla bas pad+ma'i 'dab mar gnas rnams chu tshod dbugs kyi grangs kyis so/ /gsang bar mi bdag nyis 'gyur chu tshod rnams kyis klu rnams dang ni gtum mo rnams kyang rnam par dag/de bzhin 'dod ma la sogs de dag rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis lus kyi bya ba rnam par dag/sgra rnams kyis ni grub pa mtha' dag ba sbu rnams kyis dur khrod sa gzhi la gnas 'byung po'i tshogs/ /de nyid rnams kyis gtso bo'i mtshon cha rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis khams kyi phyi yi phyag —80—

rgya'o/ /rdo rje nang gi phyag rgya rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du yang dag gnas pa'o/ /dpal ldan rdo rje can dang sna tshogs yum ni rnam gsum srid gnas 'gyur med ye shes sbyor las so/ /mdor bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ cung zad rgyas pa la mos na/ sku yi rdo rje lhan cig skyes pa'i sku ni zung du 'gyur te sogs dang /dpal ldan dag pa las ni chos skur 'gyur te/ sogs kyang brjod par bya ste/ sgrub thabs ma mo las 'byung ba bzhin no/ /de nas/ bdag nyid kyi thugs kar hūX yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang /de las byung ba'i rdo rje shugs zhal bzhi pa 'jigs pa'i sku can/rab tu bzhad cing mche ba phyir gtsigs pa/ sgra drag po sgrog pa/ spyan bcu gnyis pa/ phyag nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ shes rab dang thabs las byung ba/ gtso bo bzhin du mtshon cha rnams dang bcas pa/ glang po che'i pags pa'i gos can/ phyag rgya dang ldan zhing mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ thod pa lnga dang / mgo bo'i phreng ba 'phyang ba/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i shing rta la gnas pa nam mkha'i khams su spros te/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi nye bar rdo rje lcags kyus btab cing / phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams rdo rje zhags pas bcings nas mtshon cha lhag ma rnams kyis sdigs pa gyur/ oX shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā ra dzaX khro bo'i dbang po slar yang rang nyid la zhugs par gyur/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā re khyuXbadz+ra gan+taX pra tisnro na maXbadz+ra put+paX/ badz+ra dh+wa paX/ badz+ra dī paX/ badz+ra ni we t+yaX/ badz+ra ak+ṣa taX/ badz+ra lwa phyaX/ badz+ra hā suX/ badz+ra wā kyiX/thodz+ra snu tuX/ badz+ra gī tāX/ badz+ra kā maX pra tisnro na maX hūX waX hoXhi/ lha rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX snying gar huX/ lte —81—

bar hoX gsang bar snya/ gtsug tor du hā rnams 'khod par gyur/ dpral bar āXlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa yongs su gyur pa las/ sku rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas zhal nag cing g.yon zhal dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis 'khor lo/rdo rje/pad+ma/g.yon pa gsum gyis ral gri dril bu/ nor bu 'dzin cing rang dang 'dra ba'i yum dang bcas pa dang / mgrin par ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ āXlas byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gsung rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis pad+ma/rdo rje/'khor lo/g.yon pa gsum gyis nor bu/dril bu/ ral gri 'dzin cing / rang dang 'dra ba'i yum dang bcas pa dang /snying gar aX las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la/ huX las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ thugs rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog nag po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum gyis dril bu/ ral gri/ nor bu 'dzin pa/rang dang 'dra ba'i yum dang bcas pa rnams 'khod pa las rab tu spros te/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rjes 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la chos bstan nas/ slar yang mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ sku'i rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin pa dang /thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyis/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du —82—

gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku rdo rje dang / gsung rdo rje dang / thugs rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pas bdag nyid la dbang bskur bar gyur/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sku rdo rje dang / mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gsung rdo rje dang / snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la thugs rdo rje rnams 'khod par gyur/dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /gsung gi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /gsung gi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /thugs kyi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /thugs kyi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /ces gsol ba btab pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ma rnams kyis bdag la byin gyis brlabs shing /rdo rje gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ 〈de bzhin ltegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid nga'o//〉sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya lha ka tsit+ta swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3ha/ shes rab kyi lte bar ho las sku rdo rje/ gsang bar snya —83—

las gsung rdo rje/gtsug tor du hā las thugs rdo rje rnams 'khod par gyur/ bsdu na dbang bskur ba de tsam gyis chog la/rgyas par spro na snying ga'i 'od kyis dbang gi lha dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ dbang bdun gyi gsol ba gdab pa'i sngags dang /dbang bskur ba'i sngags nga rgyal bzung ba dang bcas pa sngags dbang gi tshul gyis blang bar bya la/ dbang gong rnams ni phra thig gi rnal 'byor las 'grub pa'i phyir skabs 'dir mi bzhed do/ /rgyas bsdus gang ltar yang / mthar/ de ltar dbang bskur bas dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te/ rgyas gdab par gyur pa ni/ rnam par snang mdzad la mi bskyod pa dang /snang ba mtha' yas la rnam par snang mdzad dang / rin chen 'byung ldan la 'od dpag med dang / don yod grub pa la rin chen dbang pos rgyas btab par gyur pa/ dag pa'i phung po chos gos dang gtsug tor 'dzin pa'o/ /de bzhin du rnam par shes pa'i rigs las byung ba ljang khu rnams la mi bskyod pa dang / 'du byed kyi rigs las byung ba nag po rnams la don yod grub pa dang / tshor ba'i rigs las byung ba dmar po rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan dang / 'du shes kyi rigs las byung ba dkar po rnams la snang ba mtha' yas dang / gzugs kyi rigs las byung ba ser po rnams la snang mdzad dang / ye shes kyi rigs las byung ba sngon po rnams la rdo rje sems dpas rgyas gdab/ lha thams cad kyi gtsug tor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la a yig mi bskyod pa dang / snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la i yig don yod grub pa dang / mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ṛ yig rin chen 'byung ldan dang / dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la u yig snang ba mtha' yas dang / lte bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor la '-i yig rnam —84—

par snang mdzad dang / gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la aX yig rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab/ lha rnams kyi nye ba snying ga mgrin pa dpral ba gtsug tor rnams su sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams la/ da u ṛ i a'o/ /lha rnams kyi dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga lte ba rnams su zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan dus me'i dkyil 'khor rnams la oX āXhuX hoX'o//rdo rje nor bur gzhom du med pa'i a yig go /gsum pa sgrub pa'i yan lag thig le'i rnal 'byor dang / bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa las lte ba'i hoXyig glog dang mtshungs pa'i gtum mo ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bar gyur pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i rang bzhin g.yon gyi dkyil 'khor phung po lnga'i rlung dang / spyan ma la sogs pa'i rang bzhin g.yas kyi dkyil 'khor khams lnga'i rlung rnams bsregs shing / mig la sogs pa'i dbang po rnams kyang gzugs la sogs pa'i yul rnams la 'jug pa bsregs nas/ spyi bo'i haX yig zhu ba las glo bur du thig le'i rgyun babs rba sa/ mgrin par sleb pas dga' ba/ snying gar sleb pas mchog dga'/ lte bar khyad par gyi dga' ba/ gsang bar lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba mngon du byas/ oṃ dzñā na pū dza 〈ye shes kyi dga' bas 〉 a nu ra lto 〈rjes su chags pa'i 〉swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/〈rang bzhi gyi bdag nyid nga'o//〉slar yang ji ltar byon pa de bzhin du steng du gshegs pas/ lte bar rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras su lhan cig skyes pa'i sku dang / snyi gar rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu chos kyi sku dang / mgrin par skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / dpral bar dri —85—

ma dang bral ba'i 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku rnams mngon du byas/ oṃ 〈de bzhi ltegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' nga gdul dka' ba 'dul ba po/〉sarba ta thā ga tā a dhi pa ti badz+ra sa tā haX dur dan+ta da ma ka huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas oX badz+ra gan+taX pra ca sogs kyis mchod/ stong nyid snying rje sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyis gong bzhin bstod/ de nas lha sku la sems 'dzin pa'am bzlas pa bya'o/ /de yang da ltar lag len la snying po gtso bor bzla bar snang zhing / rtsa sngags kyang ci rigs par bzla'o/ /gzhan yang mtshan sngags las lhag pa ni sku'i sngags so/ /tso( kā la tshwa kra ya huX swāhā/ gsung gi sngags so/ /skye( kāX swāhā/ thugs kyi sngags so//yang rtsa sngags dang / snying po dang / nye snying dang / sa bon rnams ni sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yeX shes kyi yang bzlas pa'o/ /tseX( skiX phaṭa/ bsnun pa dang / tsho rna kluX huX/ dbab pa dang / skye( rnya bo ṣaṭa/bsreg pa dang / skye tsho lkaX na maX bslang ba dang / tsho( lbāXswāhā/ rgyas pa dang / tsho( kāX wa ṣaṭa/mnyes pa ste/ 'bum 'bum bzla'o/ /de rnams kyang thugs kyi bzlas pa'o/ /de nas oX kā la tshwa kra ya swāhā/ 'bum phrag bcu bzla'o/ /dus kyi 'khor lo shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i sngags/ tsho( 6 swāhā/ zhes pa bye ba bzlas pas bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa'o//yang na skye( āXhuX ༷toXhaX k+ṣaXzhes pa'am/ tso te gisaXhuX rde steX 6 swāhā/ zhes pa'am/tso( hruX khyi hṝhūṃgle hāX zhes pa rnams gang yang rung ba zhig bye bar bzlas pas kyang brnyen pa:/ /oṃ 〈rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo //〉na mo badz+ra sa tā ya/ na mo budha bo dhi sa te khyuX〈sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//〉 na mo badz+ra kro dha in dra rā dze khyuX' rje khro tsho dbang tsho rgyal po rnams la phyag 'phro lo//〉 na mo bi shwa mā tre/〈sna rdzos yum la phyag 'phro lo//〉 na mo bzhi bo dhi satwa de lī khyuX〈4sargyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//〉 na mo badz+ra ḍā ki nī khyuX〈rdo rje mkha' —86—

lus pa gzugs brnyan ltar gsal bar mos te/ dkyil chog tu 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar/ mchod yon mngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs te/ nang mchod des chos 'gyung thig le dang bcas pa byas la/ der dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gsal bar bltas te/ o ba dha ya na ma zhes sogs mchod sngags chen mos mchod par bya'o/ /'di lta bu'i mchod pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa ma yin la/ bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pas mnyes par byed tshul te/ bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rnams maṇ+ḍal gyi nang du gzugs brnyan shar ba lta bu la mchod pa yin no/ /rgyun gyi rnal 'byor sogs la mchod pa rgyas pa de tsam mi lcogs na/bzlas pa'i mthar/ o badz+ra gan+ta pra tisnro na ma sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis gong bzhin mchod par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mchog spyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal bdud/ /sangs rgyas 'dzus pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud/ sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud//sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud//thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sogs 'dud nyi shus bstod/ spro na/ gang la thog mtha' dbus med sogs kyis kyang bstod/—93—

gsum pa ni/ gtsug tor du rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo dang /snying gar rdo rje rtse mo dgu pa'i lte bar nus ma rnams dang /dpral par rdo rje rtse mo bcu bdun pa'i lte bar phung po dang khams bzhi'i lha dang /mgrin par rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lte bar skye mched bcu gnyis khro bo bzhi dang bcas pa lus dang bsam pas rab tu phye ba rnams dang / lte bar rdo rje rtse mo drug cu rtsa lnga pa'i nye bar gsung gi rnal 'byor ma brgyad po drug cu rtsa bzhis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang /gsang bar rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lte bar sku'i sgo skyong rnams dang / las kyi 'khor lo'i tshigs chen bcu gnyis por rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gcig pa rnams kyi nye bar lha chen po bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / rkang pa dang lag pa'i sor mo'i tshigs rnams su klu dang rab gtun/ mo rnams gshegs su gsol/ de nas spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug na/ smon lam gdab cing bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa yang brjod nas/ thun mtshams la 'jug go /gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na yang / nyer bsdu'i rjes nyid la bya ste/ gtor ma bshams/ oṃ phre badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ badz+ra dh+wa tī shā rī/ ga ga na swa bhā wa sarba dra bya bi sho dha ni/ sarba dra bya ṇi bi lha( dha ya huX phre phaṭa ces pa dang / oṃ āXdz+waX/ hraXphaṭa kyis bsangs/su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum la gnas pa'i oṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ thod pa dum bu gcig pa/ de'i nang gi dbus su a las byang sems/ shar du i las rkang dmar/ lhor ṛ las —94—
