rak+ta/ byang du u las dri chu/nub du '-i las dri chen/ rlung mtshams su lī las glang po che'i sha dbang ldan du mū las ba glang gi sha bden bral du grwa las rta'i sha me mtshams su yī las khyi'i sha dbus kyi steng du ā las mi'i sha rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ sku rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od zer gyis ma dag pa'i rdzas rnams sbyangs par gyur/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sogs gong bzhin/lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du nyi ma la gnas pa'i ā gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo/de'i 'od zer gyis dag pa'i rdzas rnams spel bar gyur/oṃ u badz+ra srur+ya sogs/ lag pa gnyis ka sbyar ba'i dbus su sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hu thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od kyis rdzas rnams kha dog dri ro nus mthu gzi brjed phun tshogs pa 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ hu badz+ra a na la sogs/mkha' lding gi phyag rgya'i dbus su dus me la gnas pa'i ho yig ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo'i des 'od zer gyis zag med ye shes mchog gi bdud rtsir byas par gyur/ oṃ hosarba dharma sogs gong bzhi brjod pa ni gtor ma byin gyis bsas pa'o/ /'di ni ma sto pa ste/ gtor ma dang nang mchod byin khos rgyas pa ni 'di ltar bya la/ 'bring po ni sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin dang /bsdus pa ni/bsangs sbyangs sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ ud / ho zhes brjod pa tsam yin zhing / oṃ phre badz+ra ḍā ki nī sogs kyi sngags de kho nas kyang rdzas mtha' dag byin gyis brlob pa ste/ 'di yang bsdus pa'o/ /de nas mgron spyan drang pa ni/ sangs rgyas yab yum bcas pa sras bcas g.yog 'khor dang / /grogs bcas gnyen rnams dag gis skor ba'i tshogs pa ni/ /lha dang lha mo dag gis mnyes par byed rnams dang / /mchog gi rdo rje sems dpa' dag ni gshegs su gsol/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las —95—

'das pa'i lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ ha hā hi hi badz+ra dzhai ra wa/ ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ bhan+ta ya/bhan+ta ya/to ṣa ya/to ṣa ya/ dzaXhūX baX hoX badz+ra ḍā ki nī hri da ya huX huX phre phre phaṭa/ces pas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyang spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra gan+taX pra titsā na maX nas/ kā maX gyi bar brjod/ oX āXshuX hoX shrī kā lwa tsa grwa badz+ra bhe ra wa sgyi ka rā ya/ zhes 'don pa spos la/ sde drug bsrung ma drug cu'i tshogs dang bcas pa la gtor la 'bul tshul bsrung 'khor skabs bzhin te/rgyal ba rigs drug go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa'i bar ro/ /bar 'dir sgos kyi chos skyong rnams la'ang phul nas/ oṃ ā:hūX badz+ra ḍā ki nā khyoX sa pa ri wā re khyuX i daX/ ba li/gan+taX/ put+paX/ ga paX/ dī paX/ ak+ṣa taX/ zhes sogs yul gyi bdag po'i gtor sngags dang 'dra bas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gtor ma phul/ sngon 'gro'i skabs su brjod pa ltar/ yul gyi bdag po dang / grong gi bdag po la yang 'bul te/ a pa ra za naX ca ru swāhā/ zhes pa'i dod du/ su za naX ga tsā ca swāhā/ zhes sgyur ba ni khyad par ro/ /spro na mchod pa bcu gnyis phul/mkha' 'gro lnga bstod dang / lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /sogs dang / mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs bya/ bsdu na ma byas kyang chog de dag gi mthar/ steng na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bdud kyi phyogs gnas lha ma yin rnams mchog tu 'jigs byed dang / /mi yi 'jig rten dag na phyogs bral du gnas khro bo'i rgyal po btsun mor bcas rnams dang / /sa 'og dag na gdengs can dbang po gang dag gdon tshogs mi dge dus kun du ni 'ching byed pa/ /de rnams thams cad nyin zhag so so'i dus su mi shes 'jig rten kun nas skyong bar byed gyur cig /oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs kyi shis pa brjod/yig brgya'i mthar/bzod —96—

gsol/ gshogs gsol/ spyi dang 'dra zhing / ye shes kyi 'a nar lo rang nyid la thim/ bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams du ba la sogs lam gyis lhan skyes bde ba mchog bsgoms te/ /'gro ba'i bla ma sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan ldan sku 'di chos kyi 'khor lor yang dag gnas/ /lha rnams mgo yi gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od zer tshogs kyis zhabs kyi pad+ma la gshugs shing / /dam pa'i lam ston nyin byed bzhin du mun pa kun 'joms dus kyi 'khor lo nyid gyur cig /nyi ma dang bcas thub pa'i rigs rnams kyis ni shes rab ye shes thob par gyur 'di ji lta bar/ /rnam gsum srid par gnas pa'i sems can rnams ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i drin las e wa nyid gyur cig /skyes bu gang dag bdud kyi grogs kyis rtag tu mi bden mun par song zhing lam nyams pa/ de rnams lam 'di thob nas rdo rje nor bu'i khyim dang ring ba min par 'ong gyur cig /rnal 'byor bdag cag rnal 'byor ma thob rab tu g.yo ba'i yid kyis gal te shi bar gyur na yang / /dpal ldan mi yi 'jig rten du ni rab mchog thub pa'i rigs su rnal 'byor ldan par skye ba dang / /sngon gyi goms pa de yis slar yang ye shes rnal 'byor yangs pa dag ni kun tu 'dzin pa dang / /ye shes thob nas mi zad mchog gi gnas su rab bgrod slar yang gang du'ang skye ldan min gyur cig /dgra dang seng ge glang chen dbang po me dang ltos 'gro'i bdag dang chom rkun zhags pas 'ching / /chu gter 'khrugs dang sha za 'chi ba'i 'jigs byed nad dang dbang po'i nye bar 'tshe ba dang / /dbul dang bud med dang bral mi bdag 'khrugs pa'i 'jigs dang rdo rje ltung dang don nyams rnams/ /bdag gis rnal 'byor ma rnams zhabs ni gsal bar —97—

dran pa'i mthu las rab tu nyams gyur cig /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dus kyi 'khore lo 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /rigs su skye dang dam tshig can/ /smyo med dus kyi 'khor lo ston/ /bla ma la gus snying brtse ldan/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar rbe(ga /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang / btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam za can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces sogs smon lam ci rigs par gdab po/ gzhan yang kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang / gnyid kyi rnal 'byor dang / rmi lam gyi rnal 'byor dang / ldang ba'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa rnams la'ang nan tan du bya ste/ bla ma'i zhal snga las rgyud don zhib mor mnyan pa dang / chos rje thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dpag bsam ljon shing las shes par bya zhing / sgrub thabs kyi go don zhib mo mtha' dag kyang ngo / /khyad par nges don mthar thug dang 'brel ba'i lugs 'di nyid dang bka' srol 'di nyid la/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan dpa' bzang po zhes mtshan brjod par dka' ba de nyid rnam pa kun tu tshad mar byed dgos te/ shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po ston pa gnyis pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nyid kyis nye bar sbyar ba'i sgrub thabs rim pa drug yod pa rnams blta ba dang / nyan pa dang / bsam pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas nges pa gting tshugs par byas nas/ slad kyi dpal dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi bskyed rim ston byed yan lag dang bcas pa rnams la nan tan du byas na/ blun po rdzun gyi man ngag la skyabs 'tshol ba dang / mkhas pa glegs bam mthong bas nga rgyal ba rnams kyis rang bzos ma bslad par rdo rje 'chang chen po'i lam ma nor ba rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa'i thabs —98—

'di yang / sgrub thabs dpag bsam ljon shing zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gsung dang bye brag ma mchis pa de kho na'i dgongs don gzhir bzhag nas/ ngag 'don rnams chos rje yab sras kyi gsung las ji ltar brjod pa bde ba dag blangs shing / sgrub thabs kyi tshig gi dngos bstan la med kyang / phyag len las 'byung ba gsung gzhan las dpags na/ dgongs don la yod nges pa rnams kyis cung zad kha bskang ba yin no/ /gang 'dir gcig tu rang dga'i blo ngor nas/ /'phags pa'i gsung nyid dpang du byas nas bsdus/ /de ltar lags kyang 'khrul ba'i cha mchis na/ /bdag gis nongs pa mkhas la bzod par gsol/ /'di la gang gi lhag bsam dag pa yis/ /nye bar bskul dang mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar dang / /bdag gis 'bad las bsod nams gang skyes pa/ /de yang 'gro ba'i byang chub don du bsngo/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs dpag bsam ljon shing la 'jug pa zhes bya ba 'di yang / don gnyer can du mas bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo sum cu rtsa bdun pa la nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su sbyar ba'o// //oṃ snyu sti/ dpag yas rgyal ba'i nges gsang bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rim gyi/ /snying po rmad byung sgrub pa'i thabs gyi mchog /dpag bsam ljon pa'i ngag 'don 'bras bu'i dpyid/ /gang 'di mi thab chos kyi 'byung khungs su/ /legs par 'grub na gzhan phan mkha' khyab ces/ /nges par dgongs nas lha rigs sems dpa'i brgyud/ /4chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams dbang phyug gi /'phrin las mchog gyur dge bas par du bsgrub/ /dge des 'di la 'brel ba thogs pa rnams// sngon du 'gro ba'i mtha' yas skye dgu'i tshogs/ /phan bde'i mthar thug byang chub che thob shog /—99—

shes rgya mtsho ltos la go don long / /ye shes rgya mtsho'i dgongs don 'di bzung na/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i don kun rtogs par 'gyur/ / oṃ snya sti/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho'i dgongs don zhes bya ba/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi sku ni kun 'gro mi zad gzhom du med/ /gsung gi ska dkyang ri'agro kun skad kyis lam rab ston/ /thugs ni bde ba dam pas gang ba'i ye shes nyid/ /'phrin las mtha' yas kun mkhyen ston pa de la 'dud/ /chos tshul rgya mtsho 'di la legs zhugs na/ /spobs pa rgya mtsho nges par skye 'gyur bas/ /yon tan rgya mtsho don gnyer shes ldan dag /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog la 'jug pa'i phyir/ /ngag 'don shin tu bzung bde ba/ /dam pa'i gsung gi yi ge dang / /bla ma'i man ngag dang bcas par/ /mdo tsam 'chad la spro ba skyes/ /de la sdom ni/ slob dpon slob ma yong brtag gsol gdab mchod/ /dus dang sa sogs brtags nas cho ga brtsams/ /sa dang gsol gdab bum pa thig skud tshon/ /rdo rje dril bu slob ma sta gon dang / /mal stan lhag par gnas rnams sta gon te/ /thig gdab tshon dgye sbyin sreg bum pa dgod/ /sngon du 'gro bas dkyil 'khor rab gnas mchod/ /dkyil 'khor tshen por slob ma gzhug pa rnams/ /dbang gi sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga yin/ /chu dang cod pan de bzhin dar dpyangs dang / /rdo rje dril bu brtul zhugs ming gi dbang //rjes gnang dbang ste rnam bdun bsod nams rgyur/ /slob ma 'bring po rnams la mkhas pas sbyin//mchog gyur la ni bum pa gsang ba dang / khres rab ye shes tshul khrims tshogs kyi rgyur/ /de nas —100—

bzhi pa don dam phyag rgya che/ /ye shes tshogs kyi don du spyin par bya/ /'di dag gis ni dngos gzhi'i cho ga bsdus/ /dbul ba'i nges pa gshegs gsol rim pa dang / /bsnyen bkur rim pa dpa' bo'i ston mo yi/ /nges pa dag ste rjes kyi cho ga'o/ /kun spangs la ni mtha' dag tshig gis sbyin/ /srid gsum ma lus snying rje'i dbang gis bsdus/ /slob dpon la ni bdag po bdag po che/ /zhes pa'o//de la dang po slob dpon dang slob ma yongs su brtag pa ni/ dbang gi cho ga chen mo ye shes rgya mtshor shes par bya la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob mar 'gyur ba des/ maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ bcom ldan 'das gang du mtshams med pa lnga byed pa po rnams kyang / skye ba 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thob par lung ston zhing / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bde ba mchog tu mi 'gyur bas yang dag par bsdus pa'i phyag rgya chen po thob par lung ston pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang / dbang bskur bas mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes bla ma la lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis kyang khas blangs la/ 'og tu 'chad pa ltar so shing byin la/ mgo bor u yig sogs rigs drug gi sa bon bkod/ yid kyis bsrung ba bya/ sngags kyi che ba brjod la spro ba bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / gtor ma dang / rnal 'byor ma mchod pa rnams kyang nges par bya ste/ de ltar na gsol ba gdab cing mchod pa 'di ni/ gzhan du slob ma rjes bzung du grags pa nyid do/ /de'i rjes su dus nges pa dang / sa yongs su brtag pa yang dbang chog chen por shes par bya'o/ /'di man chad kyi don rnams bsdu na/ sa'i cho ga dang / lhag par gnas pa dang /dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang / dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang / dbang gi bya ba dang / rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /dang po ni bris sku la sogs pa dgram/ mchod pa rnams lag len bzhin du bshams/ slob dpon shar du mngon par phyogs pa'i mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod rnams nges par bsham zhing / cang te'u dang /gzhan yang rol lo'i bye brag rnams kyang tshogs par byas/ 'dir rgyud sde gzhan nas gsungs pa'i —101—

sngon 'gro gtor ma ni mtha' gcig tu mi dgos kyang / lag len la mdzad cing phan yon lhag po las skyon du 'gyur ba med par mngon/ yul bdag grong bdag gi gtor chog nyid rgyud 'di'i lugs kyi sngon 'gro gtor ma yin la/ de yang gnyis kar byed pa rang lugs yin no/ /bdag bskyed kyi sngon 'gro'i skabs ma byas kyang chog mod/ byas na legs pas sngon 'gro gtor ma lcog zlum gcig zlum gtor nyis sgrigs tshar gnyis dang / bsrung 'khor gyi mthar bsrung ma drug cu la 'bul rgyu'i gtor ma bdun nam/ gcig sa lha'i gcig gzhan zlum gtor bzang po gnyis rnams dang / gzhan yang mchod pa mang po dang bcas pa rnams grabs su tshud par byas nas/ thog mar nang mchod la dmigs te/ tsho( āXhuX hraXphaṭa/ tsho( sbi bhā wa shu khyu/༷༷sarba dharmāXsu bhā wa sko ) ( ྅haX/skye( āXhuX hoX zhes byin gyis brlabs/ de nas tshogs pa yod na sngon 'gro gtor ma'i zhu 'bul bya/tshogs pa med na mi dgos/ skye( āXhūX hraXphaṭa/ tso rna spyo bhā wa sogs/ tsho( skye( badz+ra tsan+d+ra sogasadang / oṃ āXbadz+ra srur+ya sogs dang / oṃ hūX badz+ra a na la sogs dang / oṃ hoXsarba dharma sogs sngags tshan bzhis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ h+pha badz+ra a ra snyi ho/ dzaXhuX baX hoXbadz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya stuX/ khru khyo ho/ oṃ kha kha/ ji hi ji hi/tso1 cigazo cig〉 sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa/〈gnod sbyin srin po 〉 bhā ta 〈wang po 〉 pre ta 〈yi dwags 〉 pi shā tse/〈sha za 〉 ud man dwa 〈spyo byed 〉 a lpi smu ra/〈brjed byed 〉 ḍā ka ḍā ki ni dā ya/〈mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma rnams la ster ba'i 〉 i daX ba li/〈gtor ma 'di 〉 gri snan tu/〈bzung du gsol/〉 sa ma ya rak+ta skye/〈dam tshig bsrung ba kyis shig〉 ma ma sarba sirnyi me pra ya:khyi/〈bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsal tu gsol/〉 ya the baX ya the niX/〈ji ltar 'dod pa de ltar 〉 bhu dzā thā/〈bza' ba 〉 dzi gh+ra tha/〈myang ba 〉 pi pā tha/〈bco ba 〉 ma ti kra ma tha/〈rim pa lasam 'das par 〉 ma ma sarba ka rta ya/〈bdag gi dgos pa thams cad 〉 sad su khaX bi dz+wa’ste/—102—

〈bde ba dam pa rnam par dag pa'i 〉 sa hā yi ka 〈grogs ma sgo 〉 bha wan+tu huX huX phaṭa swāhā/〈ma sgo du gsol/〉 oṃ badz+ra gan+taX pra ru na maX badz+ra pulgaX badz+ra dh+wa paX/ badz+ra dī paX/badz+ra ni wi t+yaX/ badz+ra ak+ṣa taX/ badz+ra lwa gyaX/ badz+ra hā phyaX/ badz+ra wā t+yaX/༄badz+ra snu tuX/ badz+ra gī taX/ oX badz+ra kā maX pra titsā na maX mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang / /gnod spyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / kha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /spyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus ji snyed mchis pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod —103—

sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzode/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'khru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /gang dag dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams mchod pa dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa'i bya ba la bar chad thams cad mi 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig nag po'i phyogs la dga' ba dang / gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces pa'i mthar bdud sreg pa'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad la/ tshams rngams dang rol mo'i sgra drag po bya/ rdo rje'i rwa gur sa gzhi la sogs pa dang / me'i gur sogs yid kyis bsams te/ bgegs dang mtshams bcad pa'o/ /de nas gnas yo byin rlabs kyi zhu 'bul bya/ rdo rje'i rtse mos nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ āXhūX hra phaṭa/〈rdo rje bzhi'i sa bon 〉 oṃ swa bhā wa 〈rang bzhin 〉 shudzñāX〈dag pa rnams 〉 sarba dharmāX〈chos rnams thams cad 〉 swa bhā wa shurnyo dzo3haX/〈rang bzhi dag pa'i bdag go/〉 stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bhuX las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang / gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su —104—

rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ shel gyi snod sor bcu gnyis pa rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āXhuX hoXrnams las byung ba'i chu dang / mchod yon dang / dri dang / me tog dang /bdug pa dang / snang gsal dang / zhal zas dam pa dag dang / rnam pa mang ri po'i 'bras bu ma nyams pa dang / gos dang / rgyan dang / ba dan dang / bla bre la sogs pa dang / glu dang / gar dang / me long dang / dril bu la sogs pa sil snyan gyi tshogs du ma dag dang / in+t+ra nī la la sogs pa rnam pa mang po'i rin po che dang / nang gi dam tshig rnams dang / nga/ma tshigs rnam pa bzhi'i rdzas la sogs pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu dpag tu med cing dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra gan+taX 〈rdo rje dri 〉swāhā/ badz+ra pulgaX 'a rje me mā 〉badz+ra dhū paX/'a rje bdug pa 〉 badz+ra dī paX/'a rje sgron me 〉 badz+ra nai wi tuX/〈rdo rje zhal zas〉 badz+ra ak+ṣa taX/〈rdo rje 'bras bu 〉 badz+ra lā phyaX/〈rdo rje sgeg mo 〉 badz+ra hā phyaX/〈rdo rje ba tsā ma 〉 badz+ra bā t+yaX/〈rdo rje sil snyan 〉 badz+ra khru t+yaX/〈rdo rje gar ma 〉 badz+ra gī tshuX/〈rdo rje glu ma 〉 badz+ra kā maX 〈rdo rje 'dod ma 〉 swāhā/ rol chen dang bcas te/ oX hoX〈gtso mo'i sa bon 〉 badz+ra lha rnye 〈rdo rje dril bu 〉 sarba dharma i ka 〈chos thams cad rnyag pa 〉pradzñā dh+wa ni swa bhā we/〈shes rab kyi rang bzhin 〉 sa rba ā kā re/〈rnam pa thams cad pa 〉sarba dharma pra bo dha ni/〈chos thams cad rab tu sad par byed pa 〉 sarba dharma na niX〈chog thamar+sācad 〉 su bhā we na/〈rang bzhi med pa 〉 pra po dha ya pra po dha ya swāhā/〈rab tu rtogs par mdzod mdzod/〉 zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas zhu 'bul ni/ phyag gsum btsal te maṇ+ḍal bkod/phyag gsum btsal te me rta ge bkram/ phyag gsum btsal te zhu 'bul bya/ de yang / ṭa/na bzang rnam 'phrul mchod pa'i sprin phung gis/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa —105—

dang / /yon bdag bgegs zhi tshogs gnyis bsag bya'i phyir/ /gnyis med ting 'dzin dag la gnas par ma sgo/ /ces so/ /phyag gsum btsal te me tog bsdu/ phyag gsum btsal te maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ tso( badz+ra bhā mi āXhūX/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āXhuX/ phyi lcags ri mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ hūX ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho dzam+bu gling / byang sgra mi snyan/nub ba glang spyod/ sgra gcan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dus me/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ tshogs kyi slob dpon zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gu ru i daX rat+na maṇ+ḍa la kaX ni rlu ta yā mi/ de nas tshogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon des kyang maṇ+ḍal kha gsos te gsol ba gdab bo/ /de rjes phyag gsum btsal te ci bder 'khod/ de ltar na zhu 'bul phyag dang bcas pa 'di rnams tshogs pa yod na bya la/ tshogs pa med na mi dgos shing / tshogs pa yod kyang 'di dag bor bas chog chad pa'i nyes par 'gyur ba ni ma yin no/ /de rjes skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i bar sgrub thabs su ji skad 4zhad pa'i mngon rtogs rdzogs par bsgom pa las/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod bstod bsdus pa byas pa'i mthar/ gtsug tor du rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa nas/ rab gtum/ ma rnams ga kho/gas su gsol/ zhes bsdus la/ slar yang / skye( sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti badz+ra satwa ā haX dur dwan ta da ma ka huX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes nga rgyal bzung /yul bdag grong bdag gi gtor ma cha gnyis pa de chu chang nang mchod kyis sbyangs/ oṃ āXhuX hraXphaṭa kyis bsangs/ sā bhā was sbyangs/ glu( tsho( sogs sngags tshan bzhis byin gyis brlabs/de nas oṃ āXhuX yul gyi bdag po sa pa ri wā ra sogs lan gsum dang / oṃ āXhuX grong —106—

gi bdag po sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ dril bu 'brol bzhin du/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan yang rung / /dkyil 'khor don du sa 'di ni/ /bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ /sa'i phyogs 'dir bdag rdo rje rnye mo 〈slob dpon ming 'di 〉 zhes bgyi bas/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs par 'tshal na/ khyed rnams kyis sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la stsal te/ ji srid dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du gnas gzhan du gshe/gas shing / bdag cag slob mar bcas pa la phan pa dang /zhi ba'i sems dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gtor ma phyir btang zhing rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /de nas bdud tshogs sreg pa ni/ rang nyid dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur gsal ba'i dpral par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ dkar po las rdo rje rtse mo bcu bdun pa dang / zhes pa nas/ bhasmi ku ru ku ru huX huX phaṭa phaṭa kyi bar te/ shugs drag pos me'i sngags de lan mang du bzla bar bya'o/ /de nas sa'i lha mo la gnang ba zhu ba ni/ mdun du dri bzang po'i maṇ+ḍal la me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ sa lha'i mchod gtor bshams/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ laX las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ sa'i lha mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ser mo/g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis 'khordo ra lo/ dbyug pa/ khro bo'i rdo rje/ g.yon pa gsum gyis dung / rdo rje'i lcags sgrogasgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin zhing / pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/na bza' ser po can/ rin po che'i rgyan ser pos brgyan pa'i dpral par oṃ/mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ lte bar hoX thugs ka'i huX las 'od 'phros/—107—

sa'i lha mo ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX dam tshig sems dpa' dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ lāX āXhuX/ ba su dha ri sarba brnya dza na ni/ sarba satwa u pa kā ri ṇi/ badz+ra sa tā udzñā pa ya ti/ shi gh+raX/ ā ru ā ru i daX/ gan+taX/ puṣ+ṭhaX/ dh+ra paX/dī paX/ ni we t+yaX/ pha la ak+ṣa taX/ da dā mi ta wa twa me kha/ kṛ hā kṛ ṇ+ḍa/ maṇ+ḍa la ir thaX/ ma ma za naX da da/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis byon te tshom bu'i steng du 'khod pa la/ rang gi snying gar bzhugs pa'i sa'i lha mo yang thim/ ba sun dha ri sa pa ri wā re khyeX ar+ghaX pra tismo na maX gan+taX: pulgaX ga paX/dī paX/ ni we t+yaX/ pha la ak+ṣa taX pra tismo na maX zhes pa rnams kyis mchod/ gtor rmo sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āXhuX ba sun dha ri pa ri wā re khyuX i daX ba kla sogs bsrung ma drug cu'i gtor sngags dang 'dra bas phul nas/rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rgyal bas lha yi bdag po dang bcas bdud ni bcom pa dag la lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /de phyir khyod ni mchod par bya yis lha mchog gis btung ba bzhes shig bzhes shig bdag gi mchod yon no/ /ji ltar rgyal bas byang chub slad du bdud kyi sde ni stobs ldan dag kyang rab tu bcom gyur pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis kyang ni slob ma rnams la dbang bskur slad du bdud rnams nyams pa dag tu bya/ /khyod dpang du gyur pas so/ /sarba sa tā nāX/ shwarnyi spun kṛ tā shu bha/ tsiste na/ i daX sna naX/kyi k+ta a pa ra ra naX/ ga smo ga smo swāhā/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar bsdu'o/ /yungs kar dang dri bzang gi chu dang / shing thal rnams bsres pa dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la gtor zhing / oṃ āXbigha nā na ta krita huX/ ces lan nyer gcig tsam brjod/ oṃ bhu khaX nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ hūX laX huX rdo rje'i rang bzhin du —108—

gyur/ oX me di ni badz+re bha wa badz+ra ban+ta hūX/ lngoX ha na ha na badz+ra kro dha hūX phaṭa/ oX āXhūX sho dha ya sho dha ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa huX hūX phaṭa/ ces brjod cing lag pa sa la reg ste byin gyis brlabs/ 'di ni da ltar lag len byed pa la/ khang bzang dang / gtsug lag khang dang / dkyil 'khor khang pa rnying par dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i dbang du byas te/ sa gzhi brko sbyangs mi dgos pa'i lugs yin la/ gzhan du na skabs 'dir lto 'phye brtag pa dang / sa brko ba dang / sel dbyung ba dang / gter gzhug pa rnams kyang dgos te/ dbang chog chen por shes par bya'o/ khang bzang la sogs par yang sa'i stegs bu byed na gter gzhug pa sogs pa 'ga' zhig dgos so/ /de nas bsrung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ slob dpon mas gos kyis klubs/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir 'dug ste/dang por haX las byung ba'i nam mkha'i rang bzhin zhes pa nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rak+ta tsakra swa bhā ba ut+pa ko3haX/ ces pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin no/ /de nas phur gdab ni/phur bu bcu mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ oX āXhūX hoXlan bcu gnyis kyis mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ skye rna āXhuX hraXphaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ phur bu rnams stong pa'i ngang las/ huX bcu las byung ba'i khro bo'i rgyal po gdong drug 'jigs pa khams drug rnam par dag pa rigs drug gi bdag nyid can/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas gnyis nag po dang dmar ba/ g.yon gnyis dkar po dang ser ba/ steng zhal ljang khu/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ gri gug dgra stu/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu/ thod pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs drug pa/ khro bo'i rgyan dang cha byad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/nye bar hoX rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' khro bo —109—

badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+ra gī li gī li ya sarba bi lhan ban+da hūX phaṭa/ 'a wu brjod/ gan+dhaX sogs mchod pa stso gnyis phul/ phur bu'i khro bo rnams lte ba man chad mdung gi rtse mo lta bu phur bu'i dbyibs can 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrug pa/ sa gsum gyi bdud dang bgegs thams cad 'joms pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis phur bu phyogs khor rim bzhin 'debs pa las/ tshigs bcad rnams kyi skabs/ slob dpon gyis phur bu lag tu thogs/tshigs bcad de yang dbyangs dang bcas pas byed/ tsho( āXhūX hoXhaX k+ṣaX nas/ gī la ya huX huX phaṭa phaṭa kyi bar sngags dang pos phur bu bsgril zhing phyogs so sor phur gdan la 'debs/ oṃ lha badz+ra nas/ gyu rta huX huX huX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa kyi bar sngags phyi ma 'don dus/ phur bu'i steng du tho ba'am tho ba'i phyag rgyas 'debs tshul du byed/ oṃ haX sogs phur bu bsrung ba'i khro bo'i sngags lan gsum brjod dus/ phur bu'i khro bo bgegs la btab cing / phur pa nyid kyang bsrung ba dang /gzhan yang phyogs kyi bgegs bsrung ba'i don du/ bsrung 'khor gyi khro bo las khro bo gnyis pa zhig chad de/ phur bu'i rgyab tu bzhugs par mos/ don de bzhin yid la bzhag nas/ shar gyi shar tu phur bu bto pa ni/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal khro bo che/ /nyi zla tshangs sogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gdug pa can rnams gzhom pa'i phyir/ /phur bus thob cig gī la ya//oṃ āXhūX hoXhaX k+ṣaXhūX huX huX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa badz+ra gī la/ kā ya nywa ka tsit+ta dzñā na a dhi pa ti ṣaḍa mu kha/ ṣaḍa bhu dza/ ṣaḍa tsa ra ṇa/ sarba rna bi nā ya ka ā di du gu nāX/ kā ya lha ka tsit+ta dzñā nā ni/ gī la ya gī la ya huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ oṃ snyiXbadz+ra mud ga ra/ mā ra ā dī nāX/ si ra si ka rje hrī da ye nā bho gu hre/ a rnye badz+ra gī la kwan/ ā ko ṭa ya/ ā ko ṭa ya/ k+ṣaX khriX cu k+ṇi ljo ñdza khyiX khriX tha spo huX huX hūX phaṭa —110—

phaṭa phaṭa/ oX haX badz+ra kro dha rā dza mahā u / ṣa ur dha di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ de bzhin du gzhan rnams la yang sbyar te/shar du/bgegs mthar byed pa khro bo che/ /dbang po nyed dbang 'khor dang bcas/ /gdug pa can: /phur bus thob: /oṃ āXhūX hoXhaX k+ṣaX: oX slu badz+ra: oṃ yaX badz+ra kro dha rā dza a ti bā la sarba bisna an+ta ka purba di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ lhor/shes rab mthar byed khro bo che/ /gshin rje ma mo 'khor dang bcas/ /gdug pa: /phur bus: /oṃ āXhūX hoXhaX k+ṣaX: oṃ snyi badz+ra:oX raX badz+ra kro dha rā dza rja bha ka du rtse pradzñā an+ta ka dak+ṣi ṇa di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/byang du/ pad+ma mthar byed khro bo che/ /gnod spyin nor lha 'khor dang bcas//gdub pa: /phur bur /oṃ āXhuX hoXhaX k+ṣaXje oṃ lto badz+ra: oṃ waX badz+ra kro dha rā dza mā nā ka bi rā ka pad+ma an+ta ka ut+ta ra di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ nub tu/ gshin rje mthar byed khro bo che/ /chu bdag klu yi ge bor dang bcas/ gdug pa /phur bus:/ oX āXhūX hoXhaX k+ṣaX: oX lhu badz+ra: oṃ laX badz+ra kro dha rā dza staX bha ka ya ma an+ta ka pa nyi ma di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ nub byang du/ stobs chen rgyal po khro bo che//rlung lha rig 'dzin 'khor dang bcas/ /gdug pa: /phur bus: /oṃ āXhūX hoXhaX k+ṣaXngu oṃ lha badz+ra ngu oṃ lwaXbadz+ra kro dha rā dza mahā bā la bā ya byāX di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ byang shar du/ mi g.yo rgyal po khro bo che/ /dbang ldan 'byung po 'khor dang bcas/ gdug pa: /phur bus: /oṃ āXhuX hoXhaX k+ṣaX: oṃ ldi badz+ra oṃ nywalaX dro kro dha rā dza a tsa la yī shan di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ lho nub tu/'dod pa'i rgyal po khro bo che/ /bden bral srin po 'khor dang bcas/ /gdug pa /phur bus: /oX āXhuX hoXhaX k+ṣaXje oX grwa badz+ra: oṃ rāXbadz+ra kro dha rā dza ṭak+ki ne ṛ t+yāX di shi rak+ṣaX ku —111—

ru ku ru swāhā/ shar lhor/ lo/ga sngon rgyal po khro bo che/ /me lha drang sro nga 'khor dang bcas/ /gdug pa: /phur bas: /oṃ āXhuX hoXhaX k+ṣaX: oṃ snya badz+ra: oṃ yāXbadz+ra kro dha rā dza nī la daṇ+ḍa asne skruX di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ 'og tu/ gnod mdzes rgyal po khro bo che/ /sa lha lha min 'khor dang bcas/ gdug pa can rnams gzhom pa'i phyir/ /phur bus thob cig gī la ya/ /oṃ u huX hoXhaX k+ṣaXngu oṃ blu badz+ra: oṃ hāXbadz+ra kro dha rā dza sum bha a dho di shi rak+taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ rdo rje'i tho bas brdungs te bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bde ba chen por ro gcig pa'i de bzhin nyid rnam par dag par gyur/ de nas phur bu bcu bsrung ba'i khro bo bcu dang bcas pa rnams la mchod pa'i don du/ gtor ma gcig mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs sngags tshan bzhis byin gyis brlabs/ mchod pa rnams kyang / skye( āXhuX ho / ༷༷zhes byin gyis brlabs/ skye( āXhuX hoXspu sku 〉 ṣa sogs bsung ma drug cu'i skabs ltar khro bo bcu la phul/ oṃ badz+ra gan+taX sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ ha hā yi yī dzoXwu lha slo shrī oṃ āXhuX/ zhes nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan gtsug tor sogs/ rlo ka ga gis bstod/ ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs mtha' dag bsrung ba dang / zhi ba dang /gzhom pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /de dag ni phur gdab kyi bya ba'o/ /de nas ji srid cho ga ma grol gyi bar nyin re bzhin dus gsum du phur bu rnams la yungs kar gyis gtor/ gu gul gyis bdug dri bzang gi chus bsangs gtor bya/ 'grub na sgos kyi gtor ma re yang 'bul zhing / gal te ma lcogs na bsrung 'khor dang dkyil 'khor la gtor ma 'bul ba'i skabs/ phur bu'i lha la dmigs nas gsol ba 'debs pa la'ang nan tan du bya'o/ /mdor bsdus pa'i tshe stangs stabs kyis sa bzung ba med kyang chog la/ cung zad spro na lugs 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa ni/ oṃ —112—

huX kro dha in dro sogs kyis nga rgyal bzung la/ rkang mthil gnyis su huX hūX rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas reg rdo rje'i rkang stabs kyis dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bcags nas/ gzhi bca' sngon du 'gro ba'i g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang mnyam pa'i stabs rnams bya'o/ /yaX yāXdang ral gri'i phyag rgya dang / shar du 'chag ste zlum po'i stabs so/ /raX rāXdang rin po che'i phyag rgya dang / lhor 'chag ste rol pa'i stabs so/ /laX lāXdang 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang / nub tu 'chag ste sa ka'i stabs so//baX bāXdang pad+ma'i phyag rgya dang / byang du 'chag ste taṇ+ḍa pa'i stabs kyis so/ /nub tu rdo rje'i skyil krung dang / byang du pad+ma'i skyil krung kyang bshad de/ 'di tsam zhig rgyud 'grel las 'byung ngo / /phreng ba sogs gzhan nas kha bskang ba'i gar gyi cho ga rgyas pa ni 'dir ma bshad do/ khres par 'dod na kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i gar dpe dang / lag len mthong ba brgyud pa las shes par bya'o//(〈khyu〉 gnyis pa ni/) slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la mchod pa'i don du mchod pa bshams/ tsho( āXhuX hoX lan bcu gnyis kyis byin gyis brlabs/ badz+ra gan+taX pra ru na maXnas/ badz+ra kā maX pra tismo na maX zhes pas dam tshig gi sa gzhi la mchod/ sngar sa'i lha mo gshegs su gsol ba spyan drangs te sa la thim par mos te/ oX āXlaX huX sarba bud+dhā dza na ni zhes pa nas/ za naX dang zhes pa'i bar dang / sa'i lha mo sa gzhi la thim/slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ don dam ye shes kyi rang bzhin rdo rje'i sa gzhi spyan drangs te dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ āXlwaX huX/ badz+ra bhā mi tiṣ+ṭha ma tsa la huX hūX phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra udzñā pa ya ti swāhā/ zhes lan mang du brjod/ rmeng mchod pa kha gsos te/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX pra ca na maX nas/ kwa maX pra tismo na maX zhes pas sa gzhi la mchod de/ sa lhag par gnas pa'o/ /slar yang bsrung 'khor bzhin bsrung ma drug cu'i gtor ma 'bul te/ 'byung po'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su —113—

gsol gyi bar bya/ bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams sogs smon lam dang bkra shis gang 'grub cig bya'o/ /nyi ma dang po'i bya ba'o/ /de nas mchod pas sangs sbyangs byin rlabs nas bzung / da ma ka huX huX phaṭa/ kyis nga rgyal bzung ba'i bar/ gong nyi ma dang po'i skabs dang 'dra/de nas rgyud sde gzhan gyi cho ga'i sa lha lhag gnas mi dgos te/ gong du rdo rje'i sa gzhi bkug ste sa gzhi byin gyis brlob pa de nyid 'dir rang lugs kyi sa lha lhag gnas rmad du byung ba yin pas so/ /des na/ gsol ba gdab pa dang / rdzas lnga lhag gnas dang / slob ma lhag gnas dang /mal stan lhag gnas rnams so/ /dang po ni dkyil 'khor lhag gnas kyi don yin te/ dkyil 'khor kyi sa gzhir dri bzang gis byugs/ spyi 'gro dang mthun pa'i dgos pa yod pas lhag gnas mi 'chol ba'i phyir/ thig chen brgyad dang / sku gsung thugs kyi rtsa thig dang / mda' yab kyi thig dang / bde chen 'khor lo dang / gtso bo'i pad+ma'i thig rnams skam thig tsam btab la/ lha so so'i gnas su me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i srol yod pa ltar phya / thig dang tshom bu dgod pa 'di nges par dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /gzhan yang me tog sil ma bcal du bkram/ mtha' skor du mchod pa dang gtor ma lag len bzhin bshams/ mdun bskyed/ skye( āXdza huX hraXphaṭa kyis bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung 'byung ba rim brtsegs lhun po dang bcas pa'i steng du / thugs gsung sku'i dkyil 'khor rnams mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyogs kun tu ye shes kyi 'od zer mtha' yas pa kun tu 'phro ba/dbang po'i gzhu dang / me long gi gzugs brnyan dang / pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs par snang la rang bzhin med pa/ rang gi sems nyid kyi so sor snang ba/so sor rang gis rig pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul/ gzhom du med cing rdul phra rab kyi chos las 'das pa/ dwangs shing sgrib pa med la phyi nang kun tu 'od gsal ba/—114—

mtshane nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing / rgyan gyi rnam pa mchog tu bkra ba du mas mdzes pa/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la/ zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa/ gnas thams cad du lha'i gdan thams cad kyis mdzes pa'o/ /gdan rnams kyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor stu1 yab yum/ nus ma bcu// de bzhin ga kho/gas pa yab yum bcu/ sems dpa' yab yum bcu gnyis/ khro bo khro mo brgyad/ gzungs ma bcu gnyis te thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang / rnal 'byor ma brgyad thabs dang bcas pa rnal 'byor ma drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor ba dang / 'dod ma sum cu rtsa drug ste gsung gi lha tshogs rnams dang / lha chen po bcu gnyis so sor shes rab ma dang bcas shing / pad 'dab la gnas pa'i lha mo nyer brgyad nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba/ tshes kyi lha sum brgya drug cu'i tshogs rnams dang / sgo skyong gi khro bo'i rgyal po drug po so sor yum dang bcas pa dang / phyir 'dod ma sum cu rtsa drug dang / klu rgyal chen po bcu shes rab ma dang bcas pa ste/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzhal med khang la gnas pa rnams dang / dur khrod 'khor lor bzhugs pa'i rab gtum ma bcu thabs dang bcas pa dang / rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i 'byung po bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi la sogs pa dang bcas pa rnams skad cig gis grub par gyur pa ni/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i bdag /srid gsum skye 'jig med pa'i dngos/ /zhes pa nas/ srid gsum dang ba mngon du byed gyur cig/ces pa'i bar kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i bstod chen 'don bzhin du/ zhal phyag rnams legs par gsal btab bo/ /—115—

rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mchod pa'i yul du badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa nam mkha' gang bar bzhug/sa/ oṃ āXhuX hoXtri dh+wa tu ke shwa ra 〈khams gsum dbang phyug 〉kā la tsakra 〈dus kyi 'khor lo 〉 ar+ghaX 〈ma rdzo yon 〉 pra titsā 〈so sor bzhes〉 sa pa ri wā raX〈'khor dang bcas pa rnams 〉 twaX 〈khyod 〉 bha ga wān 〈bcom ldan 'das 〉 me wa ra do bha ba shi rtsi ṇi tsa/〈bdag la mchog kun stsol bar mdzod/〉 zhes pa lan gsum/ oX shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā re khyuXpu duX pra tismo na maX de bzhin du/ añtsa ma naX pra titsā na maXprok+ṣa ṇaX pra tismo na maX khams gsum dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das/ /dus kyi 'khor lo 'khor bcas rnams/ /rnam dag rdo rje'i dri mchog 'di/ /bzhes nas bdag la mchog shom stsal mdzod/ /oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā re khyuX zhes kun la sbyar te/ badz+ra gan+taX pra ca na maX rkang pa gsum snga ma bzhin kun la sbyar te/ rdo rje me tog rnam bkra'i tshogs/ /badz+ra puṣ+ṭhaX pra stu sto na maX rdo rje bdug spos bla na med/ /badz+ra ga paX pra titsā na maX rdo rje sgron me 'od rab 'bar/ /badz+ra dī paX pra titsā na maX rdo rje zhel zas ro mchog ldan/ /badz+ra nai wi skye pra titsā na maX rdo rje ma nyams 'bras bu'i mchog /badz+ra ak+ṣa taX pra tismo na maX rdo rje sgeg mo'i mchod pa ni/ /badz+ra lwa phyaX pra tismo na maX rdo rje bzhad ma'i mchod pa 'di/ /badz+ra hā suX pra titsā na maX rdo rje sil snyan rnam mang po/ /badz+ra bā t+yāX pra titsā na maX rdo rje gar gyi mchod sprin 'di/ /badz+ra dra t+yāX pra titsā na maX rdo rje glu dbyangs yid 'phrog ldan/ /badz+ra gī taX pra tismo na maXrdo rje 'dod ma'i mchod pa mchog /badz+ra kā maX pra titsā na maX nang ma rdzo ni/ gong ltar —116—

byin gyis brlabs/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun thams cad kyi ngo bo/dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag po/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi skyob pa/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'di lko bya ba'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /o u hā/ dngos grub rgya mtsho yon tan rin chen gter//— srid dang zhi ba'i gdung ba sel ba'i sman/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang la mchod par 'bul/ /o u hu/ nyi ma'i 'od dang zla bzang lha dbang dang / /gzi brjid zlas byin lha yi dbang phyug dang / /sna tshogs gzugs dang lha yi dbang ldan te/ /chos rgyal chen po brgyad la mchod par 'bul/ /o u hu/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa pad+ma dkar po dang / /bzang po rnam rgyal bshes gnyen bzang po dang / /phyag na rin chen khyab 'jug sbas pa dang / /nyi ma grags dang shin tu bzang po mchod/ /o u hū/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal rgyal dka' nyi ma dang / /sna tshogs gzugs dang zla 'od mtha' yas dang / /sa skyong dpal skyong seng ge rnam gnon dang / /stobs chen ma 'gags mi yi seng ge mchod/ /o u hu/ dbang phyug chen po mtha' yas rnam rgyal dang / /drag po zhes bya nyi shu rtsa lnga po/ /sa yi 'khor lo rdzogs par skyong ba ste/ /tshangs pa lha dbang phyed phyed skyong rnams mchod/ /o u hu/ 'od srungs la sogs dum bur skyong ba brgyad/ /de ltar sa skyong sum cu rtsa lnga ni/ /rigs kun gcig tu mdzad pa gsang sngags kyi/ /rigs ldan brgyud pa rnams la mchod par 'bul/ /o u hū/ dus zhabs gnyis dang nā len+d+ra pa dang / /zla ba mgon po 'bro ston lo tsā dang / /lha rje sgom pa sgro ston gnam brtsegs dang / /grub chen yu mo rnams la mchod par —117—

'bul/ /oṃ u hā/ chos kyi dbang phyug nam mkha' 'od zer dang / /sprul sku jo 'bum grub thob se chen dang / /chos rje 'jam gsar chos sku 'od zer dang //kun spangs chos rje rnams la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ u hā/ byang sems chen po yon tan rgya mtsho dang / /kun mkhyen chos rje sgra bsgyur sku mched dang / /phyogs las rnam rgyal nya dbon chos rje dang / /grub chen kun blo rnams la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ u hā/ 'jam dbyangs dkon bzang 'jam dbyangs chos dbang dang / /slob dpon chos seng mkhas grub sangs ye dang / /'jam dbyangs dkon bzang nam mkha'i mtshan can gnyis/ khres rab bkra shis rje btsun grol mchog mchod/ /o u hā/ nam mkha' dpal bzang rat+na bha dra dang / /grol mchog zhabs dang sangs rgyas ye shes dang / /byams pa'i mtshan dang rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /mkhan chen chos dbang kun dga' dpal 'byor mchod/ /o u hā/dkon mchog rin chen lung rigs rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen te/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rme ngon sum ston mdzad pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ u hu phyis kyang mjug gi tshigs rnams rim pas 'don pa bsgyur bar bya'o/ /(〈dza〉 waṃ༈ lung rigs rgya mcho'i rjes nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā tha dang / /sngon sbyangs dam pa rin chen rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /mkhas grub dam pa blo gros rnam rgyal mchod/ /oṃ u hū/ grub pa'i dbang phyug ngag dbang 'phrin las dang / /'jam dbyangs ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal zhabs/ /kun dga' dar rgyas 'phrin las rnam par rgyal/ /lhun grub rgya mtsho rnams la mchod pa —118—

'bul/ /tsho( āXhuX/ ༈ 'jigs med rnam rgyal chos 'phel rgya mtsho dang / /ce rgyas kyi 'phags pa kun dga' dpal ldan rje/ /ngag dbang chos 'byor kun dga' mkhas grub dbang / /bstan pa gsal byed rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /tsho te āXhūX/ rdo rje bzang po dkon mchog dar rgyas dang / /blo gros grags pas rgyal bstan rab spel ba/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor mngon sum ston mdzad pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /tsho( āXhuX/ 'dzam thang gtsang chen gzim khang bde rnyen bshud sgrub dpal sgyu phyo brung gi gdan rabs rim byon ltar blo baṭīng rtos 'phyel bas bris pa'o )oṃ bsnyi ya na maX〈sangs rgyas la mchod do//〉 oṃ dharmā ya na maX〈chos la mchod do//〉tseX( saX ghā ya na maX〈dge 'dun la mchod do//〉 tsho( badz+ra sa tā ya na maX〈rdo rje sems dpal la mchod do//〉 oṃ pradzñā pā ra mi tā ske na maX〈shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la mchod do//〉skye tshe swa bhā bi rka kā yā ya na maX〈rang bzhin pa'i sku la mchod do//〉 tsho( dharmā kā yā ya na maX〈chos kyi sku la mchod do//〉 oṃ saX bho ga kā yā ya na maX〈longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la mchod do//〉 oṃ hā/rmya ṇa kā yā ya na maX〈sprul pa'i sku la ma rdzo do//〉 oṃ dzñā na badzā ya na maX〈ye shes rdo rje la ma rdzo do//〉 oṃ tsit+ta badzā ya na maX〈thugs rdo rje la ma rdzo do//〉 oṃ nywa ka badz+ra ya na maX〈gsung rdo rje la mchod do//〉 oṃ kā ya badzā ya na maX〈sku rdo rje la ma rdzo do//〉 oṃ tsa stung bi mo slo smyo na maX〈rnam par thar pa bzhi rnams la mchod do//〉 oṃ tsa tun pra rmi bi hā re smyo na maX〈sgos pa'i gnas bzhi rnams la mar do//〉 oṃ sa sta tri shad bo dhī pā smi ka dharme spyo na maX〈byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rnams la mchod do//〉 glu( tsa tur shī tī sma ha sra dharma skan khyu smo na maX〈bzhi dang brgyad cu'i stong phrag chos kyi phung po rnams la mchod do//〉—119—

oṃ sarba dharmā de sha ke spyo na maX〈chos thams cad ston pa po rnams la mar do//〉 oṃ rat+na tra yā ya na maḥ〈dkon mchog gsum la mchod do//〉 tsho( shākya mu ne ye na maX〈shākya thub pa la mchod do//〉 oṃ kā la tsa grwa ya na maX〈dus kyi phrog ra lo la ma rdzo do//〉 oṃ dwa nā pā ra mi tā ske na maX〈sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mchod do//〉 glu( shrī ya pā ra mi tā yi na maX〈tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mchod do//〉 oṃ nywa rnyi pā ra mi tā ske na maX〈bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la mchod do//〉 oṃ bir+ya pā ra mi tā yi na maX〈brtson lnga1ba kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ma rdzo do//〉 oṃ sgyu na pā mi tā yi na maX〈bsam gto gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mchod do//〉 oṃ pradzñā pā ra mi tā yi na maX〈shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mchod do//〉 o sna/ pā ya pā ra mi tā yi na maX〈thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mchod do//〉 oṃ pra ni dh+wa na pā ra mi tā yi na maX〈smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mchod do//〉 skye'o ba la pā ra mi tā yi na maX〈stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mchod do//〉 oṃ dzñā na pā ra mi tā ye na maX〈ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mchod do//〉 oṃ dza ya gha ṭi sbyo na maX〈rgyal ba'i bum pa rnams la mchod do//〉 skye( bi dza ya gha ṭi lco na maX〈rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa rnams la mchod do//〉 tsho te sarba tsi ha ne sbre rdo na maX〈thams cad mtshan ma rnams la mchod do//〉 oṃ sarba mu drwa smyo na maX〈thams cad phyag rgya rnams la mar do//〉 oṃ tsin+t+ra ma ṇi yi na maX〈yid bzhin gyi nor bu la mchod do//〉 oṃ dharma gaṇa sbyi na maX〈chos kyi ga rjel ma rdzo do//〉skye( dharma shaX ji ya na maX〈chos kyi dung la mchod do//〉 tsho( kalpa bri khyu ya na maX〈dpag bsam gyi shing la mchod do//〉 oṃ a khyo bhā ya na maX〈mi bskyod pa lamachod do//〉 oṃ a mo gha sing dha ye na maX〈don yod grub pa la mchod do//〉 oṃ rat+na sam+bha wā ya na maX〈rin r+pā lwa/nga ldan la mchod do//〉 oṃ a mi tā bhā ya na maX〈'od dpag med la mchod do//〉 oṃ be+e ro tsa nā ya na maX〈rnam par snang mdzad la mchod do//〉 oṃ 'e1 tsa na yi na maX〈spyan ma la mchod do//〉 oṃ —120—

mā ma kyai ske na maX〈bdag gi ma la mchod do//〉 skye( paṇ+ḍa rā yi na maX〈gos dkar mo la mchod do//〉 oX tā rā ske na maX〈sgrol ma la mchod do//〉 oṃ badz+ra bhā tī shwa ra ske na maX〈rdo rje dbyings kyis dbang phyug ma mchod do//〉 tseX( badz+ra pā ṇa yi na maX〈phyag na rdo rje la mchod do//〉 oṃ kha ga lha ya na maX〈nam mkha'i snying po la mchod do//〉 tsho( khyi ti ga lha ya na maX〈so'i snying po la mchod do//〉oṃ lo rna ke shwa rā ya na maX〈'jig rten dbang phyug la mchod do//〉 i tshe sarba ni ba ra ṇa bi skam bhi ne na maX〈sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la mchod do//〉tsho( sa man+ta bha drwa ya na ma ༷༷〈kun tu bzang po la mchod do//〉 skye( gan+dha badzā ske na maX〈dri rdo rje ma la mchod do//〉 oṃ rū pa badzā yi na maX〈gzugs rdo rje ma la ma rdzo do//〉 oṃ rā sa badzā yi na maX〈ro rdo rje ma la ma rdzo do//〉 oṃ spa zhi badzā ske na maX〈reg bya rdo rje ma la mar do//〉 oṃ sha lta badzā yi na maX〈sgra rdo rje ma la mchod do//〉 oṃ dharma bhā tu badzā be+e na maX〈chos khams rdo rje ma la mchod do//〉tsho(rdo thog 〉 khri ya na maX〈gtsug tor can la mchod do//〉 tso( bi lhan an+ta kā ya na maX〈bgegasamathar byed la mchod do//〉 tsho( pradzñā a/zla kā ya na maX〈shes rab mthar byed la mchod do//〉skye( pad+ma an+ta kā ya na maX〈pad+ma mthar byed la mchod do//〉 mdze ya ma 65rnya kā ya na maX〈gzhin rje mthar byed la mchod do//〉 i tshe ra ce na maX〈rengs byed ma la mchod do//〉 glu rna mā ni ce na maX〈nga rgyal byed ma la mchod do//〉 oṃ sto bhi ce na maX〈rmugs byed ma la mchod do//〉oṃ a ti brir+sā yi na maX〈shin tu brtson 'grus ma la mchod do//〉 oX a ti nī lā yi na maX〈shin tu sngon mo la mchod do//〉 oṃ sarba dh+wa ri ṇi smyo na maX〈thams cad gzungs ma rnams la mchod do//〉 8kho ṣa ḍāX gā ya na maX〈yan lag drug la mchod do//〉〈thugs dkyil la'o//〉oṃ badz+ra tsartsi kā yi na maX〈rdo rje rtse kā la ma rdzo do//〉 oṃ badz+ra wā rā hai na maX〈rdo rin phag mo la mchod do//〉 oṃ badz+ra ma he shwa rī na maX〈rdo rje dbang phyug wo mo la ma sto do//〉—121—

oṃ badz+ra e sgri yi na maX〈rdo rje dbang mo la ma rdzo do//〉 oṃ badz+ra pra grwa sbyi na maX〈rdo rje tshangs ma la ma rdzo do//〉 oṃ badz+ra mahā la k+ṣa myi na maX〈rdo rje dpal r+ṣa mo la ma rdzo do//〉 oṃ badz+ra ko mā phyi na maX〈rdo rje ga smo nu ma la ma rdzo do//〉 oṃ badz+ra biṣ+ṭha byi na maX〈rdo rje khyab 'dig ma la ma rdzo do//〉 oṃ aṣ+ṭa aṣ+ṭa ke na tsa tuXskesgro badz+ra yo gi nī khyo na maX〈brgyad pa brgyad kyi bzhi dang drug 'tsho rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams la mchod do//〉 oṃ ṣaṭa tri shad i tsā sbyo na maX〈drug dang sum cu'i 'dod ma rnams la mchod do//〉 〈gsung dkyil pa la'o//〉oṃ badz+ra biṣ+ṭha be na maX〈rdo rje khyab 'a sdug la ma sto do//〉 oṃ badz+ra ni ri t+yā ya na maX〈rdo rje bden bral la mchod do//〉 oX badz+ra asna ye na maX〈rdo rje me lha lam mad do//〉 oṃ badz+ra urnya ye na maX〈rdo rje rgya mtsho la ma rdzo do//〉 oṃ badz+ra iṇ+ḍa ya na maX〈rdo rje dbang po la mar do//〉 oṃ badz+ra sī shwa ra ya na maX〈rdo rje dbang phyug la ma rdzo do//〉 oṃ badz+ra prad+ma ṇi na maX〈rdo rje chas pa la mar do//〉 oṃ badz+ra bi nā ya kā ya na maX〈rdo rje log 'dren la ma rdzo do//〉tseX( badz+ra kwa rti ke yā ya na maX〈rdo rje gri gug can te gdong drug la mchod do//〉 eX( badz+ra bā ya be na maX〈rdo rje stsu lha la ma rdzo do//〉 oṃ badz+ra ya mā ya na maX〈rdo rje ge ni na rje la mar do//〉 oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi spyo na maX〈rdo rje gnod spyin rnams la mchod do//〉 oṃ bā ru sbyi maX〈chu lha mo la mchod do//〉 oṃ bā ya be+e na maX〈rlung lha mo mchod do//〉 oṃ yā mi ce na maX〈gon na rje mo la mchod do//〉 oṃ yak+ṣi rje na maX〈gnod spyin mo la mchod do//〉 oṃ mahā ba lwa ya na maX〈stobs po che la mchod do//〉 oṃ a tsa lā ya na maX〈mi g.yo ba la mchod do//〉 oX ṭak+ki rā dzā ya na maX〈'dod pa'i rgyal po la mchod do//〉 oX shī la da nā ya na maX〈stug pa sngon po la ma rdzo do//〉oṃ sum bhā rā dzā ya na maX〈gnod mdzes rgyal po la mchod do//〉 tsho'o ro dra asnye na maX〈drag spyan ma la mchod do//〉 oX badz+ra shrī kha lā ske na maX〈rdo rje lcags sgrog mal mchod do//〉 oṃ tsin —122—

dā yi na maX〈skul byed ma la mchod do//〉 oX blo ku khyi na maX〈khro gnyer can ma la mchod do//〉tsod mā rī rtsu na maXpo snod zer can ma la mchod do//〉 oX pra s+t+ya ka mā sa bhe de na 〈so so re re zla ba'i dbye bas 〉 khri sti ut+ta ra tri 〈drug stso lhag pa 〉sha ta badz+ra ti thi de bī khyo na maX〈sum brgya rdo rje chos kyi lha mo rnams la mchod do//〉 tseX( ṣaṭa tri shad pra titsā sbyo na maX〈drug dang sum tsu'i mi 'dod ma rnams la mchod do//〉 tsho( badz+ra dza yā ya na maX〈rdo rje rgyal ba la mchod do//〉 tsho( badz+ra karko ṭa kā yā na maX〈rdo rje stobs kyi rgyu la ma rdzo do//〉 oX badz+ra bā su ka ye na maX〈rdo rje nor rgyas la mchod do//〉 eX( badz+ra a nan+ta ya na maX〈rdo rje mtha' yas la mchod do//〉 tsho( badz+ra tak+ṣa kā ya na maX〈rdo rje 'jog po la ma rdzo do//〉 oṃ badz+ra mahā pad+ma ya na maX〈rdo rje pad+ma r+ṣa po la mchod do//〉 tsho( badz+ra ku li kā ya na maX〈rdo rje rigs ldan mchod do//〉 tseX( badz+ra shaX kha pā lā ya na maX〈rdo rje dung skyong la mchod do//〉 oX badz+ra pad+mā ya na maX〈rdo rje pad+ma la mchod do//〉tseX( badz+ra bi dza yā ya na maX〈rdo rje rnam par rgyal ba la mchod do//〉 〈sku dkyil pa la'o 〉skye( shā nā byā yi na maX〈khyi gdong ma la mchod do//〉 skye rna snyu ka rā byā yi na maX〈phag gdong ma la mchod do//〉 tseX( byā ghā byā yi na maX〈stag gdong ma la mchod do//〉 tseX( dzam+bu kā byā yi na maX〈lce spyang gdong ma la mchod do//〉 tseX( ga ru ḍā sgyu yi na maX〈mkha' lding gdong ma la mchod do//〉 skye( u pū kā sgyu yi na maX〈wa/ gdong ma la mchod do//〉 tseX( gro dh+wa byā yi na maX〈bya rgod gdong ma la mchod do//〉 oX kā kā sgyu yi na maX〈bya rog gdong ma la mchod do//〉 oX sarba dh+wa te sgo na maX〈'byung po rnams thams cad mchod do//〉 〈dur khrod du gnas pa la'o//〉 ༄oX badz+ra tsan+d+ra ya na maX〈rdo rje zla ba la mar do//〉 oX badz+ra sna sde ya na maX〈rdo rje nyi ma la mchod do//〉 oX badz+ra ma rgo lā ya na maX〈rdo rje bku shis la mchod do//〉 oX badz+ra bu dh+wa ya na maX〈rdo rje gza' lhag la mchod do//〉 oṃ badz+ra bṛ ha spa ta ye na maX〈rdo rje phur bu la mchod do//〉—123—

o badz+ra shu krā ya na ma 〈rdo rje pa sangs la mchod do//〉 oṃ badz+ra sha niñtsa rā ya na ma 〈rdo rje spen pa la mchod do//〉 oṃ badz+ra ke ta be na ma 〈rdo rje mjug ring la mchod do//〉 o badz+ra rā ha be na ma 〈rdo rje sgra gcan la mchod do//〉 oṃ badz+ra kā lāsna yi na ma 〈rdo rje dus me la mchod do//〉o badz+ra dhu be na ma 〈rdo rje brtan pa la mchod do//〉 skye( badz+ra a ga sdu ya na ma 〈rdo rje ri byi la mchod do//〉 oṃ sarba na k+ṣa tre spyo na ma 〈rgyu skar rnams thams cad la mchod do//〉 o dā da sha rā si khyo na ma 〈bcu gnyis kyi khyim rnams la mchod do//〉 skye( kho ṭa sha ka lwa khyo na ma 〈bcu drug gi cha rnams la mchod do//〉 o da sha di ka pā le rtso na ma 〈bcu gnyis kyi phyogs skyong rnams la mchod do//〉 o badz+ra na n+di ke shwa rā ya na ma 〈rdo rje dga' byed dbang phyug la mchod do//〉 o badz+ra mahā kā lā ya na ma 〈rdo rje nag po wo po la mar do//〉 o badz+ra lha ṇ+ḍa ka rje ya na ma 〈rdo rje dril bu'i rna ba can la mchod do//〉 o badz+ra sgro gi ṇi na ma 〈rdo rje 'bring gi ṇi la mchod do//〉 o sarba spyo tra pā le sbyo na ma 〈zhing skyong rnams thams cad la mchod do//〉 o sarba dū tī spyo na ma 〈pho nya mo rnams thams cad la mchod do//〉 tse( hā ri s+t+ya sbyo na ma 〈'phrog ma rnams la mchod do//〉tsho( sarba sirnyi rje/ na ma 〈grub pa rnams thams cad la mchod do//〉 〈'jig rten pa rnams la'o//〉o dharma tsa grwa ya na ma 〈chos kyi zha bor lo la mchod do//〉 o bha dra gha ḍā ya na ma 〈bum pa bzang po la mchod do//〉 oṃ badz+ra dun du khyi na ma 〈rdo rje rnga bo che la mchod do//〉skye( bo dhi prik+ta ya na ma 〈byang chub kyi shing la mchod do//〉 〈sku'i rta babs kyi mtshan ma la'o//〉o gu ru brnya bo dhi sa te lco na mo na ma 〈bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mchod cing phyag 'tshal lo//〉 gzhan yang rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khore gyi lha tshogs thams cad la mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo//oṃ ā hu/ bka' sdod chos skyong bsrung ma thams cad la mchod pa dam pa 'bul —124—

lo/ /o ā hu/ yul bdag grong bdag gnyug/ mar gnas pa thams cad la mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /o u hā/ rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la 'bul lo/ /oṃ u hu/ zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud tshim nas/myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar gyur cig /de nas bstod pa ni/ gang la thog mtha' dbus med gnas dang 'chi dang srid pa dang ni sgra dang dri dang ro dag dang / /reg bya gzugs dang sems med rang bzhin dang ni skyes bu med cing 'ching dang grol dang byed po med/ /sa bon dang ni gsal bar dus med mtha' dag srid pa'i sdug bsngal bde ba nyid kyi rang bzhin med/ /mya ngan 'das pa mtshan ma med cing byed pa rnams bral yon tan med pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus dang sna tshogs la sogs rdo rje dang ni skyes bu dpe med kun 'gro spros pa med pa ste/ /ther zug tu gnas snyan dang shangs dang zhal dang spyan dang dbu dang phyag dang zhabs ni thams cad pa/ /'byung po'i mtha' ste 'byung po'i mgon po mchog gi srid pa gsum 'dzin rgyu rnams dag gis rgyur gyur pa/ /rig pa la sogs rnal 'byor dag gis rtogs bya mchog bde'i go 'phang dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal/ /spros byed nus ma'i gzugs gzhan glog gi me dang mtshungs shing nyi ma bcu gnyis dag gi gzi brjid can/ /ye shes rdo rje'i snang ba mchog gi go 'phang bgrod byed rnam par bcad pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkar po 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po ri bong 'dzin pa las 'dzag 'jig rten spyi bor yang dag gnas/ /bdud rtsi 'chi ba sel zhing srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms par byed pa thig le'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo sems —125—

tsam sngags kyi ngo bo lha yis yongs su skor ba sdug bsngal dang ni bde ba'i rang bzhin te/ /dam pa rnams la zhi ba'i gzugs ni rang gis byas pa'i nyams myong mi zad rnams la mi zad pa/ /gang gis las gang rab byas rang gi sems la cho ga bzhin du de'i 'bras bu de bskyed pa/ /'jig rten dbang po sna tshogs gzugs can srid gsum bskyed mdzad rdo rje sems dpa' la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /gcig dang du ma dag kyang gcig cing mnyam dang mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab dang / /steng 'og kun nas dkar ljang sna tshogs kha dog chen po gcig gi gzugs te thung ngu ring po dang / /shin tu ring po yon to med ces yon tan dang bcas bud med skyes pa'am skyes pa bud med min/ /gang zhig kun kyi rten gcig bha ga bzang mo mchog gi bha ga khyod la 'dud de khyod la 'dud/ /de nas spos dang bcas pa'i rdor dril 'dzin pas/ sems can rnams ni thar pa'i slad du r+ghaṃ 〈slob dpon 〉bdag kyang gtso bo'i dkyil 'khor dag ni bzhengs par bgyid/ /gang dag phyogs rnams kun na sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' nyes pa rnams bral btsun mo dang bcas pa/ /de dag rnams kyi mchog gi thugs rjes dkyil 'khor du ni dbang bskur 〈bsgrub cing ma rdzo pa'i 〉slad du bdag la bskyab tu ga the dul/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol gdab/ de nas spro na da lta lag len la byed pa ltar/ rgyud sde gzhan gyi cho gas snyan gsan dbab pa yang bya ste/ bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo mchog/rig pa'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang / khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bdag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin —126—

gnang bar mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang / /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan mnga' rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni rdo rje r+sha 〈'dzin pa 〉can/ /dus 'khor ཿnga ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar snus pa'o nyer sbyor ba/ /'gro ba spyad phyir bri bar bya/ /de phyir bdag dang slob ma ni/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung ste/ /dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni/ /nye bar byon par mdzad pa'i rigs/ /zhes lan gsum/ 'on kyang 'di cho ga gzhan gyi lugs yin pa'i phyir nges par dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /slar yang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs dang / bsrung ma drug cu dang / mgon po lcam dral sogs sgos kyi chos skyong rnams dang / mkha' 'gro spyi dang / yul bdag grong bdag gi gtor ma rnams gtor chog bzhin phul la/ rjes chog ni/ tseX( āXhuX hraXphaṭa/ ces pa nas/ dpag tu med cing dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ badz+ra gan+taX swāhā nas/ kā maX swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ tsho( āXhuX hoXtri dh+wa tu kai shwa ra kā la tsakra ar+ghaX pra ca zhes pa nas/ oX shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri bā re khyuXkā maX pra ca na maX zhes pa'i bar mchod pa bcu gnyis dang / nang mchod ni/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du tseX( āXhūX/ oX shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri bā re khyuX tso( āXhūX/bstod pa ni/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ ces sogs 'dun nyi shu 'don/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/—127—

nus mthu'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ spyir gyi phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba dang / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs shing /zhal bzhugs pa rnams sku khams bzang ba dang / khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor ba dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag nas/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yig brgya ḍā gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs/ oṃ badz+ra muX bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams sogs smon lam dang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gang 'os byas la/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bar bsdu ba'o/ /de nas bum pa la sogs pa rdzas lnga lhag gnas ni/ bum pa rnams rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te stegs bu bum gdan dang bcas pa la/ dbus kyi shar du rgyal ba dang / nub tu rnam rgyal bum pa bzhag phyogs mtshams brgyad du bum pa brgyad bkod/ rgyal ba'i steng du rnam rgyal chen po'i dung chos bzhag mtshan ma rang mas su med na 'dri ba'am 'dogs/ bum rdzas rnams bcug bshad tshod med kyang lag len la gzungs thag kyang 'dogs kyin snang / glu rna āXhuX hraXphaṭa kyis bsangs/su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pas ngang las/ haX hāX hi nywa rjo lha huX huX nywa lha rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su khu ba dang rdul 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang /shar dang mer rkang 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang / lho dang bden bral du khrag 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang / byang dang dbang ldan du gci ba 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang / nub dang rlung du bshang ba 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis te/—128—

bdud rtsi'i bum pa dkar po pad+ma la gnas shing pad+mas kha brgyan pa rnams su gyur/ rang gi snying gar zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du huX las byung ba'i rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ dus kyi 'khorwa ra lo sna tshogs yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i yab kyi thugs kar zla ba dang / yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor te/ de dag kha sbyar ba las rdo rje lcags kyu dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba spros nas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ dzaXhuX baX snroXdri rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bum pa rnams dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ haX hāX hi hi rgyu grwa ni huX hṝ dzñā 〈bum pa 'a 'a sa bon 〉 badz+ra pad+ma a rmi ta gha ṭa su bi shudha dharma 〈rdo rje pad+ma bdud rtsi'i bum pa shin tu rnam par dag pa 〉 dh+wa tu sā bhā wa 〈chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhi 〉sarba dharmā na 〈chos thams cad 〉 su bi shudha dharma dh+wa tu su bhā wān ku ru ku ru ku swāhā/〈shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du mdzod mdzod/〉 zhes pa mang du bzlas/ tseX( badz+ra gan+taX pra ru na maXnas/ kā maX pra tismo na maXzhes pa'i bar mchod pa bcu gnyis phul nas/ dkyil 'khor gyis cha'i dbus dang shar la sogs pa rang gnas su bzhag par bya'o// 'dir bum rdzas bod du 'byor sla ba rnams bsdu na/ rin po che'i rigs ljang khu'am/ me tog ljang khu/ khab len/ dri'i rigs ga pur dang gla rtsi/ sman kaṇ+ḍa ka ri/ 'khru yungs nag gro sran chung rnams rgyal ba'i bum par ro/ /rin po che'am me tog sngon po dang / gzhan snga ma dang 'dra ba rnams rnam rgyal bum par ro/ /bum rdzas de rnams cha gcig pa'o/ /mu men lcags me tog nag po/ dri sug rmel ka ko la/ dzā ti/ 'bru 'bras so ba dang til dkar/ sman rtag tu ngu / cha gnyis pa ste/ shar dang me'i bum par ro/ /byi sa zangs/ me tog dmar po/ dri gur gum/ sman tig ta/ spang spos/ lco ga mgo sman/ 'bru nas dang yungs dkar rnams/ cha gsum pa ste/ lho dang bden —129—

bral gyi bum par ro/ khres dang / dung dang / mu tig dang / da tso dang / me tog dkar po dang /dri si tsho/ a kar nag po/ tsan dan/ sman dbang lag 'bru zar ma/ mon sran/ khre rnams cha bzhi pa ste/byang dang dbang ldan gyi bum par ro/ /rin po che dang / me tog ser po dang / gser dang / dri gla sgang / ru rta/ bā la/ pu shel rtsi/ sman de bā dā li/ sle tres/ 'khru til nag sran ma rnams cha lnga pa ste/nub dang rlud gi bum par ro// lnga tshan lnga char gyi thum po rnam rgyal chen por gzhug go khrim grangs gang mang yod pa la re res kyang rung ngo / /de nas thig skud rnams/ skye( āXhuX hraXphaṭa/ tso( swa bhā wa sko kyi snyeXsarba dharmā/༷༷swa bhā wa shurnyo3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las srad bu āX yī grwa mūX ā+oṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la sogs pa yum lnga'i ngo bor gyur pa'i rdo rje'i srad bu'i rnam par gyur/ rang gi snying gar zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du/ hūX las byung ba'i rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ dus kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i yum gyi thugs ka'i nyi ma las rdo rje lcags kyu dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba spros nas/ yum lnga po rnams thig skud kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaXhūX baX hoX rdo rje'i srad bu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ āX yī grwa mūX swo badz+ra snyu tra sarba dharma e ka su bhā wa/ sarba dharmya na e ka ā kā ra swa bhā wān ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa mang du bzlas/ badz+ra gan+taX nas/ kā maX pra ru na maX bum pa'i shar du rol mos spyan drangs la bkod/de nas rdul tshon rnams/ oṃ gisaXhuX hraXphaṭa/ spyo bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdul tshon aX i ṛ uX lo rnams las byung ba'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i ngo bor gyur pa'i rdo rje rdul tshon gyi rnam par gyur/ rang gi snying gar zla ba nyi ma sgra —130—

gcan gyi steng du/ hu las byung ba'i rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ dus kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs yum dang bcas par gsal pa'i thugs ka'i zla ba las rdo rje lcags kyu dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba spros nas/ sangs rgyas lnga rdul tshon gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dza / ba ho rdo rje rdul tshon rnams dang ro gcig tu gyur/ru ku ru rdo ḍi/ rngo ༈ ༵sa / nyu/ ༵spyi /dzhai ༵ bhā/ kwa ma/ ༵ kau sbyi / ༵ rdo sdu snro nub tu rol mos spyan drangs la bkod/ngang spya rdorje / /༵ byung ba~X rdos/ rnyi wor rlo /༵ rdo ༵sna/dī/dzhai snying gar zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du/ hu las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dus kyi 'khordo ra lo sna tshogs yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i/dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs ka'i zla ba las rdo rje lcags kyu dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba spros nas/ gtso bo ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dza dhū ba ho rdo rje dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ hu kro dha badz+ra sarba satwa ka ru ku/ ༷ shrī hwa / / ༵rdo~X zla sa/ kā ḍi ga ༵ nas /kwa/ ma ༵titsā na ma su ༵ sdu bha'i lho bān re ro / ༵ spyan drangs la bkod/bu ho~Xkau ༵ ༵ gh+ri/ / tshogs ༵༵ gyi/ sna ༵ ༵tshor / /rdong/ dzhai rnyi ltong ga ༵ ༵ ༵ bye ༵ sgra gcan gyi steng du/ hu las byung ba'i rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ dus kyi —131—

'khor lo sna tshogs yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i/ sna tshogs yum gyi thugs ka'i nyi ma las rdo rje lcags kyu dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba spros nas/ gtso mo ye shes sems dpa' dril bu'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaXhuX baX hoX dril bu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ hoXbadz+ra gaṇ+ḍi sarba dharma e ka pradzñā dh+wa ni/ swa bhā rlu/ sarba ā kā re/ sarba dharma pra bo dha ni/ sarba dharmu rnye/ su bhā rlu na pra bo dha ya pra bo dha ya swāhā/ mang du bzlas/ badz+ra gan+dhaX nas/ kā maX pra ti ts+tsha na maX bum pa'i byang gi char rol mos spyan drangs la bzhag par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma lhag gnas ni nyung ngu la yid ches pa'i gang zag la/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyi dgongs pa 'di kho nas chog ste/ maṇ+ḍal phul zhing / mi bzad 'khor ra bas 'jigs pa bdag ni sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis/ mngal du mngal gnas sdug bsngal sogs brjod cing / de'i don spund pas snod du rung bar byas/ so shing dor/ yi ge drug pas bsrung ba byas te/ rdo rje sems dpa' bskul ba tsam bya'o/ /bdag 'jug gi tshe slob ma sta gon len pa'i srol yang yod pa sbyir nges par dgos pa ni ma yin kyang / byed par spro na bya'o/ /da lta slob ma sta gon cho ga g.yin dang bstun pa'i rgyas pa kho na phyag len la mdzad pas/ de bzhin ltar na/bsam pa bcos shing nang dbang bskur/ /gsol btab sngags la spro ba bskyed/ /thun mong thun mong min sdom bzung / /bsrung ba gnas gsum byin rlabs mchod/ /so shing khyor chu ku sha dang / /bsrung skud sbyin nas rdor sems bskul/ /zab mos chos bshad rmi lam brtag /ces pa ni sdom mo/ /de yang dang po slob mas phyag btsal maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ mngal du mngal gnas sdug bsngal dang ni btsa' ba'i dus dang byis pa'i dngos po la yang sdug bsngal te/ /gzhon nu lang tsho dag la bud med nor dang 'byor ba nyams pa nyon —132—

mongs sdug bsngal chen pos gang / /rga dang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal nyid de slar yang 'gro ba drug tu ngu 'bod la sogs 'jigs ster ba/ /'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sgyu ma la rmongs gyur pas sdug bsngal las ni sdug bsngal 'dzin pa'o//'khor bar mi nyid du ni rgya lam zhig na gyur kyang chos kyi blo ni rgya lam zhig na'o/ /de las dge ba'i dbang gis sangs rgyas la ni rjes chags gyur kyang dang po'i theg par rab tu 'jug /de las dpal ldan rdo rje theg pa sgom pa la ni blo gros ma lus 'jug pa rgya lam na'o/ /de phyir sangs rgyas nyid 'dod mchog gi bde ba'i go 'phang dag la 'jug pa e ma shin tu dka'/ /zhes brjod cing don spund/ de nas/ rang nyid dus kyi 'khor lo yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer kyis slob ma rnams re re nas drangs zhing zhal nas zhugs/ yum gyi pad+ma ra zhu ba hu dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i dus 'khor zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur pa la rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang rang gi zhal nas zhugs pa/ snying gar rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i lam nas 'thon pa rnams kyis dbang bskur/ yum kyi pad+ma nas 'thon te rang rang gi gnas su 'khod par sgom mo/ /de nas slob mas/ skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba'i/ /srid pa'i mtsho las bdag sgrol mdzod/ /dga' chen ston pa khyod gcig pu/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu//—133—

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum kyis gsol ba btab/ bla mas/bu tshur shog cig theg chen po'i/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni//ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med pa//gang gi shākya seng ge sogs/ /mchog rnams kyis kyang bdud kyi sde/ /mi bzad chen po stobs chen bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces pa'i don bshad de/ sngags la mos pa brtan po bskyed du gzhug go/bla mas theg chen thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa'i rnam gzhan dang / bzung ba'i phan yon dang / ma bzung zhing ma srung ba'i nyes dmigs sogs legs par brda sprad/ slob mas kyang rjes zlos lan gsum byas te/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /zhes lan gsum kyis thun mong gi sdom pa bzung / de nas/'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang / /dam pa bdag la stsal nas ni/ /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi don sgrub phyir/ /bdag ni rten tu slob dpon bgyid/ /ces lan gsum kyis thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom bzung gi don du gsol ba gdab/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba —134—

dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog r+ṣa po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /spyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu spyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba/ /pad+ma'i rigs can dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgrol/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum gyis thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi sdom pa bzung ngo / /de nas slob ma'i/ dpral bar zla ba la mū/ snying gar sgra gcan la yī/ gtsug tor du nam mkha' la ā/ lte bar dus me la lī/ mgrin par nyi ma la ru/ gsang —135—

bar ye shes la aX rnams bsam du gzhug cing / slob ma'i snying mgrin dpral ba gsum la gdan snga ma dang 'dra ba la gnas pa'i huX nag po dang / āXdamar po dang / oṃ dkar po bsam la/mas rim gyis reg cing brjod de/ nyer spyod lngas mchod do/ /de nas u dum wa ra sogs 'o ma can gyi shing las skyes pa'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa srog chags med cing drang ba/ pags pa ma bzhus shing ma gsal la/ rma med pa/ dri bzang gi chus bkrus shing / mgor me tog gi phreng ba bcings pa la/ h+ma( āXhūX lan gsum gyis bsngags nas/ tsho( āXhūX hoXhaX k+ṣaX badz+ra dan+ta sta tsa tung bi mo k+ṣa mu kha bi shudha swa bhā waX kā ya lha ka tsit+ta dzñā na mu kha dan+ta ā di ma lam bi sho dha ya bi rbe( dha ya swāhā/ zhes pas slob ma kha shar du phyogs pa la byin la/ khru bzhi pa'i tshad can gru bzhi pa ba byung lngas byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal la dor nas/ so shing gi mgo gang du phyogs pa de dang mthun par las rab 'byams 'grub par go bar bya'o/ /de nas dri bzang po'i chu bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa khyor ba gsum/ oX sdiXbi shudha dharma sarba pā paX ni : a su pho sto dha ya sarba bi ka lhan a pa na ya huX/ zhes pas blud do/ /de nas ku sha gnyis bsangs la/ che ba hūX las skye shing huX bzlas pa stan dang / chung ba dhīXlas skyes shing de bzlas pa sngas kyi don du slob ma'i lag pa gnyis su/ oṃ badz+ra zhwa baX zhes brjod de sbyin/de nas slob ma'i lus tshad mnyam pa'i skud pa dmar po bsangs sbyangs te/ hūX las byung zhing huX lan bdun bzlas te mdud pa gsum byas pa/ oṃ bzhi mai khyi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa rwan swāhā/ zhes brjod de slob ma'i dpung pa la bcing ngo / /slob ma'i dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ/mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la āX snying khar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la hūX/ lte bar dus ma'i dkyil 'khor la hoX gtsug tor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khore la haX/ gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khordo ra la k+ṣaX bkod de/ oṃ a āX.aX —136—

aXbadz+ra satwa mahā su kha kā la tsakra shi rmi phya a bhi mu kho bhā wa sa skye two bhā wa/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a dhiṣ+ṭha naX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes brjod de rdo rje sems dpa' bskul bas slob ma'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas mchog stsol bar bsam mo/ /'jig rten na ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'gyung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba//de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gi sems can mnyam med don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma sa /sngon du sdig pa byas pa yang //dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag thams cad zad 'gyur na//grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos//skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med pa 'grub/ /gang gi spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang gi rgyal ba sras bcas pas/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin par// bdag nyid chen po khyed gnas te/ /de yis khyed rnams theg chen du/ /sangs ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang 'byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de gzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don bshad pas spro ba bskyed/ bla ma'am dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su mgo bstan te nyol la/ tho rangs nam gyi bzhi cha la rmi lam gang mthong ba de kho bo la smros shig ces bsgos nas slob ma rang gnas su —137—

btang ngo / /sngar gyi rdzas lnga dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs ma 'chol bar yod pa de'i ngang du/ slob dpon gyi mal stan lhag gnas bya ba'i phyir du dkyil 'khor kyi sa'i lho phyogs su mgo bo nub tu bstan pas mtshan ma brtag pa'i don du/ oṃ hoXbadz+ra ka ma la da la gar+bhe sha l+le badz+ra su kha mahā ni t+yāX ka ro mi ya thā ta thā ga te na kṛ tā haXswāhā/ zhes pa mang du bzlas nas nyal bar bya'o/ /de dag ni gsol ba btab pa dang / lhag gnas bdun te nyi ma gnyis pa'i bya ba'o/ /de la rmi lam dge ba'i mtshan ma mthong na ni legs/ ci yang ma mthong na 'bring yin pas/ nangs par nas thig 'debs pa sogs dkyil 'khor 'dri ba la 'jug mtshan ma ngan pa mthong na re zhig bzlog pa'i thabs la 'bad par gsungs kyang / da ltar gyi rdo rje slob dpon sems rnam g.yeng ngang gi grangs bsnyen song ba tsam la skyabs su byed pa rnams kyis/ dngos grub 'byung ba'i mtshan ma yang mthong ba dkon pa dang / bar chad yod kyang de'i mtshan ma rtogs pa dka' bas/ rmi lam ngan pa ma mthong yang / bar chad bzlog thabs 'di dag byas na legs shing / 'di yang dngos su slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs kho na la gsungs kyang / dgos don 'dra ba'i phyir/ sgrub mchod bdag 'jug dang bcas pa tsam la'ang 'grub na bya zhing / yang 'di slob dpon du 'os pa kho na'i bya ba yin mod kyang /dkyil na bor 'bri sgrub sogs cho ga gzhan la'ang mtshungs pas/ cho ga la zhugs pa thams cad kyis byas na legs shing / slob dpon kho na'i bya bar grags pa gzhan 'ga' zhig kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /zhes bla ma dam pa man ngag rig pa dag gsung pa ni shin tu 'thad par rtogs so/ /de'i tshul ni/ haX las byung ba'i nam mkha'i rang bzhin zhes pa nas/ 'byung po'i 'khor lo rnams gshe/gas su gsol gyi bar/ bsrung 'khor rgyas par sgom pa mngon rtogs bzhin las/ bar der mkha' 'gro ma'i gtor ma brgya phrag sogs ci nus su btang / slar yang sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin gyi chi 'gro byas nas/ logs su bshad pa ltar rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor rkang pa bcu —138—

drug pa dang / /rkang pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa'i bzlas pa ci nus su bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu slob dpon kha shar du phyogs shing rkang pa g.yon skyil krung phyed pa dang / g.yas kyi mthil sa la bzhag cing / pus mo steng du son pa'i 'dug stangs bya/ khu tshur g.yon pas thig skud bzung / slob ma shar nas de las bzlog pa'i tshul gyis gnas pas/ khu tshur g.yas par 'dzin du bcug la/ glu( āXhuX kā ya lha ka tsit+ta e ka bhā hwangaXsarba dharmā e kā kā re ṇa badz+ra sa to haX/ badz+ra bhā mi snyu tra ya mi hūX aXphaṭa/ thig skud brkyang pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra snyu tra e kā kā ra swa ru pe ṇa dzaXdzaXdzaXsarba dharmāX snyu tra ya oṃ āXhūX hoXhaX k+ṣaXphaṭa/ thig skud gdab pa'i sngags so/ /de ltar tshangs thig dang po 'debs pa ste/ gzhan rnams kyang 'di'i rig pas shes la/ 'on kyang yongs 'jom spang ba'i phyir byad dang dbang ldan dang shar dang me rnams su slob dpon mi 'gro zhing / lhag mar slob ma yang ngo / khreng bu khri gang gi tshad dang sor drug gi tshad ma 'khrul ba byas la/ de nas 'di ltar/ maṇ+ḍal dbus su phur bu bzung bya ste/gru bzhi'i mtha' nas dang por zlum por skor/ /de'i tshad du tshangs pa'i thig gnyis gdab/ /cha chung drug gis lhag pa'i gru bzhi'i mthar/ /bskor ba'i tshad du zur gyi thig gnyis gdab/ /tshangs thig rtse nas tshangs thig gzhan gyi rtser/ /logs gtub byas pas sku yi rtsa thig rnyed/ /rtsa thig 'di dang tshangs thig 'phrad mtshams nas/ /log gtub byas pas gsung gi rtsa thig rnyed/ /de bzhin gsum pas thugs kyi rtsa thig rnyed/ /bzhi pas bde ba chen po rnyed par 'gyur/ /lnga pas gtso bo'i gnas kyi phyi mtha' gdung / /thugs kyi mda' thig thugs gsung rtsa thig bar/ /gsung gi mda' thig gsung sku'i rtsa thig phyed/ /sku yi mda' thig zur thig rtse mo sbrel/ /de rnams rlon thig go /gsum char rtsa thig mda' thig bar gyi sa/ /gang yin de ni phyed du bgo bya zhing / /de yi nang ma dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /phyi ma phyed gdab de yi phyi yang phyed/ /rtsa thig nang gi sa yang phyed mar bgo /de —139—

rnams skam thig go /bde chen 'khor lo'i phyi nang thig gnyis kyi/ /bar la mtha' gnyis su ni drug cha gdab/ /nang gi gdung sna 'then pas ka ba brgyad/ /tshangs thig g.yas g.yon cha phran gnyis gnyis bor/ /sboms su cha phran gcig pa'i ka thig bri/ /sgo tshad bzhi pa'i dbus dor drug cha gdab//bde chen 'khor lo'i tshad kyi ka ba'i thig /tshangs thig g.yas g.yon de la cha gnyis bgo /dang po phyed gdab phyi phyed gnyis pa bzhi/ /skam thig go /rtsa ba'i phyi las dang po gsum par reg /de yi rtse nas logs su lnga pa'i bar/ /de yi rtse nas phyi ru mda' yab thig /zur nas ngos su thig lnga yod pa las/ /dang po gnyis ni gnyis reg rtse mo sbrel/ /lhag ma gsum ni bdun pa la reg cing / /tshangasalas drug bdun bzung nas mda' yab reg /thugs dkyil lo/ /gsung gi sgo tshad bzhi pa gong dang mtshungs/ /dbus kyi pad+ma'i tshad du sgo khyud thig /rta babs ka ba thugs kyi rtsa thig tshad/ /gsung dkyil lo/ /rtsa thig nang dang sgo tshad bzhi pa'i nang / bcu gnyis cha re rab tu gdab bar bya/ /sgo khyud thig ni bde chen 'khor lo'i tshad/ /sgo 'grams thugs kyi mda' yab tshad nas drangs/ /rta babs ka ba gsung gi rtsa thig tshad/ /gsum ka sgo dbye tshul dang rta babs ni/ /'dra ste cha ni rang rang tshad kyi rtse/ /rta babs don du sgo tshad rnam gsum gdab/ /tshangs thig sgo tshad gcig tu skam thig drangs/ /sgo tshad 'og ma'i nang mthar sum cha dang / /de yang gnyis su bgos shing bar ma yang //dbus dor mtha' gnyis bzhi cha re re gdab/ /bzhi cha gnyis la'ang nang du sum cha re/ /sgo tshad phyi ma gsum phyed dbus ma yi/ /ma mthar bzhi cha btab cing tshangs thig las/ /ngos su sgo tshad bzhi po re re la/ /drug drug phye bas cha phran nyer bzhi 'byung / /skam thig go /mda' thig phyi las bcu gnyis ngos su ste/ /tshangs pa'i thig gi g.yas dang g.yon ngos su/ /bcu gnyis brgyad dgu slar yang dgu dang drug /phyed bcas bdun pa zung dang bzhi dang drug /drug dang bzhi gnyis thig gi dkyus su 'o//ka ba phyi ma'i phyi thig myos srung mnyam/ /gdung bzhi myos srung gsum dang bum pa'i gnas/ /rang rang —140—
