thig gi sne nas 'og tu bcad/ /gnyis gsum bar du tshangs las gnyis pa dang / /me ri klu yi steng du bcad par bya/ /lnga drug bar du gzugs mig mtshams dang ni /mig mda'i phyi ru cha chung bzhi cha gcod/ /de bzhin ngos kyi drug pa'i steng nas drangs/ /brgyad dgu'i bar du dang po dang gnyis phyed//gsum bzhi'i mtshams dang bzhi par sbyo zhe thig gdab/ /bcu gcig thig sne bcu pa'i lnga par sbrel//tshangs thig mtha' ni myos srung steng ma'i thig/de nas khor yug dang po'i nang thig skor/ /de nas sgo tshad phyed gcig gzugs zla phyed/ /ri bong can gyi khor yug rim bzhin skor/ /nam mkha'i khor yug dbus su sum cha skor/ /rdo rje 'phreng ba'i gnas yin me rlung gi /mtshams te phan tshun phyed ni dur khrod gnas/ /dbus kyi gdung nang tshangs thig g.yas g.yon du/ /sum cha dang ni gdung la reg par skor/ /bde gshegs 'phar ma'i phyogs mtshams cha chung bzhi/ /bar gyi ka ba'i bar du cha gsum bskor/ /thugs kyi lha snam zur bcad de nang dang / /lhag ma cha gsum mnyam pa dbus nas bzung //cha bzhi zlum skor sgo bzhir de dang mtshungs/ /gsung gi zur bzhir de dang 'dra ba ste/ /phyogs bzhi pad+ma thugs kyi rta babs kyi/ /brtsegs ma bar ma'i re'u dbus ma la/ /steng 'og snam bu'i phyed du za bar bya/ /sku yi pad+ma thugs kyi rigs 'dra yang / /pad+ma bdun cha skor thig rim pa bzhi/ /sgo bzhi dad ni shar nub rtags babs rtser/ /sgo tshad phyed kyi shing rta gru bzhi re/ /dur khrod gnas su'ang 'khor lo sgo tshad phyed/ /tshangs zur thig nas skam thig drangs steng gdab/ khar nub gnyis su nyis rim dgod par bya/ /sgo khyud phyi yi stegs bur 'byung bzhi bri/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma rnams dang 'khor lo'i rtsibs/ /thig gdab spyi dang mtshungs par shes par bya/ /bzhi brgyad bcu drug sku yi pad 'dab grangs/ /de nas skam thig ma lus dbye bar bya/ /'di dag zhib mor lag len man ngag bzhin/ /ma 'khrul shin tu snyom par gdab par bya/ /mthar thig skud la mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod//thig skud ye shes pa rang gi snying khar thim/ nyi ma gsum pa'i bya ba'o/ /—141—

slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod cing / rdul tshon la yang mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ spro na sa'i lha mo'i gtor ma yang phul/ de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug ste/ 'di ni cho se nyid dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /rang nyid rgyal po rdo rje 'chang / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam par grol/ /'khor lo'i nang du yang dag gnas/ /glu( badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing / thugs dkyil gyi dbang ldan nas brtsams te g.yas skor gyis tshon dgye zhing / phyi nas slob mas kyang ngo / /tshigs bcad dang sngags de yang cho ga g.yin dang sgo bstun pa'o/ /mthar 'dri ba'i bya ba rdzogs nas/ rdul mtshon gyi lhag ma la yang mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ rdul tshon ye shes pa rang gi snying gar thim/thig gi rnam gzhag rgyas pa dang / /tshon gyi mtshan nyid mtha' dag ni dbang chog chen mo las shes par bya zhing / nyi ma 'di dag la zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ci 'grub tu bya'o/ /nyi ma bzhi pa dang lnga pa'i bya ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ dkyil 'khor legs par bris zin pa na/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bum pa'i sngags bzla bzhin du bum pa 'god te/ bum pa bcu yod na brgyad po phyogs mtshams brgyad du bkod/ rgyal ba shar gyi shar dang / rnam par rgyal ba nub kyi nub tu sor gnyis spangs par bkod/rgyal ba'i steng du rnam rgyal chen po bzhag nya phyis sam dung chos kyi snod du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dngos sam/ bdud rtsi ril bu lta bu bzhag la/ tsho( ā hū ho rgyu ha k+ṣa lan bdun bsngags te 'jog par bshad pa/ lag len la rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'i steng du 'jog ci te bum pa lnga yin na/ phyogasabazhir re re/ shar kyi bum pa las sor gnyis spangs pa'i shar du rgyal ba'i bum pa dang / de'i steng du dung chos ni rnam rgyal yin la/ bdud rtsi lnga ni nub kyi bum pa'i steng du'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi —142—

phyogs mtshams brgyad du sa'i stegs bu la ba byung dang / dri bzang gi maṇ+ḍal bya zhing / rgyal ba'i bum pa'i mdun du'ang khru gang gi maṇ+ḍal lhag por bya'o/ /de dag ma 'grub na'ang mchod pa rgya cher bshams shing / kha dog lnga'i ba dan dang / sa rgyan gnam rgyan/ gtor ma dang gos zung la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i mchod rdzas dang dbang rdzas de dag tshogs par byas la/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma bzhi la rdo rje dril bu dang bka'i gnang ba sbyin te/ sgo'i rdo rje slob dpon du bzhag slob ma bzang po lnga pa ni sbyin bsreg bya ba'i don du dang / mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi yang bum pa skyong ba'i don du mtshams bzhir dgod par bya ste/ de dag kyang dngos su med na yid kyis bya zhing / sbyin bsreg kyang rang nyid kyis bya bar 4gad do/ /de la cho ga bya ba'i rim pa ni sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs nas/ klu dang rab gtum ma rnams gshe/gas su garbe1la/ zhes bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor lus la bsdu ba'i bar gong bzhin/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor/ glu sto āXhūX hraXphaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ lte dwang pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i rang bzhin rtsibs bcu pa zlum po'i dbus su zhes pa nas/bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag phyed pa dang / de'i yang nang gi phyed du/ smaX snyiX khriX shāX ṅgāX yongs su gyur pa las gtso bo'i pad+ma rgyar dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga pa dang / de'i lte ba la aX yig las byung ba'i zla ba dang / āXyig las byung ba'i nyi ma dang / a yig las byung ba'i sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor ra rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa ste/ zhes pa nas/ bde gshegs 'phar ma'i shar dang thugs kyi shar sgor tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ me mtshams su tsā tshwa dzā dzha nywa/ thugs kyi lha snam gyi shar gyi g.yas su rtsa oṃ rdza dzhai nyaX/ shar lhor tsaXtshaXdzaXdzhaXnyaX bde gshegs 'phar ma'i lho dang thugs kyi lho sgor ṭa ṭha ḍa rte ṇa/—143—

bdeng lho ṭa / tu ṭa rīṭāḍiltomainā/de spre ltegs ༵spra/ ma'i ༵rde dhi thug/ ༵ ḍa lha byang lha // ༵ dī ༵ ba kā/ ༵/ba~X rjo / / bye ༵ phab bha/ ༵ga~X de sna nigs rdo phar snro spra rnyi~X ༵ /rnyi~X dī rnyi kyig ༵ ༵ hūṃ dzhai kā/ sngu kau/dhi~X rdi / rdo rde bhā ḍi/da dha na ngu/sna gh+ri ༵ /༵ rni du / ༈hā / ༵ kha byang rnyi ga /༵/ du sa skra/ du ye / ska rnam sa yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma'i gdan rnams te/ thams cad kyang rtsa ba dang / sdong bu dang 'dab ma dang ge sar dang snying po rnams yongs su rdzogs pa/ sa bon re re las byung ba ste/ bde gshe/gas 'phar ma'i phyogs bzhi dang / thugs kyi lha snam la/ shar dang lho'i g.yas dang g.yon gnyis kar dang / byang dang nub kyi g.yas dang / shar dang byang gi sgo rnams su pad+ma dkar po'o/rde /bde gshegs 'phar ma dang thugs kyi 'khor lo'i mtshams rnams dang / byang dang nub kyi g.yon dang / lho dang nub kyi sgo rnams su pad+ma dmar po'o/ /pad+ma dmar po bcu gnyis kyi lte bar lo'i phyogs nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i nya bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa/ ha yig las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dang / dkar po bcu gnyis kyi lte bar gnam stong bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa k+ṣa yig las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khore nas/ bkra ba du mas mdzes par gyur/ dbus kyi gdan kyi steng du gtso bo'i mtshan ma lhar gyur pa ni/ hu las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang /—144—

de las byung ba'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer rnam pa lnga/zhes pa nas/ dpag bsam gyi shing ser po rnams su gyur/ gyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin las/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can zhes pa dang / sna tshogs yum gyi rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can zhes pa 'dir mi dgos/ gtso bo'i thugs kar a dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po nas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i sher phyin mas 'khyud pa'i bar las rgyal mchog bzhi/ bde gshegs 'phar ma'i mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/ i yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ don yod grub pa nas/ 'og tu rdul 'gags pa'i bum pa rnams su gyur/ gyi bar mngon rtogs dang 'dra ba las/ 'khode par gyur zhes pa thams cad la bzhugs pa'o zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ sgo'i mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/ yaX yig las byung ba'i ral gri nas/ thabs gtso bor gyur pa pa'o'i bar la 'khode par gyur zhes pa rnams la bzhugs par gyur/ thugs kyi lha snam gyi mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/ a yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu nas/ sgra rdo rje ma rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon mo zhes pa nas/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa lo bar te 'khod par gyur rnams la bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes 'don pa spo/zhes pa nas/ gzungs ma grangs med pa dang bcas pa'o/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha snam la gnas pa'i mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/'a ha yig las byung ba'i gri gug nas/ gzhon nu ma 'khor dang bcas pa ni gdong drug pa'o/ /sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha snam la gnas pa'i mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/ nya nyi sngo nyu hṝ nyaX/ zhes pa nas/ gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas pa ni —145—

gdong drug pa'o/ /sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo la gnas pa'i mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/ ya yig las byung ba'i dbyug pa nag po nas/ khro bo'i lha mo rnams g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pa'o/ /sku'i stegs bu la rta babs kyi ka ba'i nang rol na gnas pa'i mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/ h+pha khyu las byung ba'i nas/rin po che 'dzin pa'o/ /dur khrod 'khor lo'i mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/ 1 dang gri gug nas/ sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa rnams kyang 'khod par gyur/ sngegasung gi stegs bu'i mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/ tsaXtshaXdzaXdzñaXnyaXrnams yongs su gyur pa las/ sgrol ma las byung ba'i nas/ nub sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa'o/ /sku'i stegs bu'i mtshan ma rnams lhar gyur pa ni/rtsa oṃ rdza dzhai nyaX rnams yongs su gyur pa nas/ sems can bslu bar mi 'dod ma rnams nub sgo'i g.yon gyi stegs bu la rim pas gnas pa'o/ /zhes pa de rnams ni dam tshig pa bskyed pa'o/ /de nas/ bdag nyid kyi thugs kar hūX yongs su gyur pa las/rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang / de las byung ba'i rdo rje shugs/ kho pa nas/ gtsug tor du ha las thugs rdo rje rnams 'khod par gyur/ de ltar dbang bskur bas dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te rgyas btab par gyur pa ni/ gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa' dang / sna tshogs yum la mi bskyod pas rgyas btab/ rnam par snang mdzad la mi bskyod pa nas/ ga the lta du med pa'i a yig go /lhag gnas kyi skabs su/ sems 'grel rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i dgongs pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la mchod cing gsol ba btab nas/ 'gro 'ong med pa'i tshul gyis gshegs su gsol ba'i phyogs la ni/ 'dir sta gon gyi lha dang sre mi dgos te/ gsol ba btab pa'i lha rnams ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du zhugs —146—

zin pas so/ /bsdus rgyud g.yin gyi dgongs pa 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub mang pos bkral ba ltar na/ lhag gnas kyi lha rnams nam mkhar 'degs pa shas che zhing rang gi snying khar bsdu ba dang / rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs pa'ang yod mod kyi/ skabs 'di'i gong 'og ci rigs par 'jug par bzhed de/ de'i tshugol mos na ni rdo rje phreng ba sogs las rtogs par bya zhing / bar 'dir spro na mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa yang cung zad bya'o/ /de dag ni dkyil 'khor rab tu gnas pa'o/ /de nas mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ gong bzhin mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor/bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mchod pa'i yul du/ zhes pa nas/ shi ṣ+ka ṇa lca zhes pa'i bar gong gsol ba gdab pa'i skabs bzhin no/ /skabs 'dir maṇ+ḍal rnams kyi steng du dngos su mchod pa rgya cher 'bul zhing /mchod yon gyi snod du yang rung ste/ lha thams cad kyi mtshan nas smos te 'bul ba yin zhing / mtshan rnams ni legs sbyar gyi skad dag por 'don shes na mchog yin mod kyang / dka' tshegs che la ma dag pa'i rgya skad du rlom pa bas/ bod skad nyid tshegs chung shing don la 'byor bas/ oṃ dpal dus kyi 'khore lo la na ma oṃ sna tshogs yum la na ma zhes sogs kyis mtshon no//skabs 'dir dkyus 'gro nyid spund par bya ste/ rnam dag ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu gter ni/ /rab dwangs kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs/ /zhal gyi rnyog pa'i dri sel yon rbang 'di/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /oṃ uhrī pra wa ra sad kā ra a the añtsa ma na pra tisnro na ma tshig rkang dang po gnyis 'dra ba la/ zhabs kyi pad+ma'i dri sel spos kyi chu/ /zhes pa dang / pu du/ de bzhi du/ kun tu 'pho ba'i gdung sel 'thor 'thung 'di/ /pro k+ṣa na/ yan lag brgyad ldan rdo rje a rgyu'i —147—

rgyun/ /ar+ghaX zhes pas chu bzhi phul/ de nas mchod pa bcu gnyis la/ yo byad kyis mchod pa ni/khams gsum dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das/ /sogs gong bzhin no/ /lha mos mchod pa ni/ tsa sde thung ring las skyes pa'i/ /dri rbang ma dang phreng ba ma/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i tshogs sprul te/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod par 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra ga rnye gan+ta a rtsanaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/'a rje dri ma 'a'i tshar po sna yi la sgo ma sgo/〉 oṃbadz+ra mā le mā la a rtsa naX ku ru ku ru swāhā/〈rdo rje phreng ba mas phreng ba'i mchod pa rnams mdzod mdzod/〉 ṭa sde thung ring las skyes pa'i/ /bdug spos ma dang snang 'gasal rma// /nam mkha' khyab pa'i tshogs sprul te/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra dhū pe dhū pa a rtsa naX ku ru ku ru swāhā/'a rje bdug spos mas bdug spos kyi mchod pa rnams rmedzod mdzod/〉 oṃ badz+ra pra dī pe pra dī pa a rtsa naX ku ru ku ru swāhā/〈rdo rje sgron me mas sgron ma'i ma rdzo pa rnams mdzod mdzod/〉pa sde thung ring las skyes pa'i/ /zhal zas ma 'a dang 'bras bu ma/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i tshogs sprul te/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra a mṛ te ni wi kyi pū rde ku ru ku ru swāhā/'a rje bdud rtsi mas zhal zas kyi mchod pa rnams mdzod mdzod/〉 skye( badz+ra ak+ṣa te ak+ṣa ta pha la a rtsa naX ku ra me ku 'u kyi swāhā/〈rdo rje ma nyams mas ma nyams pa'i 'bras bu'i mchod pa rnams mdzod mdzod/〉 ta sde thung ring las skyes pa'i/ /sgeg mo dang ni bzhad pa ma/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i tshogs sprul te/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ badz+ra lā phye wasta a bha ra ṇa pū dzī ku ru ku ru swāhā/〈rdo rje sgeg —148—

mos gos rgyan gyi mchod pa rnams mdzod mdzod/〉 oṃ ñdzi badz+ra hā gya lha ṇ+ḍa ā dar sha pū dzī ku ru ku dra mi swāhā/〈rdo rje bzhad mas dril bu me long gi ༈ mchod pa rnams mdzod mdzod/〉 ka sde thung ring las skyes pa'i/ /sil snyan ma dang gar mkhan ma/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i tshogs sprul te/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod par 'bul oṃ badz+ra bā bye bā duX pū dzī ku ru ku ru swāhā/〈rdo rje sil snyan mas sil snyan gyi ma rdzo pa rnams mdzod mdzod/〉 oṃ badz+ra snu rkye sgro tuX pū dzāX ku ru ku ru swāhā/'a rje gar mas gar gyi mchod pa rnams mdzod mdzod/〉 sa sde thung ring las skyes pa'i/ /glu dbyangs ma dang 'dod pa ma/ /nam mkha' khyab pa'i tshogs sprul te/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ spya badz+ra gī te gī taX pūX rde ku ru ku ru swāhā/ 〈rdo rje glu mas glu'i mchod rnams // mdzod mdzod mdzod/〉 tse ( stsa badz+ra kā me 〈rdo rje 'dod mas 〉 sarba 〈thams cad 〉 bud+dhā 〈sangs rgyas 〉bo dhi 〈byang chub 〉 sa tā nāX 〈sems dpa' rnams 〉 kro dha ā dī nāX 〈khro bo la sogs pa rnams kyi 〉 badz+ra su ra ta pū dzāX ku ru ku ru swāhā/〈rdo rje shin tu dga' ba'i ma rdzo pa rnams mdzod mdzod/〉 srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i sku brnyes la/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā re khyuXbadz+ra bsta āXhuX/ rab 'bar nor bu rin chen in+da snyil/ /gser dngul la sogs rin chen me tog dang / /reg na bde ba rnam mang gos kyi tshogs/ /tsan+dan la sogs dri bzang sbyar ba'i myong/ /dri zhim bdug spos bsregs pa'i sprin tshogs dang / /rtsi bcud 'bru mar dang bcas sgron me'i tshogs/ /grags —149—

stong gnyis su med pa'i dril bu'i sgra/ /gsal snang gzugs brnyan 'char ba'i me long dang / /lha rdzas bla bre nam mkha'i tshad 'jal byed/ /rnam mang 'bras bu sna tshogs bcud gter zhing / /lhab lhub g.yo ba ba dan rnam lnga'i tshogs/ /'jo sgeg rnam 'gyur spro ba'i gar mkhan dang / /sgra snyan sna tshogs rol mo'i mchod pa ste/ /bcu gsum dkyil 'khod ra lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'pho ba rab 'gags nas/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog/oṃ u ཿ ho4gle kā la tsakra maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā re khyu tra yo da sha pū dza me gha sa mu dra snya ra ṇa sa ma ya na ma rab dwangs yan lag brgyad ldan chu gtsang dang / /'o chab me tog bcas pa'i mchod yon bzang / /rlung gis bskyod pa'i dri bzang mkha' khyab dang / /lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i bdug spos dang / /ut+pal pad+ma la sogs me tog bkra/ /ma nyams sa ha ka ra'i 'bras bu smin/ /sman mchog dbang po la sogs 'bru sna tshogs/ /nyi zla nor bu la sogs snang gsal tshogs/ /bdud rtsi ro brgya ldan pa'i lha bgos dang / /kañtsa li ka lha yi gos kyi mchog /mchod pa rnam bcu phul bas sa bcu thob/ /dkyil 'khor rnam bcu sgrib bral thob par shog /oṃ u hu sogs gong gi sngags dang 'dra ba las/ tra yo da sha zhes pa'i tshab tu wa phya da sha zhes pa la sdug ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ bkra shis dpal be'u g.yung drung 'khyil/ /dge ba'i don du mnga' ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /gser gyi 'khor lo mu khyud can/ /tshangs pa chen pos phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /'dam gyi skyon gyis ma gos pa'i/ /pad+ma dkar —150—

po phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang 'bul bar bgyi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /nyon mangs bdud las rgyal ba yi/ /chos kyi rgyan mtshan phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /gdugs dkar gser gyi yu ba can/ / phul ba de bzhin bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /re ba thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /bum pa bzang po phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /snyan pa phyogs bcur sgrog pa yi/ /'bud dung g.yas 'a klul phul ba ltar/ /de bzhin bdag kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ / na bza' gsar gyi nya ris can/ /phul ba de bzhin bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /de nas rgyal srid sna bdun ni/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di 'bul bas/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad spyi khyab las/ 'bul sngags gong gis rigasa'agre/ de bzhi du/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan/ /sogs spyi khyab dang mthun pas 'dod yon lnga phul/ de nas bkra shis rdzas brgyad ni/ dri med chos kun gsal ba'i me long dang / /g.yas 'khyil chos sgra mi zad sgrog pa'i dung / /dug gsum nyon mongs 'joms pa'o gi ha dang / rtsi stsod snying po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zho/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa li khri'i rdzas/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe sgrub dur ba'i rtswa/ /don mchog bla med sgrub pa bil ba'i 'bras/ /bgegs dang bar chad kun 'joms yungs kar te/ /rgyal bas byin rlabs bkra shis rdzas brgyad po/ /phul bas 'gro la dge legs 'phel bar shog /ma dha la aṣ+ṭa dra bya/—151—

bum pa 'bul ba ni/ nag po ra ri med pa yi/ /bum pa lto che bre tshad pa/ /mchu 'phyang mgrin ring gdan dang ldan/ /mgrin pa ras bzang dag gis dkris/ /snying por ldan pa'i sman sogs bcug /'dab mar ldan pa'i lcug ma yang / /dro ngad ldan pa'i kha rgyan can/ /bdud rtsir ldan pa yis kyang mchod/ /gha ṭa pū ra/ de nas dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ ga pur gla rtsi rkang dang bzhi mnyam dang / /stobs dang mchin pa mkhris pa nyi ma dang / /rgyu ma pags pa rnams te rdzas bcu po/ /phul bas pha rol phyin bcu thob par shog /da sha sa ma ya bhañdza tha/ yum lnga'i rang bzhin mchog tu rnam dag pa'i/ khu ba bshang gci khrag dang sha rnams dang / /byang chub sems ma drug gis rnam dag pa'i/ /rna ba sna dang mig dang lce dbang po/ /bshang lam pho mo'i dbang po'i dam tshig dang / /rnal 'byor ma brgyad rnams kyis rnam dag pa/ /rnag dang bad kan shig dang srin bu dang / /chu ser dang ni zhag dang ba sbu skra/ khro mo bcu yis rnam dag dam tshig ni/ /rgyu ma mkhris pa rus pa rkang mar dang / /mchin pa glo ba rtsa dang pags pa dang / /snying dang tshil bu las byung bdud rtsi bcud/ /rnam dag rang bzhin rab gtum bcu po yis/ /mig rna sna lce bha ga bshang lam dang / /rtags dang mchan khung las byung dri ma brgyad/ /de ltar dam rdzas sum cu rtsa bdun gyis/ /bde wo dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil snyen ra mchod/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun thob/ /sum cu bdun pa'i lha tshogs rab 'grub nas/ /'gro kun bde chen gnas la 'god par shog /sa bha tring shad sa ma ya bhañdza tha/ de nas nang mchod 'bul ba dngos ne/ gong gsol btab kyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin no/ /mdun skyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku la/ gas drug dgod pa dang / mkha' gsang byin —152—

gyis brlab pa rnams yid kyis dran par byas nas/ o dzñā na pū dza a nu ra lto swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3ha/ zhes pas gsang ba'i mchod pa phul/ de nas mchod pa sna tshogs pa 'bul ba ni/ nyon mongs ma lus bcom pa'i stag lpags dang / /sgrib pa kun bral glang chen pags pa'i gos/ /'jigs byed he ru ka dpal mnyes byed pa/ /sna tshogs na bza'i mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi/ /dbang sngon karke ta na chu shel dang / /pad dmar ma ra ka ta mu tig dang / /dzam+bu chu bo'i gser dang dngul la sogs/ /bza' dang bca' ba rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /rtsa ba sdong bu 'dab ma me tog dang / /ljon shing la sogs rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /bsod nams spel phyir dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /ral gri khang pa pags pa skyed mos tshal/ /mal cha gos dang mchil lham rin po che/ /pad+ma can sogs bkra shis lha mo brgyad/ /sna tshogs rin chen las grub khang bzang dang / /dpag bsam shing dang bum pa bzang po dang / /'dod 'jo'i ba dang rin chen ri bo sogs/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ /dbang bskur dngos grub don du ni/ /lha dang bla ma mchod pa'i phyir/ /tsha mo dang ni bu mo dang / /sring mo de bzhin skyed byed ma/ /de bzhin chung ma'i ma dang ni/ /de bzhin zhang po'i bud med dang / /pha yi sbun zla'i chung ma dang / /de bzhin pha yi sring mo dang / /rang gi ma yi sbun zla nyid/ khyim pa'i rigs kyis dbul bar bsngags/ /rig ma bcu yis mchod par bgyi/ /dbang bskur ba dang dngos grub don/ /dge slong dge tshul rnams la ni/ /bla mas spyin par bya ba ste/ /lha mo bcu yi bdag nyid can/ /rlung sogs rim pas dmangs rigs mo/ /rgyal rigs de bzhin bram ze mo/ /rje mo gdol mo nya pa mo/ /gar —153—

ma de bzhin tshos mkhan ma/ /ko lpags byed ma gtum mo ni/ /mthar skyes chos khams ma ste bcu/ /rig ma chen mor yang dag brjod/ /longs spyod grol 'bras rab tu ster/ /gzhan yang sum cu rtsa drug rigs/ /rnal 'byor ma brgya'i rigs byung ba/ /mi 'gyur bde chen sgrub pa'i phyir/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /mahā bi bye mū drwa/ kun+da rab tu khyab byed dri bzang dang / /rnam dag nyi mas dag byed me tog phreng / /don dam dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /'gro bas rnam dag zla ni thob par shog /gtso/ mo 'bar bas kun rtog bsregs pa'i spos/ /snying nang gzhom med 'bar ba'i snang gsal tshogs/ /don dam dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /spros bral ye shes snang ba thob par shog /'dod yon g.yin mchog bdud rtsi zhal zas lnga/ /thig le nor bur bcings pa'i ma nyams 'bru/ don dam dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /stong pa'i gzugs kyis byang sems 'ching bar lha(ga /ma dag gnas gyur ye shes sgeg mo'i lus/ /lus rlung dh+ra tir thim pa bzhad sgra'i dbyangs/ /don dam dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha la ba 'bul/ /rdo rje'i sku dang bcu gnyis sa thob shog /gzhol med nā da'i rol mo sil snyan mchog /rnam gsum phyag rgya'i rol pa bde ba'i gar/ /don dam dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ grags stong sgra dang sgyu rtsal mchog thob shog /sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho chos nyid rdo rje'i glu/ /mi 'gyur bde sgrub phyag chen 'dod pa mo/ /don dam dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul /rdo rje'i gsung dang mi 'gyur bde thob shog /ces mchod pa stso gnyis kyi nges don dran pas mchod pa'o//—154—

de nas bstod pa ni/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /nas/ ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /kyi bar grod nyi shu dang / dus kyi 'khor lo bde r+ṣa po/ /sku gsum mchog dang dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje gsum mchog rdo rje dbyangs/ /'gyur ba med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam rtog sgom pa las 'das pa/ /phyag rgya chen po mi 'gyur bde/ /gzugs dang 'dzin pa dbyibs dag dang / /rtog dang dpyod pa rnam par spangs/ /dri za'i grong khyer rnam pa dang / /pra phab pa yi rang bzhin can/ khres rab thabs kyi bdag nyid sbyor/ /e waX yi ge de la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bskyed mdzad ma/ /skye ba dang ni 'jig pa spangs/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa can/ /sna tshogs yum de la phyag 'tshal/ /ā li kā li snyoms 'jug dang / /hūX phaṭa yi ge sogs spangs kyang / /'gyur ba med las 'khrungs pa'i sku/ /dus kyi 'khor lo de la 'dud/ /kun mkhyen ye shes sku zhes pa/ khyab bdag nyi ma lta bu'i sku/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa'i spyan/ /de nyid bcu drug dbye ba las/ /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas ni/ /rdo rje seng ge'i gdan bzhugs pa/ /lha dang lha min gyis bstod sngon/ /zla bzang gis gsol de la 'dud/ /rnam par bcas kyang rnam med bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab ma ste de yis 'khyud/ /skye 'jig spangs pa'i 'gyur med bde ba dang ldan dgod pa la sogs bde ba spangs/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bskyed mdzad sku gsum rnams dang ldan zhing dus gsum yang dag rig /kun mkhyen mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan gnyis med de nyid la phyag 'tshal/ /gang la thog mtha' dbus med gnas dang zhes pa nas/ mchog gi bha ga khyod la 'dud de khyod la 'dud/ /ces pas —155—

bstod/ gzhan yang spro zhing nus na chos rje kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i bstod chen dang / 'grel chen dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi le'u so so dang / mdor bsdus so so'i thog mar 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad rnams kyis kyang bstod par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i gnas skabs su/ /sbyin bsreg byed pa po logs na yod na des sbyin bsreg bya zhing / med na slob dpon gyis skabs 'dir rgyas pa'i sbyin bsreg bya'o/ /de'i rjes su dkyil 'khor bsrung ba po zhin bzhag la/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyir rol tu song nas gtor ma gtong ste/ de yang gtor ma drug gam bdun mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ byin gyisabarlabs nas/ bsrung ma drug cu dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs la gtor chog bzhin phul/ sde drug bsrung ma drug cu dang / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams dang / srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par mdzod la/bdag cag dkyil 'khore gyi las la zhugs pa rnams kyi yid la bsams pa'i don thams cad sgrub pa dang / bar chad thams cad las bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sbed pa dang / dngos grub kyi sdong grogs dam pa mdzad du gsol/ zhes yen las bcol la/ oṃ rbi / bi shurnya'i sngags kyis 'thor 'thung 'gro phyogs su sgrengs/ gtor ma rnams phyogs so sor gshegs su gsol/ sarba ྅spyin/ ru zhes pa'am/ drag sngags bzla zhing tsham rngams dang bcas pas bgegs rnams bskrad la/ nang mchod dam dri chus reg ste/ yi ge drug pas gnas drug byin gyis brlabs/ slob dpon gyis rting mnan la nang du 'ong / nye reg byas la bdag 'jug la sogs pa'i las la 'jug go /sgo dbye ba dang me tog 'bul ba la sogs pa ni 'dir mi bzhed do/ /lnga pa ni/ slob ma dbang bskur ba'i don du ni nges par bdag 'jug dgos pa ma yin zhing /—156—

de'i phyir phyogs 'di'i rgyud 'grel nas gsal bar ma gsungs la/ 'on te bsod nams 'phel ba'i don du lugs gzhan dang bstun te byed pa yang / bla ma dam pa'i man ngag ste tshad ldan kho na'o//de yang slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba ltar gyi cho ga mtha' dag blang ba dang / cho ga'i gtso bo rnams blang ba dang / sngags dbang tsam blangs kyang rung ste/ rgyas pa dang 'bring po dang bsdus pa'i rim pa'o/ de nas dbu rgyan la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas rnams mdun du bzhag dung chos kyi chu cung zad btung la khrus byas te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis na/ /sogs bro ka gcig dang / skye( sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hu/ maṇ+ḍal ni/ dpal dus kyi 'khore le'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gu ru rat+na sogs brjod/ de nas/ mi zad 'khor bas 'jigs pa bdag ni de ring nyid nas rgyal ba rnams la skyabs su lhag par mchi/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi chu skyes nges par srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog dag la lus ngag sems ni dag pas so/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas/ 'dod pa'i rdo rje la ni rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya bla ma dag kyang spyi bos bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen la ni spyin pa sbyin bgyi 'khor lo 'di la rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig bskyang bar bgyi/ /ral gri la ni mchod pa bgyi ste gsal bar chu skyes rigs la sdom pa rnams ni bskyang bar bgyi/ /sems can rnams ni thar pa'i slad du rgyal ba bskyed mdzad rigs la byang chub bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum/ oṃ na kha hā ho ha k+ṣa badz+ra dan ta kāṣ+ṭha 〈rdo rje so spya~X rdo~X rlo rdo rdo rdo lha tsi rdo rnye na dhi ༵ / sdu ༷ye shes 〉 ༵ ḍi sdo sna dho ༵ rdo ༵ —157—

laX 〈kha dang so la sogs pa dri ma 〉 bi lha sto dha ya bi sgo(dha ya huX/〈rnam par sbyongs rnam par spyongs/〉so shing dor/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ/ mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la āX snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la huX/ ste bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor la hoX gtsug tor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la haX/ gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la k+ṣaX oṃ hiXbi shudha sarba dharma sarba pā pāX niñtsa a gya sho dha ya sarba bi ka lhan a pa na ya huX/ khyor chu btung / oṃ āXhuX/ bdud rtsi lce la regadaga' ba la dga' khyod su kye/ /bde chen bdag ni skal ba bzang / /de nas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta uta pā ta yā miX zhes brjod cing sems bskyed la/ me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje snying gar bzung ste/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya stuX hoXsidha badz+ra ya thā su khaX/rdo rje spyi bor bzung nas/ deng khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlob par 'gyur gyis/ khyod kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsung pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing / ma dad par yang mi bya'o/ /zhes brjod nas/ oṃ āXya mun ta krita hūX/zhes brjod cing khrid de/ āXkhaX bī ra huX/ zhes pas yol ba'i nang du bcug nas bsams la/mahā ra ta su dro dha su to stso su su kho badz+ra sa tā a ju siju māX/ spyo 'don wo bskor ba byed par mos/ thal mo sbyar bas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzo pa za nā ya uta mā naX ni rgyu ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha māX/ zhes pa dang /yang de nyid las/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma ṇi/ ut+ta naX ni sto ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru māX/ zhes pa dang / ltor/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe kā ya ut+ta naX ni rlu ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi khiñtsa māX/ zhes pa dang / nub tu/—158—

oṃ sarba ba khyu pū dzo pa shrī nā ya ut+ta naX ni rlu ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra be+e ro tsa na a dhi tiṣ+ṭha māX/ zhes pa dang / byang du/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra warnya nā ya ut+ta naX ni rlu ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharma pra brta yā mi/ oṃ gu ru tsa ra kho pa snya nā ya ut+ta naX ni rlu mi/ oṃ sarba satwa pa rī t+yā ṇashrī ya ut+ta naX ni rlu ta yā mi/ zhes bla ma la phyag 'tshal bar bya ste/ phyogs rnams su yod par mos pa tsam bya zhing / phyag kyang yid kyis bya'o/ /de nas spyi bor rdo rje bldan nas/ deng khyod de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bas na ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis 'di dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/mgo bor rdo rje bzung nas dril bu dkrol zhing / 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje 'di'o/ /gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la/ /'di smras na ni mgo bo 'gems/ /rdo rje snying gar bzung ste/ oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang / khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshe/gas/ /dung gi chu btung zhing / 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig srung na dngos grub ste/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ badz+ra a khru ta u ta ra ka ṭhaX deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi rdo rje 'chang nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang mi bya ste/ khyod yang ba ma spangs par che'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ de nas ye shes dbab pa ni/ stong pa'i —159—

ngang las bdag nyid khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs/ zhabs gnyis pa/ mgrin pa gsum pa/ zhal bzhi pa/ phrag pa drug pa/ dpung pa ba khu spya gnyis pa/ phyag gi pad+ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ lhag pa'i phyag gnyis te nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ mtshon cha rnams dang phyag rgya lnga dang klu'i dbang po'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa'i skur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cig /ces lan gsum brjod la/ rang gi snying gar la las skyes pa'i sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa rdo rjes mtshan par nyi ma la hu sngon po dang / mgo bor wa las byung ba'i chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan par zla ba la ha dkar po dang / mgrin par ya las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu ba dan g.yo ba gnyis kyis mtshan par zla ba la ud mar po dang / rkang pa dag gi 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi shugs kyis sbar bzhin pa/ ra las byung ba'i me'i dkyil dmar po ra gyis mtshan pa 'od zer 'phro ba la gnas pa'i sgrod mar pos bdag nyid 'degs bzhin par gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje rnams hu ha ā rnams la thim zhing / rkang pa'i bu ga nas sna'i 'od zer gyi tshogs zhugs pa dang / hu la sogs pa'i 'od zer rnams kyis lus kyi nang mtha' dag gang bar gyur/ sngar bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga'i spos kyi dud pas bdug cing / dril bu dkrol ba dang bcas pas o a ra ra ra ra la la la la badz+ra ā bhe sha ya hu/ o ā hū zhes mgo la me tog dor/ dpral par lko/ snying gar hū/—160—

gtsug tor du haX/ mgrin par āX lte bar hoX gsang bar k+ṣaXrnams su gyur/'tshe dang mi bden gzhan gyi bud med spang bya gzhan gyi nor dang chang gi btung ba de bzhin nyid/ /'khor bar rdo rje'i zhags pa dag ste rang gi dge ba 'joms byed sdig pa lnga po 'di rnams so/ /gang zhig gang gi dus su byung ba lha dang mi yi bla ma de yi mtshan gyis rab spyin bya/ /sna tshogs gtso bo'i bka' 'di srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pa dag ste khyod kyis kyang ni bskyang bar bya/ /cho lo kha na ma tho bcas pa'i zas dang tshig ngan klog dang 'byung po lha min dbang po'i chos ba lang byis pa bud med skyes pa rnams dang lha mi'i bla ma gsod pa lnga ni mi bya'o/ /grogs po rje bo rnams dang lha dang mi yi bla ma dge 'dun yid brtan rnams la 'khu ba yang / /dbang po rnams ni kun nas chags pa dag ste de ltar srid pa'i bdag po'i brtul zhugs nyi shu lnga/ /zhes bsgrags la/ srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga po/ /sna tshogs gtso bo'i gsung ji bzhin/ /bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gyis bzung /de nas/ oX dā da sha aX ga ni ro dha kā ri ṇi huX phaṭa/ ces gdongasaḥngs/ gos ser po bsgos par mos/ dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor ba byas par mos te/ sngar brjod pa'i mahā ra ta sogs/ oX āXhuXhoXhaX k+ṣaX zhes shar sgor dung gi chus mgo la bsang gtor byas nas/tseX( āXhūX/ zhes pa lan bdun gyis bsngags pa'i me tog byin par mos/ de nas/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa ni/ /bsod nams ci 'dra de 'drar shog /de yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /bsod nams mthu yang gang 'dra ba//—161—

de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ku la bi sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes pa 'dis me tog dor/ oṃ pra ti kṛ ji twaX i maX sa twaX mahā ba la/ me tog mgo bor bcing ngo //de nas/ dpral bar raX/ mig gnyis la 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i oṃ oṃ oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang / khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla med pa/ /thams cad mig ni 'byed par mdzad/ /oṃ de byen tri yā t+yā ṭa ghā ṭa swāhā/ oṃ di bya ya na mud ghā ṭa yā mi swāhā/ zhes mig dar dgrol/ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /phyag rgya sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /dngos grub kun ni phun sum tshogs/ /dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyis/ /rdo rje pad+ma mchog rol pas/ /gsang sngags rnams la sgrub par gyis/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar gyur/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen por bdag zhugs so/ /rnam 'byor dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen po bdag gis mthong / /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen por bdag dbang bskur/ /hoXhoXhoX zhes brjod par byas te/ dkyil 'bor du gzhug pa'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol/ /zhes spyi khyab tu lan gsum gsol ba bto/ oṃ spyo bhā wa stong pa'i ngang las u yig dang pad+ma las rang nyid sku rdo rje 'od dpag med du gyur/ slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas pa'i rdo rjes khrid de/—162—

dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs pas bskor ba byas te byang gi sgo'i sa la gnas par gyur/ chu dang cod pan gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ chu dbang gi don du/ oṃ haX hāX hi nywa sdo hṝ huX hūX rlo dzñā 〈dbang gi rdzas bum pa 'a 'a sa bon 〉 ā yī zhwa mū lī 〈dbang gi lha yum lnga'i sa bon 〉 badz+ra ḍā ki rkyo 'a rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams〉 badz+ra a mṛ ta gha ṭi ra a bhi 'a ṣañtsa na tu māX swāhā/ 〈rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bum pa rnams kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol ba dag la/〉 zhesalan gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba yab yum/ byang chub sems dpa' dang lha mo/ khro bo'i rgyal po dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaXgan+dhaX sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra bhā tī shwa ri huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ tā re tu stu re tu re swāhā/ oṃ paṇ+ḍa ra bā si ni ba ra de swāhā/ oṃ mā ma gī ki ri ki ri swāhā/ oṃ lo tsa na ba su de swāhā/ zhes bum pa so so nas chu bsdus te dung chos su blug su bhā wa: stong pa'i ngang las ā las byung ba'i steng dang 'og gi bum chu rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i ngo bo/ yī las byung ba'i shar dang me'i bum chu sgron ma'i ngo bo/ grwa las byung ba'i lho dang bden bral gyi bum chu gos dkar mo'i ngo bo/ mū las byung ba'i byang dang dbang ldan gyi bum chu mā ma ki'i ngo bo/ lī las byung ba'i nub dang rlung gi bum chu spyan ma rnams kyi ngo bo gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad bum chu ye shes pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ dung gi chu bteg cing me tog gtor la/ oṃ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi —163—

bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ /des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /oX phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /des ni de ring khyod la zhi byed bkra shis shog /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye rgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /des ni de ring khyod la zhi byed bkra shis shog /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /des ni de ring khyod la zhi byed bkra shis shog /oṃ ā yī grwa ྅ lī pañtsa dh+wa tu bi sho dha ni swāhā/〈khams lnga rnam par sbyongs/〉 zhes pas skye ba'i gnas lngar dbang bskur/ de ltar chu'i dbang bskur bas khams lnga rnam par dag pa yum lngar gyur pa ni/ gtsug tor du mkha' khams rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/dpral par rlud khams sgrol ma/ mgrin par me khams gos dkar mo/ snying gar chu khams mā ma gī/ lte bar sa khams sangs rgyas spyan ma rnams su gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thamasi cad yum lnga'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ de ltar na yum lnga'i sgo nas chu'i dbang bskur ba thob/ rlung la sogs pa'i khams lnga rnam par dag cing sgrib pa dang bral/ de bzhin gshegs ma rnams byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ de nas cod pan gyi dbang gi don du/ oṃ aX i ṛ uX lo 〈phung po —164—

gas lnga'i sa bon 〉sarba bud+dhā 〈sangs rgyas thams cad 〉badz+ra mu ku ṭa ma ma 〈rdo rje cod pan bdag la 〉pañtsa brnya 〈sangs rgyas lnga'i 〉ut+pa ka ban+ta yan tu hu hu phaṭa/〈bdag nyid can bcing du gsol/〉 ces lan gsum/ swa bha wa: stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i cod pan ljang khu mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo/ e las byung ba'i cod pan nag po don yod grub pa'i ngo bo/ ṛ las byung ba'i cod pan dmar po rin r+ṣa 'byung ldan gyi ngo bo/ u las byung ba'i cod pan dkar po 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo/ li las byung ba'i cod pan ser po rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bor gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa rnams/ cod pan ye shes pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dza dza : ba ho gnyis su med par thim oṃ a a ṛ u le pañtsa ta thā ga ta pa ri hwa khri sdo swāhā/〈de bzhin gshegs pa lnga yongs su dag pa/〉 zhes dung gi chus gong bzhin dang / dbu rgyan gnas lngar gtso/sa te mgo la bcings/ cod pan gyi dbang bskur bas phung po lnga rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas lngar gyur pa ni lte bar gzugs phung rnam par snang mdzad/ dpral bar 'du shes snang ba mtha' yas/mgrin par tshor ba rin chen 'byung ldan/ snying khar 'du byed don yod grub pa/gtsug tor du rnam shes mi bskyod pa rnams su gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i rnam par o badz+ra sa mā dza dza : ba hoganyis su med par thim/ de ltar na sangs rgyas lnga'i sgo nas cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba thob/ phung po lnga rnam par dag cing sgrib pa dang bral bar gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ dbang de gnyis kyi thun —165—

mong gi dag pa ni/ tshul de lta bus byang sgor sku'i zhal gyis la chu dang cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba thob pas/ sku rdo rje dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ su bhā wa: stong pa'i ngang las/ āXyig dang pad+ma las rang nyid gsung rdo rje rin chen 'byung ldan du gyur/ slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas pa'i rdo rjes khrid de/ dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs pas bskor ba byas te lho'i sgor gnas par gyur/ dar dpyangs dang dril bu'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ dar dpyangs kyi dbang gi don du/ tsho( a ā aX aXha hā haX haXphre hoX〈nus ma bcu sa bon 〉 sarba pā ra mi tā ma ma badz+ra pa snaX ban+ta yan tu huX hūX phaṭa/〈pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad bdag la rdo rje dar dpyangs bcing du gsol/〉 ces lan gsum/ swa bhā wa: stong pa'i ngang las/ a dang ha las byung ba'i dar dpyangs nag po gnyis nag mo'i 'bar ma dang du ba ma'i ngo bo/ aXdang haXlas byung ba'i dar dpyangs dmar po gnyis dmar mo 'bar ma dang smig rgyu ma'i ngo bo/ aX dang haX las byung ba'i dar dpyangs dkar po gnyis dkar mo 'bar ma dang mkha' snang ma'i ngo bo/ā dang hā las byung ba'i dar dpyangs ser po gnyis ser mo 'bar ma dang mar me ma'i ngo bo/ phre dang hoXlas byung ba'i dar dpyangs ljang khu dang sngon po gnyis mchog gi cha ma dang / thig le ma'i ngo bor gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad dar dpyangs ye shes pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ a ā aX aX ha hā haX ha phre hoXd sha pā ra mi tā pa ri pū ra ṇi swāhā/〈pha rol tu sgro pa bcu yongs su rdzogs pa/〉 dung gi chu gong bzhin dang / dar dpyangs gnas lngar reg nas mgo la ཿngas/ dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur bas/ rlud bcu rnam par dag pa nus ma —166—

bcur gyur pa ni/ snying ga'i shar du mnyam gnas kyi rlung nag mo 'bar ma/ lhor gyen rgyu'i rlud dmar mo 'bar ma/ byang du khyab byed kyi rlung dkar mo 'bar ma/nub tu klu'i rlung ser mo 'bar ma/ shar lhor rus sbal gyi rlung du ba ma/ lho nub tu rtsangs pa'i rlud smig rgyu ma/ byang shar du lhas byin gyi rlud mkha' snang ma/ nub byang du nor las rgyal gyi rlung mar me ma/ steng du srog 'dzin gyi rlung mchog gi cha ma/ 'og tu thur sel gyi rlud thig le ma rnams su gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad nus ma bcu'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ de ltar nus ma bcu'i sgo nas dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu rnam par dag cing sgrib pa dang bral/ nus ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ de nas rdo rje dril bu'i dbang gi don du/ oṃ huX hoX〈gtso bo yab yum kyi sabon/〉bi dzñā na 〈rnam shes〉 dzñā na swa bhā we/〈ye shes kyi rang bzhi mā 〉 ka ru ṇa pradzñā ud ma ke 〈snying rje dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid can 〉 badz+re badz+ra lhan ṭi 〈rdo rje dang rdo rje'i dril bu 〉sa bye ta ra ka ra yor 〈g.yas dang g.yon gyi lag pa dag tu 〉ma ma badz+ra satwa 〈bdag la rdo rje sems dpa' 〉 saX pradzñā/ da dāX tu huX huX phaṭa/〈shes rab dang bcas bstsal du gsol/〉 ces lan gsum/ swa bhā wa stong pa'i ngang las/ hūX las byung ba'i rdo rje dus kyi 'khor lo'i ngo bo dang / hoXlas byung ba'i rdo rje'i dril bu sna tshogs yum gyi ngo bor gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad rdo rje dang rdo rje'i dril bu ye shes pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ huX hoXsrur+ya tsan+d+ra bi sho dha ka swāhā/〈nyi ma zla ba rnam par —167—

sbyongs/〉 dung gi chu sngon du 'gro bas/ rdo rje dril bu spyi bor bzhag cing lag tu sbyin/ rdo rje dang rdo rje'i dril bu'i dbang bskur bas/ rtsa ro ma dang rkyang ma rnam par dag pa gtso bo yab yum du gyur pa ni/ rkyang ma dus kyi 'khor lo dang / ro ma sna tshogs yum mnyam par sbyor ba lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du bzhugs par gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo dang / sna tshogs yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoXganyis su med par thim/ de ltar na gtso bo yab yum gyi sgo nas/ rdo rje dang dril bu'i dbang bskur ba thob/ zla ba dang nyi ma'i rtsa la la nā dang / ras nā rnam par dag cing sgrib pa dang bral/ gtso bo yab yum gyis byin gyis brlabs par gyur/tshul de lta bus lho sgor gsung gi zhal gyi sa la dar dpyangs dang dril bu'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ gsung rdo rje rnam par dag cing dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ sā bhā wa stong pa'i ngang las/ hūX las rang nyid thugs rdo rje don yod grub par gyur/ slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas pa'i rdo rjes khrid de/ dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs pas bskor ba byas te/ shar sgo'i sa la gnas par gyur/ brtul zhugs dang ming dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ rdo rje brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi don du/ glu rna a ā e i ar ur tse( e( a la sil aX aX〈skye mched bcu gnyis kyi sa bon/〉 sarba bo dhi sa tāX〈byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 〉 sa bharnyaX〈btsun mo dang bcas pa rnams 〉 sarba dā 〈thams cad kyi tshe 〉sarba kā ma 〈'dod pa thams cad 〉 u pa bho gaX 〈nye bar longs spyod pa 〉badz+ra pra ti 〈rdo rje brtul zhugs 〉 ma ma da dāX tu swāhā/〈bdag la stsal tu gsol/〉 zhes lan gsum/ sā bhā wa: stong pa'i ngang las/ a ā las me tshwa ston sil ma ljang khu phyag —168—

rdor dang chos dbyings rdo rje ma'i ngo bo/ e mai las me tog nag po nam mkha'i snying po dang reg bya rdo rje ma'i ngo bo/ ar ur las me tog dmar pos snying dang ro rdo rje ma'i ngo bo/ o au las me tog dkar po 'jig rten dbang phyug dang gzugs rdo rje ma'i ngo bo/ al ul las me tog ser po sgrib pa rnam sel dang dri rdo rje ma'i ngo bo/ a a las me tog sil ma sngon po kun bzang dang sgra rdo rje ma'i ngo bor gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad me tog sil ma ye shes pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dza dza : ba ho gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ a ā e i ar ur tse( e( al ul a a bi ṣa ya in+t+ra ya bi sna| dha ni swāhā 〈yul dang dbang po rnam par sbyongs/〉dung gi chu sngon du 'gro bas/ me tog rna ba'i ltag la sogs par 'god do/ /brtul zhugs kyi dbang bskur bas/ dbang po drug yul dang bcas pa rnam par dag pa sems dpa' yab yum bcu gnyis su gyur pa ni/ rna ba gnyis su rna ba'i dbang po phyag na rdo rje dang / yul sgra sgra rdo rje ma/ sna bug gnyis su sna'i dbang po nam mkha'i snying po dang / yul dri dri rdo rje ma/ mig gnyis su mig gi dbang po sa'i snying po dang / yul gzugs gzugs rdo rje ma/ lce'i rtsa bar lce'i dbang po 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / yul ro ro rdo rje ma/ gsang ba'i rtsa bar lus kyi dbang po sgrib pa rnam sel dang / yul reg bya reg bya rdo rje ma/ snying khar yid kyi dbang po kun tu bzang po dang / yul chos chos khams rdo rje ma rnams su gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad sems dpa' yab yum bcu gnyis kyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dza dza / —169—

ba ho gnyis su med par thim/ de ltar na sems dpa' yab yum gyi sgo nas/brtul zhugs kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas/ dbang po drug yul dang bcas pa rnam par dag cing sgrib pa dang bral bar gyur/ sems dpa' yab yum rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ de nas ming dbang gi don du/ oṃ ha hā ya yā ra rā wa chi wā la lā/〈khro bo yab yum gyi sa bon/〉 sarba kro dha rā dzā 〈khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad 〉 sa bharnya 〈bas mo dang 4sa pa 〉 me khyi ka ru ṇa 〈byams dang snying rje 〉 mu di ta 〈dga' ba 〉 u be khyi 〈bto stoms 〉sarba sa ma tā 〈thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi 〉 su bhā wa 〈rang bzhin 〉 badz+ra purba ga ma nā 〈rdo rje sngon du 'gro ba'i ming 〉 ma me da dwan tu hu hū phaṭa 〈bdag la stsal du gsol/〉 zhes lan gsum/ swa bhā wa stong pa'i ngang las/ ha hā las byung ba'i gdu bu'am me tog 'phreng ba ljang khu dang sngon po gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba dang drag spyan ma'i ngo bo/ ya yā las byung ba'i gdu bu'am me tog 'phreng ba nag po bgegs mthar byed dang shin tu brtson 'grus ma 'i ngo bo/ ra rā las byung ba'i gdu bu'am me tog 'phreng ba dmar po shes rab mthar byed dang rmugs byed ma'i ngo bo/ wa wā las byung ba'i gdu bu'am me tog 'phreng ba dkar po pad+ma mthar byed dang khengs byed ma 'i ngo bo/ la lwa las byung ba'i gdu bu'am me tog 'phreng ba ser po gshin rje mthar byed dang rengs byed ma'i ngo bo gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad lag gdub rkang gdub bam/ me tog 'phreng ba ye shes pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dza dza : ba ho gnyis su med par thim/ tsho'o ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā tsa tu rlu h+ma bi hā ra bi shurnya swāhā/〈chas pa'i gnas bzhi rnam par dag pa/〉 dung gi chu sngon du 'gro —170—

bas/ gdu bu rnams yan lag la bcing ngo / /gdu bu med na me tog phreng bas rung ngo / /kye dpal 〈mi bskyod rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o//〉 'di zhes bya'o/ /zhes ming btags pa dran par byas te/ kye r+sha mo 〈dpal mi bskyod 〉 rdo rje na maX ta thā ga ta sirnyi sa ma ya stuX bha ra bhū baXswa/ ming gi dbang bskur bas/ las dbang bya ba dang bcas pa rnam par dag pa khro bo yab yum du gyur pa ni/ mgo bo dang gtsug tor du gsang ba'i dbang po dang mchog gi dbang po/ khro bo gtsug tor can dang / bya ba dri chu dang khu ba 'dor ba gsang gnas su khro mo drag spyan ma/ kha la ngag gi dbang po bgegs mthar byed dang / bya ba smra ba rengs byed ma/ lag pa la lag pa'i dbang po shes rab mthar byed dang / bya ba len pa rmugs byed ma/ rkang pa la rkang pa'i dbang po pad+ma mthar byed dang / bya ba 'gro ba khengs byed ma/ bshang lam du bshang lam gyi dbang po gzhin rje mthar byed dang / bya ba 4nang ba 'dor ba shin tu brtson 'grus ma rnams su gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad khro bo yab yum bcu'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ de ltar na khro bo yab yum gyi sgo nas ming gi dbang bskur ba thob/ 'dod chags la sogs pa nyon mongs pa bzhi dag tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi thob/ las dbang yul dang bcas pa rnam par dag cing sgrib pa dang bral bar gyur/ khro bo yab yum rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ tshul de lta bus shar sgor thugs kyi zhal gyi sa la brtul zhugs dang ming gi dbang bskur ba thob pas/ thugs rdo rje rnam par dag cing dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ swa bhā wa: stong pa'i ngang las/ hoXlas byung ba'i rang nyid —171—

ye shes rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad du gyur/ slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas pa'i rdo rjes khrid de/ dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs pas bskor ba byas te/ nub sgo'i sa la gnas par gyur/ rjes gnang gi dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ oṃ e waX 〈rdo rje sems dpa'i sa bon/〉 pad+ma badz+ra tsi sto 〈pad+ma rdo rje mawo ma dag 〉 pradzñā u pā yo 〈shes rab thabs dag 〉 maṇ+ḍa 'a/ 〈dkyil 'khor gyi 〉 a dhi pa tī 〈mnga' bdag 〉 badz+ra su kha dzñā na aX ga ma ma da dā tāX haX haXhuX phaṭa/〈rdo rje bde ba ye shes kyi yan lag sku bdag la stsal tu gsol/〉zhes lan gsum/ su bhā wa stong pa'i ngang las haX dang k+ṣaXlas byung ba'i 'khor lo la sogs pa phyag mtshan rdo rje sems dpa' dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i ngo bor gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad phyag mtshan ye shes pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaXdzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ haX k+ṣaX dharma tsakra pra brta ka swāhā/〈chos kyi 'bor lo rab tu bskor bar byed pa/〉dung gi chu sngon du 'gro bas 'khor lo bzung la/ 'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ rgyas pa la spro na/ chos kyi zhes pa'i gnas su/ pad+ma/ rin chen/ ral gri/ rdo rje zhes pa rnamasangs/ nas/ slob ma la phyag mtshan rnams kyis rim pas dbang bskur ba yin kyang / bdag 'jug la 'khor lo gcig pus chog cing / slob ma dbang bskur ba la yang ngo / /rjes gnang gi dbang bskur bas/ ye shes kyi khams dang ye shes kyi phung po rnam par dag pa rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gyur pa ni/ gsang bar ye shes kyi phung po rdo rje sems dpa' dang / ye shes kyi khams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin mar gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer —172—

'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par badz+ra sa ma dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/de ltar na rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi sgo nas rjes gnang gi dbang bskur ba thob pas/ ye shes kyi phung khams rnam par dag cing sgrib pa dang bral/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyis byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maX bhuX las byung ba'i 'khor lo/ oṃ badz+ra bha khyi raX aXlas byung ba'i dung / a las byung ba'i po ti/ aXlas byung ba'i dril bu/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /thams cad mchog gi mnyam nyid gsal/ /deng nas brtsams te dam bcas pa'i/ /sems ni bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /de ring phan chad 'jig rten la/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /kun nas yongs su bkang nas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bgyi/ khres rab thabs kyi rang bzhin bdag /yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong bas/ /skyon med dogs dang bral ba yi/ /de ltar sems can don gyis shig /tshul de lta bus nub sgor ye shes kyi zhal gyi sa la rjes su gnang ba yan lag dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar nus zhing / ye shes rdo rje dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ rim pa de ltar dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bdun gyis mngon par dbang bskur ba thob pas/ sngags kyi tshul la dge bsnyen du gyur zhing / sa bdun gyi dbang phyug tu lung bstan pa thob pas sangs rgyas kyi rigs su skyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 〈de bzhi gshegs pa thams cad kyi 〉sa sta a bhi she ka 〈bdun gyis mngon par dbang bskur ba 〉 sa rto bhū mi —173—

pra sto ha 〈sa bdun thob pa nga /〉 rdo rje lag pa g.yas kyis gsor la snying gar bzung nas/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /dril bu lag pa g.yon pas 'khrol zhing dku g.yon par brten/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ khres rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung / /ā srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi dag /ngo bo nyid kyi srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /nges par rdo rje'i rigs dag la ni srog gcod bya ste ral gri la yang bden pa min pa'i tshig /rin chen la ni gzhan nor dbrog bya mchog gi pad+ma'i rigs nyid la yang gzhan gyi bud med dbrog /chang dang sgron ma sangs rgyas rnams dang bzang po'i yul rnams mtha' dag 'khor lo la ni bsten par bya/ /g.yung mo la sogs mtha' dag bud med rnams ni gri gug la yang mkha' yi pad+ma ra smad mi bya/ /sems can don gyi slad du nor dang bcas pa'i lus 'di sbyin par bya ste khyod kyis srung mi bya/ /rigs kyi bu kye sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba gzhan du mtha' yas bskal pas min par rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes brjod/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba spang bar gdams pa yang brjod par bya ste/ gal te g.yo sgyus dbang gis rtsa ba'i lhung ba byung na dmyal bar 'gro ste 'di dag sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes dang / dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs dkrugs pa las bu rnams kyi ni rtsa ba'i lhung ba ri bong 'dzin par 'gyur//de yi bka' la dgongs pas gzhan du 'gyur te nges par de bzhin spun la khros —174—

pas gsum pa'o/ /byams pa btang bas bzhi par 'gyur te byang chub sems ni rab tu nyams pa las kyang mda' ru 'gyur/ /drug pa grub pa'i mtha' la smod pa ri bo dag kyang ma smin mi la gsang ba byin las so/ /phung po nyon mongs pa las klu ru 'gyur te slar yang dgu pa dag pa'i chos la ma dad gang / /sgyu yi byams pa dang ni ming sogs bral ba bde ba ster la rtogs pa phyogs dang drag po'o/ /dag pa'i sems can dag la skyon brjod pa las nyi ma dam tshig thob pa gtong ba las kyang gzhan/ /bud med thams cad la smod nges par ma nur 'gyur te rdo rje theg par gnas pa rnams la'o/ /zhes pas so/ /'di ni bdag 'jug skabs bsdus pa la dga' ba'i tshe ma brjod kyang chog la/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i tshe ni nges par brjod dgos so/ /de ltar na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun bskur bas/ sngags bzlas pa dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgom pa la dbang bar 'gyur te/ 'og min gyi srid pa'i mthar thug par 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi bden pa nyid kyis bsod nams dang ye shes kyi 'bras bu thob pa'i slad du bdag gis lung bstan zhing rjes su gnang ngo //srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bton nas/ /srid pa shin tu zhi bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /bdag gis khyod ni lung bstan bgyi/ /kyai khyod ni 〈dpal mi bskyod 〉rdo rje zle mo/ ta thā ga ta shi ṣ+ka sa ma ya stu sgyir bhu ba sā/gang yang 'di ltar lung bstan pa de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston to/ /de dag ni byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang gi cho ga'o/ /mdor bsdus rgyud 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa la kha skong dang bral ba'i lugs byed na/ dri —175—

ba dris lan nas/ dam bzhug rdzogs kyi bar dang / bden pa'i byin rlabs brjod pa dang / mig dar dgrol pa'i tshigs bcad/ lta ba bskul ba/ ched du brjod pa/ dbang spyi'i gsol btab/ rjes gnang gi phyag mtshan phyi ma rnams dang / chos bshad kyi rjes gnang dang rdo rje dang dril bu'i dam tshig sbyin pa'i dmigs pa dang / tshigs bcad dang / lung bstan rnams dkyil chog gzhan gyi lugs las kha bskang bar snang bas/ bsdus pa la dga' ba'am yid ches na de rnams bor pas chog go /de nas dbang gong ma rnams zhu ba'i don du rig ma mchog dang maṇ+ḍal phul te/ sgrib pa thams cad bcom pa yi/ /dus kyi 'khor lo khyod la 'dud/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur bdes gang ba/ /ye shes sku khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /byang chub sems ni 'gyur med gang / /dbang bskur de yis bdag la ni//mgon po da ni bka' drin mdzod/ /bu dang chung ma sogs bcas pa/ /bdag ni dus kun khyod kyi 'bangs/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i mthar/ /bdag la skyabs gzhan yod ma yin/ /zhes pas thun mong du gsol ba btab nas/ khyad par bum pa'i dbang bskur bar gsol ba 'dab par bya ste/ oṃ lko 〈sku rdo rje'i sa bon/〉 pradzñā u pā yo 〈shes rab thabs dag 〉 ka la sha a bhi ṣe ka 〈bum pa'i dbang bskur ba 〉 me da dā tā hu hu phaṭa/〈bdag la stsal du gsol/〉 ces pa'o/ /de nas sngar phul ba'i phyag rgya de nyid sna tshogs yum du byin gyis brlabs nas/ lha mo dga' sbyin gnas spyin ma/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /zung cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /zung la ma snang pa dag tu gyis/ /zhes rig ma gtad/ de'i nu ma la lag pas reg pas/de las byung ba'i bde ba nyams su myong ba de 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi dga' ba'i dga' ba ste/ de nyid bum pa'i dbang gi don no/ /de ltar na phyag rgya'i lus kyi —176—

dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ sngags kyi tshul la dge tshul du gyur zhing/ sa brgyad pa mi g.yo bar lung bstan pa thob pas sangs rgyas kyi sras su gyur/ oX oX badz+ra sa te na 〈rdo rje sems dpa' 〉 badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣe ke ṇa 〈rdo rje bum pa'i mngon par dbang bskur bas 〉 a bhi ṣi lto 〈mngon par dbang bskur te 〉 badz+ra satwa 〈rdo rje sems dpa'i 〉 pu to a tsa lwa dh+wa mi la sgo haX/〈sras mi g.yo ba'i sa thob pa nga'o 〉zhes nga rgyal bzung bar bya ste bum pa'i dbang ngo / rdo/ nas gsang ba'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/oṃ āX〈gsung rdo rje'i sa bon/〉 pradzñā u pā yo 〈shes rab thabs dag 〉 gu phya a bhi ṣe kaX me da dā tāX huX huX phaṭa〈gsang ba'i mngon par dbang bskur ba bdag la stsal du gsol/〉zhes pas gsol ba btab/ skye( dwa da sha sogs kyis gdong g.yogs bcings par bsam zhing / de nas/bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs nas sku la zhugs pa chags pa chen pos zhu bar gyur pa/ a ba si ti'i lam nas brgyud de nor bur byon pa'i bdud rtsi mthe bong dang ming med kyi se bzung nas lce thog tu bzhag par gyur/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems ni bzang po yis/ /de ltar bu khyod dbang bskur bgyi/ /zhes dang / bla med de ni 'di nyid de/ /gnyis su med cing mi 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi dbyings ni dam pa yi/ /dam pa'i bde ba myang bar gyis/ /zhes brjod la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsams te/a ho mahā su khaX/ zhes brjod cing / dngos su bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba'i nang mchod kyi thig pa lan gnyis su lce la bzhag cing btung bar bya'o/ /de nas gong gi sngags kyis mig dar bsal/—177—

phyag rgya'i bha ga gsal bar byas pa yang bltas te/ de las byung ba'i bde ba nyams su myong ba 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi mchog dga'i dga' ba ste/ de nyid gsang ba'i dbang gi don no/ /de ltar na phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ sngags kyi tshul la dge slong du gyur zhing /sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros su lung bstan pa thob pas sangs rgyas kyi rgyal tshab tu gyur/ oṃ āXbadz+ra sa te na 〈rdo rje sems dpa' 〉 gu phya a bhi ṣi ke ṇa 〈gsang ba'i mngon par dbang bskur bas 〉a bhi ṣi lto 〈mngon par dbang bskur te 〉 badz+ra satwa 〈rdo rje sems dpa'i 〉 yu ba rā dzo na ba bhā mi 'khyu( haX/〈rgyal sgos dgu pa thob pa nga'o//〉 zhesang rgyal bzung bar bya ste/ gsang ba'i dbang dzo / /de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/oṃ hūX 〈thugs rdo rje'i sa bon/〉 pradzñā u pā yo 〈shes rab thabs dag 〉 badz+ra satwa 〈rdo rje sems dpa' dang 〉 bi shwa mā ta ro 〈sna tshogs yum dag 〉 pradzñā dzñā na 〈shes rab ye shes kyi 〉 a bhi ṣe kaX me da dā tāX huX huX phaṭa/〈mngon par dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/〉 zhes pas gsol ba btab/de nas bla mas/ 'dir ni khyod rnams dpang po lags/ /bdag gis 'di la 'di gtad do/ /zhes rdo rje sems dpa' dpang du byas nas/ gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis/ /sten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis rtags/ /'khor lo'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yi/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /rdo rje skyil krung gis sems ni/ / nor bu'i nang du gnas lta bas/ /zhes go bar byas te/ phyag rgya sna tshogs yum du byas pa'i dpral bar oX/ mgrin par āX snying gar hūX/ lte bar hoX gsang bar khyu/gtsug tor du hā rnams 'khode par gyur/ phyag rgya des kyang chu skyes gur kum la sogs pa'i dri bzang por byas pa ston cing / e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad —178—

yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa/ /de yi mdun na bdag gnas te/ /sangs rgyas bsten pa la sogs pa/ /pad+ma ra bya ba ji bzhin gyis/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu gnas/ /bhañdza mo k+ṣa hoXbadag nyid dus kyi 'bor lor gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX snying gar hūX/ lte bar hoX gsang bar rdza/ gtsug tor du hā rnams 'khod par gyur/shes rab kyi pad+ma āXlas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ ze'u 'bru /la hūX las byung ba'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thabs kyi rdo rje huX las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ dbus su āXlas byung ba'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyis mtshan par gyur/ lag bcangs dang gnyis spyor gyi sgo nas snyoms par zhugs/ skye( dzñā na 〈ye shes kyi 〉 pū dza 〈dga' bas〉 a nu ra3/ 〈rjes su chagasapa'i 〉su bhā ba 〈rang bzhi gyi 〉 ut+pa ko3haX/〈bdag nyid nga'o//〉 zhes brjod/ de lta bu'i sbyor ba las byung ba'i bde ba nyams su myong bar gyur pa ni/ 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ste/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don to/ /de rnams ni dga' ba bzhi'i dbye bas kun rdzob kyi dbang rnam pa bzhi'o/ /de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas sngags kyi tshul la gnas brtan tu gyur zhing /sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin la gnas par lung bstan pa thob pa rdo rje 'chang gnyis par gyur/ oṃ huX badz+ra sa te na 〈rdo rje sems dpa' 〉 pradzñā dzñā ne na 〈shes rab ye shes kyis 〉a bhi ṣe ke na 〈mngon par dbang bskur bas 〉 a bhi ṣi lto 〈mngon par dbang bskur te 〉dī dī yo badz+ra dha ro haX/'a rje phang gnyis pa nga 〉 dharma me ghā bhū mi la bh+yo haX/pung kyi sprin gyi sathob pa nga'o//〉 zhes nga rgyal bzung bar bya ste/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo / /de nas bla mas dam —179—

tshig gi nges pa sbyin pa ni/ 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nge/ ni don dam pa ma yin gyi/ don dam par rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi bde ba ni thig le 'pho ba med pa yin pas/ bde ba chen po'i rten thig le ni khyod kyis bsrung bar bya'o/ /lko gdams pa ni/ las kyi phyag rgya'i rab sbyor dang / /ye shes phyag rgya'i rjes chags la'ang / /bde ba chen po byang chub sems/ /brtul zhugs brtan pos bsrung bar bya/ /bha gar ling ga rab bzhag nas/ /byang chub sems ni spro mi bya/ khams gsum po ni ma lus pa'i/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni bsgom par bya/ /srung ba 'di nyid kho na yis/ /skye ba 'di la sangs rgyas nyid/ /tshul khrims tshogs ni yang dag rdzogs/ /bsod nams ye shes yang dag ldan/ /pha rol phyin bcu thob pa yi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dus gsum 'jug /'di yis rdzogs sangs rgyas kun gyis/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /rang dang gas don sgrub pa'i slad/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ khams gsum dbang phyug ye shes ni/ /'di las gzhan pa yod ma yin/ /skyob pa kun gyi sdom pa ni/ /gal te khyod srungs bdag gi bu/ /de tshe sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ / byin rlabs rdzogs byang chub thob 'gyur/ /ci ste chags pas zil mnan bdag /gtso bo'i mdun du blang nas ni/ /sdom pa skyong bar mi byed na/ /de tshe ngu 'bod du 'gror 'gyur/ /dman pa'i sems las skye gnas su/ /gang tshe byang chub sems lhung gyur/ /de tshe phyag rgyar shes nas ni/ /pad+ma'i phyi rol rang lces blangs/ /zhes brjod par bya ste/ sdom po byin pa'i nges pa'o/ /slar yang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la dbang bskur ba'i rab tu byed pa'i bka' drin gnang bar mdzad du gsol/—180—

zhes pas gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas bla mas/ bu khyod nyon cig kun rdzob ji lta ba bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi thun mong gi bde ba dga' ba bcu drug gi mtshan nyid ni/ 'dod pa bskyod par byed pa 'gro ba rang gi yid la'o gang ba dag ni gang ba nyid du 'gyur/ /gang ba yan lag mchog la ri bong 'dzin pa khu bar byas nas 'bar ba'i thig le bzang po 'dzag /o skyes bkug pa mchog gi bde ba rang bzhin gyis ster thig le grol ba bdag ni gsum gyi mthar/ /lta dang reg dang 'grogs las 'dzag pa'i bde ba 'di dag gis ni dga' ba la sogs dbye ba ste/ /'dod pa dga' bar byed de dang po dag kyang mi rnams kyis ni mig gi lta ba rnams kyis so/ /phyi nas gang ba rab tu sbyar ba yis te slar yang mchog gi dga' ba nyid do rang lus la/ /'bar ba nyid la thig le 'dzag pa'i dga' ba yis kyang khyad par dga' ba rdo rje pad+ma la/ /o sna thig le gsum gyi mtha' ru 'gyur ba la gnas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba rdo rje byed/ /ces pa'i don dga' ba bzhi dang / de dag re re la yang lus dang ngag dang sems dang ye shes kyi dbye bas phye ba dga' ba bcu drug tu 'gyur ba ji lta ba bzhin du/ chags bral dang po chags pa che/ kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas brjod pa'i chos 'dzin pa/ /zhes dang / rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med/ /bcu drug phyed phyed thig le 'a myong / /cha med cha las 'das pa po/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo 'chang / /zhes pa'i don thig le 'pho ba med pa don dam pa'i dga' ba bzhi yang sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi dbye bas phye ba ni de kho na nyid bcu drug yin la/'jig rten kun rdzob pa'i shes rab ye shes ni mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes tsam ste/—181—

don dam pa ma yin gyi/ des nye bar mtshon pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa dbang bzhi pa'i shes rab ye shes ni don gyi ye shes te/ de kho na nyid kyi don yin no/ /zhes 'pho ba med pa'i don dam pa spros pa dang bral zhing / stong pa nyid dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes la 'dun par bya ste/ 'jig rten pa'i dbang gsum gyi cho ga'o/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ skye( hoX〈ye shes rdo rje'i sa bon/〉pradzñā u pā ya ud+ma kaX 〈shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid can 〉badz+ra satwa mahā mu drwa 〈rdo rje sems dpa' dang phyag rgya chen mo 〉dzñā na a bhi ṣe kaX me pra yasnro tsho( āXhuX hoXphaṭa/〈ye shes kyi mngon par dbang bskur ba bdag la stsol/〉 ces pas gsol ba btab/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gi gsang chen dbang gis ni/ /khyod kyi sems rgyun dbang bskur ro/ /zhes brjod la/ rkang pa skyil krung / lus drang por srangs/ lta stangs g.yo ba med par byas la/ dngos po med la sgom pa med/ /sgom pa sgom pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pa'i/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /lko pa'i bar dang / ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ /lko dang / de bzhin sems kyi 'od gsal rtog pa yi/ /sgom pa'i thabs rnams bdag gis mi mthong ste/ /de nyid du ni rkyang ma dag dang ni/ /ro ma gcig tu sbyor bas mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / yan lag phyag rgya che sgom pas/ /rnal 'byor chen po kun mkhyen nyid/ /'gyur med bde ba'i rang bzhin sgrub/ /skye ba 'di la sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces pa'i don chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa dang bral zhing / blo rnam par rtog pa snang ba dang bcas pa thams cad 'khrul ba'i snang —182—

ba yin par shes par byas nas/ cir yang rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang nas rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid la mnyam par gzhag par bya'o//de las yan lag drug gi rim pas thob pa phyag rgya chen po dang mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba zung ngu 'jug pa'i ye shes so sor rang gis rig par 'gyur ba ni gong ma'i gong ma chen po bzhi pa'i ye shes so/ /de ltar don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du phyag rgya chen po mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ skye rgu'i bdag po sa bcu gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ oṃ hoXdharma dh+wa tu a k+ṣa ra tsa tuṅgā a bhi ṣe ke ṇa a bhi ṣi lto 〈chos dbyings 'gyur ba med pa bzhi pa'i mngon par dbang bskur ba mngon par dbang bskur te 〉 badz+ra sa tī na 〈rdo rje sems dpa'i 〉ut+pa nā haX 〈bdag nyid nga 〉 dī dī yo 〈gnyis pa 〉dā da sha bhā mi la sto 〈sa bcu gnyis thob pa 〉 badz+ra satwa 〈rdo rje sems dpa' 〉 mahā a theX〈don r+sā po to pa ra ma a k+ṣa raX〈mchog tu mi 'gyur ba 〉 tai 'e1 kya bi dza yaX〈'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba 〉 kā la tsa gro( bha ga bān 〈dus kyi 'khor lo bcom ldan 'das〉 e baX ka raX〈a baX yi ge〉zhes nga rgyal bzung bar bya'o/ dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de nas/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ sangs rgyas dang ni byang chub sems/ /dpal ldan bla ma khyed spangs nas/ /bla ma gzhan dag rmi lam du'ang / /srog dor nas ni bsten mi bya/ /gzhan yang de bzhin dus kun du/ /g.yo sgyu med par nus tshad kyis/ /lus ngag sems dang gsum po ni/ /gtso bo'i spyan sngar dbul bar bgyi/ /ral gri dang ni snag tsha dang / /skye bo kun la snyems pa dang / /zhing dang khyim gyi las dang ni/ /tshong la sogs pa mi bya'o/ /zhes dam 'cha'/ tshigs bcad phyi ma —183—

'di ma brjod kyang chog go/gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dbul par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma gzhug pa'i ched dam/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba ma yin kyang / de kho na nyid kyi bstod pa sngon du 'gro bas dkyil 'khor gyi dngos grub mngon par zhu zhing / bden pa'i byin wos bya ste/rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan pa'i phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhi/ /mi bskyod rdo rje deng bdag sgrub/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag sgrubs mdzod/ nyes pa med pa rtag pa khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyis rjes chags dang / /bcom ldan chags chen dga' ba che/ /de nyid du ni bdag sgrubs mdzod/ khren tu rnam dag chos kyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag sgrubs mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog/dbang chen mchog gi phyag rgya yi/ /rdo rje chen po gsal ba las/ /rdo rje snyems bdag bdag sgrubs mdzodi/ /sems can kun gyi ying/ khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab kyang yin/ /dam tshig mchog gi 'dod pa mchog /bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog khres rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bden pa de yis mgon po khyod/ /'dod pa bdag la yongs rdzogs mdzode/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ khyu dang las las yang dag byung / /de nyid de bzhin nyid nges byung / /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog /—184—

'di yang rgyud gzhan gyi cho ga yin pas/ 'dir bsdus pa la dga' na ma byas kyang rung ngo / /de nas snying rje'i dbang bskur bar bya ste/ thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pas/ 'gro ba drug na gnas pa'i zhes pa nas/ slar yang de rnams rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur/ zhes brjod/drug pa ni/ gong du ji skad zugad pa'i bdag 'jug gi cho ga de rnams nyid/ slob ma la bskur bas kyang dbang gi bya ba ma tshang pa med cing mchog tu dag par yang 'gyur la/ 'on kyang mig dar bcings/ gos skon pa'i skabs su/ myos su 'jug pa gsum sbyin pa dang / lha ngo bstan pa ni slob ma'i blo yul du nges pa'i phyir/ gsang sngags rnams la sgrub par gyis/ zhes lta bar bskul ba'i rjes su/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin rtsibs bcu pa zlum po'i dbus su zhes pa nas/mchog tu bkra ba du mas mdzes par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar la 'jig rten gyi khams zhu ba las slar yang 'jig rten gyi khams su gyur pa dang / sa bon rnams dor/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo zhes pa nas/ sems can bslu bar mi 'dod ma'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin du lha ngo ston pa las/ sa bon phyag 'tshal las bskyed pa'i tshig rnams dor/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun skabs/ dbang rdzas rnams lha'i ngo bor sgom zhing zhal phyag mi bskyed pa dang / dbang rdzas kyis dbang bskur zin pa'i 'bras bu la/phung khams sogs lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du bskyed pa nyid dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa yin zhing / de nyid dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi dgongs pa rma med par yang snang / lhag par mos pa brtan po can la ni/ zhal phyag gi rnam pa ma bskyed cing dbang gi go mi chod pa ni ma yin no/ /des na khams lnga sogs lhar bskyed pa'i skabs/ mngon rtogs bzhin de dang de'i zhal phyag sogs bskyed na legs so/ /dbang bdun re re la maṇ+ḍal re 'bul ba lugs srol gzhan la yod —185—

kyang / spros pa lhur blangs pa tsam du snang zhing / bsdu na dbang bdun la maṇ+ḍal gcig gis kyang chog la/ sgo bzhi nas maṇ+ḍal re re 'bul ba'i lugs 'di shin tu legs shing / dbang bdun gyi dbang re re'i mthar slob ma la mchod pa bcu gnyis tshar re 'bul ba dang / rdo rje bzhi dag pa'i dbye bas mchod pa lan bzhi dang / rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi'i mtha' kho nar 'bul ba gsum lag len rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yin kyang / re re'i mthar lan re 'bul ba legs te/ dper na cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ chu dbang gi dus su bskyed pa'i lha rnams yid yul du 'char bar dka' bas/dbang re re'i mthar mchod pa re re byas na thams cad la ma chad par 'gyur bas so/ /de yang slob ma'i lus la lha bkod nas gnyis su med par bstim/ zhes pa'i rjes su mchod pa 'bul/ gzhan yang dril bu'i dbang gi rjes su yang chu dbang bskur ba dang / brtul zhugs kyi thog mar sor gdub rdo rje sbyin pa dang / dbang bdun gyi snga phyi thams cad du chu dbang bskur ba sogs ji ltar 'os pa sbyar zhing cho ga kha bskong spros pa can gzhir ba theg pa las khungs thub kyi dbang ltar byas na/ de ltar sems can gyi don gyis shig ces chos bshad kyi rjes gnang grub pa na/ rjes gnang gi 'dogs gas dag sbyin par bya ste/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes mchog /dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsole// /zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rkang pa bcu drug pa dang /bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa dang / snying po sogs bzlas lung spyi dang mthun pa dang / byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung sbyin la/ slob ma'i mig dag la pra/ o badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hrithur ldan sman pa'i rgyal po yis/ /ji ltar 'jig rten rab rib bzhin/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis bu khyod kyi/ /mi shes pa yi rab rib bsal/ /zhes mig thur dang / chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' me —186—

long bzhin/ /der ni gsal dag rnyog pa med/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rang nyid ni/ bu khyod kyis ni snying la bzhugs/ /rang bzhin med cing gnas med pa//de ltar chos rnams shes nas khyod/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /skyob pa rnams kyi sras su skye/ /zhes me long rdo rje dang bos pa dang / ho las byung ba'i mda' gzhu/ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ya swa/ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ya mi/ mda' gzhu'i rjes gnang ngo / /de ltar sngags kyi rjes gnang dang / /mig thur dang / me long dang / mda' gzhu ste/ bzhi po 'di chos bshad kyi rjes gnang gi rjes su mdzad pa'i phyag len mgrin gcig tu snang ba dang / dkyil chog rgya gzhung gi lugs su'ang snang zhing / go rim cung zad rjes pa de tsam la skyon du 'gyur ba yang ma mthong ngo / /'on kyang gzhan dang bstun na de'i sngon du 'di dag byas na legs par mthong ngo / /dam tshig bsgrags pa'i rjes la/ deng 'dir lo rnye mo dang / rigs ldan gyi rgyal po lha mo chos ston pa'i dus dang / zla ba r+sha mo dang / nya r+sha mo dang / tsheswā rnye mo dang / gza' dang skar ma nai mo dang / sbyor byā r+ghaṃ mo dang / byed pa nai mo la bdag rdo rje slob dpon 'di zhes bgyi bas/ slob ma khyed rnams la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun bskur ba sogs brjod/ lung bstan gyi rjes kyi bya ba la phyis kyi yi ge gzhan lugs phal cher na/ rdo rje phreng ba nas 'byung ba'i dbugs dbyung la/ gzengs bstod ces brda' sbyar nas byed cing / slob ma dkyil 'khor la 'bul ba dang / slob dpon du dbugs sgo grang bar grags pa de 'dir mi byed par snang ngo / /de'i rgyu mtshan rgyud dang 'brel ba 'di'i lugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon du ma gyur bas so snyam par snang ste/ tshig 'di dag rgyud sde gzhan gyi lugs yin pas/ 'di'i rang lugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang yin min rtsi mi dgos zhing / ci ste rtsi ba yin na/ dbugs dbyung dang / chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang sogs kyang mi byed dgos/ 'chi med kyi gnas thob nas slob dpon gyi gnas ma —187—

thob pa mi 'thad cing / slob dpon ma yin pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba byed par bka'i gnang ba ster bar yang ga la rung / des na 'dir phyis byon g.yin rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ kha skongs rgyas par byed pa'i lugs ltar na/ de gnyis ka bya la/ spyir ni gnyis ka'am/ gang rung gcig ma byas kyang cho ga chad pa'i nyes par mi 'gyur zhing / rgyud gzhan la bltos pa'i slob dpon gyi gnas kyang thob pa'i phyir/ byas kyang nyes pa ma mthong ngo / /de la dbugs dbyung ba ni/ de nas slob ma'i steng du gdugs bzung la thal mo sbyar te/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byas nas shar sgor bzhug ste/ slob dpon gyis/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ /zhes brjod de/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas gdugs gzhan du bzhag nas gnas pa la/ da ni khyod nyid dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams dag kyang dgongs par 'gyur/ /sems can rnams la brtse don du/ /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad pas bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /de yi rjes su gzengs stod ni/ mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mthong zhing bzhugs pa yis/ /sdig pa kun las nges par grol/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba khyod la med/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu mtha' grub phyir/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can kun gyis/ /de ring tshe ldan dbang bskur te/ khams gsum rgyal srid chen po yi/ /bdag po nyid du khyod nges so/ /'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /'dod pa kun la nyer —188—
