spyod pas/ /gang la'ang 'jigs med rol ba nyid/ kha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' bya/ /'di las gzhan yang dam tshig srungs/ /srog chags bsad par mi bya ste/ /bud med rin chen yongs mi spang / /slob dpon spang bar mi bya ste/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' bar dka'/ khres rab thabs kyi bsam pa yis/ /mi bya cung zad yod ma yin/ /ma 'jigs khyod la sdig pa med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung ji bzhin/ /de ltar yin ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du kyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde ster bsten par bgyis/ /'gro ba bde ba myur la rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyed rnams brten par 'gyur/ /zhes brjod/ de nas/sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ches/ /zhes sogs dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa dang / lha mo sangs rgyas rig ma shing dang bcas shing bum pa dang bcas rgyal ba yi ni dag pa'i sku/ /zhes sogs dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i de kho na nyid kyang brjod par bya ste/ sgrub thabs bzhin du brjod bar bya'o/ /de tsam gyis byis 'jug gi dbang kha bskong dang bcas rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /dbang gong ma rnams ni bdag 'jug ji lta ba bzhin du phog pas cho ga la/ sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs 'bebs pa'i man ngag 'khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i dbang gi skabs gong ma rnams mdzad pa de nyid/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs sogs kyis skabs 'dir sbyor bar mdzad pa ltar byas na'ang shin tu legs so/ /byis 'jug dang dbang gong ma dkyus gcig la byed pa'i tshe/rtsa lhung bcu bzhi sgrog pa tshar gcig gis chog cing / dus so sor byed na/ mchog dbang gi skabs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig bsgrags zin pa'i rjes su yang tshar gcig bsgrag go /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga ni gzhan du bshad par bya'o/ /bdun pa ni/ bdag 'jug gam/ slob ma dbang bskur ba gang yin yang rung ste/ snying rje'i —189—

dbang bskur ba zin pa na/ gtor chog bzhin gtor ma rgya cher btang /de nas rjes chog ni/ sgrub mchod zhag sbrel sogs la sngar gong du zugad pa de kas chog la/dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol gyi tshe mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ rjes chog yig brgya bzla ba'i bar dkyus dang 'dra ba las/ de nas/ bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams sogs dang / kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i dbang gi smon lam dang / gzhan yang smon lam rgya cher gdab bo/ /rol mo'i sgra dang bcas nas dkyil 'khor la skor ba lan gsum byas te/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'dug pas/ yig brgya lan gsum las mi nyung ba brjod/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ /mgon khyod de kun bzod par mdzod/ /gtso bo nus pa ma mchis pas/ /ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / /'dir ni bya ba gang nongs pa/ /de kun khyod kyis bzod mdzod rigs/ /zhes bzod par gsol/ o khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshe/gas pa dang / /slar yang 'byordo na par mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ o ā hu badz+ra mu ye shes sems dpa' dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi snying ga'i pad+ma ra bsdu ba'am/bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba bzhin du rang gi lus la bsdus/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ a shwad tha'i 'dab ma'am/ rdo rje'am/ rang gi lag pas tshangs thig gi lam nas dbye zhing / a kā rnge'i mthar/ mdze ā hu mu zhes btags pa 'don bzhin du/ skye ba med pa'i don bsams te/ bde chen 'khor lo'i bar dbye bar bya zhing / de nas rang gi mgo bor rdul tshon cung zad bzhag nas dbus kyi pad+ma la sogs pa yang ngo / /rdul tshon rnams bum par blugakhyogs la bteg nas/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / rnga yab dang / rol mo la sogs pa mchod —190—

pa mang po dang bcas te spyan drangs nas rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu 'gram du/ rdul tshon dkar pos pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri/ 'o ma'i mchod yon dang / dkar gsum gyis sbags pa'i gtor ma dang / gzhan yang mchod pa spyi mthun du bshams/ pad+ma'i lte ba la tshom bu gsum dang / 'dab ma brgyad la re re bkod/ gtor ma byin rlabs 'bring po dang / mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' klu rgyal bcu skor ba'i dkyil 'khor klu'i tshogs thams cad kyis skor ba spyan drangs te/ gdan la 'khod pa ni/dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje gri gug dgra stu/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa la/ rang dang 'dra ba'i sher phyin ma la 'byud pa/ 'dab ma brgyad dang steng 'og rnams su/ stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma char sprin mdog /nor rgyas dung skyong byi dra'i phung po 'dra/ /mtha' yas rigs ldan kun da'i mdog ltar gsal/ /'jog po pad+ma chen po rab tu ser/ /rgyal dang rnam rgyal ljang sngon 'byung ba la/ /rdo rje gdan bzhug rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /bum pa rdo rje pad+ma nor bu'i phyag /'khor tshogs bsam mi khyab dang bcas par gyur/ /o uhrī pra ba ra sad kā ra a the añtsa ma/ na pra tismo na ma〈pu5/ pro k+ṣa na/ ar+gha/〉 sogs chu bzhi phul/ tse( a hu snamadza ya bi dza ya sogs klu bcu'i gtor sngags lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ badz+ra gan+ta pra ru na ma sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams rab 'joms shing / /bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam —191—

mi khyab/ /klu rgyal 'khore dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rgyal ba rnam rgyal stobs rgyu pad+ma dang / /nor rgyas dung skyong mtha' yas rigs ldan dang / /'jog po dang ni pad+ma chen po ste/ /klu rgyal chen po bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /klu chen po khyed rnams la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i rdul tshon 'di rnams gtad kyi/ rgya mtsho chen po'i bar du khyer la/ /sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/bdag cag la yang dngos grub stsol ba'i sdong grogs dang / yul phyogs thams cad du bde ba dam pa 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ oX badz+ra muX zhes rdul tshon mchod gtor klu'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa chu bor dor/ bum pa chus bkang nas slar dkyil 'khor khang par 'ongs te/ thig rnams bkru zhing las rjes mi mngon par byas/ sngar phur pa dngos su btab yon na/ dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol gyi rjes thogs sam/ /skabs 'dir phur pa dbyung dgos pas/ oṃ badz+ra ki la ud gī la ya sarba ki la na badz+ra dha ra udzñā ya hūX huX hūX huX phaṭa hoX zhes pas phur bu bton la/ oX ru ru slu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sirnyi lo tsa ni sarba arba sā dha ni swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i 'o mas phur pa bkru/ khung bur yang gtor la sas dgang ngo / /de nas shis brjod rgyas par bya ba ni/ bkra shis 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma dang / /bkra shis rang bzhin dus kyi 'khor lo la/ /bkra shis 'gro la spel phyir phyag 'tshal nas/ /bkra shis rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs brjod par bya/ /pad+ma'i lte bar bdud dang drag po'i steng / /rol pa'i gdan bzhugs bde ba chen po'i sku/ /stong chen 'od gsal sna tshogs yum dang sbyor/ /bde stong dus kyi 'khor los bkra shis shog /rnam bcu dbang ldan 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /pha rol —192—

phyin bcu rnam dag lha mo bcu/ /rdo rje bzhi yis grwa nas rab mdzes pa/ /bde chen 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /phung po rnam dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs/ khams drug dag pa'i yum dang mnyam par sbyor/ /'chi med grub pa'i bum pas rab brgyan pa/ /rgyal ba'i 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /dbang po rnam dag byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs/ /yul drug dag pa'i lha mos rab tu 'khyud/ /gdod nas zag med bde ba'i dpal 'byor can/ /sems dpa'i 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /las dbang rnam dag khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /bya ba rnam dag khro mor mnyam par sbyor/ /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal/ khro rgyal 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /lte ba'i rtsa rnams dag pa lha mo'i tshogs/ /tsartsi ka sogs gzhan mchod chos kyi dbyings/ /zung 'jug rol ba'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas/ /gsung gi 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /las dang bya ba'i 'khor lo rnam dag pa/ /don dam lha chen bcu gnyis 'khor ra dang bcas/ /mthil bzhi gsang gtsug rnam dag shing rta dpung / /sku yi 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /sor mo rnam dag klu dang gtum mo'i tshogs/ /'dod yon dga' bde'i rang bzhin gzugs kyi lha/ /skra dang ba sbu rnam dag grub pa dang / /'byung po'i 'khor los deng 'dir bkra shis shog /gza' dang drang srong rgyu skar khyim dang cha/ /phyogs skyong zhing skyong pho nya 'phrog ma dang / /bhaṇ+ḍa ka rna dga' byed nag po che/ /rdzu gi ni sogs 'khor gyi'ang bkra shis shog /don dam skyabs gsum thugs gsung sku yi bdag /lhun grub ye shes 'od gsal gzhal yas khang / /chos sku'i yon tan —193—

'od kyi dra ba can/ /dkyil 'khor chos dbyings chen po'i bkra shis shog /dkyil 'khor bkra shis dge legs rgya mtsho'i dbyangs/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gros rgya mtsho li ri sgras/ /rnam par bsgrags te skye dgu rgya mtsho'i/ tshogs/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i go 'phang myur thob shog /gzhan yang bkra shis kyis tshigs bcad ji ltar 'os pa brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir/ rgyas pa'i sbyin bsregs dang dpa' bo'i ston mo sogs dga' ston rgya cher bya'o/ /de ltar na cho ga'i rim pa de rnams kyi go don rgyas pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho nyid las shes dgos pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i yi ge de nyid nyan pa dang blta ba shin tu gal che'o/ /de lhar bdag gis dpal ldan sa bcu pa'i/ /gsung dang dgongs 'brel rnam dag bsten pa las/ /drang don nges don ji lta'i tshul shes nas/ /rnam dag dbang 'di gzhan gyis bskul phyir bkod/ /des ni 'gro kun dbang bzhi'i lam zhugs te/ /rnam thar tshad med bsnyen sgrub rnam pa bzhis/ /lus ngag sems dang chags pa'i sgrib sbyangs te/ /zag med sku bzhi'i dpal la spyod par shog /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho'i dgongs don zhes bya ba chos rje kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas sbyar ba ste/ rang lo sum cu so brgyad pa'i dang po shar ba la/ nags rgyal gyi dben gnas dpal jo mo nang gi dam chos gling du'o/ /'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /ma rgo la//shri yu sdu/ mi 'khyu par thig le bzhi yi rang zhal la/ /gnas skabs bzhi yi dri ma 'khrud pa dang / /rdo rje rnam bzhi mngon du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /dbang mchog ye shes rgya mtshor 'jug 'di bskrun/ /sbrang rtsis dgra bos ma myangs pa'i/ /bdud rtsi'i 'bab ngogs yongs 'du'i shing / /skabs gsum dbang po'i skyed tshal du/ /'phel shing rgyas pa'i don —194—

du bsngo/ /lha rigs byang chub sems dpa'i brgyud/ /lo chos rgyal bsod nams dbang phyug gi /bka' stsal ji bzhin lhur len pa/ /brkos kyi 'du byed mkhas rnams dang / /dag byed mkhan dang zhal ta ba/ /kun gyi lhag bsam dag pa yis/ /gung thang rgyal po'i khab chen por/ /phun tshogs gong 'phel ngang nas bsgrubs/ khubha/—195—

mngon rtogs nye bar bsdus pa bzhu / gas/na ma shrī kā la tsa grwa ya/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i bdag /srid gsum skye 'jig med pa'i dngos/ khres dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /rlung me chu dang sa yi dkyil 'khor lhun po pad+ma dang / /zla nyi dus me'i steng du dbang phyug dang ni bdud kyi mgor/ /zhabs ni srid pa'i yum gyi zhabs dang lhan cig bkod gyur pa/ /lha yi dbang pos bshud pa'i gtso la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla ba'i sku dang zung gi zhabs te me yi mgrin pa chu gter dpal ldan zhal ni sna tshogs mdog /phrag pa drug dang nyi ma'i dpung pa rgyal ba'i phyag gi pad+ma stong pa drug dang me yi tshigs/ /zhabs dag gis ni zla ba nyi ma bsreg za'i dkyil 'khor dag la bdud dang drag po skrag bzhin pa/ /rol pas mnan pa'i srid med srid pa mnyam pa dus kyi 'khor lo gcig pu de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje ral gri rtse gsum gri gug mda' dang lcags kyu ḍā ma sa /tho ba 'khor lo mdung dbyug dgra stas g.yas kyi phyag brgyan g.yon pa yang / /dril bu phub dang kha ṭāX thod pa gzhu dang zhags pa rin po che/ /pad dkar dung dang me long lcags sgrog tshangs mgos brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stag lpags dang ni rdo rje'i rgyan ldan rdo rje sku can bde ba che/ /'od gsal stong nyid sna tshogs yum gyis —196—

kun nas rab 'khru/da gser mdog ma/ /zhal bzhi phyag brgyad gri gug lcags kyu ḍā ma ru dang bgrang 'phreng dang / /thod pa zhags pa pad+ma dkar dang rin chen 'dzin mar bcas la 'dud/ /nag mo 'bar ma bdug spos tsan dan gur gum dang ni ga pur snod/ /dril bu pad+ma yongs 'du'i me tog sna tshogs me tog 'phreng ldan ma/ /dmar mo'i g.yas na mar me do shal cod pan dang ni gdub bu ste/ /g.yon na gos dang ska rags dang ni rin chen sna rgyan rkang gdub 'dzin/ /dkar mo'i g.yas na 'o ma chu dang sman mchog chang gi snod rnams te/ /g.yon na bdud rtsi grub pa'i bcud dang bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu 'bras man snod/ /ser mo 'bar ma dung dang gling bu nor bu dang ni ḍā ma sa /pi wang rnga dang lhor rnga zangs dung rang phyogs gtso bo'i zhal ldan ma/ /de dag dang mtshungs du ba smig rgyu me khyer dang ni mar me ma/ /rang mdog dang mtshungs rnga yab brgyad ldan phyag rgya lnga yis rnam brgyan ma/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan dang ldan rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma/ /mnyam pa'i stabs can pha rol phyin rdzogs srog gi dkyil 'khor 'gags la 'dud/ /tshad med rnam thar rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dbang dang bsnyen sgrub dga' ba bzhis/ /lus ngag sems dang chags pa'i thig le gnas skabs rnam bzhi rnam dag pa/ /skad cig mkhyen pa sku dang rdo rje byang chub rnam bzhi sems dpa' bzhi/ /chos kyi dung dang gaṇ+ḍi nor bu dpag bsam shing la phyag 'tshal lo khu khrag rkang dang khrag gi tshogs chen dri chu dri chen rab 'gags pas/ /'chi med rab ster 'chi med rgyun gyis mngon par gang ba'i thod pa'am/ /zla ba'i rang bzhin zla ba'i 'od ltar rab tu dkar ba'i bum pa ni/ /bdud kyi tshogs —197—

'joms bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyis shin tu gang ba rnams la 'dud/ /'du byed rlung dang ngag gi dbang po sna dang reg gzhan 'dus ma byas/ /don yod sgrol ma bgegs kyi sgra dang nam mkha'i snying po reg bya ma/ /ral gri gri gug rtse gsum phub dang dpal ldan thod pa kha ṭāX ga /nyi zla'i gdong ldan sprin nag dang mtshungs sa yi rigs kyis 'phyud la 'dud/ /tshor ba me dang lag pa'i dbang po mig dang ro gzhan bde ba che/ /rin chen dbang po gos dkar mo dang rmugs byed sa yi snying po ro/ /mda' dang lcags kyu ḍā ma ru dang gzhu dang zhags pa nor bu'i phyag/dkar nag gdong ldan nyin mor byed 'dra chu yi rigs kyis 'phyud la 'dud/ /'du shes chu dang rkang pa'i dbang po lce dang gzugs gzhan ye shes sku/ /snang ba mtha' yas mā ma ki dang khengs byed 'jig rten dbang po'i gzugs/ /tho ba mdung dang rtse gsum pad dkar me long dang ni bgrang 'phreng dang / /nag dang dmar ba'i gdong ldan dkar po me yi rigs kyis 'byud la 'dud/ /gzugs kyi phung po sa dang bshang lam lus dang dri gzhan 'od gsal gzugs/ /rtag pa spyan ma rengs byed dang ni rnam sel dri yi rdo rje ma/ /'khor lo dbyug pa khro bo'i rdo rje dung dang lcags sgrog dril bu'i phyag /dkar nag gdong ldan gser gyi ri 'dra rlung gi rigs kyis 'phyud la 'dud/ /rna ba chos khams yid dang sgra gzhan phyag na rdo rje chos khams ma/ /kun bzang sgra yi rdo rje ma ste ljang sngon phan tshun yang dag sbyor/ /g.yas g.yon nyi zla'i zhal gyis rab brgyan rdo rje gri gug dgra sta dang / /dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i gdong ldan stong pa'i rigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab dkar chu skyes mdangs bkra'i ze 'brur 'od stong bdag po'i dkyil —198—

'khor la/ /rdo rje'i gdan dang g.yas brkyang stabs bzhugs rgyal dang rgyas sras khro rgyal dang / /'dam skyes dmar po'i ge sar snying por ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs rig ma rnams dang rdo rje ma rnams la phyag 'tshal/ /de ltar lha yi 'khor lo legs mchod dri dang 'phreng ba bdug spos ma/ /snang gsal bdud rtsi 'bras bu ma dang sgeg mo bzhad ma sil snyan ma/ /gar dang glu yi sbyor ba la brtson 'dod ma 'dod la rab dga' ma/ /rgyan dang cha byad rnam 'gyur du mas yid rab 'dzin ma rnams bstod do/ /phyogs dang mtshams su chu skyes dmar dang dkar po la gnas rnal 'byor ma/ /lte ba'i rtsa brgyad drug cu rtsa bzhi rnam par dag pa'i chos can ma/ /thun tshod dang ni dbyug gu rnam dag kun nas bde la snyoms 'jug ma/ /spyan gsum phyag bzhi rol pas yongs bskor sa ga'i stabs kyis legs gnas ma/ /yi dwags la gnas tsartsi ka ni dbang pos 'phyud cing 'jigs ma dang / /rlung shugs ma dang drag mo dus kyi mche ba ma dang me 'bar gdong / /rab gtum drag mig sna chen mas bskor dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs zla zhal ma/ /thams cad gri gug rtse gsum thod pa kha ṭāX ga yis brgyan la 'dud/ /mkha' lding la gnas khyab 'jug ma ni tshangs pas 'byud cing dpal mo dang / /rnam par rgyal ma sgyu ma grags ma bkra shis ma dang dpal rgyal ma/ /dpal rgyal byed ma 'khor lo mas bskor 'khor lo dbyug tho pad+ma dang / /dung gi phyag ldan sprin nag dang mtshungs zla ba'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma her gnas pa'i phag mo la ni drag pos 'byud cing keng rus ma//rtsigs ma dus mtshan rab khros gdong ma dus kyi lce ma nag mo dang / /drag mo —199—

dang ni gzugs ngan mas bskor me yi mdog can zla zhal ma/ /dbyug pa ral gri lcags sgrog phub kyis rnam brgyan rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rma byar gnas pa'i gzhon nu ma ni tshogs bdag gis 'khyud pad+ma ma/ /rin chen phreng ma lus med gzhon nu ri dwags bdag po'i 'gros ma dang / /mig mdzes rul ma bzang mos yongs bskor byi waṃ 'od 'phro gdong drug ma/ shaka ti lcags kyu rin chen zhags pas nye bar mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyu mchog la gnas drag mo la ni gshin rjes 'byud cing phyogs kun nas/ /go ri 'degs ma gaX ga ma dang rtag ma myur ma mtshon byed ma/ /dmar ser ma dang nag mos yongs bskor zla ba'i mdog can zla ba'i zhal/ /rtse gsum cang te'u kha ṭāX ga dang ltos 'gros mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /seng ger gnas pa'i dpal mo la ni gzhon nus 'byud cing dpal dkar mo/ /'dzin ma zla ba'i ri mo can dang ri bong 'dzin zhal ngang pa'i mdog /pad+ma'i dbang mo skar mig ma dang dri med ri bong 'dzin mas bskor/ /zla 'od zla zhal pad+ma bgrang 'phreng chu skyes rin chen 'dzin la 'dud/ /glang por gnas pa'i dbang mo la ni srin pos lkod cing rdo rje'i 'od/ /bkra ba'i ri mo rdo rje'i lus ma gser ldan ma dang ur ba si/ /raX bha zug rngu med ma dang ni shin tu sgrol mas yongs bskor ma/ /gser mdog zla zhal rdo rje mda' dang dril bu gzhu yis mtshan la 'dud/ /ngang par gnas pa'i tshangs ma la ni nor lhas 'byud cing mchod sbyin 'dod/ /ngag gi dbang phyug pad+ma'i spyan ma chu skyes ldan ma blo gros ma/ /glu ma glog ma dran mas yongs bskor rig byed gdong ma gser mdog ma/ /phyag gi pad+mas pad+ma tshangs dbyug spyi blugs bar bus mtshan la 'dud/ /zla ba —200—

tshigs chen nyi ma'i tshes dang rtsa/ /rnam dag lha chen bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas/ /spyan gsum nyi zla'i mdog can pad+ma'i steng / /rol pas yongs bskor rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs pa/ /srin mos 'phyud cing yi dwags la gnas pa'i/ /bden bral la sogs nag pa'i tshes rnams gzhan/ /ral gri gri gug phub dang thod pa can/ /dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs zla ba'i zhal la 'dud/ /gtum mos 'phyud cing ri dwags la gnas pa'i/ /rlud sogs sa ga'i tshes gzhan dpag bsam shing / /yongs 'dus me tog nor bu ut+pal 'dzin/ /zla zhal mig sman mdog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lug la gnas shing chu bdag mos 'khyud pa'i/ /me lha la sogs snron gyi tshes rnams gzhan/ /mdung thung dgrag pa chu skyes spyi blugs 'dzin/ /zhal gcig pad+ma rā ga'i mdog la 'dud/ /dpal mos 'phyud cing rma bya la gnas pa'i/ /gdong drug la sogs chu stod tshes rnams gzhan/ kha ka ti mdung dang nor bu me long can/ /byi waṃ 'od 'phro gdong drug ldan pas skyong / /phag mos 'phyud cing chu srin la gnas pa'i/ /rgya mtsho la sogs gro bzhin tshes rnams gzhan/ /zhags pa rin chen sbrul zhags chu shel 'dzin/ /zla ba'i 'od can zla ba'i zhal mchod do/ /byi bar gnas shing gzhon nu mas 'byud pa'i/ /tshogs bdag la sogs khrums stod chos rnams gzhan/ /dgra stu rdo rje zhags pa nor bu'i phyag /zla zhal zla 'od lta bur dkar la 'dud/ /glang por gnas shing rlung lha mos 'phyud pa'i/ /brgya byin la sogs tha skar tshes rnams gzhan/ /rdo rje mda' dang dril bu gzhu yis mtshan/ /gser mdog zla ba'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /glog mas 'phyud cing ngang pa las gnas pa'i/ /tshangs pa la sogs smin spo201—

drug tshes rnams gzhan/ /khab dang bgrang 'phreng chu skyes spyi blugs 'dzin/ /chu yi gser mtshungs chu yi zhal gyis skyong / /u mas 'byud cing khyu mchog la gnas pa'i/ /drag po la sogs mgo yi tshes rnams gzhan/ /rtse gsum mda' dang sbrul ldan kha ṭāX gzhu/ /ri bong 'dzin zhal mkha' ltar sngo la 'dud/ /glang por gnas shing nor spyin mas 'byud pa'i/ /nor bdag la sogs rgyal gyi tshes rnams gzhan/ /nor bu be con ne'u le pad+ma'i phyag /sngon po ri dwags mtshan pa'i zhal mchod bgyi/ /dpal mos 'khyud cing mkha' lding la gnas pa'i/ /khyab 'jug la sogs mchu yi tshes rnams gzhan/ /'khor lo dbyug tho pad+ma dung gis mtshan/ /zhal gcig mar gad mdog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshin rje mas 'byud ma he la gnas pa'i/ /gshin rje la sogs dbo yi tshes rnams g.yin/ /dbyug pa ral gri lcags sgrog zhags pas brgyan/ /ljang khu ri dwags can zhal la phyag 'tshal/ /'od zer can 'byud dbyug sngon nag po ral gri dang ni rdo rje phub dang ltos 'gro 'dzin/ /tsin das legs 'byud ḍā ki dmar po me mda' dang ni lcags kyu gzhu dang zhags pas mtshan/ /khro gnyer mas 'phyud mi g.yo dkar po tho ba dang ni mdung dang pad+ma me long 'dzin/ /lcags sgrog mas 'byud stobs chen ser po lka bor lo dang ni dbyug pa dung dang nor bu'i phyag /sngon mos 'byud pa'i gtsug tor ljang khu dgra stu dang ni rtse gsum sprul zhags kha ṭāX ga /drag spyan mas 'byud gnod mdzes sngon po gri gug dang ni rdo rje thod pa dril bu 'dzin/ /phag rta seng ge glang po mkha' lding rkang brgyad kyi ni shing rta la gnas g.yas brkyang stabs/ /mthil bzhi bshang lam gtsug gi rtsa dag khro bo'i tshogs ni zhal gcig —202—

phyag bzhis brjid la 'dud/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma char sprin mdog /nor rgyas dung skyong byi dra'i phung po 'dra/ /mtha' yas rigs ldan kun da'i mdog ltar gsal/ /'jog po pad+ma chen po rab tu ser/ /rgyal dang rnam rgyal ljang sngon 'byung ba la/ /rdo rje gdan bzhugs rin chen rgyal gyis brgyan/ /bum pa rdo rje pad+ma nor bu'i phyag /rkang sor klu chen gtum mos 'phyud la 'dud/ /mdung gis 'bigs dang lhag ma brtsegs pa'i ro/ /drag po'i g.yul dang rul pa byis pa gsod/ /rnag gi dri dang sbrul gyis zos pa yis/ /dur khrod chen por bse dang bhe dran ṭa/ /dom dang khrung khrung 'bri dang bya ma byi/ /seng ge mig sngon la gnas 'khor lo'i steng / /zlum po'i stabs can mi mgo'i 'phreng ldan ma/ /gcer bu spyan gsum gri gug thod pa ma/ /phyag rgya lnga ldan klu yis rab 'khyu/da ma/ /lus la lag pa'i ser mo rnam dag ma/ /khyi gdong ma dang khwa gdong phag gdong ma/ /bya rgod gdong ma stag gdong 'ug gdong ma/ /lce spyang gdong ma nam mkha' lding gdong ma/ /steng 'og shing rtar sngon mo rdo rje'i mig /skra dang ba sbu rnam dag grub pa dang / /'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor la phyag 'tshal lo/ khren tu stobs ma rmugs byed ma dang nga rgyal can ma rengs byed ma/ /lcags sgrog ma dang khro gnyer can ma tsun da dang ni 'od zer can/ /drag spyan ma dang shin tu sngon mo rang rang rigs kyi khro bo yi/ /zhal phyag mtshon cha kha dog rgyan ldan khro mo rnams la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin sgrol ma reg bya ma dang khyab 'jug lcags sgrog kha gdong ma/ /rab sngon rab brtson tsartsi ka dang khyi gdong mas bskyed brgya byin du//dbye ba gos dang mchil 'dor reg bya lhag ma za ba kun du gdung / /skrod dang —203—

lus 'phrug yan lag bskyod par 'dod dang phyir 'dod ma la 'dud/ /gos dkar ro ma gzhon nu ma dang khro gnyer can ma bya rgod ma/ /drag spyan rmug ma phag mo dang ni phag gdong mas bskyed lho phyogs su/ /bskyod pa zas dang gar 'gugs g.yul dang rgyug pa dang ni skems pa dang / /lus kyi dri ma bshang gci zag par 'dod dang phyir 'dod ma rnams mchod/ /mā mā gī dang gzugs ma dpal mo tsun da dang ni lug gdong ma/ /sgra ma khengs ma drag mo dang ni stag gdong mas bskyed nor sbyin du/ /rgyas pa rgyan dang rgyal srid 'ching ba byis pa sdig dang rol mo'i sgra/ /'jam par smra dang mal stan rtsod mang 'dod dang phyir 'dod ma rnams rgyal/ /spyan ma dri ma myongs ma dang ni 'od zer can ma mkha' lding ma/ /chos kyi khams ma rengs ma dbang mo lce spyang mas bskyed chu bdag tu/ /rengs pa dri dang chu la rkyal ba phur bus 'debs dang sbrul 'ching 'khrig /gnyen 'dun mal brnyes sems can bslu 'dod phyir 'dod ma rnams gzhan la 'dud/ /khyod ni srid pa gsum las 'das kyang srid pa gsum gyi rnam pa can/ /phra rab rdul gyi chos dang bral yang brtan dang g.yo ba kun gyi gzugs/ /lus dang dbang po'i spyor ba spangs kyang rtag tu 'dod chags che la rol bsam gyis mi khyab brtag par dka' ba dus kyi 'khor los bdag skyongs shig /gza' dang drang srong rgyu skar khyim dang cha/ /phyogs skyong zhing skyong pho nya 'phrog ma dang / /lha ṇa ṭa kaṇ+ḍa dga' byed nag po che/ /rdzu gi ni sogs 'khor mang rgyal gyur cig /de ltar bstod pas phung po khams sogs gzhan/ /bde gshegs snying po de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings/ /glo bur dri ma'i sbugs las nges grol te/ /srid —204—

rtogs nye bar bsdus pa rdzogs so/ /sems can thams cad kyis rang rang la bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang rgyal khams phyogs med ris med pa rton pa bzhi ldan gyis bkod pa'o// //oṃ āXhuX hoXhaX k+ṣaXswāhā/ ma ṅga laX/ dge'o// //

༄༅/ /bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi bskang gso bde stong rol pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/na maXphe kā la tsakra ya/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi bskang gso bde stong rol pa ni/bsal gtan nang mtshams byed pa dang / /rgyud sde 'chad nyan dbang bskur rigs/ /chos ldan rmi lam 'khrugs pa'am/ /rnal 'byor nyams 'chags gso ba dang / sems can tshogs gnyis spel ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor lha yi nga rgyal gyis/ /dbyangs dang rnga brdung 'di skad do/ /hūX/ spros bral chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /gzugs sku mkha' khyab sems can 'dren pa'i phyir/ /dus gsum bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol/ /mdun phyogs 'ja' tshon pa drwa 'khyil ba'i dbus/ /sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab stong rgyas pa'i steng / /seṅge brgyad btegs rin chen sna tshogs khri/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /khyed la phun tshogs mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ /lta spyod rnam dag mchod yon kun nas 'khyil/ /thos bsam sgom gsum dag pa'i zhabs bsil mngar/ /sgo gsum dge bcu'i me tog sil mar bkram/ /sdom gsum dag pa'i spos mchog sprin du 'khrigs/ /bslab gsum yon tan nyi 'od mar me 'bar/ /tshogs gsum rgya mtsho spos chu'i dri mchog bltams/ /'khor gsum dag pa'i ro brgya zhal zas sbyor/ /theg gsum rol mo'i sil snyan sna tshogs dkrol/ /bka' 'khor gsum gyi rnga chen zhabar rnga brdung / /sde snod gsum gyi dung sgra khams gsum sgrogs/ /—206—

rgyud sde bzhi yi ba dan mkha' la phyar/ /rdzogs ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyen du bsgreng / /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis/ /mtha' bzhi las grol ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ /mkha' khyab dang po'i sangs rgyas thugs dam bskang / /'gyur med rang bzhin 'od gsal chos kyi sku/ /rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen thugs dam bskang / /gzhom med sgra ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang / /dpag med zhing nas mtha' yas sprul pa'i sku/ /sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i thugs dam bskang / /rgyal sras khro rgyal rnams kyi ngo bo nyid/ /chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / /spyan ras gzigs la rgyud 'grel gsan pa'i mchog /grub chen dus zhabs chen po'i thugs dam bskang / /dngos grub rnam gnyis mngon du gyur pa yi/ /grub chen dus zhabs chung ba'i thugs dam bskang / /rnam snang gangs chen mtsho la chos gsan pa'i/ /mkhas mchog nā len+t+ra pa'i thugs dam bskang / /sgrol mas lung bstan bod khams mun sel ba//paṇa chen zla ba mgon po'i thugs dam bskang //gsang 'dus zhal gzigs mngon shes rdzu 'phrul can/ /blo ldan 'bro ston losnro re thugs dam bskang / /nyin zhag bco lngar 'od gsal ngang la bzhugs//mnyam med lha rje sgom pa'i thugs dam bskang / /zla gcig ting 'dzin sgom pa'i gtsug tor 'phags/ /sgro ston gnam la brtsegs kyi thugs dam bskang / shwaka thub la sogs sangs rgyas dpag med gzigs/ /yu mo chos kyi ra chen thugs dam bskang / /byin rlabs mdzad tsam skal ldan smin grol mdzad/ /sras mchog dharmā shwa ra'i thugs dam bskang/ /dgyes pa rdo rje'i zhal gzigs lung bstan —207—

thob/ /mkhas pa nam mkha' 'od zer thugs dam bskang / /rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs/ /ma cig sprul sku jo 'bum thugs dam bskang / /dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mngon shes thogs med ldan/ khrub thob se mo che ba'i thugs dam bskang / /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis dngos su lung bstan thob/ /chos rje 'jam dbyangs gsar ma'i thugs dam bskang / /lha sa'i jo bos byang chub lung bstan pa/ /kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer thugs dam bskang / /dus 'khor ye shes dkyil 'khor mngon sum gzigs/ /kun spang thugs rje brtson 'grus thugs dam bskang / /chos nyid bde gshegs snying po dngos su brnyes/ /byang sems rgyal ba ye shes thugs dam bskang / /rlud sems dbang 'dus yi dam dpag med gzigs/ /mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /༈ dus gsum rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun 'dus dngos/ /kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan thugs dam bskang / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rgyal bstan 'dzin skyong spel/ /chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal thugs dam bskang / /mang thos rig pas phas rgol tshar gcod mdzad/ /mkhas mchog nya dbon kun dga'i thugs dam bskang / /bshad sgrub nyi zla'i ngo mtshar snang ba'i gnyen/ /'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros thugs dam bskang / /rgya chen shes bya'i gter gyur 'jig rten mig /'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po'i thugs dam bskang / /rgyal ba'i dgongs spyod zab mo'i nges gsang rtogs/ /mkhas pa nam mkha' chos skyong thugs dam bskang / /rnam mang gzhung lugs mkhyen pa'i gangs ri skyongs/ /—208—

paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang thugs dam bskang / /mdo sngags rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i 'khor los bsgyur/ /lī chen rat+na bha dra'i thugs dam bskang / /gdams pa'i chu klung ma lus sdud po mchog /dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog thugs dam bskang / /bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi'i nyams rtogs mthar son pa'i/ /mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /༈ thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /gsang bdag sgrol ba'i mgon po'i thugs dam bskang / /mdo rgyud man ngag mchog la mnga' dbang bsgyur/ /mtshungs med rin chen rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /mkhyen stobs dpung gis rgyal bstan gdugs dkar 'degs/ /mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal thugs dam bskang / /rdzogs ldan grub pa'i brtul zhugs nyams bzhes pa'i/ /grub chen ngag dbang 'phrin las thugs dam bskang / /brgyud gsum byin rlabs chu bo 'dus pa'i gter/ /ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal thugs dam bskang / /zab lam bstan pa'i gsang mdzod 'dod 'jo'i mkhan/ /rnal 'byor mkhas btsun dar rgyas thugs dam bskang / /zab lam gdams pa'i 'khor lo phyogs bcur bskor/ /kun bzang 'phrin las rnam rgyal thugs dam bskang / /gang la gang 'dul thabs mkhas rol rtsed 'a'ang / /nus ldan lhun grub rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /smin grol bdud rtsi'i 'gro phan bla med spyod/ /dkon mchog 'jig med rnam rgyal thugs dam bskang / /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rjes rang gzugs gar/ /ngag dbang chos 'phel rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor mthar son pa/ /ngag dbang chos kyi —209—

'phags pa'i thugs dam bskang / /rnam kun mchog ldan 'od gsal dbyings su rol/ /ngag dbang chos 'dzin rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / ༈ gzung 'dzin 'khrul zad rgyud sde rab 'byams bdag /kun dga' bsod nams dpal ldan thugs dam bskang / /dbang lung gdams ngag rgya mtsho'i ma sgyu di 'dzin pa/ /ngag dbang chos kyi rnal 'byor thugs dam bskang / / gnas lugs bde gshegs snying po mngon gsal ba//ngag dbang mkhas grub dbang phyug thugs dam bskang //yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i zhal gzigs pa/ /ngag dbang bstan pa gsal byed thugs dam bskang / /yi dam rgyud sde rab 'byams spro bsdu mdzad/ /ngag dbang rdo rje bzang po'i thugs dam bskang / /don dam gnas lugs bla ma'i zhal mjal ba/ /ngag dbang dkon mchog dar rgyas thugs dam bskang / /gzhan stong dbu mas 'dzam gling khyab mdzad pa/ /ngag dbang blo gros grags pa'i thugs dam bskang / /dus 'khor bskang ba'i kha skong 'dzam thang gtsang ba'i gdan rabs rim byon ltar blo bzang chos 'phel bas bris pa'o/ / ༈ de dag ni dbang brgyud ded pa yin te/ man ngag nyams khrid sogs kyi brgyud pa la mos na/ mkhas btsun dar rgyas kyi mal du/ thabs lam gtum mo'i 'bar snang la spyod pa'i/ /yongs 'dzin kun dga' chos 'phel thugs dam bskang / /zhes pa dang / lhun grub rgya mtsho dang / 'jigs med rnam rgyal zung gi tshab tu/ mngon shes spyan gyis dus gsum sgrib med gzigs/ /rtogs ldan kun dga' chos 'byor thugs dam bskang / /gnas lugs gnyug ma don gyi rang bzhin mjal/ /gu ru ngag dbang rgyal mtshan thugs dam bskang / /de sogs dbang brgyud man ngag gzhung 'grel gyi/ /bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam bskang ba'i byin rlabs rnam dag gis/ /bdag cag —210—

dpon slob skye ba kun tu yang / /rigs ldan bla ma chos rje yab sras kyi/ /rtag par zhal mthong lung rigs dbang 'byor nas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i dpal la spyod par shog /hū/ chos dbyings 'byung lnga 'od 'phreng bskor ba'i dbus/ /gru bzhi nyi ma'i sgo khang rta babs ldan/ /mchog gsum khang brtsegs rgya phub 'degs pa'i dbus/ /sna tshogs pad+ma zla nyi sgra gcan steng / /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo nam mkha'i mdog /sku bzhi'i zhal ldan nyi ma'i spyan chen bgrad/ /ral ba'i cod pan sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /zla phyed mi bskyod pa yi dbu rgyan can/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang / /rdul mun snying stobs rnam dag mgrin pa gsum/ /phyi nang dus drug dag pa'i phrag pa la/ /dus sbyor bcu gnyis rnam dag dpung pa spras/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang / /zla phyed nyer bzhi dag pa'i phyag ngar ldan/ /phyag sor lnga lnga zla ba'i yon tan 'gags/ /sor tshig gsum gsum nyi ma'i yon tan spangs/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang / /sgra gcan rnam dag chos sku nyag gcig 'bar/ /ro rkyang dag pa'i zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gyis/ /bdud dang nyon mongs bskyel ba'i snying gar mnan/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang / /thabs shes g.yas g.yon phyag gi dang po gnyis/ /bde stong rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol/ /bcom ldan dus kyi ge bor lo'i thugs dam bskang / /rnam shes ma rig gcod pa'i ral gri g.yas/ /ye shes rdo rje'i go cha phub dkar g.yon/ /bcom ldan dus kyi snye bor lo'i thugs dam bskang / /zag bcas bde ba gcod pa'i gri gug g.yas/ /zag med bde chen skyong mdzad —211—

thod khrag g.yon/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang / /sgo gsum mi dge 'bugs pa'i rtse gsum g.yas/ /sku gsum yon tan rdzogs pa'i kha ṭāX g.yon/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang / /nyon mongs dug lnga 'joms pa'i me mda' g.yas/ /ye shes lnga ldan 'bar ba'i gzhu brdung g.yon/ /bcom ldan dus kyi ga bor lo'i thugs dam bskang / /rlung sems dbu mar 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu g.yas/ /thig le rtsa rlung 'ching ba'i zhags pa g.yon/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang / /bde stong zab mo'i sgra sgrogs ḍā ru g.ya sa/ /theg gsum dam chos 'gyung gnas rin chen g.yon/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang / /glo bur bum pa brdung ba'i tho ba g.yas/ /nyon mongs skyon gyis ma gos pad dkar g.yon/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang / /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul 'khor lo g.yas/ /khams gsum chos sgra sgrogs pa'i dung dkar g.yon//bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang / /gzung 'dzin log 'dres 'bugs pa'i mdung thung g.yas/ /chos nyid stong gzugs 'char ba'i me long g.yon/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang / /bdud bzhi dpung bcas sgrol byed dbyug pa g.yas/ /las dang nyon mongs 'ching ba'i lcags sgrog g.yon/ /bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang / /ma rig sdong po gcod pa'i dgra stu g.yas/ /rig byed rnam bzhi bcom pa'i tshangs mgo g.yon//bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang / /stag lpags rdo rje'i rgyan drug sku la spras/ /stong chen sna tshogs yum la rnam par rol/ /bde stong gnyis —212—

su med pa'i thugs dam bskang / yum chen lha mo gser mdog zhal bzhi ma/ /pra phab brgyad kyi phyag rnams mtsho ni cha 'dzin/ /phyag rgya lnga yi rab brgyan yab la 'phyud/ /stong chen sna tshogs yum gyi thugs dam bskang / /pha rol phyin bcu rnam dag nus ma bcu/ /bum pa bcu dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / /gnas skabs rigs bzhi'i sgrib pa mthar mdzad pa/ /rdo rje mtshan ma rnam bzhi'i thugs dam bskang / /phung po rnam dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs/ /khams drug dag pa'i yum dang mnyam par sbyor/ /sangs rgyas yab yum tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / /dbang po rnam dag byang chub sems dpa' drug /yul drug dag pa'i lha mos rab tu 'khrud/ /sems dpa' yab yum tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / /las dbang rnam dag khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /bya ba rnam dag khro mor mnyam par sbyor/ /khro rgyal yab yum tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / /skye mched bcu gnyis rnam dag mchod sprin thogs/ /gzungs ma lha mo bcu gnyis thugs dam bskang / /lte ba'i rtsa 'khor dbyug gu rnam dag pa/ /tsartsi kā sogs gzhan mchog gtso mo brgyad/ /zung 'jug rol pa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas/ /gsung gi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskang / /kun rdzob zla ba bcu gnyis tshigs dang rtsa/ /rnam dag lha chen bcu gnyis ba the ne par bcas/ /tshes zhag sum brgya drug cu rnam dag pa//chos nyid lha mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //mthil bzhi gsang gtsug rnam dag shing rta'i steng / /khro rgyal dbyug sngon la sogs khro bo drug /'od zer can sogs khro mor mnyam par sbyor/ /sgo skyong khro rgyal yab yum thugs dam bskang //sor mo rnam dag klu dang gtum mo'i tshogs//—213—

'dod yon dga' bde'i rang bzhin gzungs kyi lha/ /skra dang ba spru rnam dag grub pa'i tshogs/ /don dam 'byung po'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / /gza' dang drang srong rgyu skar khyim dang cha/ /phyogs skyong zhing skyong pho nya 'phrog ma dang / /lha ṇ+ḍa kaṇi dga' byed nag po che/ /rdzu gi ṇi sogs 'khor gyi thugs dam bskang / /don dam skyabs gsum thugs gsung sku'i lha/ /lhun grub ye shes 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /drug brgya so bzhi yab yum 'khor dang bcas/ /chos nyid yongs rdzogs lha tshogs thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam bskang ba'i byin rlabs rnam dag gis/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /dam tshig nyams chags ma lus bskang ba dang / /phyi nang nyon mongs glo bur las grol nas/ /stobs sogs yon tan gdod nas kun ldan pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i snying po myur du thob par shog /hū/ rdo rje khang brtsegs 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /khro rgyal rdo rje shugs kyi thugs dam bskang / /pha rol phyin bcu rnam dag khro rgyal bcu/ /don dam zad par bcu yi thugs dam bskang / /stobs bcu bzhon pa ldan pa'i phyogs skyong bcu/ /chos nyid gza' chen bcu yi thugs dam bskang //ye shes dbang bcu'i bdag nyid klu rgyal bcu/ /gzhan mchog 'byung po bcu yi thugs dam bskang / /sde drug srung ma drug cu 'khor bcas dang / /dur khrod 'byung po bye ba phrag phyed la/ /gling bzhi lhun po nyi zla dpag bsam shing / /lha mi'i longs spyod tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang / /bdag cag rnal 'byor bsrung skyobs zhi rgyas sogs/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin sgrub par mdzod/ /hu/rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bcom ldan dpal chen rdo —214—

rje nag po che/ /srin po'i gzugs can sbom thung mche ba gtsigs/ /zlum po'i stabs can rus rgyan dar gyis brgyan/ /gri thod rnam 'phrul ga rnye thugs kar 'dzin/ /skra ser sbrul rgyan tshangs rkud thod rlon spras/ /dpal ldan mahā kā la'i thugs dam bskang / /e ka tsa ṭi 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ /gnod sbyin yab yum pu ṭa ming sring dang / /ru 'dren sde bzhi mi nag bya khyi sogs/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam skongs gyur cig /seng ge glang chen stag gzig dom dred sogs/ /khrab rmog dar sna rin chen sna tshogs 'dis/ /mahā kā la 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /bzhes nas thub dbang bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /rdo rje theg pa mchog tu dar bar mdzod/ /de ltar thugs dam bskang ba'i byin rlabs kyis//bdag cag byang chub snying po bsgrub pa la/ /'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad rigs thams cad dang / /nyon mongs rnam rtog dgra bgegs zhi bar mdzod/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor snyan grags dang / /sa lam yon tan ma lus rgyas par mdzod/ /mi chen rgyal po lha klu ma lus dang / /las rlung thams cad dbang du bsdu bar mdzod/ /lha mi'i longs spyod 'dod rdzas thams cad dang / /rlung sems ma lus dbu mar 'gug par mdzod/ /bstan pa'i dgra bo bdud rigs thams cad dang / /nyon mongs rags pa'i sems rnams rmongs par mdzod/ /thar pa'i chom rkun 'du 'dzi la sogs pa'i/ /mi bzad glo bur dgra rnams rengs par mdzod//bsgral ba'i zhing gyur dgra bgegs thams cad dang / /las rlung nyi khri chig stong bsad par mdzod/ /gzung 'dzin ma rig las kyi dgra bgegs dang / /'dzag bde 'pho ba'i bag chags bskrad par mdzod/ /tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po'i dngos —215—

bsdus 'di'ang / kun mkhyen rin po che shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis gsungs/ rgyud sde bzhi'i bskang ba bde stong rol pa nas khol byung du 'bri ba po ni/ dge slong ngag dbang chos 'phel te dge bar gyur cig bkra shis/

zhes bya ba bzhu/gas/oṃ āXhūX hoXhaX k+ṣaX 'dir dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod mdor bsdus pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang ma 'brel ba'i skabs yin na/ yo byad thams cad tshogs par byas nas/ nang mchod byin rlabs rgyas pa dang / sngon 'gro gtor ma gnas yo byin rlabs/ zhu 'bul/ skyabs sems yig brgya rnams dkyil chog dang sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar byed pa las/ sems can don du sems dge bas/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /tshul bzhin cho gar ldan pa yi/ /rnal 'byor la ni nyer gnas mdzod//ces pas gsol 'debs zhu 'bul byed pa ni khyad par ro/ /de nas bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs nas/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i bar rgyas bsdus ji ltar sgom kyang rung ste/ bzlas pa'i bar du bya zhing / dkyil 'khor bsgoms na rang la nye bar bsdu'o/ /mdun bskyed maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gis byugs pa'i dbus su/ nang mchod kyis chos 'byung thig le dang bcas pa 'bri ba'am/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dang bris sku sogs — yod na maṇ+ḍal ma byas kyang chog gang ltar yang bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/'byung bzhi ri rab la brten zhing srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du chud pa/khor yug chen po lngas yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal med khang lha'i gdan dang bcas pa / dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa dang bcas pa de nyid —217—

du grub par gyur pa ni/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i bdag /ces pa nas bzung / bstod chen yongs rdzogs 'don pa'am/ thugs dkyil tsam byed na/ yid rab 'dzin pa rnams la 'dud/ /ces pa'i rjes su/ khyod kyi srid pa gsum las 'das kyang sogs sbyar/ de nas/bdag nyid kyi thugs kar huX yongs su gyur pa las/ zhes pa nas/ dzaXhuX baX hoXhi/zhes pa'i bar ye shes dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phre/sa/rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa zhes mgron spyan 'dren pa nas/ khyod la 'dud de khyod la 'dud/ /ces pa'i dkyil 'khor lhag gnas skabs kyi mchod pa dang 'dra ba las/ thugs dkyil tsam byed na/oṃ ṣa ḍaX ga ya na maX zhes pa'i rjes su/ oX gu ru bud+dhā bo dhi sa te sbyo na mo na maX zhes brjod/ de nas gtor chog ltar gtor ma 'bul ba yan mā bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang 'brel ba'i skabs kyi tshogs mchod yin na/ gtor ma 'bul ba yan chad dkyil chog ltar song ba'i rjes su/ tshogs rdzas byin gyis rlabs pa man chad kyi chog ste/ de yang bdag 'jug mi byed pa'am byed kyang de'i sngon du tshogs 'khor byed na/ gtor chog sngon du len dgos so/ /de nas tshogs rdzas la nang mchod 'thor bzhin du/ oṃ phre badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ badz+ra dh+wa tī shwa rī ga ga na swa bhā wa sarba dra bye bi shwa dha ni/ sarba dra bya ṇi bi shwa dha ya huX phre phaṭa/ ces lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun brjod/ tshogs rdzas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa ā li kā li'i/ ngo bo rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di nyid/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ya —218—

hū/ de bzhi du sbyar te/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams la zhes dang /'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams la zhes dang / dam tshig gi rtsa ba mched grogs rdo rje sbun grogs rnams la zhes 'don pa spo/ o mi 'bral snying gi gzhal med khang / /mos gus gzhom med pho brang na/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /bka' drin mnyam med dam pa rje/ /rnam 'phru/la mkha' la sprin bzhin 'thib/ /'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /gnas khang 'di la byin phob la/ /tshogs rdzas 'di la bcud cig chug /'dir 'dus rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /rnam dag bde chen 'gyur med dngos/ /bde gshegs rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems/ /mkha' khyab dang po'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /rnam 'phrul mkha' sogs/ spros bral dag pa e yig dbyibs/ /rnam kun mchog ldan mkha' spyod gnas/ /'khor lo'i bdag mo sna tshogs yum/ /dbyings phyug shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rnam 'phrul sogs/ rnam gsum srid pa'i gnas kyi mchog /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten sprul sku'i zhing / /sangs rgyas byang sems khro bo'i gtso/ /dkyil 'khor lha mo'i tshogs bcas kyang / /rnam 'phrul sogs/ rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /'chi med gdengs can lha min skyes/ /'khor ba gnas 'gyur ye shes kyi/ /srid gsum lha tshogs thams cad kyang / /rnam 'phrul sogs/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnam 'phrul mchog /chos rgyal rigs ldan 'khor bcas dang / /rtsod ldan dus 'dir rdo rje 'chang / /brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs kun yang / /rnam 'phrul sogs/ sa la spyod pa'i 'og min mchog /bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad gnas mchog —219—

nas/ /sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yang / /rnam 'phrul sogs/ gang la gang 'dul skur ston pa/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /gdul dka' ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /phyag brnyan pho nya 'byung po'i tshogs/ /rnam 'phrul sogs/ bdud tshogs kun 'dul 'phrin las zhing / /dur khrod chen po bcu drug nas/ /bgegs 'joms 'dod don kun sgrub pa/ /chos skyong bstan srung tshogs rnams kyang / /rnam 'phrul sogs/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /rigs gyi cod pan ldems se ldem/ /dar gyi cod pan pur ru sa /rgyan cha mang po khral la la/ /rol mo mang po dir ri ri/ /glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug /'khor tshogs 'bum sde shar ra ra/ /sgyu ma'i rang snang rjen ne ne/ /gtad med rig pa sal la la/ /brjod med dbyings du thal la la/ /bde ba chen po khril li li/ /byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol/ /gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dngos sgrub stsol/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol/ /'khor gsum gnyis su med par rol/ /tshigs bod so so'i mthar rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /de nas phud dang po bcad la/ gtor ma la yang cung zad sgron/ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyi sprul pa dang/ /phyogs dus kun gyi mchod rdzas bzang rgu rnams/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul /mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /de nas las kyi rdo rjes lag pa g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzung / g.yas rtse gsum gyi phyag rgyas ka pa la thogs te/ steng 'og kha spyor gyi tshi gyis dzong la/ kyai/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang pos ltos/ /'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa rnams/ /rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du rī —220—

rol/ / zhes tshogs kyi gtso bo nas brtsams te rim pas bskor/ so sos kyang / bde gshegs chos la rin thang med/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes blang / slar de tshogs rdzas g.yin rnams la bsre/ yang phud gcig bcad de/ phyed sngar gyi phud dang bsre/ phyed lhag gtor la bsre ba'i phyir logs su bzhag go /da lta lag len la 'di ltar byed pa ltar bkod pa yin zhing / 'grub na tshogs rdzas so sor drangs nas/ slar so so'i phud bsdus nas 'bul bar bya'o/ /snga phyi lhan cig tu bsngo ba ni/ zhal zas ro brgya sogs dang / dus kyi 'khor lo srung ma drug bcu'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang / chos skyong chen po rnams dang / mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / 'byung po spyi dang / yul bdag grong bdag gzhi bdag rnams la gtor mchod nas 'byung ba'i gtor sngags tsam gyis phul/ mthar/ dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing / /rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /bdud rtsi mchog gi mchog par bgyi/ /sgrib pa'i dri ma kun sel zhing / /rtog pa kun las nges grol ba/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /ces brjod/ cung zad spros pa la dga' na/ gtor sngags tsam gyis phul ba'i mthar/ dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs dang / na ma 'i mtha' can gyi mchod sngags chen mos 'bul/ yang na/ na ma 'i mchod sngags gyi ṣā tu/ sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi yi bdag nyid dang / /tshad med rnam thar chos gyi phung po dang / /dam chos ston pa 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams te/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa 'bul/ /dus 'khor rdor sems shākya thub pa dang / /nus ma bum pa bcu dang rdo rje bzhi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dang khro bo'i rgyal/ /rang rang lha mor bcas pa rnams la mchod/ /gzungs ma —221—

rnal 'byor ma dang 'dod ma dang / /chos kyi lha dang gdeng can phyir 'dod ma/ /rab gtum gza' skar phyogs skyong zhing skyong sogs/ /phyed bcas bye ba gsum gyi 'byung po mchod/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas dang / /mchod yul rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod par 'bul/ /'gro kun ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho la/ /mchog tu rol bas bde chen thob par shog /ces pa tsam brjod kyang yo /bsdus pa'i skabs gtor sngags kho nas chog go/so sos phud bcad nas/ o ā gu ru brnya bo dhi sa te khyu badz+ra ni bi te hu/ ཿ bu gnyis byas/ o ha ri s+t+ya piṇ+ḍa gi pra tisnro swāhā/ yang chang bu gsum pa byas la/ skye( sarba dū tī ke/ a grwa gra sa pra titsā swāhā/ de nas nang gi sbyin sreg gi dmigs pa gsal btab la so sor longs spyod/ lhag ma bsdus la bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lhag ma'i gtor ma bzang zhing rgya che ba 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen po gyur/ o ā hū ha ho hrī oṃ a kā ro sogs dang / o kha kha 'a hi khya hi u lci khye ba li u lci rdzo bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa swāhā/ lan gsum rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te phyir btang / drag sngags kyis mtshams bcad/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma dang lhag gtor lhan cig gtong ba'i lag len yod pa ltar byas kyang rung / de nas rdo rje'i glu blang ba ni dril bu'i sgra dang bcas/ kol+la e ri ṭa 'i ā bo lwa/ /mu skru ṇi ri kak+ko la/ /gha ṇi kri bi tra ho badz+dza i/ /ka ru ṇi ki a i ṇa ro lwa/ /tā hi bā la khadz+dza yī/ /gā ḍi ma a ṇa bidz+dza a i/ /ha le ka li ñtsa ra pa ṇi a i/ /du dhu ra brji a i/ /tsa gi / sa ma tre ri sih+la/ /ka pu ri la i a i mā la in+ta na swa li dza/ /ta hi bha dag kha i a i/ /phre kha ṇa khe ṭa ka ra rnye/ khri༈gi a shudha rnya ma ni a i/ /ni ra su a ga tsa ḍa bi/ /ta hi dza sa rā bā pa ṇi a i/ /ma la a tsi kun+da ru ba ḍa i/ /ṇa ḍi ma ta hi na badz+dza a i/ /zhes brjod/ lte bar —222—

gtum mo 'bar ba yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga sregs shing / /spyan ma mig la sogs pa dag /sregs pa'i ri bong can ha 'dzag /ces brjod cing don sgom/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs bkra shis dang / sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba/ /de yi sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang / /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog /ces smon lam bto/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang 'brel ba yin na/de'i rjes chog kho nas chog ma 'brel na yig brgya bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ slar yang smon lam bkra shis dang bcas pa gtor chog bzhin du bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel bar tshogs mchod shin tu bsdus pa byed na/ zhu 'bul dor zhing / mdun bskyed rgyas pa'ang mi dgos pas/mgron spyan 'dren man chad byed pa las/ mchod pa'i tshigs bcad kyang dor/ nang mchod 'bul ba yang mchod sngags tsam gyis chog go/ skyabs sems yig brgya rnams kyang bsdus pa dang / bdag bskyed kyang lhan skyes sam dpa' bo gcig pa kho na la brten par bya'o/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rnam gzhag rgyas pa/ rgyud 'grel rnams dang rdo rje 'dzin pa gong ma rnams kyis rgyas par gsungs pa las rtogs par bya zhing / mdo tsam zhig gzhan du 'bri bar yang 'dod do/ /de ltar na tshogs mchod kyi cho ga bdud rtsi 'khyil ba zhes bya ba 'di yang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su sbyar ba'o// //ma ṅga la/—223—

'khor lo'i dgyes glu bde chen rdo rje'i gsang tshig rī ces bya ba bzhugs/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dgyes glu bde chen rdo rje'i gsang tshig ces bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /he he badz+ra mahā su kha/ a ho hū e wa kā la tsakra/ gnas dag pa 'og min sku gsum gyi zhing 'dir/ /pha bla ma rdo rje sems dpal yi sgyu 'phrul/ /lus phung khams skye mched rnam dag gi lha tshogs//dpe grangs las 'das pa mkha' dbyings kun khyab bzhugs/ 1 /sku mtshan dpe gsal bkrag ye shes kyi rang snang / /gsung gzhom med rdo rje nā da yi sgra gdangs/ /thugs spros bral g.yo med bde chen gyi rdo rje/ /dus 'gags med rnam kun mchog ldan gyi rang gzugs/ 2 /byin brlabs kyi chu 'dzin lang long du 'khrigs te/ /dngos grub kyi char rgyun 'dzad med du 'bebs shing / /ma dag pa'i dngos snang chos dbyings su zim nas/ /snang srid kun dag pa rab 'byams su shar byung / 3 /a ho ho/ snod mtshan ldan bde skyong gi kā pa la sa /bcud sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i dam rdzas rgya che na/ /nang rigs lnga ye shes kyi rang bzhin las grub/ /zag med kyi ro brgya dang ldan pa'i tshogs 'khor/ 4 /phyi nang dang gsang —224—

gsum gyi mchod pa'i sprin phung / /kha dog dang dri ro sogs ci dgar 'char 'dis/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kun bde bas dgyes so/ /rnal 'byor kun zhen med du tshims par rol bas/ 5 /snang srid kun bde chen gyi rnam par shar zhing / /gtsang sme dang tha mal gyi snang ba yal song / /nyams dga' zhing bde drod kyi snang ba rab 'byams/ /dus 'gog med 'char ba yi dga' ston ngo mtshar6/he he/ pha bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen gyi drin las/ /lam zab mo rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la brten nas/ /blo kun rtog las rlung rta pho la zhon te/ /lus phung po sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor du gnas pa'i/ 7 /rtsa nyi khri'i grong khyer srang lam nas brgyud de//ma dag pa'i snang ba sna tshogs su rgyu ba/ /dngos po kun bden med sgyu ma ru yal te/ /stong gzugs la mnyam sbyor ye shes kyi ngang nas/ 8 /srog thur dang rdor bzlas la sogs par sbyor bas/ /rtsa dbu mar a ma'i mkha' dbyings su zhugs nas/ /'khor lo drug 'gyur med bde ba yis khyab cing / /'khor 'das kun a ma'i rnam 'gyur du shes 'dug 9 /dhū tī ru nyi zla 'bar 'dzag gi snang bar//stong gzugs kyi dag snang bar 'byams su shar der/ /g.yo med kyi ye shes 'dzin med du sbyor bas/ /ma dag pa'i thig le rim bzhin du zad nas/10/'gyur med kyi thig le'i cha shas kun rdzogs shing / /rdo rje yi lam lnga myur ba ru bgrod nas/ /mthar thug gi sku bzhi'i dbang phyug tu 'gyur ba'i/ /rten 'brel de da lta 'di nyid nas 'grig song / 11 /zhes bya ba 'di nyid rnal 'byor ba —225—

rnams tshogs la rol ba'i dus su dbyangs snyan pos glu ru blangs te don la mos pa bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di dag yang rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor pa bla ma dbang mchog nas bskul ba bzhin/ thub bstan dge legs rgya mtshos tshig rtogs su bar bris pa'o// //༈ e ma ga na tsakra a la la ho/ a ho dga' 'o skyid do gsang sngags kyi gnas mchog /'dir tshogs rnal 'byor pho mo'i rang snang gi gzigs mor/ /spros bral stong nyid chos sku kun khyab kyi dbyings nas/ /sku dang zhing khams rab 'jums cig car du ngoms byung / /yi dam dpal mchog dus kyi 'khor lo 〈bde ma rdzo wor lo sdom pa 〉yi lha tshogs/ /thabs shes bde stong 'gyur med dga' bde yi myos te/ /sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yi 'du tshogs/ /dam can chos skyong pra phab gzigs snang du phebs byung / /gzung 'dzin kun bral ye bzhugs bde gshegs kyi snying po/ /rtag chad mtha' bral don dam nges don gyi lta ba/ /ye gzhi sngags kyi gzhan stong dbu ma yi gsang gnad/ /bla ma dam pa'i man ngag kho na yis rtogs byung / /tshul 'di kun mkhyen dol po'i rang lugs kyi man ngag /da bar ma chad byin rlabs don brgyud kyi bka' drin/ /khams dbang dang mthun bsam med rnal 'byor gyi zab gsang / /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob pa'i khyad chos 'di a ho/ /gtsang sme'i spros tshogs ye dag kun khyab kyi dbyings su/ /rang byung stong gzugs rab 'byams 'bad med du ngoms shing / /nyams dang rtogs pa 'phel ba'i bsod nams kyi bya ba/ a ho ga na tsakra'i rten 'brel te 'grigs byung / /'di phyi'i phan bde rab ster zab mo yi chos mchog /zla bral —226—

theg mchog gzhan stong dbu ma yi lta ba/ /rang cag 'gro ba yongs kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skabs/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba'i 'dzam gling gi norabu/ /'dir bzhugs rnal 'byor pho mo'i dga' chen gyi dus ston/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i gru char 'bad med du 'jo bas/ /sa dang lam gyi myu gu phang phung du ldem zhing / /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu 'gro kun 'bad med kyis 'tsho mdzad/ /dga' chen bde ba'i rab myos rang byung gi rdor glu/ /kun gyi rna bar 'ong ba'i rgyud mang gi rol mo/ /a ho rtogs pa 'phel ba'i cha rkyen gyi dga' ston/ /chos sku'i rgyal sa non pa'i rten 'brel te 'grigs so/ /zhes dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i 〈wor lo sdom pa'i 〉sgrub mchod kyi skabs su mkho bar mthong bas shar 'dzam thang bsam 'grub nor bu'i gling gi nye 'dabs su gnas pa blo baṭīng twos 'phrel bas bris pa'o// //—227—

nang gi mun sel gyi lag le sna bzhugs/sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ āXhuX hoXhaX k+ṣaX ye shes me lce 'od rab gsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs zur thig ni legs par btab/ /nyi ma'i sor gyis zlum por bskor/ /pad+ma dang ni thab kyi tshad/ /sum cha lte ba 'dab brgyad thig /phyi rol sor gnyis sor bzhis bskor/ /mchu dang kha khyer thig yin no/ /kha khyer mtha' nas phyi rol tu/ /khru do spangs pa rtsig pa nyid/ /sgo gcig byang du phyogs par bya/ /slob dpon la sogs gdan gsum ni/ /lho yi phyogs su dgod par bya/ /phyi ni thugs dkyil nyid dang mtshungs/ /rgyas pa'i thab la de nyis 'gyur/ /khru do gru bzhi thab nang tshad//zur thig steng du khru gang dang / /sor mo bcu gcig lhag bcas kyi/ /steng nas phyogs bzhin btang pas 'grub/ /slob dpon bden bral dbang ldan sgo/ /'di gnyis kha khyer phyir rdo rje/ /'phrin las thams cad pa la ni/ /gnyis te zhi dang rgyas pa'o/ /dang po thab dbyibs zhi rkyang 'dra/ /nang du phyed bskor bde gshegs gnas/ /de phyed bskor ba gtso bo'i gnas/ /tshangs zur bar la gsum gsum phye/ /de dag re re'ang gsum du phye/ /de la tshangs zur g.yas g.yon du/ /gnyis dang gcig dang gsum dang gcig /gnyis rnams sangs rgyas ka ba dang / /bum pa ka ba lha mo yi/ /gnas yin phyi nang rdo rje'i gdung / /sor re'i tshad dang ldan par bya/ /phyi mar tshon pa lha snam dang / /dpangs chung zheng yang dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /gnyis pa la yang des 'dre ste/ /nyis 'gyur gru bzhi'i dbyibs su bya/ /'di dag gnyis ka'ang thab kyi phyir/ /mchu la thab kyi brgyad cha dang / /re kha'i dkyil 'khor bcu drug cha/ /kha khyer bzhi cha de'i phyi sa /re kha sngar dang mtshungs pa nyid/ sgo dang rta bab nub tu —228—

phyogs/ /rwa ba'i nang gi shar phyogs su/ /slob dpon gdan ni dbus su ste/ /mchod yon sreg rdzas gdan g.yon g.yas/ /thab kyi dbyibs mtshungs pad+mas brgyan/ /kha khyer rdo rjes mtshan gdan dbus/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'am chos 'gyung ngo / /'di dag ni nyer mkho cung zad brjod pa ste/ zhib par chos rje kun mkhyen chen pos mdzad pa'i nang gi mun sel dang / paṇa chen blo gros rgyal mtshan dang /mkhen chen phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs thugs sras dam pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gsung rab las shes par bya'o/ /zhi ba rkyang pa la kha khyer dang gdan gsum dang dbus su pad+ma dang / rgyas pa rkyang pa la 'khor lo bkod nas 'dab ma la rigs bzhi yum bzhi'i phyag mtshan 'god cing / kha khyer gyi dpangs la pad 'dab dkar po bri/ las thams cad pa gnyis la thugs dkyil gyi/ mtshan ma ji lta ba ste/ dbus su rdo rje dang / kha khyer gyi phyi logs pad 'dab ljang khu'o/ /bsdus par na tshon sbungs la sogs pas kyang rung tsam yin par mngon zhing / rtsig thab ma 'grub na bris thab bya zhing / de yang ma 'grub na thig tsam 'debs pa dang / shin tu bsdus na ra ba'i nang thig tshun chad gdab cing / de phan chad yid kyi bsam pa las dngos su ma bris kyang rung ba tsam yin te/ dgos pa'i don gyi gtso bo 'grub pa'i phyir dang / cho ga gzhan dang ris pa mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /go skabs yangs shing long yod la rgyu tshogs 'dzom du rung ba'i skabs ni/ rgyud 'grel las rtsal du ston nas gsungs pa'i phyir/thab kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa nyid bri dgos la/ phye mas 'bri ba'am/ chu tshon nyid kyis 'bri ba ji ltar byas kyang 'dra ste/ rdul tshon nyid kyi rnam grangs su 'gyur ro/ /las thams cad pa gnyis la kha khyer tshun chad thams cad ljang khu dang / zhi rgyas la dkar po'o/ /de la thog ma zhi ba rkyang ba'i sbyin sreg ni/ ku sha dang bcas pa'i mchod yon/ tsan dan dkar po'i dri chab/ me tog dkar po'i dri zhim pa/ bsil ba'i bdug spos/ rtsi mar gyi snang gsal/ 'o ma dang 'bras chan gyi zhal zas/ gzhan yang gos zung la sogs pa mchod rdzas dkar po dang / 'o ma can gyi yam shing mthe'u chung las mi phra —229—

zhing mthe bong las mi sbom la/ dkyus su mtho gang pa la lnga brgya bzhi bcu la brgya brgya re tshan du bcang ba dang / dur ba 'o mas sbags pa'i sreg rdzas/ gzhan yang sreg rdzas dkar po ji snyed pa dang /mar khu bud shing dgang blugs la sogs pa tshogs par byas shing / dus kyang zhi ba la karka ṭa dang seng ge'i khyim du bshad par dmigs gsal can gyi las nges par sgrub pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong dang lha mchod pa rgyun gyi nyams len la nges pa med do/ /thab tu bud shing yang bcug rang nyid chas gos dkar por bsgyur te/ thab khung gi lhor skyil krung gi 'dug nas/ rdo rje'i zhal dag pa nas brtsams/ yul bdag grong bdag gi gtor ma dang bdud sreg pa la sogs pa bgegs la phur bus gdab pa'i bar du/ sgrub thabs kyi sngon 'gro dang 'dra ba las/ bsrung ma drug cu'i bskyed pa sogs ma lcogs na/ khro bcu tsam gyi chog pas/ thugs dkyil sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar byas kyang rung la/ phur btab kyi skabs su phur bu bcu dngos su 'god cing / n+ya gro ta'i phur bur mos pa tsam bya/ phur bu srung ba'i don du/ oṃ ha kro dha sogs brjod/ de dag thams cad la mchod bstod tsam byas la/ rang gis sgoms pa'i srung 'khor bdag nyid la bsdu/ bar 'dir bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba zhig sgom pa'ang yod la/ bsdu na bdag nyid dus kyi 'khor lo skad cig gis gsal btab nas/ zla ba'i sku dang zung gi zhabs te sogs sho lo ka gsum 'don/ rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi bzlas pa stong zad bya/ mchod yon bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ ā hu ho : ha k+ṣa zhes pa brgya tsam bzla/ ku sha'i rtse mos mchod yon nas blangs te/ rang dang thab dang yo byad thams cad la gtor/ oṃ ā hu hra phaṭa ces mang du brjod/ dkyil chog bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ o ā hu ho zhes lan mang du brjod cing sreg rdzas rnams bdud rtsir byin gyis wos/ oṃ shā n+ya ta sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i me thab dkar po zlum po rgyar khru gang dpangs su khru phyed/ dbus su pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad —230—

mtshan ma dgu dang bcas pa/ kha khyer la pad+ma'i 'phreng ba dang / kha khyer gyi dpangs la pad 'dab gyi 'phreng ba rtse mo 'og tu phyogs pa dang / phyi rol kyi sa gzhi la dur bas khyab pa/ de'i phyi rol gzhal med khang sgo gcig pa mtshan nyid thams cwad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /thab kyi nang dang rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ me lha dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na pad+ma dang shel gyi bgrang 'phreng / g.yon gnyis na ril pa spyi blug dang dung dkar 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dkar po can/ ral pa ser skya dang mig dmar ser/ pad+ma'i skyil krung gi bzhugs pa'o/ /mchod yon sgrub zin nas 'di yan chad ci bde bar/ me sbar zhing bram ze'i khyim nas blangs te 'o ma can gyi shing las me sbar bar bshad pas de ltar mos so/ /zla ba rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin me lha de gnyis kyi thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i dzaXyig yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje lcags kyu 'od zer 'phro ba rnam par 'phros nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs par gyur/ oṃ e phya hi mahā dh+wa ta de ba ri ṣi dī dza sa t+ta ma gro hi dwa yudheX mahā ra smin sa ni hi to bha wa badz+ra dh+wa ra adzñā pa ya ti swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum dang / oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /lha'i drang srong gnyis skyes mchog /mtshon cha 'dzin pa 'od zer che//'dir ni yang dag phan par mdzod/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin du'o swāhā/mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ dzaXhuX baX hoX zhes dgug gzhug bcing mnyes par mos de ni sreg bya za ba mchod sbyin gyi me lha sha za'i me lha spyan 'dren pa'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gyi steng du mthe bos mnan pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ tseX( sarba pā paX da ha na badz+ra asni badz+ra satwa sarba pā paX da ha da ha swāhā/ zhes lan gsum dang / oṃ sdig pa thams cad sreg pa rdo rje'i me/ /rdo rje —231—

sems dpas sdig kun sregs shig sregs swāhā/ rang gi snying gar gnas pa'i ye shes gdod ma'i me lha de nyid dbugs phyir 'byung ba dang / lhan cig phyi rol tu byon te/ thab nang gi me lha dang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ dzaXhuX baX hoXzhes te de ni 'dod pa'i me'am mi bzad pa'i me zhes kyang bya ste/ de nyid spyan drangs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a na la sarba dh+wa tā na dz+wa la sarba na bhasmi ku ru sarba dzā na du gin huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes dang / oṃ rdo rje lnga me ni 'byung po thams cad 'bar bar 'dod/ /thal bar mdzod cig skye bo gdug can thams cad do/ /huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pas gza' bdun gyi bdag po rta bdun pa'i shing rta can gza' bdun gyi lce bdun dang ldan pa byon par gyur/ dzaXhūX baX hoX (〈dze+e〉 rgo dus kyi 'khor lo las/ lho'i me glog dang khyim bdag gi me nyi ma dang bsreg za'i me dkyus ma 'di yin/ gza' bdun gyi bdag po ni zla ba'i lce dang nyi ma'i lce dang spen pa'i lce dang pa sangs kyi lce dang phur ba'i lce dang gza' lhag pa'i lce dang mig dmar gyi lce'o/ /de gsum kun rdzob me dang / don dam me ni ye shes gdod ma'i me rang gi snying ga nas spro ba de yin/) de ltar na khyim bdag gi me dang / sreg bya za ba'i me dang / bden pa ye shes kyi me kun tu dga' ba'i chos can/ sgrib pa med pa'i phung po la sogs pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i ngo bo'o/ /de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ pra ba ra sa ta kā raX mahā ra smin ar+ghaX pra ti stso swāhā/ zhes pas mchod yon bzed zhal du lan bdun la sogs par phul/ glu( badz+ra gan+taX pratitsā swāhā/ zhes pa nas/ tsho( badz+ra ka maX pratitsā swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ rnam dag ye shes me dpung 'bar ba yis/ /phung po khams sogs sgrib pa'i bud shing rnams/ /skad cig nyid la bsreg cing gsol mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan me yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa tsam mam/ spro na 'og nas 'gyung ba'i bstod —232—

pa rgyas pas bstod/ yam shing bsreg rdzas bsreg blug rnams zla ba'i lce la phul bas dkyil 'khor gyi snyen ra lo thams cad zag med kyi bde bas tshim par gyur/tseX( āXhuX hoXhaX k+ṣaXswāhā/ zhes pas yam shing mar gyis sbags pa brgya rtsa brgyad/ u dum wa ra la sogs pa'i shing du mos la 'bul/ 6 de bzhin du dur ba 'o mas sbags pa brgya rtsa brgyad kyang sngags de nyid kyi 'bul/ glu rdzo swāhā/ zhes pas kyang dgang blugs brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul/ las sngags sbyor tshul ni sngags re re bzhin sbyor ba'am/ bdun bdun tsam re la sbyor la/ brgya rtsa brgyad kyi tha ma kho na la sbyar kyang rung ste/ oX āXhuX hoXhaX k+ṣaXbadag cag dpon slob dpon yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi/6 sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad shan+ti ku ru swāhā/ oṃ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad shan+ti ku ru swāhā/ zhes pa lta bu ste/ dmigs bsal yod na bdag gam/ bsgrub bya'i ming dngos su 'jug cing / nad dang byur chags 'di lta bu zhes ming gsal bar brjod/ 'dis 'og ma kun la'ang rigs 'gres te/ sde tshan dang pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ oṃ hraX hri rjo hruXslo hraXswāhā/ zhes pas yam shing brgya rtsa dang sreg rdzas brgya rtsa gong bzhin phul/ tsho( 6 swāhā/ zhes pas dgang blugs brgya rtsa ste/ sde tshan gnyis pa'o/ /tsho( a ā i sī ṛ grwa u mū '-i lī aX āXswāhā/ zhes pas yam shing dang bsreg rdzas 'bul/ dgang blugs yang gong bzhin 'bul te sde tshan gsum pa'o/ /tsho( a ā e e ar ur tse( 6( al ul aX aXswāhā/ zhes pas yam shing dang bsreg rdzas 'bul/ bsreg blugs kyang gong bzhin 'bul te sde tshan bzhi pa'o/ /—233—

glu( ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā ha hā swāhā/ zhes pas yam shing dang bsreg rdzas 'bul/ bsreg blugs kyang sngar bzhin 'bul te sde tshan lnga pa'o/ /de ltar na/ sde tshan lnga po so sor/yam shing ni brgya brgyad nges par 'bul dgos la/ bsreg rdzas dang dgang blugs ni de tsam ma 'byor na ji ltar rigs pa dang / bsreg rdzas kyang dur ba 'o mas sbags pa zhi ba la gtso bo yin mod kyi/ dge ba'i las la 'os pa'i bsreg rdzas gzhan ji ltar 'os pa phul yang mi 'gal zhing legs pa yin no zhes pa ni dam pa rnams kyi man ngag go /de bzhin du bsdus par na yam shing lnga brgya bzhi bcu phul ba'i rjes su/ sngags tshan lnga po sdom pa la bsreg rdzas brgya rtsa tsam dang / rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi sngags kyi dgang blugs kyang de tsam 'bul zhing / spros pa la dga' na sde tshan re re'i mthar/ gong bzhin mchod pa bstod kyang bya'o//de bzhin du me lha la gtor ma 'bul ba yang ste/ de dag kyang gnas skabs ci rigs par lag len la gdab par bya ba yin te bla ma'i ngag go /skabs 'dir ni nges par gong bzhin mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭaklis dbang bskur ba/ khres rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs/ /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /tshangs dbang 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su skyabs pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gi sku sprul pa/ /nyon mongs bsregs pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul pa'i theg pa 'chibs/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan yong kyang bsnams la : myang na sa ri bsil 'das/ / //ga/sto/ lhi ༷ neb rdol tsha thug spong rkangs sa rje sngi/ tai/ ༷/ //ḍi/ri jig stod rti de na gnas phyag kyang —234—

'tshal/ /mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /sogs grod nyi shu dang / spro na/ gang la thog mtha' dbus med sogs kyang bya/ gling rnams mun pas khebs pa sel mdzad cing / /rtsi shing me tog 'bras sogs smin mdzad nas/ /'gro mang nyer 'tsho'i brten du gang gyur pa/ /gza' bdun bdag po khyim bdag me la 'dud//ces bstod/gtor ma byin rlabs rgyas bsdus gang rung byas la/ tsho rna āXhuX hoXmahā ra smi sa pa ri wa ra khyuX i dam ba ling gan+dhaX sogs srung ma drug cu'i gtor sngags sbyar ba'i lan gsum 'bul ba'am/ yang na gong gi spyan 'dren gyi sngags gsum po re re'i mthar/ gtor sngags sbyar na'ang legs par 'gyur ro/ /srung ma drug cu sogs yi dam chos skyong gzhan gyi gtor ma 'bul na yang skabs 'dir 'bul lo/ /de nas slob mas mchod yon gyi snod bzung / slob dpon gyis zan dang chu thogs nas phyi rol tu song ste/ oṃ dh+wa ra bhu baXswāhā/ na mo de be khyuX snyu sti pra dza khyuX swāhā rā dza khyuX zwa dha bi tri khyoX༄a laX dh+wa te khyuX ba ṣa ḍa in+d+ra ya/ zhes pa dang /steng na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag ce dre sogs nas bkra shis ci rigs pa brjod nas phyi rol tu gtor/ rang la bsangs gtor dang nye reg byas nas/ slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs te/ skye( āXhūX kā ya waka cing t+ta swa bhā wa sdos rnye swāhā/ zhes pas me la ku shas bsangs gtor bya/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /sogs bzod par gsol/ srid zhi mnyam nyid chen po yi/ /me lha 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad la//dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ /ces sogs yid la 'dod pa'i don thams cad gsol ba btab ste/ oX dzaXg tsā ru mahā ra smi lpa s+tha naX saX trib to ho/ pu na ra ga mi smri si/de bā gya/ ya da ā hā na yā mi swāhā/ oṃ dzaX gshe/gas shig gshe/gas shig 'od —235—

zer che/ /tshims nas rang gi gnas su'o/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /lha 'dir gang tshe spyan drangs na'o/ /swāhā/ zhes pas dbugs nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig ye shes kyi me rang gi snying gar thim/ sha za'i me dang khyim bdag gi me yang rang rang gi gnas su gshegs/ smon lam dang bkra shis sogs spyi dang 'dra / me rang bzhin kyi zhi ba na thal bas chu dang skam la gnas pa'i sems can la phan gdags par bya'o/ /rgyas pa kho na'i las kyang phal cher de dang 'dra ba las/ rgyas pa rkyang ba'i sbyin sreg la ni/ zho dang 'brasachan gyi zhal zas dang / 'bras sob mon sran/ tsan dan dkar po/ sran dkar nar mo/ til nag la sogs pa 'bru lnga tshan cig mar la sbags pa'i bsreg rdzas dang / a shwad tha'i phur bu dang / 'khrig pa dang bu mo'i khyim du dang / me lha'i phyag g.yas na 'khor lo dang mu tig gi 'phreng ba/ g.yon na pad+ma dang spyi blugs dang nyi ma rnam par dag pa dang / rdo rje'i skyil krung tu bzhugs pa dang / me thab gru bzhi pa/ rgyar khru do dang / dpangs su khru gang ba dang / nyi ma'i lce la phul bar bsam/ yam shing dang bsreg rdzas dgang blugs 'bul ba'i sngags la/ na maX'i mtha' can dang / spel tshig gi skabs/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi/ dpal dang 'byor pa dang tshe dang bsod nams dang stobs dang dbang thang dza ri ku sa lko brjod pa ni khyad par ro/ /de bzhin du zhi ba las thams cad pa ni zhi pa dang 'dra la/ rgyas pa las thams cad pa ni rgyas pa dang 'dra ba las/ thab bskyed pa'i skabs su me thab ljang khu byed pa dang / re kha'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi bar du kha khyer dang bcas pa/ thab kyi dbus su dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan ma lha'i gdan dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang / me lha ljang khu ba 'ad pa'i zhal/ g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang bgrang 'phreng / g.yon gnyis na dril bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan can no/ /brgyan dang gos dmar ser can/ zhi ba la sgra gcan dang / rgyas pa la dus me rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhes pa dang thab kyi phyi rol tu ku sha 'grems pa rnams khyad par ro/ /gzhan yang bsad pa la thab khung gzhi'i —236—

rnam pa khru phyed pa dang / bskrad pa la zur lnga pa khru gang ba dang / dbang la zur gsum sor nyi shu pa dang / dgug pa la zur bdun sor bzhi bcu pa dang / rmongs pa la zur drug sor sum cu pa dang /rengs pa la zur brgyad sor drug cu pa dang / de dag so so la yang mchod yon gyi snod dang / mchod yon dang / nyer spyod dang / phur bu dang / thab kyi mtshan ma dang / kha khyer gyi dpangs kyi mtshan ma dang / de'i phyi rol tu 'gram pa dang / phyogs dang / kha dog dang / dus dang / 'dug stangs dang / me lha dang / dus lce dang / sngags kyi mtha' dang spel tshigs la sogs pa re re bzhin tha dad du yod pa rnams/ so sor nges par bya dgos te/ mtha' dag nang gi mun sel las rtogs par bya zhing / blo gros chen po rnams kyis rgyud 'grel chen po las kyang ngo / /'dir spyin bsreg gzhan gyi lugs ltar/me lha'i thugs ka sogs su dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni mi dgos kyang / bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i sde tshan lnga po la/ lha so so'i ngo bor mos pa dgos sam snyam na 'di yang mtha' gcig tu mi dgos te/dbyangs lnga ring thung dang / yon tan dang / 'phel ba dang / ya ṇa ra bsgyur ba ring thung rnams dag sbyor gyi khyad par gzhan mang po la ltos pa dang / las dang dngos grub kyi khyad par sna tshogs pa 'grub pa'i dgos don mang po dbang gi yin gyi/ thugs dkyil gyi lha'i sa bon kho nar dmigs pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na ye shes kyi me lha nyid dkyil 'khor gyi lha kun 'dus kyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ spros pa gzhan gyis ci zhig bya/ 'on te bla ma'i man ngag dang / rang gi mos pa'i khyad par gyis/rgya gar gyi slob dpon rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sbyin bsreg gi cho ga 'dir sbyor ba dang / me lha'i thugs kar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgom pa sogs kyang nan gyi byed na 'dir ci zhig 'gog des na 'od kyi snye ma dang / rgyud 'dir gsungs pa'i cho ga sbrags ma byed par spro na/ phyis kyi dus 'khor ba mang pos mdzad cing / khyad par bka' srol 'di la yang / chos rgyal phyogs las rnam rgyal dang /de nyid kyi thugs sras rnams kyis mdzad pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa dpal dus gyi 'khor lo'i sbyin bsreg gi cho ga nang gi mun sel gyi lag len zhes bya ba 'di yang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas —237—

slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho sko la rngu5rgyag pa bzhu/gas/oX gu ru budha bo dhi sa te na mo na maX bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis ldan/ /dus sbyor bcu gnyis 'gags pa ste/ /kun mkhyen skye dgu'i bdag po la/ /btud nas slob dpon dbang bskur mug da/ 'dir sdom ni/ gsol dang gsol gdab chu cod pan/ /dar dpyangs brtul zhugs phyag rgya drug /rjes gnang gnyis dang 'dogs lnga dang / /dbang bzhi rdo rje gsum byin rlabs/ ched brjod mchod pa brtan bzhugs dang / /dam tshig dang ni phan yon sgrags/ /dbu gags dbyung gzengs bstod rjes kyi chos/ /bdag po'i dbang bskur yin par bshad/ /rig ma bshams shing dag pa brjod/ /bka' zhu bkas gnang gsol ba gdab//rig ma gtad cing 'khor lo sgom/ /bde ba sgom zhing chu dbang bskur/ /bkas gnang dbang bzhi bskur ba dang / /bzhi pa la ni ched brjod lhag /rjes kyi bya ba rnam gnyis te/ /bdag po r+ṣa po'i dbang yin no/ /de la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni rnam pa gnyis te/ bdag po'i dbang bskur ba dang / bdag po chen po'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ kye dpal ldan bla ma khyed kyi bka' drin las/ da ni bdag gis bde bar gshegs pa'i lam thams cad shes so/ /dus 'di nas brtsams te khyed dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams spangs nas/ bla ma gzhan bsten par mi bgyi'o/ /gang gi bdag ni khyod drin las//—239—

rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang / /thugs rjes gter gyis bdag la stso'i// /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab ste/ tshig bcad 'di yang gzhan dang go bstun pa'o/ /sgrib pa thams cad bcom pa yi/ /sogs kyis kyang lan gsum gsol ba btab/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol lam ngos yangs par/dbang stegs bcas pa'i steng du dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bkod la/ bu mo brgyad kyis bum pa brgyad bzung / ga6zhe nu ma gnyis kyis rgyal rnam rgyal gnyis bzung ste/ bum chu bsdu ba nas brtsams/ chu dbang dang / cod pan gyi dbang dang / dar dpyangs kyi dbang dang / brtul zhugs kyi dbang rnams byis 'jug gi dbang dang 'dra bar bskur ba las/ khyad par ni/ dbang gi dag pa rnams brjod mi dgos/ brtul zhugs kyi dbang rdzas mthe bong rdo rje byed pa yin pas/ me tog sil ma nag po zhes sogs/ me |zhe sil ma ljang khu nas/ sngon po zhes pa'i bar la/ mthe bo'i rdo rje sor gdub zhes pa'am/ mthe bo'i rdo rje yang gcig gam gnyis las med na/ mthe bo'i rdo rje sor gdub kyi cha sha sa gcig ces 'don pa spo/ slob ma dus kyi 'khor lo phyag gnyis pa shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/dbang rdzas/ su bhā was sbyangs/ haX las byung ba'i spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa zhal gsum nas/ gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i spyi bo'i 'khor lo nor bu dang bcas pa'i mgo rgyan du gyur/ oṃ haX pañtsa ā kā ra mahā shu n+ya ta spyo bhā ba badz+ra shi ro ma ṇi shi ra si hūX phaṭa/ mi bskyod 'khor lo'i gzugs kyis ni/ /lus mchog la ni rnam brgyan zhing / /srid pa gsum du 'khor lo bskor/ /lus mchog la gnas chu rgyun gyi/ /cig car chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /'gro ba'i don chen byed par 'gyur/ /zhes sbyin/ rna rgyan —240—

gnyis haX haXlas byung pa'i 'od dpag med zhal gsum nas/ bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i rna rgyan du gyur/ oṃ haX haXbā ma dak+ṣi ṇa ka rna yor badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ dpag med rna cha'i gzugs kyis ni/ /rna ba dag la rnam brgyan nas/ /srid pa gsum la chags par bya/ /de 'dis 'gro ba'i don byed gyur/ /mgul rgyan aX las byung ba'i rin chen 'byung ldan zhal gsum nas/ 'od 'phro ba 'dzin pa de zhu ba las byung ba'i mgul brgyan du 'gyur/ oX aX ka rje badz+ra kaṇ+ḍi ke huX phaṭa/ rin chen mgul rgyan gzugs kyis ni/ /bdag gi mgul ba rnam brgyan te/ /'gro 'di ro yis btul byas nas/ /'gro ba chu bzhin 'jug par 'gyur/ /lag gdub a āXdang / rkang gdub ha hāXlas byung ba'i rnam par snang mdzad zhal gsum nas/ dril bu 'dzin pa zhu ba las byung ba'i lag gdub dang rkang gdub tu gyur/ oṃ ā ā bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa ka ra yor badz+ra ru tsa ko hūX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha hāXbā ma dak+ṣi ṇa pā da yor badz+ra nā pu re huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ rnam snang lag gdub gzugs nyid kyis/ /lag pa dag la rnam brgyan te/ /'gro ba'i don la 'jug byas na/ /skye ba sa ltar brtan par 'gyur/ /ska rags aXlas byung ba'i don yod grub pa zhal gsum nas/ dkar po 'dzin pa/ zhu ba las byung ba'i ska rags su gyur/ oṃ āXkasmaX badz+ra me kha lā hūX phaṭa/ don yod ska rags gzugs nyid kyis/ /sked pa la ni rnam brgyan pa/ /'gro 'di rlung gis btul byas nas/ /thog med rlung gris 'gro ba 'dul/ /thal chen waX las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum nas/ gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i —241—

thal chen du gyur/ oṃ wa sarba ang ge bhasmi hu phaṭa/ gnas gsum sogs su byug tshul bya/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin gyi/ /thal ba'i lus la rnam brgyan te/ mchog gi spyod pa rab sbyang nas/ /bde ba'i yid kyis 'gro ba 'dul/ /zhes brjod/ de nas rjes gnang ni/ 'di skad ces bya ste/ gdug pa sdigs par byed pa'i mchog /gang gis ngur smrig mthong tsam gyis/ /lha min sa yis 'og tu 'phros/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bya/ /stong nyid snying rjer khyod byin rlabs/ /stong nyid snying rje rgyun mi 'chad/ /mtshan mar rdo rje dril bu bzung / /ji lta de ltar gzhan la ston/ /khyod ni yongs rdzogs slob dpon te/ /gnas brtan rgan po'ang khyod nyid yin/ khyod ni bsil gyur rnyog pa med/ /dge slong dgra bcom zag pa zad/ /'dzag pa'i 'dod chags rab spangs pas/ khyod kyi zug rngu ma lung/ ba|zhe/ /gzhan la phan pa'i gang zag mchog /khyod ni mngon sum sangs rgyas sras/ /zhes dang / de rjes spro na lugasags gyi rig pa sbyar te/ rdo rje rab gnas rdo rje nyid/ che dang dril bu chen po bzung / /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma bsdu ba nyid du bgyis/ /de bzhi du/ dbang gi don du sa ni yong brtag nags dang grong khyer grong rdal grong gi phyogs kyi cha dag dang / /thab khung rnams kyis mtshan nyid dang ni bum pa dang bcas rdul tshon sbyin sreg phur bu la sogs dang / /slob ma rnams ni bsdu ba dag dang gang yang rgyal ba'i bdag pos mchog gi dkyil 'khor bri ba dang / khres nas slob dpon gyis ni dge dang mi dge'i 'bras slad zhi ba la sogs mtha' dag rab tu bya/ /zhes brjod/ rjes gnang 'di tsam gyis —242—
