chog la/ spros pa la mngon par dga' na/ yi ge rnying pa mang po zhig la yod pa bzhin du/ lag len la yang byed pa mang du yod pa ltar/ dbang bdun nang gi rjes gnang dag pa brjod pa bor ba de byas nas/ sngags dang / mig thur dang / me long dang / mda' gzhu rnams byis 'jug slob ma la bskur ba'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin dang / chos bshad kyi rjes gnang bdag 'jug gi skabs ltar byed pa'ang yod mod kyi nges par dgos pa ni ma yin la/ rdo rje slob dpon du sgrub pa la ma 'brel ba'ang med do/ /'dir lung bstan byed pa ni shes byed yang dag pa ci yang med do/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon du sgrub pa'i bya ba mchog slar yang bum dbang /gsang dbang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang rnams bdag 'jug gi skabs su bshad pa bzhin du bskur/ slar yang sku gsung thugs rdo rje byin gyis brlab pa'i don du/ mchod phyir thogs/ a aX.aX las byung ba'i sku rdo rje zhal gsum nas/ yum dang bcas pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod phyir thogs su gyur/ oX a āX.aX sarba snya ra e ka tri khyu ra swa bhā ba badz+ra yā dzñā pa bī ta/ skan khyu huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /sogs sho lo ka gnyis brjod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā ba ut+pa ko3haX/ gsung gi don du me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i phyag mtshan gyis dbang bskur bar bshad kyang / ngos zin pa dka' na rig drug gi phyag mtshan/ a i ṛ u '-i aX zhes pa rnams las byung ba'i gsung rdo rje zhal gsum nas/ yum dang bcas pa/ de zhu ba las rigs drug gi phyag mtshan du gyur/ oX a ā i yī ṛ grwa u mū '-i lī aX aXswāhā/ dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin/ /sogs/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta bāka badz+ra sogs brjod/ dar dpyangs aX yig las dang / cod pan haX yig las byung ba'i thugs rdo rje zhal gsum nas/ yum dang bcas pa/ de zhu —243—

ba las byung ba'i dar dpyangs dang cod pan du gyur/ oṃ a a rta nā rī shwa ra badz+ra tsan+d+ra badz+ra pas āzhe hu hu phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha pañtsa ā kā ra sogs gong bzhin brjod/ dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /sogs dang / tsit+ta badz+ra/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ tshangs pa sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /gsung gi rdo rje dbang phyug che/ /rgyal po thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /de nyid khyab 'jug rdzu 'phrul che/ /rdo rje rislob dpon khyod nyid do/ /gtsug phud phud bu lcang lo can/ /ral pa muñdza cod pan thogs/ /gdong lnga gtsug phud lnga dang ldan/ zur phud lnga pa me tog thod/ /ces brjod la mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/zhes me tog gtor la brtan bzhugs bya/ 'dir ston pa po'i dbang la mngon par dbang skur ba'i dge slong ngam/ dge tshul lam/ khyim pas g.yogs la sogs pa'i chos dang / khyim pa'i chos mi bya'o/ /gal te ral gri dang / snag tsha dang / tshong la sogs pa byed na/ de'i bka' bcag par 'gyur zhing / bka' bcag pa las mnar med pa 'gro bar 'gyur te/ slob dpon gyi chos rnam par bshig pa'i phyir ro/ /phan yon ni/ 'dir rgyud kyi rgyal po dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bas ni/ dkyil 'khor thams cad du dbang bskur ba ste/ mu stegs pa rnams kyi lha dang lha mo khyab 'ju ga dang drag po la sogs pa dang / tsar tsi ka la sogs pa rnam par sbyangs pa rnams kyi dkyil 'khor yang sgrub pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma dang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud thams cad du dbang bskur bar 'gyur zhing / rgyud thams cad kyi ston pa po dang /sngags thams cad kyi rjes su gnang ba po dang / dngos grub thams cad kyi sgrub pa po ste/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud ston pa po rdo rje slob dpon ni/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal ji lta ba dang / dus kyi 'khor lo dang po'i sangs rgyas ji lta ba de bzhin du thar pa don du gnyer ba —244—

rnams kyis blta bar bya'o/ /de nas dbugs dbyung ba ni/ slob ma'i steng du gdugs bzung la thal mo sbyar/ bskor ba byas shar sgo nas bla ma dang lha la 'bul bar bsam zhing / sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur pa'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ /sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can rnams la snying brtse bas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bri/ khyod kyis nan tan skyed nas su/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ /sngags bshad tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan btags drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /khyed la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /ces so/ /de nas slob ma dbang bskur ba'i skabs su bshad pa bzhi/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /zhes sogs gzengs bstod rgyas pa bya/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod do/ /de la phyag rgya drug gi tshigs bcad dang / dbang bdun gyi nang gi rjes gnang 'dogs bcas rnams dang / rdo rje gsum gyi tshigs bcad gsol gdab/ nga rgyal bzung ba rnams dang / dbugs dbyung dang gzengs bstod rnams bor kyang / cho ga chad pa'i nyes par mi 'gyur la/ phyag rgya drug brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi dod yin pa'i/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa la brtul zhugs kyi dbang logs su bskur ba mi dgos kyang / rdo rje sor gdub kyi dbang 'di nyid gzhan la spyin pa'i don du thob na bzang ba'i phyir/ 'di yang byed pa nyid legs so/ /rgyas par na lha skyed pa thams cad la gnas gzhi byin gyis rlabs pa dang / ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ mchod pa byed pa sogs dang / sku gsung thugs rdo rjer —245—

byed pa'i skabs/ dbang rdzas byin ma thag tu/ las rgyal mchog gi skabs bzhin rdo rje gsum byin rlabs shing / dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa 'bogs pa yang yod de/ rgyas pa'i lugs yin pas/ spro na de ltar bya ba mi 'gal la/ bsdu na dbang rdzas rnams sa bon de dang de la ma byung ba/ lha so so'i ngo bor mos pa tsam gyis kyang go chod pa ni yin no/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rigs gsum las/ dge slong la dbang stegs/ rwa ba lnga'i re 'a 'dom gang gru bzhi pa'i dbus su shing stan rgyar gru do ba dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ tshon sna lngas bris pa dang / dge tshul la re sku gru do pa dang / pad+ma ma bris pa'i shing stan dang / khyim pa la rwa ba gsum gyi re 'a khru gang ba'i dbus su/ stan nang tshangs can phal pa zhig 'god par bshad/ dge tshul la bu mo bzhis bum pa bzhi dang / gzhon nu ma gnyis gong bzhin te/ dbang yang chu dang dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur zhing / phyag rgya bcing ba man chad sngar dang 'dra'o/ khyim pa la ni bu mo gcig gis bum pa dang / ga6zhe nu ma gcig gis rnam par rgyal ba bzung zhing / chu dbang dang / brtul zhugs kyi dbang tsam spyin/ rjes gnang man chad 'dra'o/ /dge tshul dang khyim pa gnyis la/ gang gis ngur smrig zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig po de mi brjod par bshad cing / de rnams lag len la yang yod mod/ lhag par mos pa'i dbang las mtha' gcig tu nges pa yang med par mngon no/ /gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pas/ bdag po'i dbang bskur bshad pa las/ dge ba cung zad gang thob des/ /'gro kun rgyal ba'i bdag por shog /da ni bdag po chen po'i dbang bskur ba bshad par bya ste/ maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa sngon du song bas/ rig ma bcu dngos su star ba'am/ yid kyi yul du gsal btab nas/ slob ma khyim pa yin na rang rigs kyi rig ma bcu slob dpon la 'bul/ slob ma rab tu byung ba yin na/ de —246—

la slob dpon gyis dbang gi don du gzhan rigs kyis rig ma bcu sbyin bar bya ba ste/ tsha mo dang ni bu mo dang / /sring mo de bzhin skyed byed ma/ /de bzhin chung ma'i ma dang ni/ /de bzhin zhang po'i bud med dang / /pha yi sbun zla'i chung ma dang /de bzhin pha yi sring mo dang / /rang gi ma yi sbun zla nyid/ /rang gi chung ma mchog gzugs can/ /sgrol ma la sogs co lo khams mthar/ /rang rigs las skyes rig ma bcu/ /thar pa 'dod pas khyim pa yis/ /dbang gi dus su rab dbul bya/ /rig ma 'di rnams rigs srung phyir/ /gal te bla mar mi 'bul na/ /de tshe khyim na gnas pa la/ /gzhan gyi dbang bskur sbyin mi bya//dge slong dge tshul rnams la ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni dbang bskur ba'i/ /dmangs rigs skyes sogs g.yin dag gis/ /bla mas spyin bya mi yi bdag/rlung sogs rim pas dmangs rigs mo/ /rgyal rigs de bzhin bram ze mo//rje mo g.yung mo nya pa mo/ /gar ma de bzhin tshos mkhan mo/ /ko lpags byed ma gtum mo ni/ /chos khams mthar skyes ma ste bcu/ /rig ma chen mor yang dag brjod/ /longs spyod grol 'bras rab tu ster/ /de dag kyang pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang / dbang bcu dang / sa bcu dang / stobs bcu rnams rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad che/ /thub pa chen po thub chen ldan/ /gsang sngags tshul chen las byung ba/ /gsang sngags tshul can bdag nyid can/ /pha rol phyin bcu thob pa ste/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu la gnas/ /pha rol phyin bcu dag pa ste/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu yi tshul//mgon po sa bcu'i dbang phyug ste/ /sa bcu la ni gnas sa po/ khres bcu —247—

rnam dag bdag nyid can/ khres bcu rnam dag 'chang ba po/ /rnam pa bcu po don bcu'i don/ /thub dbang stobs bcu khyab pa'i bdag khres bcu rnam dag 'chang ba po/ /rnam pa bcu po don bcu'i don/ /thub dbang stobs bcu khyab pa'i bdag /kun gyi don ni ma lus byed/ /rnam bcu dbang ldan che ba po/ /zhes brjod/ de nas slob mas/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kyai/ bcom ldan 'das pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad thob pa/ da ni bdag gis ci zhig bgyi/ /zhes so/ /de la slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ bcu yis nang nas/ rang gi chung ma de bzung nas/ de dang lhan cig tu bdag la gsol ba gdab par byos shigade yang khyim pas rang rigs lo nyi shu ma dang / rab byung la ni gtum mo mthar skyes lo nyi shu ma chos khams rdo rje ma sngon mor gyur pa chung mar bsam par bya'o/ /de dang lhan cig tu slob dpon la maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ khyed kyi sku la sha khrag dang / /bsha/nga gci shu kra ma mchis shing / /bco brgyad khams kyang mi mnga' ba/ /rdo rje li sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sgrib pa thams cad bcom pa yi/ /sogs lan gsum/ chung ma'i ma'am g.yung mo lo bco lnga ma sgra rdo rje ma ljang khur gyur pa/ rgyan bkrol zhing phyogs gyi gos can du byas te/ lha mo dga' ster sogs kyis slob ma la gto/ des kyang slob ma la 'byud par gyur/ slob ma dus kyi 'khor lor gyur pa la/ sgra rdo rje ma ljang khus g.yon phyogs nas 'khyud pa dang / de bzhin du shar du lo bcu gcig ma sgrol ma nag mo/ lhor lo bcu gnyis ma gos dkar mo dmar mo/byang du lo bcu gsum ma mā ma gī dkar mo/ nub tu lo bcu bzhi ma spyan ma —248—

ser mo/ shar lhor lo bcu drug ma reg bya rdo rje ma nag mo/ lho nub tu lo bcu bdun ma ro rdo rje ma dmar mo/ byang shar du lo bco brgyad ma gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo/ nub byang du lo bcu dgu ma dri rdo rje ma ser mo/ rnal 'byor ma'i snyen ra lo rig ma dgu po thams cad gcer mo skra grol ba/ phyag na gri gug dang thod pa thogs pa'o/ /de nas rig ma dgu po rnams rim pa bzhin thams cad kyis 'khyud pa las byung ba'i bde ba nyams su bstar bar byas/ slar yang gong bzhin bdag po'i dbang gi skabs su bstan pa ltar/ rig ma bcu la sogs pas bum pa bzung ste/ chu dbang bskur/ stong nyid snying rje khyod byin rlabs/ /zhes pa nas/ mngon sum sangs rgyas sras kyi bar rjes gnang byin/ slar yang maṇ+ḍal byas te/ /tse( tsho'o sogs bum dbang gi gsol gdab bya/ rig ma zhun ma'i gser dang mtshungs shing /rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa'i bu mo mdzes ma lo bcu gnyis nas/ nyi shus mthar thug pa rdul dang ldan pa rnams la slob dpon gyis 'khyud par byas shing / de'i 'og tu slob ma la slar yang gtad de/ rim gyi nu ma la lag pas reg pa las byung ba dang / slob dpon gyis kyang lo nyi shu ma chos khams rdo rje ma nu ma nyed par byas pa la/ mthong ba'i yul du gyur pa las thob pa'i bde ba nyams su myong ba ni/ 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi sogs nas/ nga rgyal bzung ba'i bar slob ma'i dbang du bshad pa'i skabs dang 'dra te bum dbang ngo / /gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ oṃ ā sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon dus kyi 'khor lo gsal ba dang / chung ma'i ma'am g.yung mo sgra rdo rje mar gyur pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa nas/ dhū ti'i lam nas rgyud de rdo rje nor bu byon pa —249—

na/ slob ma dang / de'i rig ma chung ma'am/ gtum mo chos khams rdo rje ma'i bdag nyid can/ gnyis ka'i khar rdo rje nor bu bzhag ste/ byang chub kyi sems yang dag par dbab cing / shes rab kyi na ra nā si ka la gnas pa'i rdul gyi dwangs ma yang rdo rje nor bus yang dag par gzhibs pa slob ma'i khar 'phangs par gyur/ ji ltar sogs/ lhag ma slob ma dbang bskur skabs kyi gsang dbang dang 'dra'o/ /maṇ+ḍal dang / oṃ hu sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ chung ma'am gtum mo lo nyi shu ma chos khams rdo rje ma'i bdag nyid can dang / slob dpon dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur gyur pa snyoms par zhugs pa las/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba mngon du byas nas/ slar yang rig ma de nyid gtad/'dir ni khyed rnams dpang po lags zhes pa nas/ ut+pa ko3ha gi bar slob ma'i dbang gi shes rab ye shes dang 'dra/ de'i 'og tu rig ma gzhan rnams la yang / ji ltar nus par gnyis sbyor gyi rjes su chags pa brtsam par bya ste/ mtshan mo phyed nas ji srid du chu tshod gnyis kyi rjes la nyi ma wor ba de srid du'o/ /de lta bu'i sbyor ba las byung ba'i zhes pa nas/ phyi rol rang lces blangs/ zhes pa'i bar yang slob ma'i dbang gi skabs dang 'dra ste shes rab ye shes so/ /dbang gi rab byed dang dbang bzhi pa la ni/ tshig tu brjod pa'i rim pa/ slob ma'i dbang gi cho gar bshad pa kho na yin la/ dbang bzhi pa dngos dang / nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i sngags kyi bar du/ 'jig rten gsum na gzhon lus gcig /gnas brtan rgan po skye dgu'i bdag /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'a'ang ba/ /sdug gu 'jig rten gsum na mdzes/ /'jig rten shes legs slob dpon te/ /wo dang / phyir mi zlog pa phyir mi 'ong / /'dren pa rang rgyal bse rle'i —250—

tshul/ /nges 'byung sna tshogs las byung ba/ /'byung ba chen po rgyu gcig pu/ /dge slong dgra bcom zag pa zad/ /'dod chags bral bas dbang po thul//bde ba brnyes pas 'jigs med thob/ bsil bar gyur bas rnyog pa med/ /mgo zlum brtul zhugs chen po 'chang / /tshangs par spyod pa brdul zhugs mchog /dka' thub mthar phyin dka' thub che/ /gtsang gnas dam pa go ta ma/ /bram ze tshangs pa tshangs pa shes/ /mya ngan 'das pa tshangs pa thob/ /grol ba thar pa rnam grol lus/ /rnam grol zhi ba zhi ba nyid/ /ces brjod/'di'i cho ga ni snga ma dang 'dra ba shas che yang / dbang gi ye shes rtogs tshul gyi khyad par ni ches lhag pa yin no/ /mjug tu/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /zhes sogs dang /ral gri dang ni sogs kyang brjod pa'i lag len yod pa ltar bya ste/ bdag po chen po'i dbang gi rim pa'o/ /bdag po chen po'i dbang 'di slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis ka grub pa'am rnal 'byor pa'i gnas thob pa'am/ ma thob kyang skal ba mchog lhag par mos pa brtan po kho nas bya ba yin kyang / deng sang dus kyi mtha' 'di lta bu la/ grub pa dang rnal 'byor ma'i dpon slob dkon cing / yod kyang mngon shes med pa'i phyir na ngo mi shes pa dang / zab mo'i dbang gi rnam pa lam du byed pa yang rgyun chad du phangs pa yin pas/ tha na yang ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gi tshul du zhes kyang thob par bya'o/ /'di ni nges par tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang rjes su 'brel ba yin te/ bum dbang gi sngon dang / shes rab ye shes kyi mthar nges par sbyar ro/ /slob ma'i dbang gi dbang gong ma dang / bdag po'i dbang dang / bdag po chen po'i dbang 'di rnams ni/ slob dpon rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ye shes can nam// bskyed rim la cung zad brtan pas ni/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bya ba las gzhan pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa mi dgos shing /—251—

las dang po pa'i slob dpon la yang / slob mas dbang thob par 'gyur ba'i yan lag tu/ de dgos pa ma yin kyang / slob dpon nyid kyi bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi slad du dkyil 'khor sgrub pa nges par bya ba yin la/ de yang dbang bdun sogs dang 'brel bar phyi dkyil yod na'ang legs shing / gzhan du na yang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs su rdzogs pa'am thugs dkyil tsam gyi sgom bzlas dang / sgrub thabs su bshad pa'i maṇ+ḍal mchod chog mchod gtor rgyas pa dang bcas pa dang / spro zhing nus na bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo las ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nas bdag 'jug kyang blang bar bya'o/ /'dir thams cad mkhyen pa jo nang pa chen po'i bzhed pas/las dang po pa'i slob dpon dang slob ma'i dbang gang yin yang rung ste/ dbang gong ma dang po gsum la gong ma dang / bzhi pa la gong ma'i gong ma zhes/ gong chung dang gong chen gyi dbye ba dang / dbang bcu gcig po dkyus ma 'di slob ma'i dbang dang / chu dang phyag rgya sbyin pa sogs sngon du 'a rdo ba'i dbang gong ma bzhi rdo rje gsum du sgrub pa dang bcas pa ni/ bdag po'i dbang dang / rig ma bcu dang bcas pa ni bdag po chen po'i dbang ngo / /des na las dang po pa'i gang zag la/ nyan pa'i don dang 'chad pa'i don gyi dbang gong ma rnam pa gnyis dang / gang zag mchog la bskur ba'i dbang gong ma gcig ste gsum mo/ /dang po gnyis char la yang /bum dbang sogs dbang gsum ni 'jig rten pa'i dbang dang / bzhi pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang yin pas gong chen gong chung gnyis gnyis dang / 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa gnyis gnyis so/ /rjes mthun mos pa lam byed tsam ma yin par dngos kyi dbang du byas na/phyi ma'i dbang bzhi po thams cad kyang / 'gyur med kyi gnas thob pa'i nges pas/ gong ma chen po dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa kho na'o/ /'di la chos rgyal phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis kyang / bdag po'i dbang la dbang bzhi mi bskur ba sogs 'dra min mdzad la/ bu ston chen po —252—

sogs mkhas pa phyis byon gzhan rnams kyi bzhed tshul dang ni mi 'dra ba shin tu che zhing / snga rabs rnams la ni/ lugs 'di dang mthun pa dang / phal cher mthun pa dang / phyis byon gzhan rnams dang phal cher mthun pa dang / gnyis ka dang mi mthun pa'i 'dod tshul te/ mi 'dra ba shin tu mang por mthong ngo / /'on kyang dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi dgongs don ni sngar 4gad pa kho nar gsal la/ kho bo rang nyid kyi blo gros kyi nus pa'i stobs las cha shas tsam yang rtogs pa ma yin mod kyi/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho man ngag dang bcas pa'i lde mig gis/ rgyud 'grel chen po'i nges gsang gi sgo rnam par phye pa las/ bdag lta bus kyang nges pa thob ste/ rgyu mtshan mang po bshad du yod pa ni/ 'dir bris na yig ge mang bar 'gyur ba'i gzhan du bshad par 'dod do/ /zab mo'i dbang bskur mthar thug pa'i/ /cho ga dag gsal 'byer bde ba/ /kun mkhyen chen po'i dgongs pa bzhin/ /tā ra nā thas bkod pa yin/ /'di las dge ba ci thob pa/ /des ni sems can ma lus kun/ /rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung sku/ /gdod nas gnas pa mngon 'gyur shog /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga ye shes rgya mtsho'i dgongs don zhes bya ba 'di yang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo so brgyad pa la/ nags rgyal gyi dben gnas jo mo nang gi dam chos gling du sbyar ba'o// //ma ṅga la/su sti/ bla na med pa'i dbang gi cho ga 'di/ /rgyal ba'i rigs 'khrungs mi bdag chen po yis/ /dad dang lhag bsam dkar bas bka' stsal te/ /brkos kyi rig byed mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /par du bzhengs nas chos gter rgya cher spel/ dge tshogs 'di la mngon du phyogs pa rnams/ /bsod nams ye shes rgya mtsho las 'khrungs pa'i/ /dam pa gnyis po mngon du 'gyur bar shog /ma ṅga la/'dir 'bad dge ba rnam par dkar ba'i mthus/ /bdag lus bor tshe —253—

dpal ldan sham+bha lar/ /rigs ldan rgyal po'i 'khor du legs skyes nas/ /dus 'khor bstan la bya ba byed par shog /ces pa 'di ni chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis smon lam btab pa'o/ /dge ba 'di yis glo bur dri ma'i tshogs/ /srog dang thur sel rtsa dang lhan cig tu/ /'joms par nus pa'i thabs zab la brten nas/ /gzhan mchog bde gshegs snying po myur thob shog /ces pa 'di ni rton pa bzhi ldan gyis smon lam mdzad pa'o// //

gong ma'o cho ga bzhugs/na ma shrī kā la tsa grwa ya/ 'dir zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi 'khrid kyi sngon du nges par sgrub dgos pa/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pas/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can bskyed par byed pa'i dbang bskur ba mchog dbang gong ma nyid bskur ba'i tshul ni/ bris sku la sogs pa'i mdun du mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis sam/gtso bo'i zlum gtor gcig sde drug la zlum gtor ram zur gsum re re/ chos skyong dang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sogs bshams/ bum pa dung chos gzungs thag rdo rje sogs kyang spyi dang mthun par 'cha'/ slob dpon gyi drung du nang mchod rdor dril cang te'u sogs tshogs par byas nas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma la myong btang / thog mar nang mchog la dmigs te/ tsho( āXhūX hraXphaṭa/ tsho( swa bhā wa shu khyu/༷༷sarba dharmāXsu wa bhā wa ṭa smosa3haX/ tseX( āXhuX hoX zhes byin gyis brlabs/ tseX( āXhūX hraXphaṭa/ oṃ su bhā wa shudhaXsarba dharma swa bhā wa shurnyo3haX/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sogs/ oṃ āXbadz+ra su rla sogs dang / oX huX badz+ra a na la sogs dang / oṃ hoXsarba dharma sogs sngags tshan bzhis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ phe badz+ra ā ra snyi ho/ dzaXhūX baX hoX badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya stuX/ khru shu ho/ oṃ kha kha/ ji hi ji hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsa/un man da/ a pa sma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki/ n+ya da ya/ i daX ba li/ grit+na tu/ sa ma ya rak+ta skye/ ma ma sarba sirnyi sme pra yasnro skye/ ya the baX/ ya thegaX bhu dza thā/ dzi gha tha/ pi pa tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba ka rta ya/ sad su khaX bi shudha/ sā ha yi ka bha skyi/—255—

hu hu hu phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra gan+ta pra titsā na ma badz+ra put+pa/ badz+ra dhu pa/ badz+ra dī pa/badz+ra nai wi ju/ badz+ra ak+ṣa ta/ badz+ra lwa gya/ badz+ra hā gya/ badz+ra wā t+ya/ badz+ra khru t+ya/ badz+ra gi ta/ oṃ badz+ra kā ma pra ca na ma mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rim chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa bsnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro /lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang / /gnod spyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i /ཿnga po'i: /yi dwags: kha za'i: /spyo byed: /brjed byed: /mkha' 'gro'i /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus ji snyed mchis pa rnams/ /'dir gshe/gas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs//—256—

dngos grun kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzode/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan pa ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /gang dag dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams mchod pa dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa'i bya ba la bar chad thams cad mi 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig nag po'i phyogs la dga' ba dang / gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces pa'i mthar bdud bsregs pa'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad la/ mtshams rngams dang rol mo'i sgra drag po bya/rdo rje'i rwa gur sa gzhi la sogs pa dang / me'i gur sogs yid kyi bsams te mtshams bcad pa'o//de nas gnas dang yo byad la/rdo rje rtse mos nang mchod gtor/ oX āXhūX hraXphaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudha sarba dharmā su bhā wa shurnyo3haX stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bhuX las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ shel gyi snod sor bcu gnyis pa rnams kyi nang du/ oX aXshuX hoXrnams las byung ba'i chu dang /mchod mchod yon dang dri dang / me tog dang / bdug pa dang / snang gsal dang /zhal zas dam pa dag dang / rnam pa mang po'i 'bras bu ma nyams pa dang / gos dang / rgyan dang ba dan dang / bla bre la sogs pa dang / glu dang gar dang / me long dang / dril bu la sogs pa sil snyan gyi tshogs du ma dag dang / in+d+ra nī la —257—

la sogs pa rnam pa mang po'i rin po che dang / nang gi dam tshig rnams dang /dam tshig rnam pa bzhi'i rjes la sogs pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu dpag tu med cing dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra gan+taX swāhā/ badz+ra put+paX/ badz+ra dhu paX/ badz+ra dī paX/ badz+ra ni bi tuX/ badz+ra a k+ṣa taX/ badz+ra lā gyaX/ badz+ra hā khyu/ badz+ra wā t+yaX/ badz+ra n-i kyiX/ badz+ra gī taX/ badz+ra ka maX swāhā/ rol chen dang bcas te/ oṃ hoXbadz+ra ga rnyesarba dharmā e ka pradzñā dha ni/ sā bhā we/sarba ā ka re/ sarba dharma pra bo dha ni/ sarba dharma ṇi sā bhā wān pra bo dha ya pra bo dha ya swāhā/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ de dag ni sngon du bya ba'i rim pa yin no/ /da ni bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya ste/ spro zhing nus la shin tu rgyas pa spros pa la dga' ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bsgom par bya ba la 'bring du na/ thugs dkyil rgyas bsdus gang rung bsgom kyang shin tu legs par 'gyur zhing / bsdus pa la dga' bas lha bcu gsum dang lha dgu sogs ci rigs pa dang shin tu bsdus pa la dga' bas/ lhan skyes rgyas bsdus gang rung la brten nas kyang / mchog dbang gong ma bskur du rung la/ spyir dbang gong ma ni bskyed pa'i rim pa la mi ltos zhing / rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi cho ga'i spros pa gtso bor gyur pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ slob dpon de yan lag dang po'i rnal 'byor la brtan pa thob cing / bar pa bzhi'i rnal 'byor rjes mthun pa rnams su myong ba yan chad kyis/ bdag mdun gyi cho ga med par yang bskur bas chog pa kho na ste/ rgyu mtshan dbang gong ma rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gdod ma nas grub pa rnal 'byor pa'i ye shes kyi nyams su myong ba nyid 'di'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i cho ga yin gyi rtog pas sgom pa'i dkyil 'khor dang rdul tshon dang ras bris la sogs pa dbyibs su bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ dbang gong ma rnams kyi dkyil 'khor ma yin pa'i phyir dang / slob ma la byin rlabs —258—

'jug pa yang de 'dra la ma ltos pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang de 'dra des bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi slad du de ltar byed pa yang mi 'gal lo/ /da lta 'i dus kyi rdo rje'i slob dpon du grags pa/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa tsam la brten pa dang bskyed rim kho na la gnas pa dang / rdzogs rim gyi nyams myong cung zad skyes su chug kyang / yan lag dang po la brtan pa ma thob pa dang / de tsam thob kyang yan lag phyi ma rnams rjes mthun pa rgyud la ma skyes pa dag gis ni/ bdag bskyed dang phyi rol kyi mchod gtor nges par bya ste/ dbang gong ma'i yan lag tu dgos pa ma yin kyang / bdag nyid bsod nams spel zhing / lha'i byin rlabs slob ma la 'jug pa'i dgos pa chen po yod pas so/ /ci ste rjes dran gyi yan lag dngos thob pa yan chad kyi rnal 'byor pas ni bdag nyid ye shes kyi rnam rol la dbang 'byor ba yin pa'i phyir/ rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi cho ga'i yan lag phra mo la ma ltos te/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i spyod yul lo zhes rtogs par bya'o/ /des na skabs 'dir lha dgu'i bdag nyid can gyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa logs su bstan pa ltar/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi thugs kar thim/ gyi bar rdzogs par bsgoms te bdag bskyed do/ /de nas bum pa sgrub pa ni/ glu rna āXhuX hraXphaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ rke(nga pa'i ngang las/ haX hāX hi nywa sno spru/ huX huX hṝ dzñā rnams yongs su gyur pa las/dbus su khu ba dang rdul 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang / shar dang mer rkang 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang / lho dang bden bral du khrag 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang / byang dang dbang ldan du gci ba 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang /nub dang rlung du bshang ba 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis te/ bdud rtsi'i bum pa dkar po pad+ma la gnas shing pad+mas kha brgyan pa rnams su gyur/ rang gi snying gar —259—

zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du/ huX las byung ba'i rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/dus kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba dang / yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor te/ de dag kha sbyar ba las rdo rje lcags kyu dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba spros nas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud ñdzu spyan drangs/dzaXhūX baX hoX rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bum pa rnams dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ haX hāX hi hi hṝ hṝ hūX hūṃ lha lha badz+ra pad+ma a mṛ ta gha ṭa su bi shurnya dharma bhā tu swa bhā wa sarba dharmya na su bi shurnya dharmā dha tu su bhā wān ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes mang du bzlas/ oṃ badz+ra bhan+taX pra titsā na maXnas/ kā maX pra titsā na maX zhes pa'i bar mchod pa bcu gnyis phul/ de dag ni bum pa sgrub pa'i cho ga'o/ /'di la 'og tu slob ma la khyor chu sbyin pa tsam las/ dgos don gzhan med pa'i phyir/ bum pa sgrub pa 'di mtha' cig tu dgos pa min pa ltar snang yang rdo rje 'chang dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis phyag len yin pas phyir/ nan tan du bya ba kho na'o/ /de nas mchod gtor 'bul ba ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 6 zhes pa yongs su gyur pa las/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ āXshuX hoXhaX k+ṣaXzhes lan mang du brjod cing / dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba rang gi blo dang mtshams par yid kyis gsal btab bo/ /spro na bstod chen gyi tshig ji ltar 'os pa/ 'don pa sogs mngon rtogs rgyas bsdus gang rung dang mthun par ngag nas brjod kyang legs/ 'on kyang yid kyi bsams —260—

pa tsam gyis chog cing gtso bo yab yum kho na sgoms pas kyang rung ngo / /de nas mgron spyan drangs shing mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mchod pa'i yul du badz+ra sa mā dzaXdzaXhūX baX hoX sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas nga / nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs/ oṃ āXhūX hoXtri dh+wa tu ke shwa ra kā la tsakra ar+ghaX pra ca sa pa ri wā rāXtwaX bha ga wān me wa ra do bha wa shi rtse nā sma zhes pa lan gsum/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā re khyuX pa duX pra titsā na maX de bzhin du sbyar te/ añtsa ma naX pra tisnro na maX pro k+ṣa naX pra titsā na maX khams gsum dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das/ /dus kyi 'khor lo 'khor bcas rnams/ /rnam dag rdo rje'i dri mchog 'di/ /bzhes nas bdag la mchog stsol mdzod/ /oṃ shrī kwa la tsakra sa pā ri wā re khyuX zhes kun la sbyar te/ badz+ra gan+taX pra ru na maX rkang pa gsum snga ma bzhi kun la sbyar te/ rdo rje me tog rnam bkra'i tshogs/ /badz+ra put+paX pra titsā na maX rdo rje bdug spos bla na med/ /badz+ra dhu paX pra titsā na maXrdo rje sgron me 'od rab 'bar/ /badz+ra dī paX pra tismo na maX rdo rje zhal zas ro mchog ldan/ /badz+ra ne wi khye pra titsā na maX rdo rje ma nyams 'bras bu'i mchog /badz+ra ak+ṣa taX pra tismo na maX rdo rje sgegs mo'i mchod pa ni/ /badz+ra lā phyaX pra titsā na maXrdo rje bzhad ma'i mchod pa ni/ /badz+ra hā gyaX pra tismo na maX rdo rje sil snyan rnam mang po/ /badz+ra bā t+yaX pra tismo na maX rdo rje gar gyi mchod sprin 'di/ /badz+ra dra t+yaX pra titsā na maX rdo rje glu dbyangs yid 'phrog ldan/ /badz+ra gī taX titsā na maX rdo rje 'dod ma'i mchod pa mchog /badz+ra kā maX pra titsā na maX—261—

nang mchod ni gong ltar byin gyis bsas/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun thams cad kyi ngo bo/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag po/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi skyob pa drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'di zhes bya ba'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ ā hu/ dngos grub rgya mtsho yon tan rin chen gter/ /srid dang zhi ba'i gdung ba sel ba'i sman/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'a myong la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ ā hu/ nyi ma'i 'od dang zla bzang lha dbang dang / /gzi brjid zlas sbyin lha'i dbang phyug dang / /sna tshogs gzugs dang lha yi dbang ldan te/ /chos rgyal chen po brgyad la mchod par 'bul: 'jam dbyangs grags pa pad+ma dkar po dang //bzang po rnam rgyal bshes gnyen bzang po dang / /phyag na rin chen khyab 'jug sbas pa dang / /nyi ma grags dang shin tu bzang po mchod rgya mtsho rnam rgyal rgyal dka' nyi ma dang / /sna tshogs gzugs dang zla 'od mtha' yas dang / /sa skyong dpal skyong seng ge rnam gnon dang / /stobs chen ma 'gags mi yi seng ge mchod: dbang phyug chen po mtha' yas rnam rgyal dang / /drag po zhes bya nyi shu rtsa lnga po/ /sa'i 'khor lo rdzogs par skyong ba ste/ /tshangs pa lha dbang phyed phyed skyod rnams mchod: 'od srung la sogs dum bu skyong ba brgyad/ /de ltar sa skyong sum cu rtsa lnga ni/ /rigs kun gcig tu mdzad pa gsang sngags kyi/ /rigs ldan brgyud pa rnams la mchod par 'bul dus zhabs gnyis dang nā len+d+ra pa dang / /zla ba mgon po 'bro ston lo tsā dang / /lha rje sgom pa sgro ston gnam brtsegs dang / /grub chen yu mo rnams la mchod pa 'bul: chos kyi dbang phyug nam —262—

mkha' 'od zer dang / /sprul sku jo 'bum grub thob se chen dang / /chos rje 'jam gsar chos sku 'od zer dang / /kun spangs chos rje rnams la mchod par 'bulajebyang sems chen po yon tan rgya mtsho dang / /kun mkhyen chos rje sgra bsgyur sku mched dang / /phyogs las rnam rgyal nya dpon chos rje dang / /grub chen kun blo rnams la mchod par 'bul 'jam dbyangs dkon bzang nam mkha'i mtshan can gnyis/ /nam mkha' dpal bzang rat+na bha dra dang / /grol mchog zhabs dang lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen te/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mngon sum ston mdzad pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchog par 'bul/ /oṃ āXhūX/ phyis kyang mjug gi tshig rnams rim pas 'don pa bsgyur bar bya'o/ /oṃ kā la tsakra ya huX swāhā/ tsho( āXhuX/ tsho( bi shwa mā ta lho to tshu swāhā/ skye( a ā aX aX ha hāX haX haXswāhā/ oX āXhūX hoX a ā i sī ṛ grwa u mū '-i lī/ ha hā hi hi gri : hu hu dzñā hṝ haX haX a ā e e ar ur e rna 6( al ul/ ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā/oX āXhuX/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor la 'bul/ bar 'dir sgos kyi chos skyong la'ang phul thams cad kyi mthar/ oṃ gu ru brnya bo dhi satwa sbyo na mo na maX gzhan yang rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad la mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āXhuX/ bka' sdod chos skyong bsrung ma thams cad la mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āXhuX/ yul bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad la mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āXhuX/ rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la 'bul lo/ /oṃ āXhuX/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba'i rgyud tshims nas/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar —263—

gyur cigade nas bstod pa ni/ mchog spyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid snying po khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dzu ma pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /ces 'dud nyi shus bstod/ spro zhing nus na/ gang la thog mtha' dbus med gnas dang 'chi dang srid pa dang ni sgra dang dri dang ro dag dang / /reg bya gzugs dang sems med rang bzhin dang ni skyes bu med cing 'ching dang grol dang byed po med/ /sa bon dang ni gsal bar dus med mtha' dag srid par sdug bsngal bde ba nyid kyi rang bzhin med/ /mya ngan 'das pa mtshan ma med cing byed pa rnams bral yon tan med pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus dang sna tshogs la sogs rdo rje dang ni skyes bu dpe med kun 'gro spros pa med pa ste/ /ther zug tu gnas snyan dang shangs dang zhal dang spyan dang dbu dang phyag dang zhabs ni thams cad pa/ /'byung po'i mtha' te 'byung po'i mgon po mchog gi srid pa gsum 'dzin rgyu —264—

rnams dag gi rgyur gyur pa/ /rig pa la sogs rnal 'byor dag gis rtog bya mchog bde'i go 'phang dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal/ /spro byed nus ma'i gzugs gzhan glog gi me dang mtshungs shing nyi ma bcu gnyis dag gi gzi brjid can/ /ye shes rdo rje'i snang ba mchog gi go 'phang bgrod byed rnam par bcad pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkar po 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po ri bong 'dzin pa las 'dzag 'jig rten spyi bor yang dag gnas/ /bdud rtsi 'chi ba sel zhing srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms par byed pa thig le'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems tsam sngags kyi ngo bo lha yis yongs su bskor ba sdug bsngal dang ni bde ba'i rang bzhin te/ /dam pa rnams la zhi ba'i gzugs ni rang gis byas pa'i nyams myong mi bzad rnams la mi bzad pa/ /gang gis las gang rab byas rang gi sems la cho ga bzhin du de yi 'bras bus de bskyed pa/ /'jig rten dbang po sna tshogs gzugs can srid gsum bskyed mdzad rdo rje sems dpa' la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /gcig dang du ma dag kyang gcig cing mnyam dang mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab dang / /steng 'og kun nas dkar ljang sna tshogs kha dog chen po gcig gi gzugs te thung ngu ring po dang / /shin tu ring po yon tan med ces yon to dang bcas bud med skyes pa'am skyes pa bud med min/ /gang zhig kun gyi brten gcig bha ga bzang mo mchog gi bha ga khyod la 'dud de khyod la 'dud/ /ces pas kyang bstod do/ /oṃ dzñā na pū dza a nu ra lto swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ zhes rjes chags kyis mchod cing nga rgyal bzung de nas lha dgu'i sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs nas brtsams/ yid la 'dod pa kun —265—

'grub tha(ga /gi bar gyi 'phrin las bcol ba yan chad gtor chog ltar gtor ma 'bul/ 'byung po spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs kyang btang / steng na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag ces sogs shis brjod bya/ mchod gtor gyi rim pa'o/ /de nas spro zhing lcogs na bla ma rnams kyi phyag len la mdzad pa ltar/ tshogs rdzogs pa'i don du sngon 'gro'i maṇ+ḍal nas brtsams te/mchog dbang mtha' dag bdag 'jug gi tshul du rdzogs par blangs na shin tu legs shing / spyir slob dpon gyis bdag 'jug ma blangs kyang / slob ma dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'i yan lag nyams par 'gyur ba ni ma yin no/ /de dag gi skabs 'di la ltos pa'i slob dpon gyi bya ba rgyas pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol lam/ yol khang gi phyi rol tu mngon du phyogs pa la sbyang ba ni/ bgegs gtor rnams bshams/ bsangs sbyangs 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma'am mtheb skyu gsum po rim gyis bskor la/ oX sarba rnaX khyuX na maXsarba ta thā ga ta sne bh+ya bi shwa mu khe khyuX sarba thā khaX ud ga te spa na ṇa i maX ga ga ṇa khaX gro ste daX ba li te swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ 'dir slob ma rnams la dbang gi ye shes skye ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim nas/ phan pa dang bde ba'i sems dang ldan pas gzhan du dengs shig zhi bas sbyang ba'o/ /oṃ nga ni ra huX huX phaṭa/ tsho( groṇ+ḍa grihā huX huX phaṭa/ skye rna gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya huX huX phaṭa/ tseX( ā na ya ho bha ga wān bir+ya rā dza huX huX phaṭa/ lan gsum bzlas shing rdo rje gsor la/ ting lo'am chang bu bskor/ 'dir slob ma 'di rnams la dbang gi ye shes bskyed pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa de thams cad/ gtor ma lam brngan/ ting —266—

lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces pa ni zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba'o/ /hū mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas nas bden stobs brjod la/ mthar drag po'i mtshams rngams rol chen dang bcas pas bskrad pa ni/ 'di ltar/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa dang / kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis 'dir slob ma 'di rnams la dbang gi ye shes bskyed pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag deng dpal rdo rje 'a shugs kya bka' thos pas/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par myur ba nyid du song shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag thams cad dus gsum gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o/ /bsdu na de tsam mam shin tu spros pa la dga' na phyag rgya dang mtshon cha dgod pa sogs byas nas/ bstod dbyangs rgyas pa sngon du 'gro bas byas kyang wo la spros pa 'bring tsam dbang du byas na/ rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs dang / rje bo sna tshogs sogs dang / nga ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /nga ni khro rgyal he ru ka /nga ni —267—

dpal ldan dus 'khor lo/ /nga yi bka' las ma 'da' zhig /lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje shugs/ /bka' yi 'khol lo rab sbyor bar/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ /lus gsum las skyes dgas par bya/ /gal ste kha cig bdag tshig 'da'/ /'dir ni 'jig 'gyur gas du min/ /rdo rje'i rwa gur rab tu brtan/ /rdo rje khro bo'i sprin spros nas/ /mtsho ni cha yig 'khru me dpung 'bar/ /bar mtshams med par mtshams bcad do/ /zhes nyungs dkar gtor gu gul la sogs kyi dud pas bdug rol mo'i sgra sgrogs te/ bgegs bskrad cing gtor ma phyi rol tu dor te/ drag pos sbyang ba'o/ /bsdus pa la mos na/ bka' bsgo ba yid kyis byas nas sngags tsam brjod do/ /bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad snying gar yi ge ba gyi rnam par gnas pa lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis ded de/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa mdun gyi til lam yungs dkar la thim/ bsangs sbyangs/ 'bar ba'i me nang du khro bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa zhal gdangs pa'o/ / oṃ badz+ra ḍā gi kha kha shrī snri/ sarba pā pa da ha na bhasmi ku ru swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ lasakyi rdo rjes til lam yungs dkar g.yas g.yon du bskor nas/ g.yas su me dag g.yon tu chur dor bas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du gsol ba dang / rgya mtsho chen por bsgyur bar bsam mthar me yang chu nang du ldug go /sdig pa sbyang ba'o/ /skabs 'dir spros pa la dga' na drug bzhi ldan gyi sgo nas phyur bsal bar mdzad pa'i phyag len yang gda' ste mi 'gal lo/ /de nas 'di skad ces/khyed rang rnams kyi mgo bor mū yig dang / snying gar yī yig dang / gtsug tor —268—

tu ā yig ste/ thabs kyi rigs gsum dang / lte ba lā yig dang / mgrin par rā yig dang / gsang bar ā yig ste shes rab kyi rang bzhin yi ge gsum gyis bsrungs shing rgyas btab par mos shigade nas sems bskyed gsal 'debs pa dang chos spyi 'gro'i bshad pa cung zad byas nas/'dir rdzogs rim thams cad kyi mthar thug zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la sngar ma smin na smin byed kyi dbang dgos la/ sngar smin yang ye shes ma skyed pa bskyed pa'i phyir du/ skabs 'dir nges par dbang gong ma rnams bskur dgos shing / gang zag dbang po dman pa la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang yang rung bar/thun mong gi smin byed byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun thob na legs mod/ yang gsang 'dus bde mchog dgyes rdor sogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bsdus rgyud phal cig gi rjes su 'brangs te/ 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub phal cher la grags pa'i/ cho ga rnam dag gcig gi steng nas bum dbang du grags pa de thob na yang /byis 'jug dang don gyi gnad gcig pa'i legs te/ go rim ma 'chol zhing /spyir btang gi bshad pa'i rim pa dang mthun/ dbang po dman pa rnams la de ltar 'thad cha shas che/ 'on kyang dbang po rnon po rnams dang / dbang brtul la yang bsam pa dang dgos pa'i khyad par gyi dmigs bsal la byis 'jug gi dbang ngam/ de'i dod sngon du ma song bar yang / mchog dbang bskur du mi rung ba ma yin te/ dbang bskur ba ni sdom pa 'bog pa'i cho ga yin la/ sdom pa 'bogs yul la 'bogs chog byed pa/ gsang sgrogs su 'gyur ba'i go skabs —269—

nam yang yod pa ma yin zhing / 'on kyang go rim brgal ba'i skyon yod snyam na de yang spyir btang dmigs gsal gyi khyad yin te/ dge bsnyen la sogs pa'i sdom pa sngon du ma song bar snyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa skye ba bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro//'dir skabs slob ma rnams sngar dbang ji ltar rigs pa thob ma thob dang brtun nas/ de dang mthun pa'i brda' sprod bya/ sngon 'gro'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brjod la/ slob ma'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ mi zad 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa bdag ni de ring nyid nas rgyal ba rnams la skyabs su lhag par mchi/ khyed kyi zhabs kyi chu skyes nges par srid pa'i 'jigs 'a ce1ga dag la lus ngag sems ni dag pas so/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba bto/ sdom pa bzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos byar gzhug te/ 'dod pa'i rdo rje la ni rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya bla ma dag kyang spyi bos bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen la ni sgyin pa sbyin bgyi 'khor lo 'di la rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig bskyang bar bgyi//ral gri la ni mchod pa bgyi ste gsal bar chu skyes rigs la sdom pa rnams ni bskyod pa bgyi/ /sems can rnams ni thar pa'i slad du rgyal ba bskyed mdzad rigs la byang chub bdag gis bskyang bar bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum mo/ /bsdus pa la mos na sngon 'gro de tsam gyis chog la/ 'bring po la mos na/ de rjes slob ma'i gnas drug tu dri bzang gi thig le dngos su byed pa'am byas par mos la/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āthugs kar hū/ lte bar ho gtsug tor tu ha/ gsang bar 'a rnams su gyur/ces brjod/ oṃ ā hū/ zhes nang mchod nas slob ma'i lus la bdud rtsi gtor la srung bar byas par mos/ de nas cung zad spro na bum chu nas bsres pa'i dri bzang gi chu blud la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ dam tshig bsrung ba dngos —270—

grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ badz+ra a bru ta u ta ka ṭha ṭha hu/zhes brjod/ bla ma dang dus kyi 'khor lo gnyis su med pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa' mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ khyod rang rnams kyi lus la thim pas/ lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab par mos pa gyis shig rol mo'i sgra dang cas te/ lko a ā a a badz+ra satwa mahā su kha badz+ra kā la tsakra shi khu gya a bhi mu kho sna wa sa skye sno bha wa ba ra do bha ba/ kā ya bāka tsit+ta a la na ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes mang du bzlas te rdo rje sems dpa' bskul ba'o/ /cung zad spros pa la dga' na rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs nyer lnga sbyin par yang bzhed de mi 'gal lo/ /de nas bum chu dung chos kyis blangs nas/ glu rna ha ha sogs bum pa'i sa bon rnams lan mang du brjod la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ a i ṛ u le pañtsa dha du bi shwa dha ni swāhā/ zhes pas khrus gsol zhing 'thung du gzhug go /'di skabs phyag len lugs gcig la slob ma sta gon gyi khyor chu'i sngags kyis sbyin par mdzad pa'ang yod mod kyi/ bum sgrub dang 'brel ba'i phyir 'di nyid legs so//sngon 'gro shin tu spros pa la mos na/ lo tsā ba blo gros dpal gyis mdzad pa'i gong ma'i dbang mchog bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas su bshad pa ltar/ slob ma sta gon gyi chos thun mong ma yin pa rnams dang /phyi dkyil gyi 'jug pa'i cho ga rags pa rnams sbyor ba'i lugs kyang yod pa/ dbang gong ma'i yan lag tu ni mi dgos mod/ slob ma'i mos pa dang bstun nas byed pa yang mi 'gal lo/ /dngos gzhi'i thog mar 'di skad ces bya ste/ de yang rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdo rje'i thig —271—

ni gdab pa dang / /tshon rtsi dag ni dgye ba dag /sngags kyi de nyid kyis mi bya/ /byas na byang chub rnyed par dka'/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dbang gong ma rnams ni rdul tshon la sogs pa phyi dbyibs bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor du bskur ba ma yin la/ chu dbang la sogs pa bum dbang du bshad pa yang / de ltar ming btags pa tsam ste dbang bzhi'i nang tshan gyi bum dbang ma yin pa dang / dbang bzhi ni gong ma kho na las phye ba yin par mthar thug gi rgyud sde rnams las gsungs pa yin zhing / des na phyag rgya'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bum dbang /bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang / kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes 'jig rten pa'i dbang / don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du bzhi pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang rnams bskur ba yin pas/ de ltar go dgos shing dbang bskur ba po ni thams cad la rdo rje slob dpon te/ de yang bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo'i g.yas zhal sku rdo rje la bum dbang /g.yon zhal gsung rdo rje la gsang dbang / mdun zhal thugs rdo rje la sher dbang / rgyab zhal ye shes rdo rje la bzhi pa rnams zhu ba'i bsam pa bskyed dgos/de la thog mar mchog dbang bzhi po spyi khyab kyi don du/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rigs kyi phyag rgya dang / zhing khams rnam par dag pa rin po ches phyur bur bkang bar mos la/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ lko brjod cing slob mas kyang / maṇ+ḍal phul te/ sgrib pa thams cad bcom pa yi/ /dus kyi 'khor lo khyod la 'dud/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur bdes gang ba/ /ye shes sku khyod la phyag 'tshal//stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /byang chub sems ni 'gyur med bde/ /dbang —272—

bskur de yis bdag la ni/ /mgon pos da ni bka' drin mdzod/ /bu dang chung ma sogs byas pa/ /bdag ni dus kun khyod kyi 'bangs/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i mthar/ /bdag la skyabs gzhan yod ma yin/ /zhes pas thun mong du gsol ba btab/de nas bum dbang nyid kyi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ lus la sku rdo rje byin rlabs 'jug pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin//mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mjodi/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum sgoms pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mjodi/ /ces lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slar yang bum dbang dngos gzhi'i don du gsol ba lan gsum 'debs pa ni/ oṃ oṃ pradzñā u pa au ka la sha a bhi ṣe kaX me da dā tāX hu hūX phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ /bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa thams cad kyi dpral ba'i oṃ yig dkar po las/ oṃ yig 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dpag tu med pa byon nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas/ lus kyi dri ma dag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ byas la/ rol wo bya zhi /phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slob ma 'di'i lus kyi thig le dang / sad pa'i gnas skabs 'gags shing / dga' ba'i dga' ba rdzogs nas/ sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku sgyu 'phrul drwa bas mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa —273—

thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces slob ma'i ched du sangs rgyas rnams la bla mas gsol ba gdab bo/ /de ni bum dbang gi byin rlabs dbab pa'o/ /de nas bum dbang dngos ni/sngar phul ba'i phyag rgya de nyid sna tshogs yum du byin gyis brlabs nas/ lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /zung zhig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /zung la mchod pa dag tu gyis/ /zhes rig ma gtad/de'i nub ma la lag pas reg pas de las byung ba'i bde ba nyams su myong ba de 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi dga' ba'i dga' ba ste/ de nyid bum pa'i dbang gi don no/ /de ltar na phyag rgya'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ sngags kyi tshul la dge tshul du gyur zhing / sa brgyad pa mi g.yo bar lung bstan pa thob pa sangs rgyas kyi sras su gyur pa yin no/ /zhes brda sprad/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra satwa na badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣe ke ṇa a bhi ṣe lto badz+ra satwa pu hro a tsa lā bhā mi la sno haX/ zhes rjes zlos byed du bcug pas nga rgyal bzung bar bya ste bum pa'i dbang ngo / / ༄de nas gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ ngag la gsung rdo rje'i byin brlabs gzhugs pa'i don du/ gong gi tshigs bod la/ dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin/ /zhes 'don pa spos te lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ gsang dbang dngos gzhi'i don du/oṃ āXpradzñā u pa yo gu phya a bhi ṣe kaX me da dwa tāX huX huX phaṭa/ ces pas gsol pa gdab/bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa thams cad kyi/ mgrin pa'i āXyig dmar po las/ āXyig 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba dpag tu med pa byon te/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas —274—

ngag gi dri ma dag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ rol wo bya/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slob ma 'di'i ngag gi thig le dang / rmi lam gyi gnas skabs 'gags shing / mchog dga'i dga' ba rdzogs nas/ gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnam pa nyi shus mngon par rdzogs pa byang chub thob par byin gyis brlab tu garben la/ ces bla mas brjod de gsang dbang gi byin rlabs 'bebs pa'o/ /de nas gsang dbang dngos ni/ oX dā da sha aX ga ni ro dha ka ri ṇi hūX phaṭa/ gdong g.yog ཿngas par bsam pa'am dngos su bcings/ de nas/ bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa spyan drangs nas sku la zhugs pa/ chags pa chen pos zhu bar gyur/a wa ga ti'i lam nas brgyud de nor bur byon pa'i bdud rtsi mthe bong dang ming med kyi so bzung nas lce thog tu bzhag par gyur/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur / /byang chub sems ni bzang po yis/ /de ltar bu khyod dbang bskur bgyi/ /zhes dang / bla med de ni 'di nyid de/ /gnyis su med cing mi 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi dbyings ni dam pa yi/ /yang dag bde ba myang bar gyis/ /zhes brjod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsam te/ a ho mahā su khaX/ lko brjod / dngos su bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba'i nang mchod kyi thigs pa lan gnyis su lce la bzhag cing btung bar bya'o//mi dar bsal/ oṃ de byen dra ya rkyu ḍa ghā ṭa ya swāhā/ phyag rgya'i bha ga gsal bar byas pa yang bltas te/ de las byung bas bde ba nyams su myong ba 'jig rten —275—

kun rdzob kyi mchog dga'i dga' ba ste/ de nyid gsang ba'i dbang don no/ /de ltar na phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/sngags kyi tshul la dge slong du gyur zhing / sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros su lung bstan pa thob pa sangs rgyas kyi rgyal tshab tu gyur pa yin no/ /zhes brda' sprad la/oṃ āXbadz+ra sa te na gu phya a bhi ṣe ke ṇa a bhi ṣi lto badz+ra satwa/ yu ba rā dzo na wa bhu mi la sto haX/ zhes rjes zlos byed du bcug pas nga rgyal bzung bar bya ste/ gsang ba'i dbang ngo / /de nas/shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ yid la thugs rdo rje'i byin brlabs 'jug pa'i don du/ dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /zhes gong gi tshigs bcad la 'don pa spos te gsol ba gdab/ shes rab ye shes dngos gzhi'i don du/ oṃ hūX pradzñā u pa yo badz+ra satwa bi shwa mā ta ro/ pradzñā dzñā ne a bhi ṣe kaX me da dā tāX huX huX phaṭa/ ces pas gsol ba btab/ de nas bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer zhes sogs/ byin rlabs dbab pa snga ma rnams kyis rigs 'gre ba las/ thugang sna ka'i huX yig sngon po las/ huX yig 'od zer sngon po 'phro ba/ snying ga nas zhugs yid kyi dri ma dag thugs rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs/ zhes dang / yid kyi thig le dang / gnyid 'thug gi gnas skabs 'gags/ khyad dga'i dga' ba rdzogs/ thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku rnam pa lngas mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa/ kho kyang 'don pa stso/ /de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dngos ni/ bla mas sngar phul ba'i rig ma de slob ma la gtad par mos la/ 'dir ni khyed rnams dpang po lags/ /bdag gis 'di la 'di gtad do/ /zhes rdo rje sems dpa' dpang por byas nas/ gzung ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyi/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ /'khor lo'i rim —276—

pa'i sbyor ba yi/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /rdo rje skyil krung gis sems ni/ /nor bu'i nang du gnas blta bas/ /zhes go bar byas/ phyag rgya sna tshogs yum du byas pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX snying gar hūX/ lte bar hoXgasang bar snyu/ gtsug tor du hā rnams 'khod par gyur/ phyag rgya des kyang chu skyes gur gum la sogs pa'i dri bzang por byas pa ston cing / e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa//de yi mdun na bdag gnas te/ /sangs rgyas bsten pa la sogs pa/ /pad+ma ra bya ba ji bzhin gyis/ /bde r+ṣa rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu gnas/ /bhañdza mo k+ṣa hoX bdag nyid dus kyi 'khor lo gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par āX snying gar huX/ lte bar hoX gsang bar snya/ gtsug tor tu hā rnams 'khod par gyur/ shes rab kyi pad+ma āXlas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la hūX las byung ba'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thabs kyi rdo rje huX las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/dbus su āXlas byung ba'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pas mtshan par gyur/ lag bcangs dang gnyis sbyor gyi sgo nas snyoms par zhugs/ oṃ dzñā na pū dza a nu ra sto spyo bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ lko brjod/ de lta bu'i sbyor ba las byung ba'i bde ba nyams su myong bar gyur pa ni/ 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang /lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ste/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don no/ /de rnams ni dga' ba bzhi'i dbye bas/ kun rdzob kyi dbang rnam pa bzhi'o/ /de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor tu shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas/ sngags kyi tshul la gnas brtan tu gyur zhing / sa bcu pa chos kyi —277—

sprin la gnas par lung bstan pa thob pa rdo rje 'chang gnyis par gyur pa yin no/ /zhes brda sprad la/ oṃ huX badz+ra satwa na/ pradzñā dzñā ne na a bhi ṣe ke na a bhi ṣi lto dī dī yo/ badz+ra dha ro3haX dharma me gha mi la sto3haX/ zhes rjes zlos byed du bas pa'i nga rgyal bzung bar bya ste/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dngos so/ji de nas bla mas/dam tshig gi nges pa sbyin pa ni/ 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba de ni don dam pa ma yin gyi/ don dam par rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi bde ba ni thig le 'pho ba med pa yin pas bde ba chen po'i rten thig le ni khyod kyis bsrung bar bya'o/ /kho bya ba ni/ las kyis phyag rgya'i rab sbyor dang / /ye shes phyag rgya'i rjes chags la'ang / /bde ba chen po byang chub sems/ /brtul zhugs brtan pos bsrung bar bya/ /bha gar ling ga rab bzhag nas/ /byang chub sems ni spro mi bya/ khams gsum po ni ma lus pa'i/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni bsgom par bya/ /srung ba 'di nyid kho na yis/ /skye ba 'di la sangs rgyas nyid/ /tshul khrims tshogs ni yang dag rdzogs/ /bsod nams ye shes yang dag ldan/ /pha rol phyin bcu thob pa yi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dus gsum 'jug /'di yis rdzogs sangs rgyas kun gyi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /rang dang gzhan don sgrub pa'i slad/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /khams gsum dbang phyug ye shes ni/ /'di las gzhan pa yod ma yin/ /skyob pa kun gyi sdom pa ni/ /gal te khyod srung bdag gi bu/ /de tshe sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /byin rlabs rdzogs byang chub thob 'gyur/ /ci ste chags pas zin mnan bdag /gtso bo'i mdun du blangs nas ni/ /sdom pa skyong bar mi byed na/ /de tshe ngu 'bod —278—

du 'gror 'gyur/ /dman pa'i sems las skye gnas su/ /gang tshe byang chub sems ltung 'gyur/ /de tshe phyag rgyar shes nas ni/ /pad+ma'i phyi rol rang lces blangs/ /zhes brjod par bya ste/ sdom pa sbyin pa'i nges pa'o/ /spros pa la dga' na skabs 'dir/gal te g.yo sgyu'i dbang gis zhes sogs rtsa lhung bcu bzhi ston pa'i rgyud tshig rnams brjod nas don yang spyod do/ /slar yang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la dbang bskur ba'i rab tu byed pa'i bka' drin gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas bla ma'i bu khyod nyon cig kun rdzob ji lta ba bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi thun mong gi bde ba/ dga' ba bcu drug gi mtshan nyid ni/ 'dod pa spyod par byed pas 'gro ba rang gi yid la'o gang ba dag ni gang ba nyid du 'gyur//gang ba yan lag mchog la ri bong 'dzin pa khu bar byas nas 'bar ba'i thig le bzang po 'dzag /o snas bkug pa mchog gi bde ba rang bzhin gyis ster thig le grol ba dag ni gsum gyi mthar/ /blta dang reg dang 'grogs las 'dzag pa'i bde ba 'di dag gis ni dga' ba la sogs dbye bas te/ /'dod pa dga' ba byed de dang po dag kyang mi rnams kyis ni mig gis blta ba rnams kyis so/ /phyi nas gang bas rab tu sbyar ba yis te slar yang mchog gi dga' ba nyid de rang lus la/ /'bar ba nyid la thig le 'dzag pa'i dga' ba yis kyang khyad par dga' ba rdo rje pad+ma la/ /o sna thig le gsum gyi mtha' ru 'gyur pa la gnas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba rdo rje byed/ /ces dga' ba bzhi dang de dag re re la yang / lus dang ngag dang sems dang / ye shes kyi dbye bas phye ba dga' ba bcu —279—

drug tu 'gyur ba ji lta ba bzhin du/ chags bral dang po chags pa che/ kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas brjod pa'i chos 'dzin pa/ /zhes dang / rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med/ /bcu drug phyed phyed thig le 'a myong / /cha med cha las 'das pa po/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo 'chang / /zhes thig le 'pho ba med pa don dam pa'i dga' ba bzhi yang sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi dbye bas phye ba ni de kho na nyid bcu drug yin la/ 'jig rten kun rdzob pa'i shes rab ye shes ni mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes tsam ste/ don dam pa ma yin gyi des nye bar mtshon pa 'jig rten las 'das pa dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes ni don gyi ye shes te/ de kho na nyid kyi don yin no/ /zhes 'pho ba med pa'i don dam pa spros pa dang bral zhing stong pa nyid dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes la 'dun par bya ste/ de yan chad dbang gong ma chung ngu zhes bya ste 'jig rten pa'i dbang gsum pa'i cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa'o/ /de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang bzhi pa zhi ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ ye shes la ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs gzhug pa'i don du/ dpal ldan ye shes rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed rdo rje bzhi bsgoms pas/ /lko pa dang / phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mi phyed rdo rje bzhi bsgoms pas/ /zhes gong gi tshigs bcad la 'don pa spos te gsol ba bto/ dbang bzhi pa dngos gzhi'i don du/ oṃ hoXpradzñā a pā yo/ ut+pa kaX badz+ra satwa mahā mu dra dzñā na a sgyi ṣe kaX me pra yasmotso tshe āXhuX hoXphaṭa/ ces pas gsol ba btab/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i sogs/ byin rlabs dbab pa snga ma rnams kyis rigs 'gre ba las/ lte ba'i hoXyig 'od zer ser po 'phro ba/—280—

lte ba nas zhugs/ chags rtogs gi dri ma zhes dang / ye shes kyi thig le dang bzhi pa'i gnas skabs lhan skyes kyi dga' ba/ ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid kyi sku sgyu 'phrul drwa bas mngon par zhes kyang 'don pa spon/ /de nas dbang bzhi pa dngos ni/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gis gsang chen dbang gis ni/ khyod kyi sems rgyud dbang bskus ro/ /zhes brjod la rkang pa skyil krung / lus drang por srong / lta stangs g.yo ba med par byed du bcug la/ 'di skad ces/ de ltar yang rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ dngos po med la sgom pa med/ /sgom pa sgom pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing rgyud kyi rgyal po las gsungs pa/ shes rab ye shes dag ni sems dang de'i snang ba dag kyang rnam pa bcu po nyid du 'gyur//dbang ni dri med ri bong can mtshungs me long gzugs brnyan lta bu 'di la zhugs pa gang yin pa/ /de las mya ngan 'das pa'i bde ba 'pho med lhan cig skyes pa 'gyur med nyid ni bzhi pa ste/ /sangs rgyas zhal ni gang gi thugs dang zhal la gnas par gyur pa de ni dpal ldan bla ma'o/ /zhes pa'i don chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa dang bral zhing / blo rnam par rtog pa snang ba dang bcas pa thams cad 'khrul ba'i snang ba yin par shes par byas nas/ ci yang rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang nas rnam pa thams cad pa'i mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /de las yan lag drug gi rim pas thob pa/ phyag rgya chen po dang mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes so sor rang gis rig par 'gyur ba ni/ gong ma'i gong ma chen po bzhi pa'i ye shes so/ /de ltar —281—

don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du phyag rgya chen po mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ skye rgu'i bdag po sa bcu gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par gyur pa yin no/ /zhes brda sprad la/ oṃ hoXdharmā bhā tu ak+ṣa ra tsa tu the a bhi ṣe ke ṇa a bhi khri sto/ badz+ra sa twa na/ ut+pa nā haX/ dī tī yo/ dwa da sha bhu mi 'khyu(/ badz+ra satwa/ mahā a the pa ra ma a k+ṣa raXtri lo kya bi dza yaXkā la tsakre( bha ga bān/ e baX ka raX zhes rjes zlos byed du bcug pas nga rgyal bzung bar bya ste/don dam pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab ye shes dbang gong ma chen po zhes bya ba dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de nas/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas dang ni byang chub sems/ /dpal ldan bla ma khyed spangs nas//bla ma gzhan dag rmi lam du'ang / /srog dor nas ni bsten mi bya/ /gzhan yang de bzhin dus kun tu/ /g.yo sgyu med par nus tshad kyis/ /lus ngag sems dang gsum po ni/ /gtso bo'i spyan sngar dbul bar bgyi/ /zhes rjes zlos kyis dam 'chang ru bcug gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang / btang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dbul bar bya'o/ /deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi/ khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol/ /zhes rjes zlos lan gsum dang dge ba bsngo/ bar 'dir tshogs kyi 'khor lo'am dpa' bo'i ston mo bya/ gtor ma gsar du bsham pa'am snga ma rnams kha gsos la/ lha dgu'i sgrub thab kyi gtor chog skabs nas 'byung ba ltar/ gtor ma byin rlabs nas gzhi bdag gtor ma'i bar rnams btang la/ spyi dang mthun par rdo rje'i glu blangs pa'am/ ma blangs kyang rbang ste/ steng na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag —282—

sogs shis pa brjod do/ /rjes chog gi mchod pa rnams kha gsos/ oX āXhūX hraXphaṭa nas/ dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āXhūX hoXtre dh+wa tu nas/ shiṣ+ṭha na sma zhes pas mchod yon phul/ gan+dhaX sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis sngags tsam gyis phul nas/ tseX( kā la tsakra sogs kyis gong bzhin nang mchod phul/ mchog spyin rdo rje sogs rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bstod/mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje nus mthus 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ spyir gyi phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba dang / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs shing / zhal bzhugs pa rnams sku khams bzang ba dang / khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor ba dang bcas pas thog drangs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag nas/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yig brgya tshar gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs/ badz+ra muX mgron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshe/gas/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang nyid la thim/ zhes brjod/ gsang bar haX yig zhes pa nas/ 'byung po'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams sogs dang / bkra shis kyi tshig gang 'os bya'o/ /zhes zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi sgyud kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i dbang gong ma bskur tshul/ rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku kun mkhyen jo nang pa chen po yab sras kyi phyag bzhes phyin ci —283—
na gnas dpal jo mo nang du'o// //bkra shis/

sgrub thabs ye shes 'od 'phro zhes bya ba bsdo/ste//na mo gu ru budha bo dhi sa te khyoX dpal dus kyi 'khor lo snying po'i dkyil 'bor gyi sgrub thabs ye shes 'od 'phro zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan 'gyur med ye shes dngos/ /rnam par rtog pa kun spangs shing / /ming dang tshig las rab 'das pa/ /chos dbyings de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /spros med brjod pa dang bral ba/ /chags thogs med pa'i gnas lugs ni/ /rnam pa kun tu 'char ba yi/ /ye shes de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtags pa'i dri ma kun bral yang / /dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor thams cad pa/ /brda' las don dam mtshon pa'i tshul//yang yang spel ba 'di re mtshar/ /de ltar bla ma lha bcas la btud nas/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mngon du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /kun la nyer 'khor dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yi/ /sgrub thabs 'bri bar 'gyur ba su yis 'gog /'di la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi bya ba gsum las/ dang po la/ rgyud sbyang ba thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang / nges par bya ba thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag nyid sgrub thabs nyams len gyi skabs su nges par dgos pa la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas gsum mo/ /de yang / bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas gzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad bcu rtsa —285—

bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o//rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi sbyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudha sarba spyi mi swa bha wa shurnyo3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi spyi bor paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūX las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/lte ba la huX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa ma cedi/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus huX la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las/ bcol ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khrud pa/yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang pad+ma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āXthugs kar huX/ lte bar hoX thugs ka'i hūX las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi —286—

'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka tī no pa nga ḍi sgo me bha wa/ su to stso me bha wa/ a nu ra lto me bhā wa/ su po stso me bhā wa/ sarba sirnyi sme pra ru sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taX shri yaX ku ru huX/ ha ha ha ha hoX bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka ma me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa a huX phaṭa/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum zla ba zhu ba ltar gyur pa/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas thim pas rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje dang /rang gi lus ngag yid gsum ye shes rdo rje rnams dbyer med du gyur/gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro rnam pa bcu ni/rdo rje'i zhal dag rigs drug dgod pa dang / /rdo rje bzhi dang yan lag drug rnams 'god/ /bdud tshogs gzhom zhing bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom/ /mkha' la rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams rtogs byas ste/ /bla med mchod pa rnam pa bdun gyis mchod/ /lam bsten stong pa nyid la dmigs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ oṃ āXhūX hoXhaX k+ṣaXpradzñā u pa ya/ ut+pa ka kā ya lha ka tsit+ta dzñā na a dhi pa te/ ma ma kā ya nywa ka tsit+ta dzñā na badz+raX/badz+ra a spo ta sla bha waX/ ku ru ku ru skan+ta dh+wa tu ā ya ta naX niXswa bhā waX swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ de nas gtsug tor gyi steng du waX yig yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje zla —287—

ba'i dkyil 'khor cha bcu drug pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de zhu ba lus la zhugs pas gtsug tor nas rkang sen gyi mthar thug pa'i ma dag pa'i lus sprul gyi shun pa ltar lan gsum dor te/ lus dang ngag dang sems dang ye shes rnam par dag pa rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zla ba dri ma med pa ltar gyur/gnyis pa rigs drug 'god pa ni/ oṃ sā bhā wa shudhaXsarba dharmaXspyo bhā wa shurnyo3haX/dpral bar oṃ dkar po las snang ba mtha' yas rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas zhal nag cing g.yon zhal dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis tho ba/ mdung rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gsum gyis 'dab ma brgyad pa'i pad+ma dkar po me long bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ mgrin par āXdamar po las rin chen 'byung ldan rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dmar po g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis me'i mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma sa g.yon pa gsum gyis gzhu/ zhags pa rin po che rtse mo dgu pa 'od 'phro ba 'dzin pa/ snying gar huX nag po las don yod grub pa rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog nag po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis ral gri/ gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gsum gyis phub/thod pa kha ṭāX ga dkar po 'dzin pa/ lte bar hoXser po las rnam par snang mdzad rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ser po/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis 'khor lo dbyug pa/ khro bo'i rdo rje/ g.yon pa gsum gyis dung / rdo rje lcags sgrog sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ gtsug tor du haX ljang khu las mi bskyod pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ gri gug—288—

dgra sta/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ gsang bar k+ṣaXsngon po las rdo rje sems dpa' rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang so sor dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnam pa rnams 'khod par gyur/gsum pa rdo rje bzhi dag pa ni/ lag pa phan tshun mnye zhing dkrug pa'i phyag rgya byas nas/ tsho( hraXsarba a lha rā dza/ mā ra kle sha an+ta ka ra/ badz+ra stu duXkha ts+tsha da ma ma ka raX bi sho dha ya swāhā/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung la sogs pa rtsa ba'i tshigs rnams su/a i ṛ u '-i/ dbus kyi tshigs rnams su/ a e ar o al/ steng gi tshigs rnams su/ ha ya ra wa la/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong la sogs pa'i steng gi tshigs rnams su/ lwa wā rā yā hā/ dbus kyi tshigs rnams su ul au ur i ā/ rtsa ba'i tshigs rnams su/ lī mū grwa sī ā/ lag pa gnyis ka sbyar ba'i dbus su hūX gi yi ge mthon mthing / zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi sa bon de dag las grub pa'i lag pa rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bong gtsug tor nas brtsams te lus thams cad la reg cing / oX āXhuX hoXhaX k+ṣaX kā ya lha ka tsit+ta dzñā na a dhi pa te badz+ra kā ya/ ma ma kā ya lha ka tsit+ta dzñā na badz+raX badz+ra kā ya swa bhā waX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ ༷bzhi pa yan lag drug dgod pa ni/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bong gnyis snying gar reg la/ o la grwa hri da yā ya na ma/ dpral bar reg nas/ oṃ rgyuX si ra si swāhā/ gtsug tor du reg nas/oṃ hri shi ji yi po ṣaṭa/ yan lag rnams la reg ste/ oṃ sbru ka ba tsā ya huX/ mig gnyis la —289—

reg ste/ oṃ hāX ni tra ya wa ṣaṭa/ g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub phyogs bcur brdabs la/ oṃ hraX.a sta ya phaṭa/ nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya hri da ya si raXrngon ka wa tsa nai tra/ a tra badz+ra/ ṣaṭa aX ga swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/lnga pa bdud tsho gos gzhom pa la/ sngon du 'gro ba gtor ma ni/ oṃ āXhuX hraXphaṭa/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sarba dharma su bi shudha su bhā wa sarba dharmya na bi sho dha ya swāhā/ oṃ āXbadz+ra srur+ya sarba dharma pa bo dha ka sarba dharmya na pra bo dh+wa ya swāhā/ oṃ hūX badz+ra a na la sarba dharma pra dī pa ka sarba dharmu na pra dī pa ya swāhā/ oṃ hoXsarba dharma badz+ra a mṛ ta ka ra sarba dharmya na badz+ra a mṛ taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ āXshuX/ yul gyi bdag po sa pa ri wā ra ya/ e daX bā ling / gan+taX/pulgaX dhu paX/ pra dī paX/ ak+ṣa taX/ da da ma he/ sa pa ri wā ra/ shī gh+raX/ ā ga tsā tu/dzaXhuX baX hoX i daX ba ling groṇ+ḍa n+tu/ sku da tu/ bi wa tu/ sa pa ri wā ra ka sarba satwa naX/ shwan+taX/ stse rak+ṣa a wa ra ṇa/ gu sti/ ka ro tu/ i daX satwa naX/ tu klu ba hre maṇ+ḍal bhu myuX tiṣ+ṭha tu huX hūX phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra a pa ya ti swāhā/ khyi'i phyag rgya bcas la/oX āXhuX grong gi bdag po ā ga tsā ā ru/ ghāX/ i daX bā ling / gro hā gro hā/snu k+ta bi tā tri lha/ kri tā sarba satwa naX/ shān+ti/ tsit+taX/ kri twa/ a pa ra za naX/ gats+tsha ca swāhā/ 'di ni sgrub mchod kyi bdag bskyed sogs la dgos kyi/ rgyun gyi nyams len la ni/ sngon 'gro rgyas pa'i skabs kyang 'di bor bas rung la byed pa'i lugs la'ang gang rung re byas na yang legs so/ /gnyis pa dngos ni/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ dkar po las rdo rje rtse mo bcu bdun pa dang / mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la āXdamar po las rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa dang / snying gar sgra gcan kyi dkyil 'bor la huX nag po las rdo rje rtse mo dgu pa dang / lte bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor la —290—

hoXser po las rdo rje rtse mo drug cu rtsa lnga pa dang / gtsug tor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la haX ljang khu las rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa dang / gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la k+ṣaXsngon po las rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams su gyur/de bzhi du/ las kyi 'khor lo rnams dang / bya ba'i 'khor lo rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / las kyi dbang po rnams la rdo rjes mtshan par gyur/ de ltar bdag nyid rdo rje'i skur gyur nas/ de nyid las 'phros pa'i rdo rje'i me dpung steng dang 'og tu ljang khu dang sngon po/ shar dang mer nag po/ lho dang bden bral du dmar po/ byang dang dbang ldan du dkar po/ nub dang rlung du ser po 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba'i rdo rje rnams kyis sems can rnams la rnam par 'tshe bar byed pa'i bdud kyi tshogs phyogs bcu na gnas pa mtha' dag nges par bsregs nas bde ba chen po la bkod par gyur/ oṃ āXhuX hoXhaX k+ṣaX hāXhāXhāXhāX ra ra ra ra badz+ra a na la/ sarba a pa ra ṇa dharma pra la ya swa bhā wa/ sarba mā ra kā yi ka bisnin bi nā ya ka ā dī nāX/ da sha di ka ga tā nāX/ kā ya lha kri khyu ni/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/bhasmin ku ru ku ru hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ ces lan gsum sogs drag tu 'don no/ /drug pa srung pa'i snyen ra lo bsgom pa ni/rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang rwa gur rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ oṃ paX bi shwa badz+ra pad+maX ku ru ku ru swāhā/dbus kyi lte ba'i nang du khru bcu gnyis pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/oX raXbadz+ra srur+ya badz+ra srur+ya ā sa naX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ pad+ma'i lte ba khru bzhi pa'i steng du/ de dang mnyam pa'i nyi ma'i gdan dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du huX las bdag nyid khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo dang mtshungs pa las/ sku mdog nag po dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs shing /—291—

lhag pa'i phyag gnyis te/ phyag nyi shu rtsa drug dang ldan pa/ yi dwags kyi gdan la gnas pa/ zhal thams cad mche ba gtsigs pa/ rab tu khros shing 'jigs su rung ba can/ spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu sgra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ sku la rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/phrag par bdud rigs brgya'i mgo bo'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ spyi bor thod pa lnga'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /lhag pa'i phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pa nag po dang g.yon pa ser pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas te/ glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa khrag dang bcas pa mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i rkang lag gnyis nas bzung ste gyon zhing /bdud kyi mgo bo dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /klu'i dbang po rgyal ba cod pan la bcings shing / rnam par rgyal ba dar dpyangs la bcings pas gnas pa/ stobs kyi rgyud dang pad+ma rna rgyan la gnas pa/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong phyag gdub la gnas pa/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan 'og pag dang mgul rgyan la gnas pa 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po zhabs gdub la gnas pa/ de ltar bdag nyid khro bo'i dbang po dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs shing / rab tu 'jigs pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ huX kro dha ispro3haX kro dh+wa nāX udzñā dā ya ka swāhā/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams kyi nang du/ raXyig yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams su gyur/ bdag nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ha ya ra wa la brtsegs pa'i rang bzhin yi ge'i gong bu rnams su gyur/ ha hā las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu dang sngon po dag yongs su gyur pa las gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba mi bskyod pa lta bu dang / gnod mdzes rgyal po rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu dag zhal gyi gtso bo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag nas spros te/—292—
