steng dang 'og tu rtsibs kyi nang du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la gnas pa'o//yi yī las byung ba'i ral gri nag po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ bgegs mthar byed dang dbyug sngon can don yod grub pa lta bu dag g.yon dang po po kyi sna bug dag nas spros te/ shar dang me'i rtsibs su gnas pa dang / snorwa las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ shes rab mthar byed dang ṭak+ki rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu dag g.yon dang g.yas kyi mig dag nas spros te/lho dang bden bral gyi rtsibs su gnas pa dang / wu lha las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ pad+ma mthar byed dang mi g.yo ba snang ba mtha' yas lta bu dag lce dang chu lam nas spros te/ byang dang dbang ldan gyi rtsibs su gnas pa dang / slo slu las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po dag yongs su gyur pa las gshin rje mthar byed dang stobs po che rnam par snang mdzad lta bu dgabashang lam dang gtsug tor nas spros te/ nub dang rlung gi rtsibs su gnas pa ste/ thams cad kyang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas shing / khro bo'i dbang po lta bu'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rak+ṣa tsakra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ oṃ haX badz+ra kro dha rā dza mahā ur+sha ṣa urnyi di shi rak+ṣa ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oX yaX badz+ra kro dha rā dza a ti bā la sarba 'a an+ta ka purba di shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/oṃ raX badz+ra kro dha rā dza rdza bha ka duXne pradzñā an+ta ka dak+ṣi ṇa di shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/oṃ waX badz+ra kro dha rā dza mā na ka bi rā ga pad+ma an+ta ka ut+ta ra di shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ laX badz+ra kro dha rā dza stuX bha ka ya ma an+ta ka nyi pa ma di shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oX lāXbadz+ra kro dha rā dza mahā bā 'i bā ya byāX di shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ lkoX wāXbadz+ra kro dha rā dza a tsa la i shā na di shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ rāXbadz+ra kro dha —293—

rā dza ṭak+ki ni ri t+yāX di shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ yāXbadz+ra kro dha rā dza nī la dan asna yaX di shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ tshiXbadz+ra kro dha rā dza nga a dho di shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ de dag gis kyang bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams rdo rje lcags kyus btab cing rdo rje zhags pas bcings pa rnams kyi steng du/ rdo rje phur bu rno zhing rab tu 'bar ba/ stod khro bo'i gzugs can rnams kyis btab par gyur/ phur bu bsgril pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ āXhuX hoXhaX k+ṣaXhuX huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra gī la kā ya lha ka tsit+ta dzñā na a dhi pa te ṣaṭa mu kha/ ṣaṭa bhu dza/ ṣaṭa tsa ra ṇa/ sarba byu bi nā ya ka ā di dusaX naX/ kā ya lha ka tsit+ta dzñā nā ni/ gī la ya gī la ya huX hūX phaṭa/phur bu 'debs pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ snyi badz+ra mud ga ra mā ra ā dī nāX/ sa ra si ka rje hri da ye nā bho gu hre/ a rnye badz+ra gī la kā na/ ā ko ṭa ya ā ko ṭa ya/ k+ṣaX nywaX k+ṇi skyu ljo snya khyiX khriX rta blo hūX huX huX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/rdo rje'i tho bas brdungs te bgegs kyi 'i tshogs rnams bde ba chen por ro gcig pa'i de bzhin nyid rnam par dag par gyur zhing / lhag ma rnams kyang ring du bros par gyur/ badz+ra ste ra wa dhi skra rā ya sa pa ri wa re khyuX badz+ra gan+taX pra titsā na maX badz+ra puṣ+ṭhaX pra ca na maX badz+ra dhu paX pra tisnro na maX badz+ra dī paX pra tisnro na maX badz+ra nai wi tuX pra tisma na maX badz+ra ak+ṣa taX pra ca na maX badz+ra lā phyaX pra ru na maX badz+ra ha gyaX pra tisnro na maX badz+ra wā tuX pra tisnro na maX badz+ra snu tuX pra tismo na maX badz+ra gī taX pra ru na maX badz+ra kā maX pra ru na maXgasang bar haX yig la khro bo'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ de yan chad la/rgyun gyi nyams len la bsdus pa kho na la dga' bas lha dgu'i skabs su bshad pa ltar byas kyang rung ngo / /bdun pa tshogs kyi zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ bdag nyid skad cig gis dus kyi 'khor —294—

lo'i skur gsal ba'i snying gar paX las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po'i 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar aX yig yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ huX las byung bru'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang / de las rdo rje nyi ma bzhin du 'od zer kha dog lnga rnams 'phros pas/ bla ma dang de bzhin gshe/gas pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pas/ nam mkha'i mthil du badz+ra sa mā dzaX 'od zer gyi tshogs rnams rang gi snying ga'i rdo rje la zhugs par gyur/brgyad pa mchod pa rnam pa bdun ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /srid gsum skye 'jig med pa'i dngos/ shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dus 'kho(ra la phyag 'tshal//phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das/ /pra phab pa yi rang bzhin can/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchoge ldan ma/ /phyag rgya chen mo de la 'dud/ /oṃ badz+ra garnye gan+ta a khyu/naX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra mya lo myu 'a los spyoskyinaX ku ru kurus sma oṃ cadro rje pe ༷ nyusne rna ji dro yirib si dhu pa a rta'i na ku sde kyi ku da9 swāhā/ ba pra dā pe pra phya pa caX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ te nai we tu i rna 'apū dzaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ badz+ra ak+ṣa te ak+ṣa ta pha la ats+tshanaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ lkoX badz+ra lā phye wasta a bha ra ṇa pū kyu ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ha phya bhaṇ+ḍa ā dar+sha pū rja ku ru ku ru —295—

swāhā/ lkoX zhi badz+ra wa bye wa tu pū rdza ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dra rkye snu tu pū rdza 1 ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ lja badz+ra gī te gī ta pū rja ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ snyu badz+ra kā me rka sarba brnya bo dhi satwa naX kro dha a dī nāX/ badz+ra su ra / ta pū rdza ku ru ku ru swāhā/ srid 'gro nyams dar byis pa'i blo yis ni/ /shin tu mi bzad sdig pa gang bgyis pa/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i sbyan sngar mchis nas ni/ /sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rnam mang dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag mtha' dag la ni sdig pa rnams bral byang chub spyod la rjes su gnas pas rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi lus 'bul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing mya ngan mi 'da' yun ring bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do/ /dgu pa lam bsten pa ni/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing / /bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang / /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin sbong ba'i/ /rtsa ba gsum dang phar phyin bcu/ /tshad med bsdu dngos bzhi bsten bgyi/ /mi dge bcu dang sgrib pa lnga/ /nyon mongs bzhi dang zag pa bzhi/ /deng nas brtsams te spangs par bgyi/ /ya pa stong pa nyid la dmigs pa ni/ dngos po med la bsgom pa med/ /sgom pa bsgom pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pa/ /sgom pa dmigs su —296—

med pa'o/ khams gsum po rnam par dpyad na cir yang mi dmigs pa dang /bdag nyid kyi lus kyi chu'i khams kyis me rnam par nyams shing / me med pas sa yang sra ba nyid dor nas lan tshwa bzhin du zhu bar gyur te/ /chu la thim zhing / chu yang rlung gis bskams par byas nas rlung gi tshogs rnams nam mkha' la mi snang bar gyur te/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid do/ /oX shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ oṃ a ni mit+ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ oṃ a na dhi skaX ra dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la/ sku rdzogs pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gsung rdzogs pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag las rgyal mchog thig le rdzogs pa sgrub pa'i yan lag thig le'i rnal 'byor/ bde ba rdzogs pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro//dang po la/ rten gzhal yas khang bsgom pa dang / brten pa lha bsgom pa gnyis las/ dang po gzhal yas khang gsal gdab pa ni/rdo rje'i rang bzhi rtsibs bcu pa/ zlum po'i dbus su chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams la yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po/ dbus su gzhu'i rnam pa rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po dbus su gru gsum gyi rnam pa bkra shis kyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po dbus su zlum po'i rnam pa pad+ma'i mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po dbus su gru bzhi'i rnam pa rdo rjes mtshan pa/de thams cad kyang steng dang 'og tu huX las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis gnyis dang ldan par gyur/ sa'i steng du maX las ri rab lhun po de'i steng du k+ṣaX —297—

las sna tshogs chu skyes lte bar pad+ma'i sum cha'i tshad dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du haX las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor pad+ma'i lte ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du rnam par bcad pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zla ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du thig le las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor mthon mthing nyi ma dang mnyam pa/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa las 6 zhes pa'i sa bon gyi ye ge yongs su gyur pa las 'jig rten gyi khams snga ma bzhin du grub par gyur/ lhun po'i steng du huX las byung ba'i rdo rje'i gur rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su rdo rje'i sa gzhi phyogs kyi mdog can gyi gzhi la bhuX yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes rin po che lnga'i rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi dang ldan pa/nang nas rim pa bzhin du rin po che nag po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po'i ra ba rim pa gsum dang ldan pa ste/ sgo dang mnyam pa'i sgo khyud dang / sgo 'gram dang / sgo logs te glo 'bur gyi rnam par grub pa'i sgo khang nyid do/ /ra ba'i phyi rol du stegs bu dkar po 'gram stegs kyi rnam pa can khor yug tu yongs su bskor ba dang / ra ba'i steng du rin po che'i snam bu dmar po kha bad kyi rnam pa can la rin po che du mas mdzes par spras pa dang / de'i steng du thog phubs kyi gdung 'degs pa'i ka thung rnams kyi bar bar du chu srin ma ka ra'i kha nas 'phyang ba'i do shal dang do shal phyed pa dkar po me long dang rnga yab dang bcas pa/steng du bya 'dabs las thur du 'phyang ba'i bā ku li dang / steng du mdzes par mtshar du dngar ba'i kra ma shir+ṣa dkar po'o/ /sgo khang rnams kyi steng du sgo las sum 'gyur gyi rta babs nor bu gser gyi rang bzhin brtsegs ma gsum dang /sgo logs kyi g.yas dang g.yon gyi stegs bu'i steng du btsugs pa'i ka ba ser po —298—

bzhi bzhis btegs pa rnams te/ brtsegs ma re re la'ang gdung dang myos pa srung ba dang / ka thung rnams kyi bar bar du mchod pa'i lha mo'i gnas gsum brtsegs ༵ dang ༵'i/ sna/ gnyis na 1 hūṃ rdo sbyi ༵ ༵/ pa'i seng ge rdo/ga/ sdo sna / brtsegs ma gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i logs gnyis nas mchod pa'i lha mo dag gis gdung 'degs bzhin pa dang / steng du har mi mdzes pa bum pa'i tog dang bcas pa/ bum pa'i g.yas dang g.yo ni du rgyal mtshan dang / rnam bu rnams las dril bu dang / me long dang / ba dan dang / rnga yab la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas du sgo dpa sgo khyud snru sdu~X sa/ rdzu ༵ sdu dhi~X ༵ rdo ༵༵༵ rlo / par ༵ rdo rdo lo/ //phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi phyed du bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'o/ /de'i yang nang gi phyed du oṃ yig las byung ba'i gtso bo'i pad+ma dang / de'i lte ba la ma yig ༵༵ sbya ga~Xḍi gyi sdo ḍā ༵/ tshor tsho rnama~X steng nga ba 9 rinas ldu ༵ kā~X /gas ༵ rnyi la/ sna dhi ༵ sdo ga pa~X/ nyi/ sna kā wo rlo dhi ༵ ༵ rdo nga dā/'i ༵dog ༵sna hā sna hā sngu 'phre sdo ba/hūṃ ༵ sna ༵ sna rdo nga phre/byang rdo ༵bla'i dī ṭā ༵ ma/ sni / bzhi dpa / / nub tu 'khore lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa bzhi'o/ /ka ba de rnams kyi nang gi thad sor yang gtso bo'i pad+ma la gru bzhir bskor ba'i ka ba bcu gnyis te/ phyi nang gis ka ba de dag gis btegs pa'i rdo rje'i gdung rim pa gnyis kyi nang ma nag —299—

po dang phyi ma ljang khu'o/ /nang gi ka ba rdo rje'i gdung dang bcas pa'i steng du yang ka ba rnams kyis btegs pa'i gtso bo'i gnas kyi thog phub phyur bu'i rnam pa mdzes pa/ rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis nye bar mdzes pa'o/ /ra ba'i nang du snying po'i sgo'i drug cha spang par lha rnam dkar po'o/ /gtso bo'i pad+ma 'og gzhi sngon po dang / de nas mchod pa'i sa'i mthar thug pa'i 'og gzhi rdo rje'i sa dang / steng gi thog rnams kyi mdog ni/ gtso bo'i zhal gyi dbye bas/ shar nag po/ lho dmar po/ byang dkar po/ nub ser po'o/ /phyi rol mchod pa'i sa gzhi la pad+ma dang bum pa bzang po la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin phung du ma nye bar 'khrigs pa dang /de'i phyi rol tu sa'i 'khor yug gi steng gi nam mkha' la dbang ldan nas zla ba nya gang ba 'char bzhin pa dang / bden bral du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nub bzhin pa'o/ /de'i yang phyi rol tu chu dang me dang rlung gi 'khor yug rnams dang / de'i phyi rol tu nam mkha'i khor yug la dbus su rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa'i yongs su bskor ba ste/ de ltar dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi rol phyogs kun nas rdo rje me lce ye shes kyi 'od zer mtha' yas pa kun tu 'phro ba'o/ /bde gshegs 'phar ma'i ka ba rnams kyi bar bar du oṃ yig las skyes pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lha'i gdan du gyur pa rnam pa brgyad de/ phyogs bzhi dkar po dang /mtshams bzhi dmar po'o/ /de dag gi bar bar du yang bdud rtsi'i bum pa brgyad kyi gnas so/ /lha rnam la shar dang lho'i g.yas dang g.yon dang / byang du nub kyi g.yas rnams su oṃ yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang /mtshams rnams dang / byang dang nub kyi g.yon dag tu/ oṃ yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang / shar dang byang gi sgor pad+ma dkar po dang /—300—

lho dang nub kyi sgor pad+ma dmar po'o/ /pad+ma dmar po bcu gnyis kyi lte bar lo'i phyogs nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i nya bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa ma yig las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dang / dkar po bcu gnyis kyi lte bar gnam stong bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa ra yig las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis so/ /me dang rlung gi 'khor yug gi mtshams su dur khrod chen po mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa brgyad do/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor chen po kun nas dwangs zhing sgrib pa med la/ phyi nang kun tu 'od gsal zhing mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rgyan gyi rnam pa mchog tu bkra ba dus mas mdzes par gyur/gnyis pa brten pa lha sgom pa la gnyis las/ dang po lha bskyed pa ni/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la gnas pa'i zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo a i ṛ u le/ a e ar tse( al/ ha ya ra wa la aX zhes pa rnams g.yon skor dang / lā wā rā yā hā/ ul o ur i ā/ lī mū grwa yī ā aXzhes pa rnams g.yas skor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs dang ldan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /de'i 'og tu dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ skru smra yi khra lha lha/ khru lha rja yi gha/sma spru tho kru/ t+ta s+tha sdo spya sno/ lpa h+pha bru lju sma/ spyo da khra stu ṇ+ḍa/ ts+tsha ts+tsha hū ཾ ljo rnyi/ spro khru glu rda dh+ra /zhes pa rnams g.yas skor dang / nga gha ga kha ka nya dzña dza tsha tsa/ ṇa lha ḍa ṭha ṭa/ ma bha ba pha pa/ na dha da tha ta/ rkosha ṣa pi sa/ ha ya ra ba la/ bha ḍa ya wa la/ zhes pa rnams g.yon skor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor —301—

gsal byed dang ldan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /zla ba'i dbus su hūX yig zla ba'i mtshan ma lta bu so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /de rnams gcig tu gyur pa hi yig dang bcas pa bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes so/ /de las lha'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa haX yig dang bcas pa ni shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ bdag nyid dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga rnams 'gyed cing / bdud dang nyon mongs pa'i snying gar mnan pa'i zhabs gnyis/ pa/ mgrin pa gsum pa/ zhal bzhi pa/ phrag pa drug pa/ dpung pa bcu/ gnyis pa/ phyag gi pad+ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ mtshon cha rnams dang rdo rje'i rgyan gyis rnam pa brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas pa dmar po brkyang pas 'dod lha dmar po gdong gcig pa/ lag pa bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis me tog gi mda' lnga lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis kyis gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'i snying khar mnan pa/g.yon pa dkar po bskum pas drag po dkar po gdong gcig pa/ mig gsum pa/ lag pa bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang ḍa ma sa g.yon gnyis kyis kha ṭāX ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i snying khar mnan pa/ bdud gyi dga' ma dang / drag po'i u ma dag ni dman pa'i gdong gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi mthil la 'dzin par byed kyang g.yo ba med par gnas pa/ sku mdog sngon po g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus kyi mgrin pa nyi ma dang zla ba dang bung ba'i mdog can/ mdun zhal nag po mche ba phyed gtsigs pa/ g.yas zhal dmar po chags pa dang bcas pa/ g.yon zhal dkar po rab tu zhi ba/ rgyab zhal ser po ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa ste/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /ral pa'i cod pan la sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / rdo rje sems —302—

dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ spyi gtsug tu rdo rje nor bu dang / rdo rje rna rgyan dang / rdo rje mgul rgyan dang / rdo rje gdub bu dang / rdo rje ska rags dang / rdo rje rkang gduspudang / rdo rje dar dpyangs dang / rdo rje 'phreng ba dang / stag gi pags pa'i na bza' dang lden pa/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi phrag pa dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po/ de bzhin du dpung pa gnyis nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gnyis dkar po/ phyag ngar bzhi nag po/ bzhi dmar po/ bzhi dkar po/ de dag re re la yang sor gdub rnams kyis spras pa'i mthe bong ser po/mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang khu'o//de rnams re re la yang phyag mthil nas brtsams te tshigs kyi 'phreng ba dang po rnams nag po/ gnyis pa rnams dmar po/ gsum pa rnams dkar po'o/ /de lta bu'i phyag g.yas pa rnams kyi nag po bzhis rdo rje/ ral gri/ rtse gsum/ gri gugadamar po bzhis/ mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma sa tho ba/dkar po bzhis 'khor lo mdung dbyug pa dgra sta rnams 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa rnams kyi nag po bzhis/ rdo rje dril bu/ phub kha ṭāX ga kha bye ba/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ dmar po bzhis gzhu zhags pa rin po che pad+ma dkar po bzhis dung me long rdo rje lcags sgrog tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin cing / phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'byud pa ste/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes don dam pa'i bden pa'o/ /de la 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum ser mo zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad/spyan bcu gnyis ma ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi nub zhal gtso bor ba theg pa lta bu/mdun zhal ser mo/ g.yas zhal dkar po/ rgyab zhal nag po/ g.yon zhal —303—

dmar po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis gri gug lcags kyu sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma sa bgrang 'phreng rnams 'dzin cing / g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa/ zhags pa 'dab ma brgyad pa'i pad+ma dkar po/ rin po che rnams 'dzin pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bcom ldan 'das la 'khril zhing / des kyang snyoms par zhugs pa ste/ shes rab dang ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin ma/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid do/ /sbyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa gzhan brgyad ni 'dab ma brgyad la gnas pa ste/ shar dang nub tu a ā/ byang dang lhor aX āXrnams yongs su gyur pa las rim pa bzhin du bdug spos kyi snod dang / dri'i dung dang lha bskos dang / mar me phyogs kyi mdog can rnams dang / me dang rlung du ha hā/ dbang ldan dang bden bral du haX hā rnams yongs su gyur pa las rnga yab phyogs kyi mdog can rnams so/ /de rnams yongs su gyur pa las shar du nag mo 'bar ma/ nag dmar ser dkar ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis bdug spos dang / tsan dan dang / gur gum dang / gla rtsir bcas pa'i ga bur gyi snod dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu dang / pad+ma dang / yongs 'dus me tog dang / me tog sna tshogs kyi 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lhor dmar mo 'bas ma/ dmar ser dkar nag pa'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis mar me dang / do shal dang / cod pan dang gdub bu dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis gos dang / ska rags dang / rin po che'i rna rgyan dang / /rkang gdub 'dzin pa/ byang du dkar mo 'bar ma/ dkar nag dmar ser ba'i zhal bzhi/—304—

phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis 'o ma dang / chu dang sman bzang po dang / chang rnams kyi snod dang / g.yon pa rnams kyis bdud rtsi dang / grub pa'i bcud len dang / bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu dang / 'bras pha rnams kyi snod 'dzin pa/ nub tu ser mo 'bar ma/ ser dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad kyis g.yas pa rnams kyis dung dang / gling bu dang / nor bu dang / ḍa ma sa g.yon pa rnams kyis pi waX dang / rnga dang / zhabar rnga dang / zangs dung rnams 'dzin pa/mer du ba ma nag mo 'bar ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag brgyad na rnga yab nag po brgyad bsnams pa/ bden bral du smig sgyu ma dmar mo 'bar ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag brgyad na rnga yab dmar po brgyad bsnams pa/ dbang ldan du me khyer ma dkar mo 'bar ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag brgyad na ru rnga yab dkar po brgyad bsnams pa/ rlung du mar me ma ser mo 'bar ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag brgyad na rnga yab ser po brgyad bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gyi mdog ni g.yas skor gyi rim pa ste/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ zhal bzhi/ phyag brgyad/spyan bcu gnyis pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can no/ /'di dag gi rgyab tu yang / dbang ldan du oṃ las byung ba'i chos kyi dung dkar po dang /bden bral du āXlas byung ba'i chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi dmar po/ mer huX las byung ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu nag po/ rlung du hoXlas byung ba'i dpag bsam gyi shing ser po rnams su gyur/ de nas dkyil 'khor pa rnams spro ba ni/ 'dod chags chen po gdul bar bya ba'i sems can rnams dang po'i sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snod du mngon par gzigs nas/ yum la snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i shin tu dga' ba'i sgras/ nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i rnam par dag pa'i —305—

phung po khams dang skye mched las dbang yul dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin de bzhin ba/gegs pa yab yum/ byang chub sems dpa' yab yum/ khro bo yab yum thams cad rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pas rang gi lus la zhugs par gyur/ slar yang rang nyid las 'phros te sna tshogs yum la zhugs par gyur/ de las kyang ldog nas slar yang rang nyid la zhugs te/ zla ba byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par zhu ba rnams rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra spros te/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las lha dang lha mo'i tshogs su gyur pa ni/ a yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu nas/ gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa la/ rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas 'phyud pa nam mkhar spros nas sems can gyi don byas te/ slar yang rang nyid la bdag por zhugs par gyur/ i yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las/ don yod grub pa nag po la spyan ma ser mos 'khyud pa/ shar du pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ ṛ yig las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po chen 'byung ldan dmar po la/ mā ma gī dkar mos 'byud pa/ lhor pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ u yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ snang ba mtha' yas dkar po la gos dkar mo dmar mos 'byud pa/ byang du pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ '-i yig las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad ser po la/ sgrol ma nag mos 'byud pa/ nub tu pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ lnga char yang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ pad+ma dkar po —306—

dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje gdan gyis gnas shing / thabs gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /yī yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las sgrol ma steng / sna dī ra ༵ nga/ rmi yig ༵ sna / ba'i rjo/ ༵ ༵ rdo~Xr sta ༵tshong ṭā~X bde sna bra~X du~X da zla'i rnyi nga du ༵ rdo /dā ༵ ༵tha/u dhi da ༵༵ byung ba'i kā ༵/ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las mā ma gī dkar mo la rin chen 'byung ldan dmar pos 'khyud pa/ dbang ldan du pad zla'i steng du ka lod par gyur/ lī yig las don sngu grub pa na ga ༵ yong lhas 'khyud dod da ༵ gyu/ ༵ sdu ༵ sdu sngu sna steng du dhi par gyur/ thams cad kyang pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la pad+ma'i gdan gyis gnas shing shes rab gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /de dag gi g.yon dang bu~X ༵ dkar ༵ shā dzī gan sa sni ljo /rna~Xdhi ༵ ༵༵ pa dī~Xrdo rdo shar / rdo~X 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang / lhor khrag 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang /byang du gci ba 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang / nub tu bshang ba 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang / ha ha las byung ba'i steng du khu ba 'gags pa'i bum pa dang /'og tu rdul 'gags pa'i bum pa rnams su gyur/ ha yig las byung ba'i rdo rje yig kho rgi pas byung gyu ri rtsa pa / shad dod ra / / 'i ya sgi snyu ka tsug pos byung nga /dhī dhi / sngi ༷ smo bye s+t+ri bhi/༵ rto —307—

bgegs mthar byed nag po la/ laXyig las byung ba'i rengs byed ma ser mos 'phyud pa/ shar sgor pad zla'i steng du 'khod pa gyur/ raX yig las byung ba'i dbyug pa dmar po yongs su gyur pa las shes rab mthar byed dmar po la/waXyig las byung ba'i khengs byed ma dkar mo 'byud pa/ lho sgor pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ waX yig la byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po yongs su gyur pa la pad+ma mthar byed dkar po la/ raXyig las byung ba'i rmugs byed ma dmar mos 'byud pa/ byang sgor pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ laX yig las byung ba'i tho ba ser po yongs su gyur pa las gshin rje mthar byed ser po la/ yaXyig las byung ba'i shin tu brtson 'grus ma nag mos 'phyud pa/ nub sgor pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ khro bo khro mo brgyad po de rnams zhal re re la spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / dbu skra dmar ser gyen tu brdzes pa/ rab tu khros shing 'jigs su rung ba/ klu'i dbang po dang phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ shar dang byang gi sgor pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / lho dang nub kyi sgor pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la khro bo rnams g.yas brkyang dang / khro bo'i lha mo rnams g.yon brkyang gis gnas shing thabs gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /steng gi khro bo ma bskyed kyang mi 'gal lo/ /a yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las phyag na rdo rje ljang khu la sgra rdo rje ma sngon mos 'byud pa/ lho sgo'i g.yon du pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/e yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las nam mkha'i snying po nag po la dri rdo rje ma ser mo'i 'byud pa/ shar sgo'i g.yas su pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ ar yig las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po yongs su gyur pa —308—

las/ sa'i snying po dmar po la/ gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mos 'byud pa/ lho sgo'i g.yas su pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ oṃ yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar po la/ ro rdo rje ma dmar mos 'byud pa/ byang gi g.yas su pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/al yig las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ sgrib pa rnam sel ser po la/ reg bya rdo rje ma nag mos 'phyud pa/ nub kyi g.yas su pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ aX yig las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po yongs su gyur pa las kun tu bzang po sngon po la/ chos khams rdo rje ma ljang khus 'byud pa/shar gyi g.yon du pad nyi'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ thams cad kyang pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje gdan gyis gnas shing thabs gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /ā yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las chos khams rdo rje ma ljang khu la/ kun tu bzang po sngon pos 'byud pa/ nub kyi g.yon du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ i yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po yongs su gyur pa las reg bya rdo rje ma nag mo la/ sgrib pa rnam sel ser pos 'phyud pa/ me mtshams su pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ ur yig las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po yongs su gyur pa las ro rdo rje ma dmar mo la 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar pos 'byud pa/ bden bral du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ au yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po yongs su gyur pa las gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo la/ sa'i snying po dmar pos 'khyud pa/ dbang ldan du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ ul yig las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ dri rdo rje ma ser mo la/ nam mkha'i snying po nag pas 'byud pa/—309—

rlung mtshams su pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ āXyig las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po yongs su gyur pa las/ sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo la/ phyag na rdo rje ljang khus 'byud pa/ byang gi g.yon du pad zla'i steng du 'khod par gyur/ thams cad kyang pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la pad+ma'i gdan gyis gnas shing / shes rab gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /de ltar na de rnams thams cad kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa ste/ don yod grub pa/ sgrol ma/ bgegs mthar byed/ shin tu brtson 'grus ma/ nam mkha'i snying po/ reg bya rdo rje ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog nag po nas/ kha ṭāX ga dkar po 'dzin pa/ rin chen 'gyung ldan/ gos dkar mo/ shes rab mthar byed/ rmugs byed ma/ sa'i snying po/ ro rdo rje ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dmar po nas/ 'od 'phro ba 'dzin pa/ 'od dpag med/ mā ma gī pad+ma mthar byed/ khengs byed ma/ 'jig rten dbang phyugagazugs rdo rje ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal dang / sku mdog dkar po nas/ bgreng 'phreng 'dzin pa/ rnam par snang mdzad/ sangs rgyas spyan ma/ gshin rje mthar byed/ rengs byed ma/ sgrib pa rnams sel/ dri rdo rje ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ser po nas/dril bu 'dzin pa/ phyag na rdo rje dang chos khams rdo rje ma rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu nas/ gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ kun tu bzang po dang / sgra rdo rje ma ni rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po nas/ gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa ca(/ / spro sgru snyu stu rnams sku(ngas su gyur pa las/ṇ+ḍi|'i ji ///blo ga sku1na dang g.yas kyi stegs bu la/ shar ṇa tā du dri ma dang 'phreng ba ma nag mo/lhor bdug spos ma dang snang gsal ma dmar mo/ byang du bdud rtsi ma dang 'bras —310—

bu ma dkar mo/ nub tu sgeg mo dang bzhad ma ser mo/ steng du sgra ma dang gar ma ljang gu/ 'og tu 'dod ma dang glu ma sngon mo ste/ thams cad kyang rang gi ming dang mthun pa'i mchod rdzas thogs shing / gzungs ma grangs med pa dang bcas pa'o/ /de ltar ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes 'khor dang bcas par gyur/ oX su bi shudha dharma dha tu swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ /gnyis pa snying rje'i dbang bskur ba ni/ thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa dag gis/ 'gro ba drug na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad bkug nas dkyil 'khor chen por bcug par gyur/ de nas phyogs bcu de bzhin gshegs pa yum dang bcas pa thams cad bkug nas rang gi snying gar rab tu zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par zhu bar gyur pa rnams gsang ba'i rdo rje las spros nas sems can thams cad la dbang bskur bar gyur/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer rnams kyis reg pa'i sems can de rnams mchog gi dga' ba dang bde bas gang ba'i lha'i sku thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid zhal dang sku mdog la sogs pa sna tshogs pa dang ldan pa dang / de dag re re zhing yang skad cig gis lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gyur/ k+ṣa khyi gh+ri khri sko las phung po lnga rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas lnga dang / khri gh+ri klu khri sko las ༄khams lnga rnam par dag pa yum lnga dang / k+ṣa spu k+ṣar khyo 'al k+ṣaX rwa las dbang po drug rnam par dag pa sems dpa' drug dang / nywa spu nywar khyo 'il k+ṣaXlas yul drug rnam par dag pa sems ma drug dang / lgi snyi spri lgi —311—

spo las las kyi dbang po lnga rnam par dag pa khro bo lnga dang / spyi spu spri kwa snya las las kyi dbang po'i yul lnga rnam par dag pa khro mo lnga ste/ sbra sgyu 'o sgyumatshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par gyur te slar yang de rnams rang rang gi zhing du gshegs su gsol/gnyis pa gsung rdzogs pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag las rgyal mchog ni/ lte ba dang gtsug tor gyi a wa dh+wa ti'i lam du hoXyig dag dang / dpral ba dang mgrin pa dang snying ga rnams su sne gsung thugs kyi rdo rje oṃ āXhuX rnams las byung ba'i zla ba dang nyi ma dang sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor rnams 'khod par gyur/ hoXyig dus kyi me'i 'od zer gyis steng dang 'og nas sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams bzhus te/ gtum mo shes rab kyi chags pas yab yum gnyis zla ba zhu ba ltar gyur/ spyan ma bdag ni 'gro ba'i yum/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rgyu mthun gnas//bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /mā ma gī bdag sring mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rnam smin gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /gos dkar mo bdag bu mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi skyes bu'i gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /sgrol ma bdag ni tsha mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dri bral gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /stong pa'i dkyil 'khor nyams myong nas/ /'gro ba bsgral ba'i bsam pa yi sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil snyen ra ni/ /'gro ba'i mgon pos spro bar mdzod/ /ces pa glu rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das stong pa nyid la rab tu zhugs pa 'gro ba'i —312—

don mdzad pa'i slad du bskul ba las/ bcom ldan 'das rab tu sad de 'gro ba mtha' dag sgyu ma lta bur gzigs nas gzhan gyi don du slar yang bskyed par mdzad pa ni/ huX las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / de las byung ba'i dus kyi ge bor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ rdo rje'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan zhing mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i ngo bo sna tshogs yum gyis 'phyud pa'i skur gyur pa dang / 'dam ma brgyad la nus ma brgyad/ phyi rol kyi grwa bzhi la rdo rje bzhi dang bcas pa rnams skad cig gis bzhengs par gyur pa ni/ zla ba'i sku dang zung gi zhabs te me yi mgrin pa chu gter dpal ldan zhal ni sna tshogs mdog /phrag pa drug dang nyi ma'i dpung pa rgyal ba'i phyag gis pad+ma stong pa drug dang me yi tshigs/ /zhabs dag gis ni zla ba nyi ma sreg za'i dkyil 'khor dag la bdud dang drag po skrag bzhin pa/ /rol pas mnan pa'i srid pa mnyam pa dus kyi 'khor lo gcig pu de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje ral gri rtse gsum gri gug mda' dang lcags kyu ḍa ma sa /tho ba 'khor lo mdung dbyug dgra stas g.yas kyi phyag brgyan g.yon pa yang / /dril bu phub dang kha ṭāX thod pa gzhu dang zhags pa rin po che/ /pad dkar dung dang me long lcags sgrog tshangs mgos brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stag lpags dang ni rdo rje'i rgyan ldan rdo rje'i sku can bde ba che/ /'od gsal stong nyid sna tshogs yum gyis kun nas rab 'phyud gser mdog ma/ /zhal bzhi phyag brgyad gri gug lcags kyu ḍa ma ru dang bgrang 'phreng dang / /thod pa zhags pa pad+ma dkar dang rin chen 'dzin mar bcas la 'dud/ /nag mo 'bar ma bdug spos tsan dan gur gum dang ni ga bur snod/ /dril bu pad+ma yongs 'du'i me tog sna tshogs me tog 'phreng ldan ma/ /dmar mo'i —313—

g.yas na mar me do shal cod pan dang ni gdu bu ste/ /g.yon na gos dang ska rags dang ni rin chen rna rgyan rkang gdub 'dzin/ /dkar mo'i g.yas na 'o ma chu dang sman mchog chang gi snod rnams te/ /g.yon na bdud rtsi'i grub pa'i bcud dang bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu 'bras yon snod/ /ser mo 'bar ma dung dang gling bu nor bu dang ni ḍa ma sa /pi wang rnga dang mkhar rnga zangs dung rang phyogs gtso bo'i zhal ldan ma/ /de dag dang mtshungs du ba smig sgyu me khyer dang ni mar me ma/ /rang mdog dang mtshungs rnga yab brgyad ldan phyag rgya lnga yis rnam brgyan ma//rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan dang ldan rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma/ /mnyam pa'i stabs can pha rol phyin rdzogs srog gi dkyil 'khor 'gag pa 'dud/ /tshad med rnam thar rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dbang dang bsnyen sgrub dga' ba bzhi/ /lus ngag sems dang chags pa'i thig le gnas skabs rnam bzhi rnam dag pa//skad cig mkhyen pa sku dang rdo rje byang chub rnam bzhi sems dpa' bzhi/ /chos kyi dung dang gaṇ+ḍi nor bu dpag bsam shing la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang na de rnams sngon bzhin bskyed kyang chog go /yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa rnams dang / dkyil 'khor pa rnams dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gyi don du rang gi lus la rab tu bcug nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par zhu bar gyur pa rnams rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra spros te/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las lha dang lha mo'i tshogs su gyur pa ni/ aX yig las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po nas/ gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa la/ rang dang 'dra ba'i sher —314—

phyin mas 'byud pa nam mkhar spros nas sems can gyi don byas te/ slar yang rang nyid la bdag por bzhugs par gyur/ i yī las byung ba'i ral gri nag po dag dang / ṛ grwa las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po dag dang / u snyu las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po dag dang / mṛ lī las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po dag dang /hi hi ljoshā hu hu hṝ rmyo haX haXrnams so/ /haX haXlas byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu dang sngon po dag dang / yaX yig las byung ba'i ral gri nag po dag dang / raX yig las byung ba'i dbyug pa dmar po dag dang / waX yig las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po dag dang / laX yig las byung ba'i tho ba ser po dag dang / a aX las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu dang sngon po dag dang / e e las byung ba'i ral gri nag po dag dang /a ur las byung ba'i rin po che dmar po dag dang / o au las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po dag dang / al ul las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po dag dang / aX ā las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu dang sngon po dag dang / rnya ji hri snyu stu rnams te/ de rnams so sor yongs su gyur pa gha r+ghaṃ 1ghā rwa las/ khu khrag rkang dang khrag gi tshogs can dri 'a zaka pyu chu dri chen rab 'gags pas/ /'chi med rab ster 'chi med rgyun gyis mngon par gang ba'i thod pa'am/ /zla ba'i rang bzhin zla ba'i 'od ltar rab tu dkar ba'i bum pa ni/ /bdud kyi tshogs 'joms bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyis shin tu gang ba rnams la 'dud/ /'du byed rlung dang ngag gi dbang po sna dang reg gzhan 'dus ma byas/ /don yod sgrol ma bgegs kyi dgra dang nam mkha'i snying po reg bya ma/ /ral gri gri gug rtse gsum phub dang dpal ldan thod pa kha ṭāX ga /nyi zla'i gdong ldan sprin nag dang mtshungs sa yi rigs kyis 'byud la 'dud/ /—315—

tshong ba me dang lag pa'i dbang po mig dang ro gzhan bde ba che/ /rin chen dbang po gos dkar mo dang rmugs byed sa yi snying po ro/ /mda' dang lcags kyu ḍa ma ru dang gzhu dang zhags pa nor bu'i phyag /dkar nag gdong ldan nyin mor byed 'dra chu yi rigs kyis 'khyud la 'dud/ /'du shes chu dang rkang pa'i dbang po lce dang gzugs gzhan ye shes sku/ /snang ba mtha' yas mā ma gī dang khengs byed 'jig rten dbang po gzugs/ /tho ba mdung dang rtse gsum pad dkar me long dang ni bgrang 'phreng can/ /nag dang dmar ba'i gdong ldan dkar po me yi rigs kyis 'phyud la 'dud/ /gzugs kyi phung po sa dang bshang lam lus dang dri gzhan 'od gsal gzugs/ /rtag pa spyan ma rengs byed dang ni rnam sel dri yi rdo rje ma/ /snyen ra lo dbyug pa khro bo'i rdo rje dung dang lcags sgrog dril bu'i phyag /dkar nag gdong ldan gser gyi ri 'dra rlung gi rigs kyis 'khyud la 'dud/ /rna ba chos khams yid dang sgra g.yin gsang ba'i dbang po dri chu gzhan/ /phyag rdor chos khams kun bzang sgra ma gtsug tor shin tu sngon mo sbyor/ /nyi zla'i zhal ldan ljang dang sngo ba rdo rje gri gug dgra sta dang / /dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i gdong ldan stong pa'i rigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab dkar chu skyes mdangs bkra'i ze'u 'brur 'od stong bdag po'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rdo rje'i gdan dang g.yas brkyang stabs bzhugs rgyal dang rgyal sras khro rgyal dang / /'dam skyes dmar po'i ge sar snying por ri bor 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs rigs ma rnams dang rdo rje ma rnams la phyag 'tshal/ /de ltar lha yi 'khor lo legs mchod dri dang 'phreng ba bdug spos ma/ /snang gsal bdud rtsi 'bras bu ma dang sgeg mo bzhad ma sil snyan ma/ /gar dang glu yi sbyor ba la brtson 'dod —316—

ma 'dod la rab dga' ma/ /rgyan dang cha byad rnam 'gyur du mas yid rab 'dzin ma rnams bstod do/ /de ltar bsgom pa'i phung po khams sogs gzhan/ /bde gshegs snying po de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings/ /glo bur dri ma'i sbub las nges grol te/ /srid gsum dang ba mngon du byed gyur cig /'dir yang steng gi khro bo mi bskyed na/rna ba chos khams sogs bstod chen gyi dkyus ltar bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid kyi thugs kar huX yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang / de las byung ba'i rdo rje shugs zhal bzhi pa 'jigs pa'i sku can rab tu bzhad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ sgra drag po sgrog pa/ spyan bcu gnyis pa/ phyag nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ shes rab dang thabs las byung ba/ gtso bo bzhin du mtshon cha rnams dang bcas pa/ glang po che'i pags pa'i gos can/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ thod pa lnga dang / mgo bo'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/sprul gyis brgyan pa/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i shing rta la gnas pa nam mkha'i khams su spros te/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi lte bar rdo rje lcags kyus btab cing /phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams rdo rje zhags pas bcings nas/ mtshon cha lhag ma rnams kyis sdigs par gyur/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā ra dzaX khro bo'i dbang po slar yang rang nyid la zhugs par gyur/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā re khyuXbadz+ra gan+dhaX pra ru na maX badz+ra pusaX/ badz+ra dhu paX/ badz+ra dī paX/ badz+ra nai we tuX/ badz+ra ak+ṣa taX/ badz+ra lā suX/ badz+ra ha suX/ badz+ra wa tuX/ badz+ra hṝ tuX/ badz+ra gī tāX/ badz+ra kā maX pra ru na maX huX baX hoXtī/ lha rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX snying gar hūX/ lte bar hoX gsang bar snya/ gtsug tor du hā rnams 'khod par gyur/dpral bar āXlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo dkar —317—

po rtsibs brgyad pa yongs su gyur pa las sku rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas zhal nag cing g.yon zhal dmar ba/phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum gyis ral gri/ dril bu/ nor bu 'dzin cing / rang dang 'dra ba'i yum dang bcas pa dang /mgrin par ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la āXlas byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dam ma brgyad pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gsung rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dmar po g.yas zhal dkar zhing / g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis pad+ma/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa gsum gyis nor bu/ dril bu/ ral gri 'dzin cing / rang dang 'dra ba'i yum dang bcas pa dang / snying gar aX las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la huX las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po yongs su gyur pa las thugs rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog nag po g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ g.yon pa gsum gyis dril bu/ ral gri/nor bu 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum dang bcas pa rnams 'khod pa las rab tu spros te/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rjes 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la chos bstan nas slar yang mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ sku'i rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku rdo rje dang / gsung rdo rje dang / thugs rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pa'i bdag nyid la dbang bskur bar gyur/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sku rdo rje —318—

dang / mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gsung rdo rje dang / snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil snyen ra la thugs rdo rje rnams 'khod par gyur/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzode/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mi phyed rdo rje: /sku yi rdo rje: /byin rlabs gnas: /dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed rdo rje: /gsung rdo rje: /byin glos gnas: /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mi phyed rdo rje: /gsung gi rdo rje: /byin rlabs gnas: /dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed rdo rje: /thugs kyi rdo rje /byin rlabs gnas su: /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams//mi phyed rdo rje: /thugs kyi rdo rje: /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /ces gsol ba btab pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ma rnams kyis bdag la byin gyis brlabs shing / rdo rje gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya nywa ka tsit+ta sā bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ shes rab kyi lte bar hoXlas sku rdo rje/ gsang bar snya las gsung rdo rje/ gtsug tor du hā las thugs rdo rje rnams 'khorwa da par gyur/ de ltar dbang bskur bas dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te rgyas btab par gyur pa ni/ rnam par snang mdzad la mi bskyod pa dang / snang ba mtha' yas la rnam par snang mdzad dang / rin chen 'byung ldan la 'od dpag med dang /don yod grub pa la rin chen dbang pos rgyas btab par gyur pa'i dag pa'i phung po chos gos dang gtsug tor 'dzin pa'o/ /de bzhin du ljang khu rnams la mi bskyod pa dang / nag po rnams la don yod grub pa dang / dmar po rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan dang / dkar po rnams la snang ba mtha' yas dang / ser po —319—

bto /kau ༵ ༵ sna rnyi glu ga / ༵/ tor/ / /༵ ༵dho~X rdo~X ༵ tshor ༵ ༵ ༵ ga mi bskyod pa dang / snying khar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'bor la i yig don yod grub pa dang / mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ṛ yig rin chen 'byung ldan dang /pye~X 'id sbyi ༵༵ rnar ༵ ṭā ༵ dhi dhi tshi tri dī dzad dang sa/ /༵nga/ ba sna ༵ shes kyi dkyil 'khore la a yig rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab/ lha rnams kyi lte ba snying ga mgrin pa dpral ba gtsug tor rnams su sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i dkyil 'khore rnams la '-i u ṛ i a'o/ /lha rnams kyi dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga lte ba rnams su/ zla ba'i nyi ma sgra gcan dus me'i dkyil 'khore rnams la oṃ u shu ho'o/ rdo rje nor bur gzhom du med pa'i a yig go /gsum pa sgrub pa'i yan lag thig le'i rnal 'bye tshor ni/ yab yum snyer mas par zhugs pa las lte ba'i ho yig glog dang mtshungs pa'i gtum mo ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bar gyur pas/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa lnga'i rang bzhin g.yon gyi dkyil phyu~X wor kha ༵dī lnga'i ༵ /rnams bsre gas shi nga /pa~X ga~X ༵/༵ rlo snab sngi po rnams kyang gzugs la sogs pa'i yul rnams la 'ju ga pa bsregs nas/sni sngu / sdig/ rnyi ḍi las glog zer sleb pa~X hā ༵sna le snore dag 'a rgyu/ rnyi dī~X ༵ sdo ༵sdo dzhai dag 'a 1 ༵/ /zhe bha tsho ༵༵ ༵ko ༵ḍi/ skyes pa'i dga' ba mngon du byas/ oṃ dzñā na pū dza a nu ra lto —320—

bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag phra mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ slar yang ji ltar byon pa bzhin du steng du gde/gas pas/ lte bar rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu'i lhan cig skyes pa'i sku dang / snying gar rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu chos kyi sku dang /mgrin par skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / dpral bar dri ma dang bral ba'i 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku mngon du byas/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti badz+ra sa tā haX du rdo n+ta da ma ka huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaX pra titsā na maX sogs kyis mchod/ stong nyid snying rje sogs glo ka gnyis kyis gong bzhin bstod/de nas lha sku la sems 'dzin pa'am bzlas pa bya'o / /de yang da ltar lag len la snying po gtso bor bzla bar snang zhing / rtsa sngags kyang ci rigs par bzla'o/ /kyi dus 'khor loshes rab ma dar bcas pa'i sngags snyaX( 6 swāhā/ zhes pa bye ba bzlas pas bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /yang na tseX( aXhuX hor+shaXhaX k+ṣaX zhes pa'am/ tseX( āXhūX ho doX6 swāhā/ zhes pa'am/ tseX( hāX khyo hṝ hū ཾ ༷ rte/ hāXswāhā/ zhes pa rnams gang yang rung ba zhig bye bar bzlas pas kyang bsnyen pa'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba la mchod pa dang bstod pa dang / nyer bsdu gsum las/ dang po ni/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la mchod pa rgyas pa ma lcogs na/ bzlas pa'i mthar oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaX pra ca na maXsogs mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis bzhi mchod par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mchog spyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /sogs 'dud nyer gcig gis bstod/ spro na gang la thog mtha' dbus med sogs kyis kyang bstod/ gsum pa ni/ gtsug tor du rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo dang / snying gar rdo rje rtse mo dgu pa 'i lte bar nus ma rnams dang / dpral bar rdo rje rtse mo bcu bdun pa'i lte bar phung po dang khams bzhi'i lha dang / mgrin par rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lte bar skye —321—

mched bcu gnyis khro bo bzhi dang bcas pa lus dang bsam pas rab tu dbye ba rnams gshe/gas su gsol/de nas spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug na/ smon lam gdab cing bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa yang brjod nas/ thun mtshams la 'jug go/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na yang / gtor ma bshams/ oṃ phre badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ badz+ra dha tī shwa rī/ ga ga na swa bhā wa sarba dra bya bi shwa dha ni/ sarba dra bya ṇi bi shwa dha ya hūX phre phaṭa/ ces pa dang / o āXhuX hraXphaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlud gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX rmes me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar ba'i mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i oṃ yongs su gyur pa las thod pa dum bu gcig pa/ de'i nang gi dbus su a las byang sems/ shar du i las rkang mar/lhor ṛ las rak+ta/ byang du mū las dri chu/ nub tu li las dri chen/ rlud mtshams su lī las glang po che'i sha dbang ldan du mū las ba glang gi sha bden bral du grwa las rta'i sha me mtshams su yī las khyi'i sha dbus kyi steng du ā las mi'i sharlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ sku rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od zer gyis ma dag pa'i rdzas rnams sbyangs par gyur/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sogs gong bzhi/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du nyi ma la gnas pa'i āXgasung rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od zer gyis dag pa'i rdzas rnams spel bar gyur/ oṃ āXbadz+ra snyu rla sogs/ lag pa gnyis ka sbyar ba'i dbus su sgra gcan gyi dkyil snyen ra la gnas pa'i huX thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od kyis rdzas rnams kha dog dri ro nus mthu gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa 'bar bar —322—

gyur/ oṃ huX badz+ra a na la sogs/ mkha' lding gi phyag rgya'i dbus su dus me la gnas pa'i hoXyig ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo/ de'i 'od zer gyis zag med ye shes mchog gi bdud rtsir byas par gyur/ oṃ hoXsarba dharma badz+ra a spru ta sogs gong bzhin brjod pa ni gtor ma byin gyis bas pa'o/ /de nas mgron spyan drang ba ni/ sangs rgyas yab yum bcas pa sras bcas g.yog 'khor dang / /grogs bcas gnyen rnams dag gis bskor ba'i tshogs pa ni/ /lha dang lha mo dag gis mnyes par byed rnams dang / /mchog gi rdo rje sems dpa' dag ni gshegs su gsol/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ ha hā hi hwa badz+ra bhe ra wa/ ā kwa r+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ ban+ta ya/ ban+ta ya/ to ṣa ya/ to ṣa ya/ dzaXhūX baX hoX badz+ra ḍā ki nī hri da yaX huX huX phre phre phaṭa/ ces pas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyang spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra gan+taX nas/kā maX gyi bar brjod/ oX āXhuX hoX shrī kā la tsakra badz+ra bhe ra wa dhi ska rā ya/ sa pā ri wa re khyuX i daX/ ba lī/ gan+taX/ pulgaX dha paX/ dī paX/ ak+ṣa taX/ da dwa ma he/ te tsa ā ga kyi/ sa pa ri wa ra/ shī gh+raX/ i daX be+e li/ groṇ+ḍa skye/ ji dan tu/ pi ban+tu/ dzaXhuX baX hoX saXrta stuX sarba satwa nāX/ shwan+taX/ dzan/ rak+ṣa/ a ba ra ṇa/ gu sti/ kuṇ+ḍa skye huX hūX phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra udzñā pa ya ti swāhā/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ āXhuX hoX u zhi lga nga ni nga/ rna an+ta ka nī la dwaṇ+ḍa/ pradzñā an+ta ka ṭak+ki rā dza/ pad+ma an+ta ka a tsa la/ ya ma an+ta ka/ mahā ba le khyuX gri gug gi phyag rgya dang / skye( āXhūX hoX ā kā sha ba yu/ te dza/ u da ka pri thi snyi/ sā dhi khyuX ral gri'i phyag rgya dang / oX āXhūX hoXprad+ma/ biṣ+ṭa/ nai ri tu/ ba yu/ ya ma/ asni/ sa mu dra/ yī shwa ra/ in+t+ra/ yak+ṣi khyuXrin po tsho phyag rgya dang / oṃ āXhuX hoX ra hu kā la asni/ tsan+d+ra/ srur+ya/ bu dha/ maX ga —323—

la/ shu kra pri ha spa ti/ ke tu/ sha ni khyuX pad+ma'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āXhuX hoX dza ya/bi dza ya/ pad+ma karko ṭa ka wā su ki shaX kha pā la/ ku li ka a nan+ta/ tak+ṣa ka mahā pad+me khyuX 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ āXhuX hoX be ta ḍa/ bi kri ta mu kha/ shā/ kā kasnyu ka ra/ gro dha/ byā gh+ra/ mū lu ka dzaX bu ka ga ru ḍa/ mu khe khyuX zhes pa rnams kyi mthar/ sa pa ri wā re khyoX i daX bā li/ gan+dhaX/ pulgaX dh+wa paX/ dī paX/ ak+ṣa taX/ da dwa ma he/ te dza ā ga tu/ sa pa ri wā raX shī gh+raX/ i doX bā li/ gros skye/ 'a dan+tu/ bi wan+tu/ dzaXhūX baX hoX saX tri dzñāX sarba sa tā nāX/ shin+taX/ puk+ṣi rak+ṣa/ ā ba ra ṇa gu lha/kuṇ+ḍaskyi huX hūX phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra udzñā pa ya tī swāhā/ phyi ma rdzo ni/ badz+ra lhi ra wa sgyi skra rā ya/ sa pa ri wā re khyuX badz+ra gan+dhaX pra titsā na maX badz+ra put+paX pra zi na maX badz+ra dhu paX pra titsā na maX badz+ra dī paX pra tisnro na maX badz+ra nai bi t+yaX pra stusmo na maX badz+ra ak+ṣa taX pra titsā na maX badz+ra lā suX pra tismo na maX badz+ra hā phyaX pra titsā na maX badz+ra wā tuX pra ru na maX badz+ra snu tuX pra tismo na maX badz+ra gī taX pra tismo na maX badz+ra kā maX pra tismo na maXnang mchod ni/ oṃ badz+ra ste ra wa/ ha ya ra wa la/ nga nya ṇa ma na/ gha dzha lha bha dha/ ga dza ḍa ba da/ kha tsha ṭha pha tha/ ka tsa ṭa pa ta/ oṃ āXshuX/ bston pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par mdzad/ /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po/ /dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /rje bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyi gtso/ /dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs he ru ka /rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde drug srung ma drug cu 'khor bcas la/ mchod gtor 'di dang dri dang me tog dang / /bdug spos snang gsal ma nyams bdag 'bul gyi/ /de rnams 'khor dang bcas pa tshur byon la/ /gtor ma 'di dag len zhing gsol ba dang / /btung bar mdzad de shin tu mnyes pa yis/ /'gro la —324—

zhi rgyas bsrung skyob sba ba rnams/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhin mdzad du gsol/ /bar 'dir chos skyong ye shes pa rnams la so so'i gtor chog ltar gtor ma 'bul oṃ āXcwaXspe/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī khyuX sa pa ri wā re khyuX i daX bā li/ gan+dhaX/ put+paX/ dh+wa paX/ pra dī paX sogs/ yul bdag gi gtor sngags dang 'dra ba la 'don pa spos pas/ rdo rje mkhe'i 'gro ma rnams la gtor ma 'bul/ yul bdag grong bdag la yang gong bzhin gtor ma 'bul ba las/a pa ra shrī naX ca zhes pa'i dod du/ swas+thā ga tsā ga smo swāhā/ zhes bsgyur ba ni khyad par ro/ /oṃ badz+ra gan+taX pra ca na maX sogs ma sgo pa ༅ gnyis phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /sogs kyisa'aphrin las gzhol/ steng na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bdud kyi phyogs gnas lha ma yin rnams mchog tu 'jigs byed dang / /mi yi 'jig rten dag na phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas khro bo'i rgyal po btsun mor bcas rnams dang / /sa 'og dag na gdengs can dbang po gang dag gdon tshogs mi dge dus kun du ni 'ching byed pa/ /de rnams thams cad nyin zhag so so'i dus su mi shes 'jig rten kun nas skyong bar byed gyur cig /ces shis pa brjod/ yig brgya'i mthar bzod gsol gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang 'dra ba las/ ye shes kyi 'bor lo rang nyid la thim/gsang bar haX yig la khro bo'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ gtsug tor du aX yig la zad par gyi 'khor lo dang / dpral bar ṛ yig la phyogs skyong gi—'khor lo dang / mgrin par ṛ yig la gza'i 'khor lo dang / /snying gar u yig la klu'i 'khor lo dang / ste bar kla yig la 'byung po'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams du ba la sogs lam gyis lhan skyes bde ba mchog bsgoms te/ /'gro ba'i bla ma sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan ldan —325—

sku ni chos kyi 'khor lor yang dag gnas/ /lha rnams mgo yi gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od zer tshogs kyis zhabs kyi pad+ma la gtso/sa shing / /dam pa'i lam ston nyin byed bzhin du mun pa kun 'joms dus kyi 'khor lo nyid gyur cig /nyi ma dang bcas thub pa'i rigs rnams kyis ni shes rab ye shes thob par gyur 'di ji lta bar/ /rnam gsum srid par gnas pa'i sems can rnams ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i drin las e waX nyid gyur cig /skyes bu gang dag bdud kyi grogs kyis rtag tu mi bden mun par song zhing lam nyams pa/ /de rnams lam 'di thob nas rdo rje nor bu'i khyim dang ring ba min par 'ong gyur cig /dgra dang seng ge glang chen dbang po me dang ltos 'gro'i bdag dang chom rkun zhags pas 'ching / /chu gter 'khrugs dang sha za 'chi ba'i 'jigs byed nad dang dbang po'i nye bar 'tshe ba dang / /dbul dang bud med dang bral mi bdag 'khrugs pa'i 'jigs dang rdo rje ltung dang don nyams rnams/ /bdag gis rnal 'byor ma rnams zhabs ni gsal bar dran pa'i mthu las rab tu nyams gyur cig /de nas/dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sogs dang / rigs su skye dang dam tshig can/ /sogs dang / lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /sogs dang / sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /ces sogs smon lam ji ltar rigs pa gdab par bya'o/ /kha zas kyi rnal 'byor la sogs pa rnal 'byor gzhan rnams kyang nyams len gyi skabs su ma chad pa gal che'o/ /'dir smras pa/rdo rje rnam bzhi'i yid bzhin nor/ /rnal 'byor bzhi yi thabs mkhas kyis/ /dri ma rnams bzhi sbyangs pa las/ /sku bzhi'i 'od zer spro ba'i thabs/ /mngon sum ye shes lam byed dang //rjes dpag mos pa'i lam byed gnyis/ /rgyal bas rgyud sde mtha' dag las/ /gsal ba gsungs la nges brnyes nas/ /snying por gyur pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus min 'di/ /gsal bar bris las dge ba —326—

thob shog /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs ye shes 'od 'phro zhes bya ba 'di yang / rgyud sde'i mthar thug 'di la mos shing / bskyed rim gtso bor byed pa rnams la shin tu mkho bar mthong zhing / don gnyer du mas bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas/ nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su sbyar ba'o// //zhus dag bkra shis/

༄༅/ /dpal sdom pa chen po'i sgrub dkyil gyi rim pa'i khyad par gsal byed bzhugs/na mo gu ru ba dha bo dhi sa te sbyo na mo na maX thig le wo po yig drug dang / /stong pa chen po yi ge lnga/ /zung 'jug de la phyag 'tshal nas/ khres rab rgyud kyi sgrub thabs bshad/ /'di dpal dus kyi 'khor lo chos kyi dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs dang /dpal sdom pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs gnyis spyi khyab mtshungs pa las/ sdom chen la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams bshad par bya'o/ /de la bsrung 'khor rgyas par na/ sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin bya ba dang / /rgyun gyi nyams len la bsrung 'khor bsdus pa sogs skabs su gang bab byed pa yin mod kyang chog sgrigs sogs kyi skabs su/ thugs dkyil gyi sgrub thabs su zugad pa ltar khro rgyal rdo rje shugs khro bo bcu dang bcas pa tsam bsgom pa skabs su bab par shes par bya'o/ /de ltar blo la ba theg ste/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams/ sngon 'gro rnam pa bcu dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bskyed pa yan chad thugs dkyil gyi sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin du bya la/ zhes gsungs te/ 'di la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi bya ba gsum las/ dang po la/ rgyud sbyong ba thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang / nges par bya ba thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag nyid sgrub thabs nyams len gyi skabs su nges par dgos pa la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas gsum mo/ /de yang / bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs —328—

pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan rnams la skyabs su mchi'o//dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas ga pa chas dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis spyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /oṃ su bhā wa shudha sarba dharma su bhā wa shuzlo3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi spyi bor paX las pad+ma dang /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūX las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ lte ba la hūX gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchob/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus huX la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i brgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang pad+ma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āXthugs kar huX/ lte bar hoX thugs ka'i huX las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams —329—

cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dza / ba ho gnyis su med par thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa mā ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka te no pa nga khru rnyo me bha wa/ su to stso me bha wa/ a nu ra sto me bha wa/ su po stso me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi sme pra ca sarba karma su tsa me tsit+ta shri ya ku ru hū/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka mā me muts+tsha he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa a hu phaṭa/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum zla ba zhu ba ltar gyur pa/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas thim pas rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje dang / rang gi lus ngag yid gsum ye shes rdo rje rnams dbyer med du gyur/gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro rnam pa cu ni/ rdo rje zhal dag rigs drug dgod pa dang / rdo rje bzhi dang yan lag drug rnams 'god/ /bdud tshogs gzhom zhing bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom/ /mkha' la rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams rtogs byas te/ /bla med mchod pa rnam pa bdun gyis mchod/ /lam bsten stong pa nyid la dmigs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ oṃ u shu ho ha k+ṣa pradzñā u pa —330—

ya/ ut+pa ka kā ya lha ka tsit+ta dzñā na a dhi pa ti/ ma ma kā ya nywa ka tsit+ta dzñā na badz+raX/badz+ra amri ta su bhā waX/ ku ru ku ru skan+ta dh+wa tu ā ya ta naX niXswa bhā waX swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ de nas gtsug tor gyi steng du waX yig yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha bcu drug pa yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de zhu ba lus la zhugs pas gtsug tor nas rkang sen gyi mthar thug pa'i ma dag pa'i lus sprul gyi shun pa ltar lan gsum du dor te/ lus dang ngag dang sems dang ye shes rnam par dag pa rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zla ba dri ma med pa ltar gyur/gnyis pa rigs drug 'god pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+ngha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shurnyo3haX/dpral bar oX dkar po las snang ba mtha' yas rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas zhal nag cing g.yon zhal dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis tho ba/ mdung rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gsum gyis 'dab ma brgyad pa'i pad+ma dkar po me long bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ mgrin par āXdamar po las rin chen 'byung ldan rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog dmar po g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis me'i mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma sa g.yon pa gsum gyis gzhu zhags pa rin po che rtse mo dgu pa 'od 'phro ba 'dzin pa/ snying gar huX nag po las don yod grub pa rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog nag po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dmar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis ral gri gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gsum gyis phub thod pa kha ṭāX ga dkar po 'dzin pa/ lte bar hoXser po las rnam par snang mdzad rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ser po/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing g.yon zhal nag pa/—331—

phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis 'khor lo dbyug pa/ khro bo'i rdo rje/ g.yon pa gsum gyis dung rdo rje lcags sgrog sgra dang cas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ gtsug tor du haX ljang khu las mi bskyod pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje gri gugadagra sta/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ gsang bar k+ṣa sngon po las rdo rje sems dpa' rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu thod pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang so sor dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnam pa rnams 'khod par gyur/gsum pa rdo rje bzhi dag pa ni/ lag pa phan tshun mnye zhing dkrug pa'i phyag rgya byas nas/oṃ hraXsarba no rā dza/ mā ra kle sha an+ta ka ra/ badz+ra zu duXtshe da ma ma ka raX bi sho dha ya swāhā/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung la sogs pa rtsa ba'i tshigs rnams su a i ṛ u '-i/ dbus kyi tshigs rnams su/ a e ar o al/ steng gi tshigs rnams su ha ya ra wa la/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong la sogs pa'i steng gi tshigs rnams su lwa wā rā yā hā/ dbus kyi tshigs rnams su/ ul au ur i ā/ rtsa ba'i tshigs rnams su/ lī mū rī yī ā/ lag pa gnyis ka sbyar ba'i dbus su hūX gi yi ge mthon mthing / zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi sa bon de dag las grub pa'i lag pa rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bong gtsug tor nas brtsams te lus thams cad la reg cing / oṃ ā huX hoXhaX k+ṣaX kā ya lha ka tsit+ta dzñā na ā dhi —332—

pa ti badz+ra kā ya/ ma ma kā ya lha ka tsit+ta dzñā na badz+raX/ badz+ra kwa ya swa bhā waX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra kwa ya su bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/bzhi pa yan lag drug dgod pa ni/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bong gnyis snying gar reg la/ oṃ hṝ hri da yā ya na ma/ dpral bar reg nas/ oṃ hū ཾ ༷ si ra si swāhā/ gtsug tor du reg nas/oṃ tri shi sku yi bo ṣaṭa/ yan lag rnams la reg ste/ 8 do hrī ka ba tsā ya hūX/ mig gnyis la reg ste/ oṃ hāX ni tra ya wa ṣaṭa/ g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub phyogs bcur brdabs la/ oṃ hraX.a sta ya phaṭa/ nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya si raXrngon ka wa tsa ni tre/ a tra badz+ra/ ṣaṭa aX ga swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/lnga pa bdud tshogs gzhom pa la/ sngon du 'gro ba gtor ma ni/ oṃ āXhūX hraXphaṭa/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sarba dharma su bi shudha su bhā wa sarba dharmya na bi sho dha ya swāhā/ oṃ āXbadz+ra srur+ya sarba dharma pra bo dhe ka sarba dharmya na pra bo dh+wa ya swāhā/ oṃ hūX badz+ra a na la sarba dharma pra dī pa ka sarba dharmya na pra dī pa ya swāhā/ oṃ hoXsarba dharma badz+ra a mṛ ta ka ra sarba dharmya na badz+ra a mra taX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ āXhūX/ yul gyi bdag po sa pa ri wa rā ya/ i daX bā ling / gan+taX/pulgaX dhu paX/ pra dī paX/ ak+ṣa taX/ da da ma he sa pa ri wā ra/ shī gh+raX/ ā ru tu/dzaXhuX baX hoX i daX ba ling griṇ+ḍa skye/ ji da tu/ pi wa tu/ sa pa ri wā ra kaX sarba sa tā naX/ shān+ti/ pa sna/ rak+ṣa/ a wa ra ṇa/ gu lha/ ka ro tu/ i daX sa tā naX/ trak+ta ba hre maṇ+ḍal bhu myuX tiṣ+ṭha tu huX hūX phaṭa/ badz+ra dha ra adzñā pa ya ti swāhā/ khyi'i phyag rgya 4sa la/ oṃ āXhuX grong gi bdag po ā ru ā ca shī gh+raX/ i daX bā ling / gro hā gro hā/ bhak+ta bitwa tristi/ kri twa sarba sa tā naX/ shārnyi/ tsit+taX/ kri twa/ a pa ra sna naX/—333—

ga smo gats+tsha swāhā/ 'di ni sgrub mchod kyi bdag bskyed sogs la dgos kyi/ rgyun gyi nyams len la ni/ sngon 'gro rgyas pa'i skabs kyang 'di bor bas rung la byed pa'i lugs la'ang gang rung re byas na yang legs so/ /gnyis pa dngos ni/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ dkar po las rdo rje rtse mo bcu bdun pa dang / mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ā dmar po las rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa dang / snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la hu nag po las rdo rje rtse mo dgu pa dang / lte bar dus me'i dkyil 'khor la ho ser po las rdo rje rtse mo drug cu rtsa lnga pa dang / gtsug tor du nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la ha ljang khu las rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa dang / gsang bar ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la k+ṣa sngon po las rdo rje rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams su gyur/de bzhi du/ las kyi 'khor lo rnams dang / bya ba'i 'khor lo rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / las kyi dbang po rnams la rdo rjes mtshan par gyur/ de ltar bdag nyid rdo rje'i skur gyur nas/ de nyid las 'phros pa'i rdo rje'i me dpung steng dang 'og tu ljang khu dang sngon po/ shar dang mer nag po/ lho dang bden bral du dmar po/ byang dang dbang ldan du dkar po/ nub dang rlung du ser po 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba'i rdo rje rnams kyis sems can rnams la rnam par 'tshe bar byed pa'i bdud kyi tshogs phyogs bcu na gnas pa mtha' dag nges par bsregs nas bde ba chen po la bkod par gyur/ oṃ ā hū ho ha k+ṣa hru hru grwa hā ra ra ra ra bi rdo ༵ ka dhi/ dho //rdo sna di rdo stog tā rdol/ rdo ༵ lto po/ sna/rdo rnyi je lha /yi pa~Xpa tsa/ —334—

bhasmin ku ru ku ru hū hū phaṭa phaṭa/ ces lan gsum sogs drag tu 'don no/ /drug pa srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ni/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang rwa gur rab tu yangs ba'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ oṃ pa bi shwa badz+ra pad+ma ku ru ku ru swāhā/dbus kyi lte ba'i nang du khru bcu gnyis pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/o ra badz+ra srur+ya badz+ra srur+ya ā sa na ku ru ku ru swāhā/ pad+ma'i lte ba khru bzhi pa'i steng du/ de dang mnyam pa'i nyi ma'i gdan dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hu las bdag nyid khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo dang mtshungs pa las/ sku mdog nag po dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs shing /lhag pa'i phyag gnyis te/ phyag nyi shu rtsa drug dang ldan pa/ yi dwags kyi gdan la gnas pa/ zhal thams cad mche ba gtsigs pa/ rab tu khros shing 'jigs su rung ba can/ spyan dmar po gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ sku la rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/phrag par bdud rigs brgya'i mgo bo'i 'phreng ba 'phyang ba/ spyi bor thod pa lnga'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ /lhag pa'i phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pa nag po dang g.yon pa ser pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas te/ glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa khrag dang bcas pa mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i rkang lag gnyis nas bzung ste gyon zhing /bdud kyi mgo bo dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /klu'i dbang po rgyal ba cod pan la bcings shing / rnam par rgyal ba dar dpyangs la bcings bas gnas pa/ stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma rna rgyan la gnas pa/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong phyag gdub la gnas pa/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan 'og pag dang mgul —335—

rgyan la gnas pa/ 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po zhabs gdub la gnas pa/ de ltar bdag nyid khro bo'i dbang po dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs shing / rab tu 'jigs pa'i sku gyur/ oṃ hūX kro dha i dzñā&haX kro dh+wa nāX udzñā dā ya ka swāhā/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams kyi nang du/ raXyig yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams su gyur/ bdag nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ha ya ra wa la brtsegs pa'i rang bzhin yi ge'i gong bu rnams su gyur/ ha hā las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu dang sngon po dag yongs su gyur pa las gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba mi bskyod pa lta bu dang gnod mdzes rgyal po rdo rje sems dpa' lta bu dag zhal gyi gtso bo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi rna ba dag nas spros te/steng dang 'og tu rtsibs kyi nang du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la gnas pa'o//yi yī las byung ba'i ral gri nag po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ bgegs mthar byed dang dbyug sngon can don yod grub pa lta bu dag g.yon dang po gh+ri sna bug dag nas spros te/ shar dang me'i rtsibs su gnas pa dang / rnge sbrulas byung ba'i rin po che dmar po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ shes rab mthar byed dang ṭak+ki rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu dag g.yon dang g.yas kyi mig dag nas spros te/ lho dang bden bral gyi rtsibs su gnas pa dang / wu lha las byung ba'i pad+ma dkar po dag yongs su gyur pa las/ pad+ma mthar byed dang mi g.yo ba snang ba mtha' yas lta bu dag lce dang chu lam nas spros he/ byang dang dbang ldan gyi rtsibs su gnas pa dang / slo grwa las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po dag yongs su gyur pa las gshin rje mthar byed dang stobs po che rnam par snang mdzad lta bu —336—

dag zugang lam dang gtsug tor nas spros te/ nub dang rlung gi rtsibs su gnas pa ste/ thabs cad kyang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas shing / khro bo'i dbang po lta bu'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rak+ṣa tsakra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ oṃ haX badz+ra kro dha rā dza mahā urdzi ṣa u rje dī shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ yaX badz+ra kro dha rā dza a ti bā la sarba bisnan an+ta ka purba di shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/oṃ raX badz+ra kro dha rā dza dzo bha ka duXne pradzñā an+ta ka dak+ṣi ṇa di shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/oṃ waX badz+ra kro dha rā dza mā na ka bi rā ga pad+ma an+ta ka ut+ta ra di shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oX laX badz+ra kro dha rā dza staX bha ya ma an+ta ka parnyi ma di shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/oX lwa badz+ra kro dha rā dza mahā bā la bā yaX byāX di shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ wāXbadz+ra kro dha rā dza a tsa la i shā na di shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ rāXbadz+ra kro dha rā dza ṭak+ki nai ri t+yāX di shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oX yāXbadz+ra kro dha rā dza nī la daṇ+ḍa ak+ṇi yaX di shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oX hāXbadz+ra kro dha rā dza nga a dho di shi rak+ṣaX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ de dag gis kyang bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams rdo rje lcags kyus btab cing rdo rje zhags pas bcings pa rnams kyi steng du/ rdo rje phur bu rno zhing rab tu 'bar ba/ stod khro bo'i gzugs can rnams kyis btab par gyur/ phur bu bsgril ba'i sngags ni/ tsho ( āXhuX hoXhaX k+ṣaXhūX huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra gī la ka kā ya lha ka tsit+ta dzñā na a dhi pa ti ṣaṭa mu kha/ ṣaṭa bhu dza/ ṣaṭa tsa ra ṇa/ sarba bighān bi nā ya ka ā di du guX naX/ kā ya lha ka tsit+ta dzñā nā ni/ gī la ya gī la ya huX hūX phaṭa/ phur bu 'debs pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ltu badz+ra mud ga ra mā ra ā dī nāX/ si ra si ka rje tri da ye nā bho gu phya/ a rnye badz+ra gī la kā na/ ā ko ṭa ya ā ko ṭa ya/ k+ṣaX khriX k+ṣi ṭī rwa blo khyi khri —337—

tsa sko huX hūX hūX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ rdo rje'i tho bas brdungs te bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bde ba chen por ro gcig pa'i de bzhin nyid rnam par dag par gyur zhing / lhag ma rnams kyang ring du bros par gyur/ badz+ra bhe ra wa dhi sku rā ya sa pā ri wa re khyuX badz+ra rdoX pra ru na maX badz+ra puṣ+ṭhaX pra titsā na maX badz+ra dhu paX pra ca na maX badz+ra dī paX pra ca na maX badz+ra ni wi kyiX pra tīts+tsha na maX badz+ra ak+ṣa taX pra byu na maX badz+ra lā gyaX pra ru na maX badz+ra ha phyaX ca na maX badz+ra wa tuX ca na maXbadz+ra mṛ tuX pra titsā na maX badz+ra gī taX pra ru na maX badz+ra kā maX pra ca na maXgasang bar haX yig la khro bo'i 'khor lo rnams gshegs su gsol/ de yan pha la/rgyun gyi nyams len la bsdus pa kho na dga' bas lha dgu'i skabs su bshad pa ltar byas kyang rung ngo / /bdun pa tshogs kyi zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ bdag nyid skad cig gis dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur gsal ba'i snying gar paX las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar aX yig yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ huX las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang / de las rdo rje nyi ma bzhi du 'od zer kha dog lnga rnams 'phros pas/ bla ma dang de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pas/ nam mkha'i mthil du badz+ra sa mā dzaX 'od zer gyi tshogs rnams rang gi snying ga'i rdo rje la zhugs par gyur/brgyad pa mchod pa rnam pa bdun ni/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la —338—

'dud/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /srid gsum skye 'jig med pa'i dngos/ /shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das/ /pra phab pa yi rang bzhin can/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan ma/ /phyag rgya chen mo de la 'dud/ /oX badz+ra ga rnye gan+dha caX ku ru ku ru swahā/ oṃ badz+ra mā le mā la caX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ga pe si pa caX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pra dī pe pra dī ༄pa ca naX ༄ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ 'a badz+ra a mṛ te ni wi tu pū dzāX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ lkoX zlo badz+ra ak+ṣa te ak+ṣa ta pha la caX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ hū ཾ badz+ra lwa su wasta a bha ra ṇa pū rde ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ha su bhaṇ+ḍa ā dar+sha pū dzāX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra wa bye wa du pū dz+wa ku ru ku ru swāhā/ badz+ra snu bye snu t+ya pū dzāX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ lju badz+ra gī te gi ta pū dzāX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ oṃ spya badz+ra kā me ka sarba brnya bo dhi sa tā nāX kro dha a dī nāX/ badz+ra su ra ta pū / dzāX ku ru ku ru swāhā/ srid 'gro nyams ngar byis pa'i blo yis ni/ /shin 'a tu mi bzad sdig pa gang bgyis pa/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spyan sngar mchis nas ni/ /sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams —339—

dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rnam mang dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag mtha' dag la ni sdig pa rnams bral byang chub spyod la rjes su gnas pas rjes yi rang/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi lus 'bul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing mya ngan mi 'da' yun ring bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do/ /dgu pa lam bsten pa ni/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing / /bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang / /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin spong ba'i/ /rtsa ba gsum dang phar phyin bcu/ /tshad med bsdu dngos bzhi bsten bgyi/ /mi dge bcu dang sgrib pa lnga/ /nyon mongs bzhi dang zag pa bzhi/ /deng nas brtsams te spang bar bgyi/ /bcu pa stong pa nyid la dmigs pa ni/ dngos po med la bsgom pa med/ /sgom pa sgom pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar di ngos po dngos med pas/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /khams gsum po rnam par dpyad na cir yang mi dmigs pa dang /bdag nyid kyi lus kyi chu'i khams kyis me rnam par nyams shing / me med pas sa yang sra ba nyid dor nas lan tshwa bzhin du zhu bar gyur te/ chu la thim zhing / chu yang rlung gis bskams par byas nas rlung gi tshogs rnams nam mkha' la mi snang bar gyur te/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid do//oṃ shā n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ oṃ a ni mit+ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa —340—

dpal sdom pa chen po'i sgrub dkyil gyi rim pa'i khyad par gsal byed bzhugs/ko3snya/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dzñā na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3ha/ oṃ a na dhi ska ra dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3ha/gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la/ sku rdzogs pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gsung rdzogs pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag las rgyal mchog thig le rdzogs pa sgrub pa'i yan lag thig le'i rnal 'byor/ bde ba rdzogs pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro//dang po la/ rten gzhal yas khang sgom pa dang / brten pa lha bsgom pa gnyis las/ dang po gzhal yas khang gsal gdab pa ni/rdo rje'i rang bzhin rtsibs bcu pa zlum po'i dbus su chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams la ya las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po/ dbus su gzhu'i rnam pa rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ra las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po dbus su gru gsum gyi rnam pa bkra shis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ba las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po dbus su zlum po'i rnam pa pad+mas mtshan pa/de'i steng du la las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po dbus su gru gzhi'i rnam pa rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de thams cad kyang steng dang 'og tu hu las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis gnyis dang ldan par gyur/ sa'i steng du ma las ri rab lhun po'o/ /de'i steng du k+ṣa las sna tshogs chu skyes lte bar pad+ma'i sum cha'i tshad dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du ha las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor pad+ma'i nye ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du rnam par bcad pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zla ba dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du thig le las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor mthon mthing nyi ma dang mnyam pa/༵ /༵ ༵ gyur kā nā ༵rī ga je༈ ༵ kā ༵༵ snye snga dī ba dho ༈ ༵ sdi spu —341—

gyur/ lhun po'i steng du hu las byung ba'i rdo rje'i gur rab tu yangs pa'i dbus su rdo rje'i sa gzhi phyogs kyi mdog can gyi gzhi la de nas 'di ltar/ bhu yig yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes rin po che lnga'i rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor chen po zlum po sgo brgyad pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du/ ljang khu dang / nag po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / ser po'i ra ba rim pa lnga lnga dang ldan pa ste/ sgo dang mnyam pa'i sgo khyud dang / sgo 'gram dang / sgo logs te glo 'bur gyi rnam par grub pa'i sgo khang nyid do/ /ra ba'i phyi rol tu stegs bu dkar po 'gram stegs kyi rnam pa can khor yug tu yongs su bskor ba dang / ra ba'i steng du rin po che'i snam bu dmar po kha bad kyi rnam pa can la rin po che du mas mdzes par spras pa dang / de'i steng du thog phubs kyi gdung 'degs pa'i ka thung rnams kyi bar du chu srin ma ka ra'i kha nas 'phyang ba'i do shal dang do shal phyed pa dkar po me long dang rnga yab dang bcas pa/ steng du bya 'dabs las thur du 'phyang ba'i bā ku li dang / steng du mdzes par tshar du dngar ba'i kra ma shir+ṣa dkar po'o/ /sgo khang rnams kyi steng du sgo las sum 'gyur gyi rta babs nor bu gser gyi rang bzhin brtsegs ma gsum dang / sgo logs kyi g.yas dang g.yon gyi stegs bu'i steng du btsugs pa'i ka ba ser po bzhi bzhis btegs pa rnams te/ brtsegs ma re re la'ang gdung dang myos pa srung ba dang / ka thung rnams kyi bar bar du mchod pa'i lha mo'i gnas gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ 'og gzhi kha dog sna tshogs pa shin tu mdzes pa'o/ /de la brtsegs ma dang po'i logs gnyis nas glang po che mnan pa'i seng ge dag dang / brtsegs ma gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i logs gnyis —342—
