nas mchod pa'i lha mo dag gis gdung 'degs bzhin pa dang / steng du har ma mdzes pa bum pa'i tog dang bcas pa/ bum pa'i g.yas dang g.yon du rgyal mtshan dang / snam bu rnams las dril bu dang / me long dang / ba dan dang / rnga yab la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas du ma nye bar dpyangs pa ste/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol sgo'i bar mtshams kyi rtsig pa'i ngos rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje dang / sgo dang sgo khyud kyi phyi'i phugs kyi zur rnams la/ rin po che du mas mdzes par spras pa/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bcu/ drug pa'i nye ba la/zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu 'og gzhi ljang khu'i steng du ye shes kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa/ lte ba'i mu khyud kyi nang mtha' la gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/de'i phyi rol tu 'og gzhi nag po'i steng du sa'i 'khor lo ser po 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa dang / de'i phyi rol tu 'og gzhi dmar po'i steng du chu'i 'khor lo dkar po pad+ma'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa dang / de'i phyi rol 'og gzhi dkar po'i steng du/ me'i 'khor lo dmar po/ rin po che'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa dang / de'i phyi rol 'og gzhi ser po'i steng du/ rlung gi 'khor lo nag po ral gri'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa dang / de'i phyi rol 'og gzhi sngon po'i steng du nam mkha'i 'khor lo ljang khu lte ba'i mu khyud kyi nang mtha' la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa ste/ 'khor lo thams cad kyang rtsibs brgyad brgyad dang ldan pa'o//de'i phyi rol rwa ba'i nang tshon sa'i khor yug ste/ de yang shar dang mer nag po/lho dang bden bral dmar po/ byang dang dbang ldan dkar po/ /nub dang rlung ser —343—

po'o/ /gtso bo'i pad+ma'i 'og gzhi sngon po dang / de nas sa'i khor yug gi nang mtha'i bar gyi 'og gzhi'i kha dog kyang tshon sa dang mtshungs pa/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol mchod pa'i sa gzhi la/ pad+ma dang / bum pa bzang po la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin phung du ma nye bar 'khrigs pa dang / de'i phyi rol tu sa'i khor yug gi steng gi nam mkha' la dbang ldan nas zla ba nya gang ba 'char bzhin pa dang / bden bral du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nub bzhin pa'o/ /de'i yang phyi rol tu chu dang me dang rlung gi khor yug rnams dang / de'i phyi rol tu nam mkha'i khor yug la dbus su rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pas yongs su bskor ba ste/ de ltar dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi rol phyogs kun nas rdo rje me lce ye shes kyi 'od zer mtha' yas pa kun tu 'phro ba'o/ /gtso bo'i gdan sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bdud dang nyon mongs pa'i lha gnyis bskyel ba dang / snying po'i pad+ma'i phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi 'dab ma dang / 'khor lo drug po'i rtsibs bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad dang sgo brgyad dang / mtshams brgyad de/ lha'i gnas bdun cu rtsa gnyis po rnams su/ dbugs bral gyi gdan re re'o/ /me dang rlung gi khor yug gi mtshams la/ shar du mdung gis 'bigs pa/ mer lhag ma can/ lhor ro bsregs pa/ bden bral du drag po'i g.yul/ byang du rus par gyur pa/ dbang ldan du byis pa shi ba/ nub tu rnag gi dri can/ nub byang du sbrul gyis zos pa ste brgyad tshan dang po dang / de dag gi bar bar du dur khrod gzhan brgyad de/ rlung gi g.yas su kang ka le dang / g.yon du ko la ha la/ dbang ldan gyi g.yon du ha ha sgrog pa dang / g.yas su drag tu rgod pa/ bden bral gyi g.yon du drag po'i sgra —344—

can dang / g.yas su pheṭa ka ra/ me'i g.yas su 'jigs rung dang / g.yon du 'jigs par byed pa ni brgyad tshan gnyis pa ste/ dur khrod chen po bcu drug mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor chen po kun nas dwangs shing sgrib pa med la/ phyi nang kun tu 'od gsal zhing mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rgyan gyi rnam par mchog tu bkra ba du mas mdzes par gyur/ sa 'khor gsang ba'i byed dag pa/ /rga shi gzhu khyim 'gags pa las/ /skye rim rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ 'dod gzugs dzā lan+ta ra dang / /gang ba'i ri dang o rgyan rnams/ /shar la sogs pa'i rtsibs bzhi'o/ /sa dkyil gsang gnas phyed gzhan la/ /skye ba sdig khyim 'gags pa las/ /dri med sa la sdud pa'i rim/ /go da wa ri dga' dbang phyug /lha mo'i mkhar dang ma la ba/ /rlung sogs rtsibs la rim pas te/ /de ltar ye shes 'khor lo'o/ /chu dkyil lte ba'i phyed dang po/ /srid pa srang gi dus sbyor dag /skye ba'i rim pa 'od byed sa/ /arbu ta dang mu skru ni/ au tre byed pa'i pā ṭa ka khar la sogs pa'i rtsibs bzhi ste/ /chu 'khor lte ba'i phyed phyi ma/ /len pa bu mo rnam dag pa/ /'od 'phro'i sa la sdud rim ste/ /phur gsum las kyi pā ṭa ka /ko sa lā dang lā ḍa ni/ /rlud phyogs la sogs rtsibs bzhi ste/ /de ltar sa yi 'khor le'o/ /chu 'khor snying ga'i phyed phye ma/ /sred pa seng ge'i khyim 'gags pa/ /skye ba'i rim pa sbyang dka'i sa/ /ka ling ha ri ke la dang / /zla ba'i gling dang la sba ka /shar la sogs pa'i rtsibs bzhi'o/ /chu dkyil snying ga'i phyed dag pa/ /tshor ba karka'i khyim gzhan ni/ /mngon gyur sa la sdud pa'i rim/ /ka lta re yul dang kod ka na/ /hi ma la ya bal —345—

po'i yul/ /rlung la sogs pa'i rtsibs bzhi ste/ /chu yi 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /me dkyil mgrin pa'i 'khor lo phyed/ /reg pa 'khrig khyim 'gags pa las/ /skye rim ring du song ba'i sa/ /mā tra gri ha pra yā ka /ko la ki ri khyim gyi lha/ /dbang po la sogs rtsibs bzhi ste/ /me dkyil mgrin pa'i phyed gzhan la/ /skye mched drug dang glang khyim 'gags/ /mi g.yo'i sa la sdud rim ste/ /so da ni dang kha che'i yul/ /gser gling sing ga la rnams ni/ /g.yo ba la sogs rtsibs bzhi ste/ /me yi 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /me dkyil dpral ba'i phyed dag pa/ /ming gzugs lug khyim 'gags pa ste/ /skye rim legs pa'i blo gros sa/ /na ga ra dang dbang chen drag /sin dhu ki rwan ta yi yul/ khar phyogs la sogs rtsibs bzhi ste/ /rlung dkyil dpral ba'i phyed phyi ma/ /rten 'brel rnam shes nya khyim 'gags/ /chos kyi sprin chen sdud pa'i rim/ /ma rle'i yul dang ka ha ra/ /ku lu ta dang mahā mal/ /rlung sogs rtsibs la rim pa bzhin/ /rlung gi 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /rlung dkyil gtsug tor 'khor lo'i phyed/ /'du byed bum pa'i khyim 'gags pa/ /skye ba'i rim pa kun tu 'od/ /tsā ri dra dang ke ra la/ /lhan da gzhon nu ma grong rnams/ /shar la sogs pa'i rtsibs bzhi'o/ /rlung dkyil gtsug tor phyed phyi ma/ /ma rig chu srin 'gags pa ni/ /bcu gnyis sa ste bsdud pa'i rim/ /rdul bral dang ni keng ka na/ /grong gsum shri ha khye ka /nub byang la sogs rtsibs bzhi ste/ /nam mkha'i 'khor lo zhes bya'o/ /'di rnams dag spyor gyi don gal wo yin pas/ go zhing shes nas bsgom pa gal che'o/ /dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la gnas pa'i zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo a i ṛ u le/ a e —346—

ar o al/ ha ya ra ba la aX zhes pa rnams g.yon skor dang / lwa wā rā yā hā/ul 6ṭo ur mai ā/ lī mū zhwa khyu a aXzhes pa rnams g.yas skor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs dang ldan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /de'i 'og tu dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo khro 'u khru khyu snyi/ khru smra rla sgra ny-i/ sla spru khu k+shi ghi/ t+ta thru sdo dzhai sno/ lpa h+pha bru sni sma/ spyo rngo khyu rnya/stso stsoljoX/ rnyi/ phya khri glu gha gha ja zhes pa rnams g.yas skor dang / nga gha ga kha kanya dzha tsa/ ṇa khyu ḍa ṭha ṭa/ ma bha ba pha pa/ na dha da tha ta/ rkosha ṣa pi sa/ ha ya ra ba la/ bha ḍa ya wa la/ zhes pa rnams g.yon skor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed dang ldan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /zla ba'i dbus su huX yig zla ba'i mtshan ma lta bu so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /de rnams gcig tu gyur pa hi yig dang bcas pa bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes so/ /de las lha'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa haX yig dang bcas pa ni shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ bdag nyid dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/ mkha' 'gro ma'i drwa ba sdom pa chen po/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed pa/ dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga rnams 'gyed cing / bdud dang nyon mongs pa'i snying gar mnan pa'i zhabs gnyis pa/ mgrin pa gsum pa/ zhal bzhi pa/ phrag pa drug pa/ dpung pa bcu/ gnyis pa/ phyag gi pad+ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa lhag pa'i phyag gnyis te/ nyi shu rtsa drug dang ldan pa/ mtshon cha rnams dang rdo rje'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas pa dmar po brkyang pas 'dod lha —347—

dmar po gdong gcig pa/ lag pa bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis me tog gi mda' lnga dang / lcags kyu/ g.yon gnyis kyis gzhu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'i snying gar mnan pa/ g.yon pa dkar po bskum pas drag po dkar po gdong gcig pa/mig gsum pa/ lag pa bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang ḍa ma sagayon gnyis kyis kha ṭāX ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i snying gar mnan pa/ bdud kyi dga' ma dang / drag po'i u ma dag ni dman pa'i gdong gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi mthil la 'dzin par byed kyang g.yo ba med par gnas pa/sku mdog sngon po g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus kyi mgrin pa nyi ma dang zla ba dang bung ba'i mdog can mdun zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal dmar po/ g.yon zhal dkar po/ rgyab zhal ser po/ zhal bzhi char yang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing rab tu khros pa/ ag i dang smin ma rab tu 'bar ba/ skra tshogs dmar ser gyi ral ba'i cod pan la/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ spyi gtsug tu rdo rje nor bu dang / dpral bar thod pa lnga'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang / stag gi pags pa'i na bza' dang ldan pa/ bdud rigs brgya'i mgo bo'i 'phreng ba phrag pa la 'phyang ba/ dbu la rdo rje dar dpyangs kyi steng du rdo rje zla ba phyed pa dang bcas pa'o/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi phrag pa dang po nag po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po/ de bzhin du dpung pa gnyis nag po/ gnyis dmar po/ gnyis dkar po/ phyag ngar bzhi nag po/ bzhi dmar po/ bzhi dkar po/ de dag re re la yang sor gdub rnams kyis spras pa'i mthe bong ser po/—348—

mdzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ srin lag nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang khu'o//de rnams re re la yang phyag gi mthil nas brtsams te tshigs kyi 'phreng ba dang po rnams nag po/ gnyis pa rnams dmar po/ gsum pa rnams dkar po'o/ /de lta bu'i phyag g.yas pa rnams kyi nag po bzhis/ rdo rje ral gri rtse gsum/ gri gugadamar po bzhis/ mda' rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma sa tho ba/dkar po bzhis 'khor lo mdung dbyug pa dgra sta rnams 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa rnams kyi nag po bzhis/ rdo rje dril bu phub kha ṭāX ga kha phye ba/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ dmar po bzhis gzhu zhugs pa rin po che/ pad+ma/ dkar po bzhis/dung me long rdo rje lcags sgrog tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ lhag pa'i phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pa nag po dang g.yon pa ser po'i sdigs mdzub dang bcas te/ glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa khrag dang bcas pa mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i rkang lag gnyis nas bzung ste gyon zhing / 'chi bdag bdud kyi mgo bo dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /klu'i dbang po rgyal ba ral pa'i cod pan la bcings shing / rnam par rgyal ba dar dpyangs la bcings pa/stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma rna rgyan la gnas pa/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong phyag gdub la gnas pa/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan 'og pag dang mgul rgyan la gnas pa/'jog po dang pad+ma chen po zhabs gdub la gnas pa'o/ /phyag dang po gnyis yum la 'khyud pa'o/ /dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes don dam pa'i bden pa'o/ /oṃ haX haXbā ma dak+ṣi ṇa kaṇ+ḍa yor badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa le huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ aX aXka bye ka rje badz+ra me kha —349—

la badz+ra kaṇ+ḍi ke huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ a ā bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa ka ra yor badz+ra ru tsa ko huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha hā bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa pā da yor badz+ra nā pu re hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ haX baX pañtsa a ka ra mahā shā khyu spyo bhā wa badz+ra shi ro ma ṇi shi ra si sarba aX ge bhasmi huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ aX adhe na rī shwa rā badz+ra a rta tsan+d+ra badz+ra pas sdi khye hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ a āX.aX sarba su ra e ka tri swa ra spyo bhā wa badz+ra ya rto pa bī ta skarnye huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/oṃ k+ṣaXdur dwa n+ta a bhi ma na k+ṣa yaX ka ri byā gra tsarma ka ṭo huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ haX k+ṣa tri shad swa ra sa snya ti hra su di rgyu byañdza na swa bhā ba nai tu ku la sha ta si ro bhi ra mraṇa ḍa mā le skan+ta a ba laX bhi ni ska rje huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha hi hṝ hu lha pañtsa skan+ta bi shu: swa bhā ba shi ra si ka pā la mā le hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ spyi gro dha badz+ra huX phaṭa/ oṃ ñdziX badz+ra kha'i / ༷ phaṭa/ oṃ rdziXbadz+ra tri shu la hāX phaṭa/ oṃ spriXbadz+ra ka rta ri huX phaṭa/ oṃ rdzadz+rabān huX phaṭa/ oṃ spre gu sha huX phaṭa/ oṃñdziX badz+ra ḍa ma ru ka hūX phaṭa/ oṃ spriXbadz+ra mud gar hūX phaṭa/ oṃ sne tsakra huX phaṭa/ oṃ ñdziXkun da hūX phaṭa/ oṃ ñdziXbadz+ra daṇ+ḍahuX phaṭa/ khro spyir dz+ra par+sha hu phaṭa/oṃ hāX badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi hoXrlu phaṭa/ oṃ hāX badz+ra khe ṭa ka hoXrlu phaṭa/ oṃ hāX badz+ra kha ṭāX ga hoXrlu phaṭa/ oṃ hāX badz+ra ka pā la hoXrlu phaṭa/ oṃ hāX badz+ra tsa pa hoXrlu phaṭa/ oṃ hāX badz+ra pā sha hoXrlu phaṭa/ oṃ hāX badz+ra rad na hoXrlu phaṭa/ oṃ hāX badz+ra pad+ma hoXrlu phaṭa/ oṃ hwaX badz+ra shaX kha hoXrlu phaṭa/ oṃ hāX badz+ra ā dar+sha hoXrlu phaṭa/ oṃ hāX badz+ra shri kha le hoXrlu phaṭa/ oṃ hāX tsa stun be da mu kha swa bhā ba prad+ma shī raX hoXrlu phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣa khyi khyi khyo ljo glu khri khri sko sko k+ṣaX k+ṣaX ha hā hi hi hri hṝ hu hu hṝ zhwa haX haX sarba bisna bi dā ri ta —350—

ga dza tsarma pa ṭa ar tra rak+ta shra ba ta huX rlu/ oṃ huX badz+ra dza ya nā ga in+d+ra badz+ra dza ṭa mu ku ṭa ban+dhe tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ khriX badz+ra bi dza ya nā ga in+d+ra badz+ra pa ṭa brnye tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ oX h+phaX h+phuX badz+ra karko ṭa ka badz+ra pad+mo bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa kuṇ+ḍal yo tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ hraX hruX badz+ra ba su ki shaX kha pā lo bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa ru tsa ka yo tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ hwaX hāX badz+ra a nan ta ku li ko me sku lwa ka rje ka lo tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ tshoX khyuX badz+ra tak+ṣa ka mahā pad+mo bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa pā da nu pu ra yoXtiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ de ltar na phyag rgya phyag mawo 'god par grags pa 'di dag 'di la nges par 'os bab yin pas gal che mod/ rgyun gyi nyams len la ma lcogs na yang mi 'gal tsam mo/ /de la 'byud pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma g.yas gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ dpral ba dang / mgrin pa dang/ snyan dang / ske rgyan dang / zhabs gdub la dril bu g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang / thod pa'i dum bu'i 'og pag dang / thod pa skam po'i dbu rgyan dang / do shal gyis mdzes pa rdo rje sems dpa'i cod pan can/ g.yon brkyang gis bcom ldan 'das la 'byud cing / des kyang snyoms par zhugs pa ste/ shes rab dang ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin ma/ rang bzhin phyis 'od gsal ba/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid do/ /spyin pa la sogs pa pha rol tu phyin pa gas brgyad ni pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'dab ma brgyad la gnas pa ste/shar dang nub tu a ā/ byang dang lhor aX āX me dang rlung du ha hā/ dbang ldan —351—

dang bden bral du haX haXrnams las byung ba'i cang te'u rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du nag mo 'bar ma/ lhor dmar mo 'bar ma/ byang du dkar mo 'bar ma/ nub tu ser mo 'bar ma/ mer du ba ma/ bden bral du rmig sgyu ma/dbang ldan du me khyer ma/ rlung du mar me ma ste/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ gcer bu dbu skra grol ba/ phyag g.yas cung zad steng phyogs su bskyod pa'i ḍa ma ru 'phrol zhing /g.yon kha ṭāX ga thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang / dum bu'i ske rags dang / dril bu g.yer kha'i tshogs dang / mgo bo'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /de dag gi bar bar gyi 'dab ma rnams la/ hi hi hri hṝ hu hu hṝ hṝ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba brgyad de/ shar du rkang 'gags pa'i thod pa gnyis dang / lhor khrag 'gags pa'i thod pa gnyis dang /byang du gci ba 'gags pa'i thod pa gnyis dang / nub tu bshang ba 'gags pa'i thod pa gnyis te/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa brgyad yang dag par gnas par gyur pa ste de dag ni bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'o/ /'dod chags chen pos 'dul bar bya ba'i sems can rnams dang po'i sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snod du mngon par gzigs nas/ yum la snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i shin tu dga' ba'i sgras/ nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i rnam par dag pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched las dbang yul dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin de bzhin gshe/gas pa yab yum/ byang chub sems dpa' yab yum/ khro bo yab yum thams —352—

cad rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pas rang gi lus la zhugs par gyur/ lhar yang rang nyid las 'phro / sa te sna tshogs yum la zhugs par gyur/ de las kyang ldog nas slar rang nyid la zhugs te/ zla ba byang chub sems kyi rnam par zhu ba rnams rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra spros te/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las lha dang lha mo'i tshogs su gyur pa ni/ a yig las byung ba'i rdo rje ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog ljang khu/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu/ thod pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa la/ rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mas 'phyud pa nam mkhar spros nas sems can gyi don byas te/ /slar yang rang nyid la bdag por zhugs par gyur/shi spyi sdo spru spru ldi slo shī/ /smyo shi spru khra shrī spu shwe slo/ 1 /dhi hūṃ dri hūṃ thu shrī kli dhī/ /hṝ dhi byu dro shrī thu dhī hṝ/ 2 /bhi hū ཾ bṛ phyu phu bri bla hṝ/ /hū ཾ bhi phyu bṛ hṝ phu sgyi bla/ 3 /dhi snyo zlo bhu thu shrī lco dhī/ /② dhi ṣ+ka dzo dzo thu shrī blo/4 /dzhai ༈dzo tsū tshu dzī lcu dhī/ khro dzhai tsū dzo dzo tshu dhī tshwa/ 5 /sti spyi kṛ khyu khu shrī klo snri/ /hūṃ ghi khyu kṛ hṝ khu skyi kli/ 6/'bor lo drug gi lha'i sa bon ni/ nya nywa ṇa ṇa ma mā na nā/ sko sgrong ngu ha hā k+ṣa nywa/rnams dang phyag mtshan gri gug dang rdo rje rnams so/ /de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ 'khor gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams su —353—

gyur pa/ gsang ba'i pad+ma las phyir spros te so so'i gnas su 'khode pa gyur pa ni/ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i shar du shi rdo rje ma spyi rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / lhor dz+dza rdo rje ma la snyi rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / byang du spru rdo rje ma la ji rdo rjes 'phyud pa dang / nub tu slo rdo rje ma la shrī rdo rjes 'phyud pa dang / rlung du spyi rdo rje ma la shi rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / dbang ldan du sgrurdo rje ma la spre rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / bden bral du khṛ rdo rje ma la rdzu rdo rje 'phyud pa dang / mer shī rdo rje ma la slo rdo rjes 'byud pa'i/ /sa kha spyas kyi lubor lo'i shar gyi rtsibs la/ dhi rdo rje ma la hṝ rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / lhor khru rdo rje ma la hūṃ rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / byang sdu thu rdo rje ma la hṝ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / /nub tu klirdo rje ma la dhī rdo rjes lkod pa dang / rlung du hṝ rdo rje ma la dhi rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / dbang ldan du hūṃ rdo rje ma la khru rdo rjes 'a 'khyud pa dang / bden bral du hṝ rdo rjes ma la thu rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / mer dhī rdo rje ma la til rdo rjes 'khyud pa'o//chu khams kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs su/ bhi rdo rje ma la snya rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / lhor bṛ rdo rje ma la phyu rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / byang du phu rdo rje ma la shrī rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / nub tu spru rdo rje ma la sgyi rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / rlung du snya rdo rje ma la bhi rdo rjes 'phyud pa dang / dbang ldan du phyu rdo rje ma la bṛ rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / bden bral du hṝ rdo rje ma la phu rdo rjes 'khyu/da pa dang / me mtshams su sgyi rdo rje ma la bla rdo rjes 'byud pa'o/ /me khams kyi 'khor lo'i shar du bhi rdo rje ma la lha rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / lhor dzordo rje ma la khru rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang /byang du thu rdo rje ma la shrī rdo rjes 'gyud pa dang / nub tu til rdo rje ma la hṝ rdo rje —354—

'byud pa dang / rlung du hṝ rdo rje ma la rje rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / dbang ldan du bhu rdo rje ma la lkar rdo rje zu 'byud pa dang / bden bral du shrī rdo rje ma la thu rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / mer dhī rdo rje ma la hṝ rdo rjes 'byud pa'o/ /rlud khams kyi ge bor lo'i shar du dzhai rdo rje ma la hṝ rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / lhor dzi rdo rje ma la tsū rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / byang du tshu rdo rje ma la dzī rdo rjes 'byud pa dang /nub tu zla rdo rje ma la dhī rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / rlung mtshams su hṝ rdo rje ma la dzhai rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / dbang ldan du hṝ rdo rje ma la : rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / bden bral du dzhai rdo rje ma la tshu rdo rjes 'khyud pa dang / me mtshams su dzhai rdo rje ma la stu rdo rjes 'byud pa'o/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams la shar du ghi rdo rjes ma la spyi rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / lhor kṛ rdo rje ma la khyu rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / byang du khu rdo rje ma la shrī rdo rjes 'byud pa dang /nub tu kṛ rdo rje ma la sgyi rdo rjes 'phyud pa dang / rlung du hūṃ rdo rje ma la ghi rdo rjes 'byud pa dang / dbang ldan du khyu rdo rje ma la kṛ rdo rjes 'phyud pa dang / bden bral du shrī rdo rje ma la khu rdo rjes 'phyud pa dang / me mtshams su snri rdo rje ma la klo rdo rjes 'byud pa ste/ de ltar na dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma bdun bcu rtsa gnyis las/ shar dang shar lho'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams sku mdog nag mo thabs dpa' bo rnams ser po/ lho dang lho nub kyi mkha' 'gro rnams sku mdog dmar mo/thabs dpa' bo rnams dkar po/ byang dang byang shar gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams sku mdog dkar mo/ thabs dpa' bo rnams dmar po/ nub dang nub byang gi mkha' 'gro ma rnams sku mdog ser mo/ thabs dpa' bo rnams nag po'o/ /rnal 'byor —355—

ma bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad po thams cad kyang / gtso bo la mngon du phyogs pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis cung zad thung ba'i lus can g.yas gri gug 'chu/ra ba dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khu/da pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa/ dpa' bo bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad po thams cad zhal gnyis phyag bzhi pa dang po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang rang gi shes rab ma'i mgul nas 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭāX ga 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas thabs shes mnyam par sbyor ba glang lpags spangs shing mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ lhag ma brgyan dang cha byad bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa ste/ 'khore lo drug gi lha tshogs rnams/ shes rab ma gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang wo po'i shar sgor nya rdo rje ma/ shar rdzo sgor nywa rdo rje ma'o/ /lho sgor ṇa rdo rje ma/bden bral gyi sgor ṇa rdo rje ma'o/ /byang sgor ma rdo rje ma/ dbang ldan gyi sgor mā rdo rje ma/ nub sgor na rdo rje ma/ rlung mtshams kyi sgor nā rdo rje ma/ de ltar na phyogs kyi lha mo bzhi ljang khu/ mtshams kyi lha mo bzhi sngon mo/ thams cad kyang sgo khyud kyi nang mtshams na gnas pa'o// rlung dang byang gi mtshams su na rdo rje ma sngon mo/rlung dang nub kyi mtshams su she rdo rje ma ljang khu/ me dang shar gyi bar du nga rdo rje ma ljang khu/ me dang lho'i bar du ngu rdo rje ma sngon mo/ byang dang dbang ldan gyi bar du ha rdo rje ma ljang khu/ dbang ldan dang shar gyi bar hā rdo rje ma sngon mo/bden bral dang lho'i bar du k+ṣa rdo rje ma ljang khu/ bden bral dang nub kyi bar du nywa rdo rje ma sngon mo ste/ de ltar brgyad po rnams ni rtsig pa'i phyi rol sgo khyud —356—

rnams kyi bar gyi stegs bu la yang dag par gnas pa'o/ /de ltar na sgom mtshams ma bcu drug ni/ dur khrod chen po bcu drug la yang dag par spyod pa ste thams cad kyang cher khros shing drag mo'i tshul can 'khor lo dang mi ro'i gdan la gnas pa skra gyen la brdzes pa ste/ rgyan dang phyag mtshan rnam 'gyur lhag ma rnams ni/ nus ma rnams dang mtshungs pa'o/ /da ni rjes 'brang gi lha rnams bskyed par bya ste/ phyogs bzhi'i sgo rnams kyi g.yas dang g.yon gyi stegs bu la klu rnams gnas pa ste/ stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma nag po la/ mkha' lding gdong ma dang lce spyang gdong ma ser mos 'byud pa/ shar sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu'i steng du/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dang / nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar po la/ lug gdong ma dang stag gdong ma dkar mos 'khyud pa/ lho sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu'i steng du/ me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dang / mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar po la/ bya rgod gdong ma dang phag gdong ma dmar mos 'phyud pa/ byang sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dang / 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po ser po la/ khwa gdong ma dang khyi gdong ma nag mos 'phyud pa/nub sgo'i g.yon dang g.yas kyi stegs bu'i steng du/ sa'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa ste/ klu rnams zhal gcig phyag bzhi bum pa rdo rje pad+ma nor bu 'dzin pa dang /rab gtum ma rnams khro mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rdo rje skyil krung gis phan tshun du bzhugs pa'o/ /de bzhin du sgo'i g.yas dang g.yon gyi stegs bu la/ shar du dri ma dang 'phreng ba ma nag mo/ lhor bdug spos ma dang —357—

snang gsal ma dmar mo/ byang du bdud rtsi ma dang 'bras bu ma dkar mo/ nub tu sgeg mo dang bzhad ma ser mo/ steng du sgra ma dang gar ma ljang gu/ 'og tu 'dod ma dang glu ma sngon mo ste/ thams cad kyang rang gi ming dang mthun pa'i mchod rdzas thogs shing gzungs ma grangs med pa dang bcas pa'o/ /klu dang gzungs ma 'di rnams sdom chen gyi skabs 'dir/ dus 'khor chos dbyings gsung dbang dang mi 'dra ste/ 'khor lo sdom pa nyis 'gyur brgya rtsa nyi shu'i lha la mi thi bas/ rtsa ba'i lha ma yin rjes 'brang gi lha tsam yin no/ /de'i phyir skabs 'dir sa bon nam/ skad cig tsam las bskyed na legs te thob tshod yin no/ /'on kyang chos rgyal phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs che ba na 'di rnams kyang mkha' spro mdzad de de yang mi 'gal lo/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor la sa bon dang mtshan ma sna tshogs pa las byung ba'i 'byung po bye ba phrag phyed dbang bzhi dang / gza' bcu dang / dhu wa dang / a ga sdu la sogs pa'i drang srong rnams dang / rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa skar ma thams cad dang / khyim bcu gnyis dang / cha bcu drug dang phyogs bcu skyong ba dang / dga' byed dbang phyug dang / nag po chen po dang /dril bu'i rna ba can dang / bh+ring gi ni dang / zhing skyong dang / pho nya thams cad dang /'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang / skra'i grangs gyi grub pa rnams/ dbyibs dang /kha dog dang / mtshan ma sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa rnams kyang 'khod par gyur/ de ltar ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid/ bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo mkha' 'gro ma'i dra ba sdom pa chen po/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par mdzad pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes 'khor dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ su bi shud dha dharmā dha tu sā bhā wa ut+pa ko3ha/—358—

thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa dag gis/ 'gro ba drug na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad bkug nas dkyil 'khor chen por bcug par gyur/ de nas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa yum dang bcas pa thams cad bkug nas rang gi snying gar rab tu zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa rnams gsang ba'i rdo rje las spros nas sems can thams cad la dbang bskur bar gyur/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer rnams kyis reg pa'i sems can de rnams mchog gi dga' ba dang bde bas gang ba'i lha'i sku thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid zhal dang sku mdog la sogs pa sna tshogs pa dang ldan pa dang / de dag re re zhing yang skad cig gi snga lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gyur/ klu spu spri ku sko las phung po lnga rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas lnga dang / nywa gh+ri rdzi snyu snyi las khams lnga rnam par dag pa yum lnga dang / k+ṣa spyo ltar khyo snyal k+ṣaX las dbang po drug rnam par dag pa sems dpa' drug dang / khri tai nywar klo skyal k+ṣaXlas yul drug rnam par dag pa sems ma drug dang / k+ṣa kyi 1 nga las las kyi dbang po lnga rnam par dag pa khro bo lnga dang /di 1 k+ṣa kā sko las 'is kyi dbang po'i yul lnga rnam par dag pa khro mo lnga ste/tsho'i rwa lda mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil lubor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam par gyur te/ slar yang de rnams rang rang gi zhing du gshegs su gsol/gnyis pa gsung rdzogs pa nye bar sgrub pas yan lag las rgyal mchog ni/ lte ba dang gtsug tor gyi a wa dh+wa ti'i lam du hoXyig dag dang / dpral ba dang mgrin pa dang snying ga rnams su hūṃ gsung thugs kyi rdo rje oṃ āXhuX rnams las/ byung ba'i zla —359—

ba dang nyi ma dang sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor rnams 'khod par gyur/ ho yig dus kyi me'i 'od zer gyis steng dang 'og nas sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnams bzhus te/ gtum mo shes rab gyi chags pas yab yum gnyis zla ba zhu ba ltar gyur/ spyan ma bdag ni 'gro ba'i yum/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rgyu mthun gnas/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzode/ /mā ma gī bdag sring mo ste/ /rnal 'byo(ra pa yi rnam smin gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /gos dkar mo bdag bu mo ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi skyes bu'i gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /sgrol ma bdag ni tsha mo ste/ /rnal 'byore pa yi dri bral gnas/ /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyis/ /dus 'khor bzhengs la bdag 'dod mdzod/ /stong pa'i dkyil 'khor nyams myong nas/ /'gro ba bsgral ba'i bsam pa yis/ sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba'i mgon pos spro bar mdzod/ /ces pa'i glu rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das stong pa nyid la rab tu zhugs pa 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i slad du bskul ba las/ bcom ldan 'das rab tu sad de 'gro ba mtha' dag sgyu ma lta bur gzigs nas gzhan gyi don du slar yang bskyed par mdzad pa ni/ hu las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / de las byung ba'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/ mkha' 'gro ma'i dra ba sdom pa chen po/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par mdzad pa/ dri ma med pa'i 'od zer zhes pa nas/ bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'o zhes pa'i bar gong bzhi las/gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /yab yum —360—

snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa rnams dang / dkyil 'khor pa rnams dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gyi don du rang gi lus la rab tu bcug nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par zhu bar gyur pa rnams rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra spros te/ de dag yongs su gyur pa las lha dang lha mo'i tshogs su gyur pa ni/ aX yig las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dang sku mdog sngon po/ g.yas zhal dmar zhing g.yon zhal dkar ba/ phyag g.yas pa gsum gyis rdo rje/ gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon pa gsum gyis rdo rje dril bu/ thod pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa la/ rang dang 'dra ba'i sher phyin mas 'byud pa nam mkha' spros nas sems can gyi don byas te/ slar yang rang nyid la rke por bzhugs par gyur gyi bar thugs dkyil gyi las rgyal mchog bzhin no/ zha spyi khro snyi zhes pa nas/ sna tshogs 'dzin pa rnams kyang 'khod par gyur gyi bar gong bzhi du brjod par bya'o/ /lo dang zla ba la sogs dbye ba'i dus kyi dag pas dpal ldan rdo rje can 'gyur mi yi bdag /lo gcig gi ni sna tshogs yum ste zhal la sogs pa rnam thar bzhi ni rnam par dag pa'o/ /sbyin pa sogs dang phung po 'byung ba yul dang yul can gzhan yang dbang po lnga la sogs pa dang / /phyogs sa phyogs kyi stobs dang dpal ldan rgyal sras dbang rnams kyis kyang mig ri lha mo rnam par dag /dpal ldan rdo rje can ni thugs kyi rdo rjer 'gyur te mi bdag dkyil 'khor sku yi rdo rje'o/ /lha rnams 'khor lo ā li kā li'i rigs skyes gsung gi rdo rje zla ba nyi ma'i steng du'o/ /de bzhin du ni ye —361—

shes rdo rje nges par srid pa'i 'jigs 'joms sna tshogs yum gyi rang bzhin no/ /rgyal ba'i sku yi rdo rje yul dang yul can rnams kyi bgrod bya min pa rnam pa thams cad pa/ /gsung gi rdo rje sems can thams cad rang snying skad rnams dag gis chos ni go bar byed pa'o/ /rdo rje can gyi thugs kyi rdo rje sems can rnams kyi sems kyi rang bzhin mtha' dag sa la gnas/ /dri med nor bu lta bu dngos po rnams kyi 'dzin byed gang yin de nyid ye shes rdo rje'o/ /de nas 〈dus lor gsung dbang gi sgrub thabs su spund pa bzhi/〉bdag nyid kyi thugs kar huX yongs su gyur pa las/ zhes pa nas/ gtsug tor du hā las thugs rdo rje rnams 'khod par gyur/zhes pa'i bar yang 'dra ba las/ tsho( shrī kā la tsakra zhes pa rnams la/ tso( shrī kā la tsakra badz+ra ste ra wa sgyi ska ra ya sa pa ri wā ra zhes 'dogs sbyor ba ni khyad par ro/ /sngags dbang blang bar 'dod na/ oṃ haX haX sogs kyis chu dbang gi don du gsol ba btab/o.a i ṛ mū '-i pañtsa dh+wa tu bi sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes chu dbang bskur/ des mtshon te cod pan dang / dar dpyangs dang /rdo rje dril bu dang / brtul zhugs dang / ming dbang dang / oṃ e rkeX pad+ma badz+ra sogs kyis rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba btab/ oṃ haX k+ṣa dharma tsakra pra brta ka swāhā/ zhes pas rjes gnang gi dbang bskur/ skye( sarba ta thā ga ta sa bha a bhi ṣe ka ta sa lta bhū mi pra sto3haX/ zhes pa'o/ /'di la 'og tu phra thig gi rnal 'byor bsgom dgos pa'i phyir gong ma bzhi po'i sngags dbang mi dgos la/ ci ste na phra thig mi bsgom pa'i rigs la ni de yang blang dgos so/ /de ltar dbang bskur bas dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te/ rgyas btab par gyur pa ni/ rnam par shes pa'i rigs las byung ba'i ljang khu rnams la mi bskyod pa dang zhes pa nas/ de la 'dud kyi bar du rgyas btab rnam pa bzhi dang / phra thig gi rnal 'byor nga —362—

rgyal bzung / mchod bstod rnams dus 'khor gsung dbang gi sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin no/ /de nas bzlas pa ni/ oX rkye huX hūm̐ huX huX phaṭa/ ces pa dang / oX āXhuX hoX ༅ huX rlu huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa ni snying po'o/ /tseX( hāX sbru hṝ hūm̐ rne hru huX phaṭa swāhā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /gzhan yang 'phreng ba'i sngags kyi bstod 'a pa rkang pa bcu drug pa dang / gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'i yan lag gi sngags rkang pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa yang nges par bzla bar bya zhing / 'khor rnams la/ tseX( a āX.aX āXha hā haX zhe rlu rdo rteXsko tuX huX phaṭa/oX ha hā hi hi lha tshwa hu hu hṝ hṝ huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/ lkoX sli hū ཾ pu pū khro ski rā shi shī haX hwahwaX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ lkoX hṝ thu hūṃ dra hṝ dhī la lwa huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/ lkoX bli hū ཾ phu phu bṛ shrī bhi dhī wa wā huX huX pha phaṭa/ oX zla 'a thu khru rje rje lha lha ra rā huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/oX blo la tshu tsū snye dzo dzhai dhī ya yā huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ kṛ spyi khu khyu kṛ shrī ghi sgyi ha hā huX huX phoṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha hā k+ṣa nywaXng ngu da ka na nā ma mā ṇa ṇa nya nywa huX hūX rlu rlu phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pa ste/ sngags tshan dgu yod pa rnams bsnyen pa'i skabs su ci rigs pa bzla ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ drag po'i las dang bgegs tshar gcod pa'i skabs su ni/ rkang pa bcu drug pa'i gzhugs la/ sde tshan dgu po de dag btags te bzla ba yin pa las/ thog ma'i oṃ dgu po spangs/ sde tshan rnams kyang gong du bshad pa las go rim zlog ste/ ha hā k+ṣa nywa sogs kyi sde tshan thog mar byed cing / a ā aX āXsogs kyi sde tshan gnyis tha mar sbyar te bzla dgos pa yin no//oX āXhuX hoXhaX k+ṣaX 6 ka lwa tsakra hā badz+re huX huX phaṭa/ 1 oX dur dun ta da ma kaXdzā ti dza rā ma ra ‘ ṇa na ta ka ha badz+re: 2 lkoX tri lo kya bi dza ya ā badz+re: 3oX mahā bī re shwa ra a badz+re: 4 oX badz+ra ste ra wa rnyaXbadz+re 5 oX badz+ra kā ya aXbadz+re: 6 oX badz+ra gwa tra haX badzi: 7 oṃ badz+ra nai tra aX badz+re: 8 lkoX badz+ra sho tra —363—

hā badzi: 9 oṃ badz+ra ghā ṇa ha badz+re: 10 oṃ badz+ra dzi hwa khri badz+re: 11 oṃ badz+ra nān+ta k+ṣa badzi: 12 oX badz+ra na kha spyi badz+ra ghi badz+re 13 badz+ra ke sha khyu badz+ra kṛ badz+ra: 24oX badz+ra lo ma kṛ badz+ra khu badz+ra: 15 oṃ badz+ra bhā ra ṇa ny-i badz+re kṛ badz+ra: 16 oX badz+ra hā sa dā badzi: 17 oṃ badz+ra gī ta da badz+re: 18 oX badz+ra dra tu ghi badz+re spyi badz+ra: 19 oṃ badz+ra yu ta ka ra kṛ badzi khyu badz+ra: 20 oX badz+ra kro dha rā dza a dhi pa ti khu badz+re shrī badz+ra: 21 oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kṛ badzi sgyi badz+ra 22 oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī dz+wa la pa ri phri ta zlo badz+re dzhai badz+ra: 23 oṃ badz+ra shī ghaX ā ga smo ā ga tsā tshu badz+re dzi badz+ra: 24 oṃ sa tā dzñā ya sarba mā ra ca bi nā ya ka kin na ra ki pu ru kha ga ru ḍa ga rga rta yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhā ta mahā pre ta ku lha ṇ+ḍa pa sma ra slo tra pā la be tā ḍa pū ta na dus nā ga gra hā da yo ye sarba dz+wa ra sarba bya dhi khyi dro pa dra bā kā ri ṇaXsarba satwa nā na sarba a pa ka ra ra tāXtāX sa rbu ñdzaX shī gh+raX badzā aṅgā she nā kṛ dzī kṛ rtsi dzi badz+re tshu badz+ra:25 oX sprujo di shi ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ bya dhī badzi zle badz+ra5 26 lkoX purba di shi ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ rtsi nywa badz+ra: 27 oX dak+ṣi ṇa di shi ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ rtsi nya badz+re 28 oX ut+ta ra di shi ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ bya dzhai badz+re lhab sgro: 29 oX pa nyi ma di shi ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ rtsi rmi badz+re tshu badz+ra: 30 oṃ ba ya bya di shi ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ yi tshu badz+re rmi badz+ra: 31 oX i shā na di shi ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ yi lha badz+re dhī badz+ra: 32 oX nai tu di shi ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ rtsi dzo badz+re ḍi badz+ra 33 lkoX asne ya di shi ga tā nā kriṣ+ṭha kṛ rtsi bhu badz+re rje badz+ra 34 oṃ a rdo di shi ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ bya dzo badz+re thu badz+ra 35 oṃ ā kā sha maṇ+ḍa la ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ pya dhī badz+re blo badz+ra 36oṃ bā yu maṇ+ḍa la ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ rtsi ṇa badzi: 37 oṃ te dzo maṇ+ḍal ga tā nā kṛ t+yā —364—

kṛ dzī ṇa badz+re: 38 lkoX to ya maṇ+ḍal ga tā nā kṛ byā kṛ rtsi dhi badz+re lha badz+ra: 39lkoX pri thi bi maṇ+ḍa la ga tā nā kṛ dzī spo bya dzo badz+re khru badz+ra: khu0 oX kā ma dh+wa tu ga tā nā kṛ dhī kṛ nyu thu badz+re shrī badz+ra: 41 lkoX rū pa dha tu ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ yi blo badz+ra hṝ badz+ra : 42 oX a rū pa dh+wa tu ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ nyu khyi badz+re bhi badz+ra khu3 oṃ kā ya dh+wa tu ga tā nā kṛ dzī kṛ bya phyu badz+re bṛ badz+ra 44 oX lha ka dh+wa tu ga tā nā kṛ dzī kṛ rtsi shrī badz+re phu badz+ra: 45 oṃ tsit+ta bhā tu ga tā nā kṛ ā+o ཾ kṛ yi sgyi badz+re bla badz+ra: 46 oṃ pañtsa skan+ta ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ rtsi mā badz+ra: 47 oṃ pañtsa dh+wa tu ga tā nā kri dzī kṛ yi ma badz+ra 48 oX pa sgyesnru ya ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ ṣ+ka bhi badzi hū ཾ badz+ra 49 oX pa nyu shi ṣa ya ga tā nā kṛ khyu kṛ sgri bṛ badz+re phu badz+ra: 50 oṃ pañtsa ka rmyesmyu ya ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ dzī phu badzi bṛ badz+ra 51 oṃ pañtsa karma e ji ya bi ṣa ya ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ sgri : badz+re sgyi badz+ra:52 oX sarba to ya tra ku tra tsit+ta ga tā nā kṛ ṣ+ka kṛ sgri blo bo dzi dhi badz+ra 53 oX mahā rmi shā ni badz+ra asni dz+wa li ta bhā myaX ni pā ta ya ni pā ta ya hūṃ badz+re rje badz+ra 54 oX badz+ra pa she na sarba bhu dze khu ban+ta ya ban+ta ya rje badz+re thu badz+ra : 55 oX badz+ra shri kha la yā sarba pā de khu ni ro dha ya ni ro dha ya dhī badz+re slobadz+ra 56 oX sarba sa te khu kā ya lha ka tsit+ta khri dro pa dra ba ka ra ra taX mahā kro dha badz+re ṇa tsuṇ+ḍa ya tsuṇ+ḍa ya nā badz+rengu57 oṃ badz+ra khaṅge na ni krin+ta ya ni krin+ta ya na badzi 58 oṃ badz+ra tri shā le na bhe da ya bhe da ya dhī badz+re slo badz+ra: 59 oX badz+ra karti ka ya ha na ha na khru badz+re hūṃ badz+ra 60oX badz+ra bā ṇi na bin+ta bin+ta thu badz+re rlo badz+ra: 61 oṃ badz+ra gī la keXgī la ya gī la ya rtu badzi dhī badz+ra 62 oṃ badz+ra mud ga re nā ko ṭa yā ko ṭa ya spyi badz+re shi badz+ra: 63 lkoX badz+ra tsakre ṇa ts+tsha da ya rtswa da ya stsi dzi nyu badz+ra: 64 oṃ badz+ra —365—

ku rnye na bin+ta bin+ta khri badz+ra sbubadz+ra: 65 oX badz+ra da rnye na tā ṭa ya tā ṭa ya shi badz+re slo badz+ra 66 oX badz+ra par+sha nā tshin+ta tshin+ta bā badz+ra: 67 oX swa dhe tri ko ṭi khaṇ+ḍaX kṛ tā shā shā na bhā myuX sarba bhā te lco ba liX ku ru ku ru skabadz+re: 68 lkoX badz+ra ḍā ma ru ke ṇa badz+ra ḍā ki dwo rā bā ha ye bā ha yā shī badz+re spyi badz+ra: 69 oX badz+ra ḍā ki nī sbyo ma ra kā yi ka nāX ru dhi raX ni be da ya bi be da ya sngu badz+ra khri dz+ra: 70 oX pañtsa a klu ta hā ri ṇi khyuXbadz+ra a mṛ taX ni be ta ya ni rbo ta ya spru badz+re khor badz+ra 71oX sarba badz+ra ḍi zhi nī sa hi taXsarba sa tā nāX shwarnyi kaX pu spyiX kaX rāk+ṣa a wa ra ṇa gu lha ku ru ku ru : badz+re shī badz+ra huX huX phaṭa/ 72 de ltar thams cad kyi mthar huX hūX phaṭa ces sbyar ro/ /'di rnams 'khor kho na'i sngags su 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ rkang pa re re bzhin gtso bo'i sngags yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na yang nus ma brgyad dang dur khrod kyi lha mo bcu drug ste nyer bzhi la gtso bo'i yum du sbyar bas yab yum gnyis med kyi bzlas par 'gyur la/ lhag ma rnams gtso bo'i sngags rkang pa re re la/ dpa' bo re pho nya'i tshul dang / mkha' 'gro ma re pho nya mo'i tshul du sbyar ba yin pas gtso 'khor dbyer med kyi bzlas pa zhes bya ste/ don la 'khor rnams bsham bur btags pa'i gtso bo'i bzlas pa nyid yin par shes par bya'o/ /sngags 'di dag kyang gal po che'i yin pas nges par blo la bzung zhing ci rigs pa 'don no// bzlas pa'i mthar/ maṇ+ḍal mchod pa dang gtor chog sogs byed na/ dus 'khor gsung dbang gi sgrub thabs gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pas rigs 'gre sgrub mchod sogs dang rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la rgyas pa ma lcogs na/ tseX( badz+ra gan+taX pra tismo na maX sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis kyis mchod/ 'dud nyi shus bstod/ rang gi snying ga'i 'khor lo la nus ma thod pa dang bcas pa rnams thim/ gsang ba'i rtsa'i 'khor la ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang / lte ba'i rtsa 'khor la —366—

sa'i snyen ra lo'i lha tshogs rlams dang / snying ga'i rtsa 'khor la chu'i 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang / mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor la me'i 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang / dpral ba'i rtsa 'khor la rlung gi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang /gtsug tor gyi rtsa 'khor la nam mkha'i 'khor lo'i lha tshos/sa rnams dang / gsang gnas dang gtsug tor du dur khrod kyi dbang phyug ma bcu drug gzungs ma dang bcas pa rnams dang / phyag zhabs kyi sor mo'i tshigs rnams la klu dang rab gtum ma rnams thim/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug nyid kyang cig car ram/ rim pas 'od gsal gyi ngang du zhugs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid sdom pa chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ o ā hū ho ha k+ṣa dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/de ltar na bshad zin pa 'di ni sgrub thabs rgyas pa'i rim pa yin la/ rgyun gyi nyams le myo/ bsdus pa la mos na/ rgyal mchog gnyis las gang rung gcig gi lha tshogs spro ba bor bas kyang rung la/ yang lha dgu'i sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar gyi sngon 'gro bsdus pa de byas nas/ gzhal yas khang dang gtso bo'i skyed chog sngar bzhin dang / 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams mngal 'byin mi byed par/sa bon tsam las bskyed/ thugs ka nas rdo rje shugs spros te/ ye shes spyan 'dren man chad gong bzhin byas pas chog la/ de las kyang bsdu na gtso bo yang sa bon phyag mtshan tsam las bskyed pa wo mod/ 'on kyang mngon byang lnga bskyed nyid bzang ngo / /bskyed chog 'di'i rigs la gtso bo nus ma dang bcas pa yan chad dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog yin/ 'khor gyi lha tshogs bskyed pa nas brtsams te las rgyal mchog tu byed/ lha dgu'am gtso rkyang lta bu bsgom na/ ye shes spyan 'dren man chad las rgyal du byed pas/ sgrub thabs yan lag bzhi pa'i dag bya dag byed rags pa rnams/ rgyas bsdus de dag tshun chad la tshang bar shes par bya'o/ /de las kyang bsdus pa rnams la ni yan lag —367—

bzhi pa'i don mi tshang yang / spyir bskyed chog bsdus pa dang dbu ma'i don tshang na gtso bo'i don sgrub pa la mi bslu bas/ bskyed rim gyis dgos pa grub par shes par bya'o/ /de dag gis ni sgrub thabs kyi phyogs la thun mong min pa'i khyad par rnams bstan zin to/ /da ni dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rim spyi la go ba chags pa sngon du song na/ skabs 'dir 'di la cung zad dpyad par bya ste/ sdom chen gyi sgrub thabs gsal byed grags chen po/ glo bo 'bris lo tsā ba dpal ldan byang chub kyi yi ge de/ pa khya chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa'i man ngag yin yang zer te/ rtsa 'khor lo drug gi lte bar rgyal ba rigs drug dang / rtsa 'khor drug la 'khor lo drug gi dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams dang / bu ga re la dur khrod kyi lha mo gnyis gnyis te bcu drug bkod/ nus ma dang thod pa yang gsang ba'i snyen ra lor bkod pa'i lus dkyil zhig byas sde la gzhan gyis rgol du dogs nas rig bzo med rgya dpe bzhin yin zer ro/ /spyir sdom chen 'di bde mchog mngon brjod 'bum pa nas gsungs pa yin pas/ lus dkyil 'gyung du rung ba'i rigs su 'dug kyang da lta yod pa'i rgyud dang sems 'grel las lus dkyil gsal bar ma gsungs shing / man ngag gi rgya gzhung tshad ldan yang mi 'dug pa dang / gal te lus dkyil zhig 'byung na rtsa 'khor lo drug la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo drug bkod pa'i sbom yor de tsam ma yin par yul chen zhe brgyad dag pa'i sku'i cha so sor lha zhe brgyad bekod pa cig yong thang ba la/ de ltar mi snang ba dang / rang lugs kyi bla ma gong ma tshad ldan rnams kyang / lus dkyil gyi spros pa mi mdzad pas/ re zhig de ni btang snyoms su bzhag go /'bris lo nas brgyud pa de ka'i —368—

dbang du byas nas/ gu ge grags rgyal gyis sdom chen gyi sgrub thabs brtsams pa na/ dpa' bo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad chad/ 'khor lo drug gi rnal 'byor ma zhe brgyad la/ zhal gnyis phyag bzhi byas pa sogs shin tu nor ba che/ de ni 'bris los mkha' 'gro bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad ces bshad pa de mkha' 'gro ma kho nar 'khrul/yab kyi zhal phyag ston byed rnams lha mo'i yin par nor ba'i rtsing chos so/ /'khor lo re la sa bon brgyad brgyad las med pas/ lha bcu drug mi dgos so snyam pa cig go ba 'dra ste/ sa bon re re las yab yum kha sbyor re skyed dgos pa ma shes par zad do/ /lar 'bris lo'i yi ge na/ phyi dkyil rang la'ang ma dag pa cung zad yod do/ /lugs de la brgyud pa ni/ dpe med mtsho/ gnyis med dpal 'dzin/ chos kyi 'byung gnas/ bi kyā ta/ kha che paṇa chen/ bhū mi shrī/ sha shwa ta pa/ a pa ra karmi ta/ 'bris lo zer ba yod cing / de rjes chos 'dzin pa/ngag dbang pa/ byang seng pa/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen sogs nas brgyud pa yod zer/ rje grol mchog gis kyang gsan 'dug a brka rmi zhes pa a bha ya ka rar byas ni shin tu 'khrul lo/ /de bas khungs che ba/ yar klungs lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'ang yod de/ dus zhabs che chung / nā len dra pa/ so ri pa/'jigs med 'byung gnas/ byā ya ka pa/ da sha ba la bi khyu ta de ba/ shākya shrī/bim la shrī/ shung ke lo tsā ba/ zhes pa yod cing / de nas ci rigs par gyes mod kyi/ lo mchog pa/ bag ston pa/ thog ston shes rab rdo rje/ 'u yug pa sangs rgyas bzang po/ gnyal pa bde legs dpal/ kyegs gnas rnying ba rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bla chen grags rin pa/ nam mkha' tshul khrims pa/ smrar ston rgyal —369—

'od/ gong ma tshes lnga pa'i bar du brgyud cing / de las brgyud pa'ang rung ba'i skabs yod par snang mod/ rang lugs ni yan lag brgyad ldan gyi mtsho 'gram du ba tshwa'i khron pa gang la rko ste/ byin rlabs zla bral tshig don gnyis ka'i brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen po nyid dang 'dra ba la sdo// 'jam dbyangs chos dbang las brgyud pa nyid yin no/ /yang sdom chen la shin tu rtsal 'don mdzad pa/ chos rgyal rnam rgyal grags bzang gis rje phyogs pa'i dngos slob rgyal ba jo bzang pa la gsan pa nyid gtso bor mdzad la/ yang byang sems rgyal yes/ rje 'phags 'od/ rje bu ston/ mkhan chen dharma shrī nas brgyud nas/ chos rje yon tan 'byung gnas pa la'ang gsan nas cher spel/ de nas shangs ston kun dpal ba nam mkha' dpal bzang ba brgyud/ shes rab bkra shis pa la rje grol mchog gis gsan/ de ltar brgyud pa sna tshogs 'dug mod kyang / 'bris blo nas brgyud zer ba de/ dbang gi rgyun rang ni yod pa'i rigs su 'dug na'ang / lag len dbang bskur yang / dus 'khor rang lugs kyang ma yin/ 'phreng ba'i lugs lta bu zangs mar sbyar ba yang ma yin pa'i 'dra min cig las med/ brgyud pa gzhan rnams dus 'khor rang lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa yin/ lar dus 'khor 'gyur byed lo tsā ba so so rnams las/ 'bro lo dang / yar klung lo tsā ba gnyis la dkyil 'khor 'di'i dbang rgyun byung / gzhan snga rabs pa mang po zhig la/ dus der yod pa'ang srid mod/ rgyun dang yig ri rigs med la/ rwa lugs/ rtsa mi lugs/ chag lugs sogs la ni/ spyir dus 'khor gyi dbang rgyun man ngag 'phrin las cher byung yang / dkyil 'khor 'di'i —370—

sgos kyi dbang rgyun med do/ dpyad pa gcig go /sdom chen gyi gtso bo 'di/ dus 'khor rdo rje 'jigs byed ces bya ba de kho na yin la/ he ru ka'i nang nas rdor sems he ru ka yin/ dpal rdo rje shugs ni mi bskyod pa he ru ka ste/ spyir he ru ka la nang sel rigs drug yod kyang / he ru kar 'jog byed kyi sgo nas/ mi bskyod pa'i he ru ka nyid he ru ka dngos gzhir—byed pas/ dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs he ru ka /zhes rdo rje shugs rang la he ru kar gsungs pa yin no/ /dpyad kla gnyis so/ /sdom chen gyi sku'i rnam pa la/ 'ga' zhig dbu skra dmar ser gyen brdzes su bzhed de/ rdo rje shugs dang mtshungs pa'i legs cha tsam yod kyang / 'di gshegs khro sems/ dpa' gsum gyi nang nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kho na yin pas/ rgyud 'di'i dkyil 'khor gyi gshegs pa la/ ral pa'i thor tshugs nyid dgos par mngon/ rang lugs kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyang thor tshugs nyid bzhed cing / kun mkhyen chen po'i thugs dam bris sku la/ dbu skra thor tshugs kyi kha dog dmar ser du yod do/ /spyir khro bo rnams kyi dbu skra'i kha dog gi skabs/ser skya ser po dmar ser khams ser rnams dgos don gcig go /de'i phyir smin ma dang ag tshom dmar ser cung zad byed pa sogs kyang dgos la/ sku sbom thung sogs ni mi bya ste/ dus 'khor sna tshogs gtso bo dang 'dra'o/ /dpyad pa gsum pa'o/ /zhal so so la nyams tha dad byed pa'ang mi 'thad de/ dpyad pa bzhi pa'o//yum gyi sku mdog skabs/ 'jigs dus rtse mo can mtshungs mkha' 'gro —371—

ma la'o dag byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i don la kha cig bskal me'i tha ma de nam mkha'i khams yin pas ljang khur yod dgos/ des na yum ljang khu'o zhes 'chad pa ni/ sdom pa chung ja'i yum ljang khur bshad pa dang mtshungs pas legs pa ltar snang ba zhig byung yang / 'jigs dus kyi me mkha' khams kho na yin pa'i rgyu mtshan med cing / mkha' khams kyi me ljang khu'i rgyu mtshan med la yum ljang khur 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gzhan yang med do/ /gal te snga ma 'thad na 'jigs dus kyi sprin yang ljang khur 'gyur bas/ dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs par gsungs pa thams cad ljang khur thal lo/ /yang kha cig lung de la brten rjos sku mdog dmar mor mdzad de/ 'di dag 'jig rten grags pa'i tshad mas sgrub ste/ tshig de'i don yum kyi sku mdog la sbyor na lung don de 'grig la/ bde mchog bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpas mdzad pa las kyang yum dmar mo 'dam kha la rung bar gsungs pa dang mthun zhing / nag po thabs kyi gsung la/ dmar mo shes rab kyi gsung gis rgyas 'debs pa'i dag sbyor yang yod mod kyi/ 'dir yum la 'chad srid na ni/ sku mdog la mi sbyor te/ dper na rdo rje phag mo sku mdog nag ser dkar mo sogs la'ang / bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba zhes 'byung ba dang 'dra ste/ gzi brjid drag shul che ba'i dpe'o/ /de ltar na yang 'gyur rnying 'ga' zhig las dus mtha'i sprin mtshungs zhes pa yod pa dang / phyis kyi rgya dpe ma dag ces grags pas 'di gtso bo'i sku mdog ston byed du 'go pa ngos bde'o/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug khyab byed kyi lha la/ khyab bya khams drug phan tshun gyi lha sbyor tshul de rtsi mi dgos pas/ 'dir —372—

yang sna tshogs gtso bo bzhin du/ yab sku mdog sngon po dang / yum ser mo ste/'di dang dus 'khor phyag nyer drug pa la dbye ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /dpyad pa lnga pa'o/ /'khor lo drug po la/ 'ga' zhig phyi rol kyi mu khyud byed pa na mi 'thad de/ rgyud 'grel las ma gsungs shing / thig gi skabs su 'khor lo re re cha chung drug par yin pa las/ gnyis re lte ba dang bzhi re rtsibs su gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /lte ba la phyag mtshan gyi 'phreng ba yod pas na/ mu khyud yod na de la yang dgos pa las/ de 'dra ma bshad pas so/ /dpyad pa drug pa'o/ /yang kha cig dur khrod bcu drug ces pa/ sgo brgyad dang stegs bu brgyad po rnams nyid yin par 'dod pa ni me rlung gi khor yug la dur khrod yod par dus 'khor chen po'i dkyil 'khor las gsung pa dang 'gal zhing / sgo khang dang stegs bu de dag la dur khrod kyi rtags mtshan/ mi ro dang / keng rus la sogs pa 'god na ni/ sngon med pa'i gtam yin zhing / 'god du mi rung na ni dur khrod zer ba'ang bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /des na shar sgo'i dur khrod ces sogs gsungs pa ni/ shar sgo'i thad kyi khor yug yin pa sogs la dgongs pa yin la/rtsa thig gi phyi rol phan chad dur khrod kyi bdag mo mkha' 'gro rnams rgyu zhing spyod pa'i gnas yin zhing / de rnams kyi bzhugs gnas sgo mtshams su byed pa yin te/ de rang la ltos pa'i yang gtso bo dang nye ba'i phyir/ gnas kyi mchog yin pa dang / sgo mtshams rnams stong par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /yang gzhal med khang rtseg pa sgo dang bcas pa mi sgom na ni/ 'khyams dang 'byung bzhi'i khor yug kyang —373—

med pas/ nam mkha'i 'khor lo'i phyi rol tu rdo rje'i sa gzhi la dur khrod rnams 'byung ste/ de'i tshe mkha' 'gro bcu drug rnams kyang dur khrod nyid na gnas so/ /gzhal yas khang sgo can yod med la dur khrod dang dur khrod kyi bdag mo 'god tshul mi 'dra ba 'di ni/ dus 'khor gyi sdom pa che chung dang / rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs khyabs 'jug sbas pas mdzad pa dang / phyag rdor stod 'grel gyi dkyil 'khor te gsum ka la'ang 'dra'o/ /bde mchog bsdus pa'i skabs sems 'grel las/ khwa gdong ma shar phyogs kyi dur khrod chen por kun du spyod/ ces sogs gsungs pa la/ dus khrod kyi sa mtshams ci ltar yin/ phyis kyi dus 'khor ba kha bo can rnams la dris na/ oṃ tig pa yod yod mi 'dra'o/ /dpyad pa bdun pa'o//yang 'khor lo drug po re re bzhin/ rang rang gi sum cha lte bar 'dod pa ni/ 'khor lo nang ma kho na dang / 'khor lo rim pa gcig pa 'ga' re la/ de ltar gsungs pa'i rigs 'gre kha thal ba ste/ 'khor lo rim pa mang tsho rnam gzhag la blo kha ye ma phyogs pa'o/ /gal te de ltar byed na/ 'khor lo phyi ma rnams la de dang der bzhugs pa'i lha rnams rang gi gnas dang mtshams par bsgom na ni/ gtso bo sku tshad shin tu chung zhing / 'khor lo phyi ma rnams kyi lha rim pas je che je cher song bas shin tu mi rigs shing bkra mi shes par 'gyur la/yang gtso bo las dpags te 'khor rnams chung bar byed na ni/ 'khor lo phyi ma rnams kyi rtsibs la lha rnams bkod pa na yang / 'khyams stong pa chen po rer mi re bsdad pa ltar shin tu mi mdzes par 'gyur ro/ /des na gtso bo'i gnas dang /pad+ma'i 'dab ma dang / 'khor lo so so'i rtsibs kyi rgya rnams mnyam par byed pa —374—

nyid gtso che'o/ /dpyad pa brgyad pa'o/ /yang 'di yod de 'di'i sgrub thabs cho ga rgyas pa la/ rgyal mchog gnyis kar du/ phyag rgya rgyan bkod byed/ de'i nang gi yang / las rgyal la dam tshig pa bskyed pa'i skabs sam/ rgyas btab kyi rjes su byas kyang rung ba man ngag yin zhing / 'bring po la las rgyal gyi skabs su mi dgos pa dang / bsdus pa la ni phyag rgya rgyan bkod med kyang chog go /zhes pa rang lugs blo la bzhag dgos shing / rdo rje shugs la phyag rgya rgyan bkod mi rung ba'i sgrub byed du/ rdor shugs 'jigs byed tha dad yin zhing / rgyan bkod 'jigs byed kho na la yin/ der ma zad mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog pa sogs gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'i skabs su bshad kyi/ srung 'khor gyi skabs su ma yin zhes grub mtha' 'cha' ba rnams kyis sdom chen la rgyal mchog gnyis gyis skabs su/ rgyan bkod byas na dgag pa de rang la bzlog par 'gyur te/ de ni mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog dgos pa'i don gyis rdo rje 'jigs byed la yin gyi/ sdom chen gyi bskyed rim la ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /de'i phyir phyogs pa'i sgrub thabs na yang med do/ /bdag po rnam grags ni khas blangs snga ma de bzhed bzhin du/ sdom chen gyi dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi gtso bo la rgyan bkod mdzad pas nang 'gal gyi skyon de yang 'jug la/ kun mkhyen chen po'i sna tshogs gtso bo'i dkyil ge bor rgyal mchog la/ phyag rgya rgyan bkod byar rung par gsungs pa la mi 'thad de/dus 'khor ni phyag mtshan dang dus gcig bsgom dgos pas phyis de dag 'god pa mi 'thad cing / sgrub thabs dngos gzhi'i skabs 'di dag tu bshad pa med —37do

pa'i phyir/ zhes 'gog bzhin du/ sdom chen gyi rgyal mchog dang po la de ltar mdzad pa ni/ rgyan dgod kyi don ma dgongs shing / ha cang brjed ngas ches pa dang / rnal du mi gnas pa'i gtam ste/ sdom chen la yang rgyu mtshan de'i phyir phyag rgya rgyan bkod mi 'thad par thal bas so/ /spyir rgyan bkod kyi don sngar gang yang med pa la/ rgyan dang phyag mtshan gsar pa g.yog pa'i don ma yin gyi/ sngar bskyed zin pa rnams sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i don no/ /des na gnod byed de mi 'jug cing / bdud bgegs tshar gcod pa'i don yin pas/spyir sna tshogs gtso bo dang rdo rje 'jigs byed gnyis kar la rung zhing / phyag nyer drug pa la lhag par yang gal che ba yin no/ /de'i phyir rdo rje shugs la yang rgyan bkod nges par 'thad de/ bdud tshar gcod pa'i dgos pa'i don la mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na go bgos shing mtshon cha bstar ba'i las de/g.yul du 'jug pa thams cad la dgos kyi/ dum bu g.yul du 'jug pa la ni dgos/ skyong ba la mi dgos pa'i khyad par med pa bzhin du/ phyag rgya rgyan bkod de yang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis bdud 'jom pa la dgos/ rdor shugs kyis bdud 'jom pa la mi dgos pa'i khyad par mi 'thad do/ /des na rnam rtog cig gis cig shos bcom pa'i tho cho'i rjes su mi 'jug par shing rta chen po'i gzhung rgyo rnga pa nyid legs so / /dpyad pa dgu pa'o/ /sgrub thabs 'di'i dag bya dag byed mdo tsam ni/ mngon rtogs kyi dkyus la 'don pa de dag yin la/ rnam pa'i dag sbyor rgyas pa ni rgyud 'grel nyid las shes par bya'o/ /dag bya dag byed kyi gtso bo dag rdzogs smin gsum sbyor tshul —376—

ni/ phal cher dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgrub thabs dang gcig pa nyid de/ phal cher ni cho ga lnga gcig pa kho na yin la/ dkyil 'khor spro ba'i skabs su/ mngal gyi zla ba bcu ma rig pa la sogs pa snga phyi'i rim pa ma 'khrugs par 'di la sbyor du mi rung bas/ spyir 'khor lo drug gi khyim bcu gnyis dang dus sbyor bcu gnyis sbyor ba tsam yin gyi zla ba'am go rim sgrig mi dgos la/ dus 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po la/ las rgyal gyi skabs su lha tshogs spro ba'i rim pa snga phyi thams cad bsdoms nas khams lnga'i lha tshogs spro ba'i rnam gzhag byed pa bzhin du/ 'dir rgyal mchog gnyis kar du byed de/mngal du khams lngas bsdus pa'i lus ngag sems gsum 'phel ba rnams sbyong byed dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi lha tshogs spro ba dang / mngal nas btsas ma thag pa'i dkyil 'khor lnga'i rlung rgyu ba rnams sbyong byed las rgyal mchog gi spro ba rnam pa lnga'o/ /dus 'khor rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor la yang / khams lnga'i lha tshogs spro tshul 'dres mar yod kyi/ khams so so'i sde tshan med pa bzhin du/ 'dir yang yin mod/ de la ye shes nam mkha'i khams gcig tu brtsi ba'am/ ye shes kun khyab tu byed pa gnyis ka mi 'gal yang / rnam gzhag snga ma ltar gtso che bas nus ma dang / dur khrod kyi lha mo rnams nam mkha'i sde tshan yin/ lhag ma 'khor lo bzhi po la 'byung chen gyi dbang du byas na/ 'khor lo bzhi 'byung ba bzhi dang sbyor/'byung phran gyi dbang du byas na/ shar dang me'i lha rnams rlung sogs phyogs kyi rim pa 'byung ba bzhi dang sbyor ba yin/ mkha' ye'i 'khor lo gnyis ni bzhugs gnas kyi dbye bas/ mkha' ye'i sde tshan du'ang bsdu/ sku mdog gi dbye bas —377—

'byung bzhi'i sde tshan du'ang bsdu bas phyogs gnyis kar bstan pa'o/ /nus ma rnams ni sku mdog so sor yod kyang / rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs yin pas ye shes su'ang 'gyur mod/ skabs 'gar nam mkhar yang byed pas der yang 'gyur mod/ gtso bo dang lhan cig skyed pa'i phyir/ spro ba rnam pa lnga'i lha la mi the'o/ /dpyad pa bcu pa'o/ /'dir cho ga rgyas pa'i skabs/ zhu ba glus bskul la/ spyan ma dag ni 'gro ba'i yum sogs byed pa nyid bzang / bsdus rgyud kyi tshig kho nas kyang / cho ga 'bring po man chad la legs mod kyi/ kha cig mno' na/ sdom chen gyi dkyil 'khore gyi lha la spyan ma sogs yum lnga dngos su med pas/ spyan ma bdag ni 'gro ba'i yum/ /zhes sogs zer du mi rung snyam pa yin na ni/ thum go (〈lbo〉 rmu mgo ) ba ste zhu ba glus bskul gyi lha mo bzhi ni/ skad cig gis sam thig le las sprul pa yin gyi dkyil 'khor la bkod pa de ye ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dpyad pa bcu gcig pa'o/ /'dir mkhas pa 'ga' zhig dus kyi 'khor lo zhes rgyud dang sems 'grel gyi tshig las 'byung ba rnams/ sdom pa chen po zhes sam/ rdo rje 'jigs byed ces par 'don pa bsgyur ba ni mi dgos te/ spyir yang rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang phyug dang / /he ru ka dang dus 'khor lo/ /zhes don gcig par gsungs pas so/ /zhes zer ba ltar yang 'thad la/ der ma zad kun rdzob lha so so'i dbye ba byed na/ sdom tshen gyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo ni/ dus 'khor kho na yin gyi/'khor lo bde mchog ma yin pas/ dus kyi 'khor lo zhes byas na/ sdom chen ma —378—

yin pa song dogs pa ga la dgos/ de bas na 'di ni/ lha dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor/ rgyud 'khor lo sdom pa chen po las gsungs pa zhig yin pas/sdom chen zhes bya yi/ dus 'khor ma yin par bde mchog gam sdom chen zer ba'i lha logs pa cig tu go bar mi bya'o/ /der go na jo bo dza ma li dang / sgam po gnas nang ba'i mgon po'i rten bshad bzhin du bzhad gad kyi gnas su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /dpyad pa bcu gnyis pa'o/ /de ltar na sgrub thabs dang rjes su 'brel bar dogs gcod nyer mkho than thun bshad zin to// //da ni dus kyi 'khor lo rtsa ba'i dkyil lubor gyi dkyil chog la 'don pa spo ba'i tshul cung zad brjod na/ nyi ma dang po la yo byad tshogs par byas nas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas dang mchod pa byin rlabs zhu 'bul rnams byas nas/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar gong du bshad pa'i sdom chen gyi mngon rtogs bzhin bya/ de nas oX sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti zhes sogs nga rgyal bzung ba dang / yul bdag grong bdag gi gtor ma btang ste sa bslang ba/bdud tshogs bsreg pa dang / sa'i lha mo la gnang ba zhu ba dang / sa gzhi bya bas sbyang ba/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa huX huX phaṭa yan chad/ dkyil chog ye shes rgya mtsho la 'jug pa bzhin du bya'o/ /de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ rgyas pa srung ma drug cu bsgom pa byas kya ngu legs mod kyi/dkyil 'khor dngos gzhi'i cho ga dang rgyas bsdus 'grig pa'i phyir/ thugs dkyil sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar/ rdor shugs khro bcu dang bcas pa tsam bsgoms na legs pas/ haX las byung ba'i nam mkha'i rang bzhin nas/ tsakra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ de nas phur gdab ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas/gzhom pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol gyi bar/ dkyil chog ma mo dang —379—

'dra de nas yo ā hu lan bcu gnyis kyis mchod pa byin rlabs pa nas bzung / sa'i lha mo sa la bstim pa dang / gtor 'bul dang / smon lam bkra shis sogs kyang dkyil chog bzhin bya ste/ nyi ma dang tsho bya ba'o/ /de nas nangs par sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin rlabs/ sdom chen nyid kyi sgrub thabs ltar bdag bskyed rnams byas nas/ mdun bskyed tso( ā hu hra phaṭa kyis bsangs/ tsho rdo pa bu dang bcas pa'i steng du nas/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo he ru ka 'khor lo drug gi sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyogs kun tu nas/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo yab yum nus ma bcu/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma mnyam par sbyor ba bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/dur khrod skyong ba'i rnal 'byor ma bcu drug gzungs ma bcu gnyis/ gtum mos 'byud pa'i klu brgyad/ rlud gi dkyil 'khe(ra la gnas pa'i 'byung po bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi dang bcas pa rnams skad cig gis grub par gyur pa ni/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i bdag /ces pa nas/ srid gsum dang ba mngon du byed gyur cig /ces pa'i bar/ dpal sdom pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi bstod pa rdzogs par 'don/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam zhes pa nas/ slob dpon chos seng mkhas grub sangs ye dang / /byams pa'i mtshan dang khro ༵khro/ dhī /hūṃ/ dhī dhī / rdo ༷ smo | rde/ two / snye snye rdo bān / ༷ lju —380—

oṃ slo spyi spru snyi dz+dza j-i shi shwe haX ha na maX oṃ ha hā k+ṣa klu nga ngu rko kre na nā ma mā ṇa ṇa nya nywa huX huX phre phre phaṭa phaṭa na maX hi hi hri hṝ hu hu gla hṝ haX ha na maX h+pha khyu hra hā 4sgo / gli sbyo / /sgre rdzu ni 3kuX khye/ /smi :sa zu/ 3kuX ṇ+ḍi'aspyo na maX oX gu ru bud+dhā bo dhi sa te sbyo na mo na maX zhes pa nas/ bstod pa dang snyan sna mnan pa dang / rjes chog kyang dkyil chog bzhin no/ /de nas bum pa lhag gnas sogs rdzas lnga sta gon dang / slob ma lhag gnas dang / mal stan lhag gnas kyi bar du yang khyad par med de/ nub gnyis pa'i bya ba'o/ /nyi ma gsum pa dang bzhi pa lnga pa'i bya ba yang phal cher 'dra'o/ /'on kyang thig gdab pa dang tshon gyi dbye ba ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /'di dkyil 'khor cung zad rgya chung bas/ bcu gnyis pa la thig gdab 'dod pa ma nu'i nyin theg dag la dpal ldan rdul tshon dbye ba nyid/ /ces pa de dgos sam mi dgos snyam na/ thob thang la bshad tshod bzhin dgos te/ dus de dag la bya ba de rnams 'os shing shis pa'i dbang du mdzad pa yin gyi/ las tshar mi tshar kho na'i dbang du mdzad pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag gi bar du gzhan bzlas brjod dang mchod pa la sogs pa'i dus 'da' ba yin no/ /deng sang de lta bu mi byed pa ni/ chog gra ba rnams kyi brel ba gtso bor byed pa'i skabs yin pas/ 'di la ni chos kyi gleng brjod byed sa med do/ /de'i phyir cho ga yang gzugs brnyan tsam mo/ /de nas dngos gzhi'i nyi ma la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsams te/ dkyil 'khor lus la bsdu ba'i bar sngar dang 'dra ba las/ bdag bskyed kyi mngon rtogs brjes pa tsam mo/ /mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor glu rna āXhūX hraXphaṭa kyis bsangs/ spyo bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang —381—

las rdo rje'i rang bzhin rtsibs bcu pa zlum po'i dbus su zhes pa nas/ nam mkha'i 'khor ra lo zhes bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar thugs dkyil dang / sdom chen gyi sgrub thabs sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ gtso bo'i mtshan ma hu dang rlu las lhar gyur pa ni/ hu las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang / de las byung ba'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo mkha' 'gro ma'i dra ba sdom pa chen po/ zhes pa nas/ de dag ni bde ba chen po'i 'khordo ra 'o ca(/ /zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin no/ /lha'i gnas gzhan rnams su/ shi smi/ zhes pa nas/ k+ṣa k+ṣa rnams dang / phyag mtshan rdo rje dang gri gug rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs su gyur pa ni/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i shar du/ shi rdo rje ma la/ zhes pa nas/ gzungs ma grangs med pa dang bcas pa'o/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor la nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rab 'byams rgya mtshos bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ de nas bdag nyid kyi thugs kar hu yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa dang / de las byung ba'i rdo rje shugs zhes pa nas/ gtsug tor du ha las thugs rdo rje rnams 'khod par gyur/ de ltar dbang bskur bas dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te rgyas btab par gyur pa ni/rnam par shes pa'i rigs las byung ba'i ljang khu rnams la mi bskyod pa nas/gzhom du med pa'i a yig go /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam zhes pa nas/ mchog gi bha ga khyod la 'dud de khyod la 'dud/ /ces pa'i bar du dkyil chog tu bshad pa dang 'dra ba las/ na ma chen mo sta gon gyi skabs bzhin 'don pa spo/ de nas sdom chen nyid kyi dkyil 'bor gyi bstod pa/ yang 'don par bya/—382—

de man chad gtor ma gtong ba dang / bdag 'jug dang / rjes chog dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i bar du/rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par 'og tu 'chad 'gyur ci rigs tsam ma gtogs/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil chog dang khyad par med do/ /ci ste slob ma dbang bskur ba'i skabs su/ lha ngo ston pa na 'don pa spos la gzhan gsung dbang kho na bzhin du bsgrubs na yang mi legs pa ma yin mod/ stod 'grel lugs kyi bde mchog dang / rigs ldan khyab 'jug sbas pas mdzad pa'i/ sgrub thabs kyi rjes 'brang rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil chog na yang / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor rnams phyag gnyis pa byed pa dang mthun par dbang bskur ba'i lha yang phyag gnyis par mdzad de/ de dang 'di yang rigs mtshungs pas na 'dir yang phyag gnyis pa byas na legs te/ 'di skad ces/yum lngar gyur pa ni/ gtsug tor du mkha' khams rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma ljang khu/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dpral bar rlud khams sgrol ma nag mo ral gri dang phub 'dzin pa/ mgrin par me khams gos dkar mo dmar mo ḍa ma ru dang nor bu 'dzin pa/ snying gar chu khams mā ma gī dkar mo/ tho ba dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lte ba sa khams sangs rgyas spyan ma ser mo/ 'khor lo dang dung 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang thugs kar 'khyud rgya mdzad cing pad ma'i skyil krung gis pad zla la bzhug/sa pa/ zhes bya zhing / cod pan gyi skabs sangs rgyas lnga yang des rigs 'gre ba la/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis pad nyi la bzhugs pa zhes bya/ dar dpyangs kyi skabs/shar ltor rus sbal gyi rlung du ba ma nag mo/ lho nub tu rtsangs pa'i rlung smig sgyu ma dmar mo/ byang shar du lha spyin gyi rlung mkha' snang ma dkar mo/ nub byang du nor lhas rgyal gyi rlung mar me ma ser mo/ steng du srog 'dzin gyi rlung mchog gi cha ma ljang khu/ 'og tu thur sel gyi rlung thig le ma sngon mo rnams cang te'u thod pa kha —383—

ṭā ga rnams 'dzin cing / g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing skra grol ba'o/ /rdor dril gyi skabs su/ yab phyag nyer drug pa dang / yum phyag gnyis ma bskyed/ brtul tsos kyi skabs/ rna ba'i gnas su rna ba'i dbang po phyag na rdo rje ljang khu rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yul sgra sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo/ kun tu bzang po 'dra ba spyo dang /snying gar yid kyi dbang po kun tu bzang po sngon po gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/yul chos chos khams rdo rje ma ljang khu phyag na rdo rje dang 'dra ba/ zhes lhag por brjod cing gzhan rigs lnga yab yum dang 'dra/ yab rnams rdo rje skyil krung gis pad nyi dang yum rnams pad ma'i skyil krung pad zla la bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing / rnam grangs mi 'dra ba la/ mig gnyis su mig gi dbang po sa'i snying po dmar po/ me'i mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhes byas kyang rung / des gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre ste 'dir ma smos/ ming dbang gi skabs/ khro bo gtsug tor can dang khro mo drag can ma gnyis ka ljang khu yin/ des mtshon pa'i lag pa dang / rkang pa'i lha la'ang khro bo yab yum sku mdog mtshungs/ rmugs byed ma dmar mo lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa byas kyang chog smra ba shin tu brtson 'grus ma dang / bshang ba 'dor ba rengs byed mar byas na yang legs so/ /thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen brdzes/ phyag g.yas phyag mtshan 'phyar zhing / g.yon thugs kar gtod pa/ stag lpags dang sprul gyis brgyan cing /g.yas brkyang dang g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis pad nyi la gnas pa'o/ /zhes brjod/ rjes gnang gi skabs kyang / gsang bar ye shes kyi phung po rdo rje sems dpa' dang ye shes kyi khams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par gyur pa ni/ sku mdog sngo sangs gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lhag ma rigs lnga dang 'dra/ spyir 'di dkyil chen rang —384—

yin mod/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor dang bstun na/dkyil 'khor 'di dag cung zad bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor yin pa'i phyir/ cho ga'ang cung zad bsdus pa legs par 'gyur na/ slob ma bdag nyid gtso bo phyag gnyis pa kho nar bskyed/ rdo rje bzhir bskyed pa bor/ rjes gnang gi skabs su phyag mtshan 'khor lo gcig pus chog 'dogs la chos bshad kyi rjes gnang dang sngags dbang tsam byed/ dag pa'i chos bshad la rdor dril spyin pa'i skabs/ rdor sems yab yum du mi bskyed par/ oṃ mahā badz+ra hu/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi a zhes spyin/dbugs dbyung ring po yang mi dgos so/ kha skongs kyi cho ga gzhan yang bzhug tu yod mod kyi/ ha cang bsdus pa yang mi legs pas 'tsham par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyal ba bskyed mdzad rnams kyi nges gsang 'di/ /byis pa'i blo can rnams kyi yul min mod/ /'di tsam rgyud 'grel don du 'gyur snyam nas/ g.yin la phan phyir cung zad bshad pa yin/ /dpal sdom pa chen po'i sgrub thabs dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang bcas pa la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bshad pa 'di ni/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o/ /bdag gis ni 'di'i sgos kyi dkyil chog ma mthong ste/ gsung dbang gi dkyil chog nyid 'di la spyor ba yin/ sgrub thabs la rgya gar ba nā ya ka shis mdzad pa dang / bal po rā ma a tsar yar grags pa/ shrī ta nu bha dras sbyar ba/ yod 'dug ste/ bod du ma 'gyur ba 'dra/mthong ni ma mthong / yar klungs lo tsā ba dpon slob kyi tho chung 'dra yod zer/ phyis gsang bu brag nag pa ngag dbang grags pas kyang sgrub dkyil gnyis ka yod zer/ kun mkhyen chen po las brgyud pa rje phyogs pas sgrub thabs che chung gnyis mdzad/ bu ston chen po'i dngos slob stag tshang ba rin chen dbang phyug gis sgrub thabs dang bstod pa mdzad/ zhe slob yon tan 'byung gnas pa'i sgrub thabs kyang yod/ gzhan yang rje shes rin pas byas pa dang / mkhas pa dbang phyug grags dang glo ston lo tswa'i rjes su 'brang zer ba/ mkhan chen kun rgyal ba'i byas pa dang / bdag chen rnam rgyal —385—

kyi tho dang / lus dkyil gyi tho sogs yig sna thor bu 'ga' dang / de'i rjes 'brang du rlom pa gu ge grags rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs dang 'phreng ba dang 'dra min gyi dbang gi tho yig sogs kyang mthong mod/gtso bo dkyil 'khor 'di ston byed kyi rgyud 'grel nyid dang / mkhas pa rnams kyis byas pa'i 'grel bshad du ma bklags cung zad nges pa rnyed de bkod pa yin no// //bkra shis/ zhus dag

dkyil 'khor la bstod pa bzhugs/oṃ na maXshwe kā la tsa grwa ya/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i bdag /srid gsum skye 'jigs med pa'i dngos/ khres dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das/ /pra phab pa yi rang bzhin can/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan ma/ /phyag rgya chen mo de la 'dud/ rlud me chu dang sa yi dkyil 'khor lhun po pad+ma dang / /zla nyi dus me'i steng du dbang phyug dang ni bdud kyi mgor/ /zhabs ni srid pa'i yum gyi zhabs dang lhan cig bkod gyur pa/ /lha yi dbang pos btud pa'i gtso la spyi bo'i phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla ba'i sku dang zung gi zhabs te me yi mgrin pa chu gter dpal ldan zhal ni sna tshogs mdog /phrag pa drug dang nyi ma'i dpung pa gnyis lhag rgyal ba'i phyag dang stong pa dgu dang me yi tshigs/ /zhabs dag gis ni zla ba nyi ma sreg za'i dkyil 'khor dag la bdud dang drag po skrag bzhin pa/ /rol pa'i mnan pa'i srid med srid pa mnyam pa dus kyi 'khor lo gcig pu de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku mdog mkha' 'dra zhabs g.yas dmar pos 'dod lha dmar po gdong gcig pa/ /lag pa bzhi yis mda' lnga gzhu dang lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin pa mnan/ /g.yon pa dkar pos drag po dkar po gdong gcig mig gsum rig byed lag /rtse gsum thod pa ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭāX 'dzin pa brdzis la 'dud/ /g.yas brkyang stabs —387—

gzhugs bdud dang nyon mongs chung ma gnyis kyang ma bzod par/ /dman pa'i gdong gis 'dzin par byed kyang g.yo med gnas pa rdo rje'i sku/ /gtsug gi nor bu sna tshogs rdo rje zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan/ /thod skam 'phreng dang thal ba phyag rgya klu rgyal bcu yis brgyan la 'dud/ /dbus dang g.yas g.yon mgrin pa'i mdog ni mu men byu ru kun+da mtshungs/ /mdun zhal dbang sngon 'bar ba'i 'od dang g.yas ni nyi ma 'char ka mtshungs/ /g.yon zhal zla 'od rgyab ni gser mtshungs spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs la 'dud/ /g.yas g.yon phrag pa dang po mthon mthing gnyis pa gsum pa dmar dang dkar/ /phrag pa re la dpung pa gnyis gnyis de dag so sor phyag gnyis ldan/ /dpung pa phyag dang bcas pa rnams kyang gang las byung ba phrag pa'i mdog /phyag rnams re re so mo lnga lnga sor gdub ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthe bo'i mdog ni mchog gi gser mtshungs mdzub mo dung dang kun+da'i mdog /gung mo pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ming med gnag cing mthe chung ljang / /sor mo re re'ang tshigs gsum dang ldan rtsa ba'i phyogs nas go rim bzhin/ /dus mthu'i sprin dang nyin mor byed 'dra zla ba'i mdog dang ldan la 'dud/ /rdo rje ral gri rtse gsum gri gug mda' dang lcags kyu ḍa ma sa /tho ba 'khor lo mdung dbyug dgra stas g.yas kyi phyag brgyan g.yon pa yang /dril bu phub dang kha ṭāX thod pa gzhu dang zhags pa rin po che/ /pad dkar dung dang me long lcags sgrog tshangs mgos brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhag ma'i phyag gnyis sdigs mdzub tshul gyis gti mug glang chen pags rlon brgyangs/ /g.yas nag g.yon ser 'chi bdag mgo dang lha min khrag gang thod pa 'dzin/ /stag —388—

lpags dang ni rdo rje rgyan ldan bdud rigs brgya yi mgo 'phreng 'chang / /sma ra smin ma dbu skra ser zhing ral pa'i cod pan ldan la 'dud/ /'od gsal stong nyid sna tshogs yum nyid rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dpal sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser gyi ri mtshungs bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /gri gug dang bcas phyag g.yas sdigs mdzub g.yon pa thod khrag 'dzin zhing 'khyud/ /skra grol skam rlon mgo bo'i 'phreng ldan phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan la 'dud/ /sku mdog mthing ga mi 'gyur bde ba che/ /dus sbyor bzhi tshan gsum dang gnyis tshan drug /bcu gnyis zla ba dag pa'i mgrin pa dpung / /zhal bzhi 'gyur med thig le bzhi la 'dud/ /nyer drug phyag ni bshol los zla ba'i phyogs/ /de nyid byed por bcas pa'i phyag mtshan te/ /pha rol phyin bcu dag pa'i phyag rgya bcu/ /nyon mongs bdud spangs phyogs gnyis zhabs la 'dud/ /nyi ma'i khyim gcig sku dang zla khyim gcig /zhal ras stong nyid rnam thar spyan gsum ldan/ /mtshan bral smon med phyag dang 'du mi byed//rnam par thar pa'i phyag mtshan 'dzin la 'dud//bcu drug dga' ba sgrib bral chu skyes 'dab/ /phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi 'dab mar nus ma brgyad/ /thabs dang shes rab cang te'u kha ṭāX 'dzin/ /bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs g.yas brkyang stabs/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i rang bzhin rnams la 'dud/ /bar gyi 'dab ma brgyad la thabs kyi dngos/ /kun da ltar dkar thos pa bdud rtsis gang / /dngos grub bzhir 'gyur lha tshogs mnyes byed rdzas/ /dga' chen mchod pa'i gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de ltar 'khor lo'i dbus kyi chu skyes la/ /bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug yab yum ni/ /nus —389—

ma'i tshogs dang mchod yon snod bcas pa'i/ /dkyil ga bor bde wo lubor lo la phyag 'tsha/la/ /lte bar gri gug 'phreng bas mdzes pa yi/ /nam mkha'i gzhi la ye shes snyen ra lo sngo/ /phyogs rnams dus sbyor gzhu dbang rga shi dag /mtshams rnams sdig khyim skye ba 'gags la 'dud/ /ye shes khams la dbang bsgyur rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bor bcas pas sde'i mtshan gyis btags/ /phyogs bral 'og rnams nyi ma'i chos kyis sbyangs/ /steng dang phyogs rnams zla bas dag la 'dud/ shar sogs phyogs dang rlung sogs phyogs bral la/ /ye shes nang tshan rlung me chu sa yi/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams sa chu me rlung gi /rigs kyi yab gyur mkha' 'gros 'byud la 'dud/ /rlung gi gzhi la sa yi 'khor lo ser/ /lte bar 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas mdzes pa yi/ /phyogs rnams dus sbyor srang dang srid pa 'gags/ /mtshams rnams len pa bu mo dag la 'dud/ /sa yi khams la dbang bsgyur rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bor bcas pa ta sde'i dag pa can/ /phyogs bral 'og rnams nyi ma'i chos kyis sbyangs/ /steng dang phyogs rnams zla bas dag la 'dud/ shar sogs phyogs dang rlung sogs phyogs bral la/ /dbang chen nang tshan rlud me chu sa yi/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams sa chu me rludagi /rigs kyi yab gyur mkha' 'gro'i 'phyud la 'dud/ /me dkyil gzhi la chu yi 'khor lo dkar/ /lte bar pad+ma'i 'phreng bas mdzes pa yi/ /phyogs rnams dus sbyor seng ge sred pa dag /mtshams rnams karka tshor ba 'gags la 'dud/ /chu yi khams la dbang bsgyur rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bor bcas pa pa sde'i sa bon skyes/ /phyogs bral 'og rnams nyi ma'i chos kyis sbyangs/ /steng dang phyogs —390—

rnams zla ba'i dag la 'dud/ khar sogs phyogs dang rlung sogs phyogs bral la/ /gsher byed nang tshan rlung me chu sa yi/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams sa chu me rlud gi /rigs kyi yab gyur mkha' 'gros 'khyud la 'dud/ /chu dkyil gzhi la me yi 'khor lo dmar/ /nye bar nor bu'i 'phreng pas mdzes pa yi/ /phyogs rnams dus sbyor 'khrig dang reg pa 'gags/ /mtshams rnams skye mched glang khyim dag la 'dud/ /me yi khams la dbang bsgyur rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bor bcas pa ṭa sde'i rdo rjes mtshan/ /phyogs bral 'og rnams nyi ma'i chos kyis sbyangs/ /steng dang phyogs rnams zla bas dag la 'dud/ shar sogs phyogs dang rlung sogs phyogs bral la/ /'bar byed nang tshan rlung me chu sa yi/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams sa chu me rlung gi /rigs kyi yab gyur mkha' 'gros 'byud la 'dud/ /sa yi gzhi la rlung gi 'khor lo nag /lte bar ral gri'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa yi/ /phyogs rnams dus sbyor lug dang ming gzugs dag /mtshams rnams nya khyim rnam shes 'gags la 'dud/ /rlung gi khams la dbang bsgyur rnal 'byor ma/ /dpa' bor bcas pa tsa sde'i yi ge gzhan/ /phyogs bral 'og rnams nyi ma'i chos kyis sbyangs/ /steng dang phyogs rnams zla bas dag la 'dud/ /shar sogs phyogs dang rlung sogs phyogs bral la/ /g.yo ba'i nang tshan rlung me chu sa yi/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams sa chu me rlud gi /rigs kyi yab gyur mkha' 'gros 'phyud la 'dud/ /ye shes gzhi la nam mkha'i 'khor lo ljang / /lte bar rdo rje'i 'phreng ba'i mdzes pa yi/ phyogs rnams dus sbyor bum pa 'du byed 'gags/ /mtshams rnams chu srin ma rig dag la 'dud/ /nam mkha'i khams la dbang bsgyur rnal 'byor ma//—391—

dpa' bor bcas pa ka sde'i ye shes skyes/ /phyogs bral 'og rnams nyi ma'i chos kyis sbyangs/ /steng dang phyogs rnams zla bas dag la 'dud/ khar sogs phyogs dang rlung sogs phyogs bral la/ /stong pa'i nang tshan rlung me chu sa yi/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams sa chu me rlud gi /rigs kyi yab gyur mkha' 'gros 'khyud la 'dud/ /dus sbyor bcu gnyis thun bzhi rnam dag pa/ /mi bdag dur khrod rnams la dbang bsgyur mkhan/ /rang mdog dang mtshungs 'khor lo'i gdan steng du/ /rnam par rol mdzad gtum mo'i tshogs la 'dud/ /rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor mkha' ye brgyad/ /phyogs dang phyogs bral sgo brgyad rnams su bzhugs//'khor lo bzhi yi steng 'og dang 'brel ba'i/ /phyogs mtshams dur khrod brgyad por spyod la 'dud/ /spyi dang khyad par gnyis ka nam mkha' dang / /ye shes khams kyi rang bzhin lha mo rnams/ /sgo khyud bar gyi phyi rol stegs bur bzhugs/ /bar bar dur khrod brgyad po skyong la 'dud/ /ye shes stong pa'i 'khor lo'i steng 'og dang / /ha k+ṣa thung ring sde pa rnams dag pa/ khyab byed khams gnyis dag pa ba yi dngos/ /dus sbyor bzhi dang thun bzhi 'gags la 'dud/ /'khor lo drug dang sgo mtshams gnas pa yi/ /rnal 'byor ma kun gtso mo dang mtshungs shing / /mi ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang stabs kyis gnas/ khro zhing thung ba'i sku can rnams la 'dud/ /'khor lo drug gi dpa' bo bzhi bcu brgyad/ /zhal gnyis phyag bzhi rdo rje dril bu dang / kha ṭāX ga 'dzin g.yon brkyangs stabs kyis sbyor/ /he ru ka dpal rigs las byung la 'dud/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma char sprin mdog /nor rgyas dung skyong byu dra'i phung po 'dra/ /mtha' —392—
